meaningAr: أداة تنكير (تُستخدم قبل اسم مفرد يبدأ بصوت ساكن) / أداة تنكير (تُستخدم قبل اسم مفرد يبدأ بصوت متحرك، بدل a)
example: I saw a dog in the park.
exampleAr: رأيتُ كلبًا في الحديقة.

meaningAr: يهجر / يترك (شخصًا أو مكانًا) نهائيًا / يتخلى عن (خطة أو فكرة)
definitionEn: to leave somebody, especially somebody you are responsible for, with no intention of returning
example: They had to abandon the sinking ship.
exampleAr: اضطروا إلى ترك السفينة الغارقة.

definitionEn: the fact that somebody/something is able to do something
example: She has the ability to solve complex problems.
exampleAr: لديها القدرة على حل المشكلات المعقدة.

definitionEn: to have the skill, intelligence, opportunity, etc. needed to do something
example: He wasn't able to attend the meeting.
exampleAr: لم يكن قادرًا على حضور الاجتماع.

definitionEn: to officially end a law, a system or an institution
example: The government voted to abolish the tax.
exampleAr: صوّتت الحكومة على إلغاء الضريبة.

definitionEn: the deliberate ending of a pregnancy at an early stage
example: The clinic provides abortion services.
exampleAr: تقدّم العيادة خدمات الإجهاض.

definitionEn: on the subject of somebody/something; in connection with somebody/something
example: This book is about the history of Rome.
exampleAr: هذا الكتاب عن تاريخ روما.

definitionEn: a little more or less than; a little before or after
example: It's about ten o'clock.
exampleAr: الساعة العاشرة تقريبًا.

definitionEn: at or to a higher place or position than something/somebody
example: The plane flew above the clouds.
exampleAr: حلّقت الطائرة فوق الغيوم.

definitionEn: at or to a higher place
example: See the diagram above.
exampleAr: انظر الرسم البياني أعلاه.

definitionEn: in or to a foreign country
example: She studied abroad for a year.
exampleAr: درست في الخارج لمدة عام.

meaningAr: الغياب (عدم الحضور) / عدم وجود / انعدام (in the absence of)
definitionEn: the fact of somebody being away from a place where they are usually expected to be; the occasion or period of time when somebody is away
example: His absence from school worried his parents.
exampleAr: أقلق غيابه عن المدرسة والديه.

definitionEn: not in a place because of illness, etc.
example: Three students were absent today.
exampleAr: كان ثلاثة طلاب غائبين اليوم.

meaningAr: مطلق / تام (كامل) / مطلق (سلطة، لا حدود له)
definitionEn: total and complete
example: The show was an absolute success.
exampleAr: كان العرض نجاحًا تامًا.

definitionEn: used to emphasize that something is completely true
example: I absolutely agree with you.
exampleAr: أوافقك الرأي تمامًا.

meaningAr: يمتص (سائلاً) / يستوعب (معلومات) / يشغل كل الانتباه (be absorbed in)
definitionEn: to take in a liquid, gas or other substance from the surface or space around
example: The towel absorbed the water quickly.
exampleAr: امتصت المنشفة الماء بسرعة.

definitionEn: based on general ideas and not on any particular real person, thing or situation
example: Love is an abstract concept.
exampleAr: الحب مفهوم مجرد.

definitionEn: based on general ideas and not on any particular real person, thing or situation
example: Please submit a 200-word abstract of your paper.
exampleAr: يُرجى تقديم ملخص من 200 كلمة لبحثك.

definitionEn: extremely silly; not logical and sensible
example: It's absurd to expect me to finish this in an hour.
exampleAr: من غير المعقول أن تتوقع مني إنهاء هذا في ساعة.

definitionEn: a large quantity that is more than enough
example: The region has an abundance of natural resources.
exampleAr: تتمتع المنطقة بوفرة من الموارد الطبيعية.

meaningAr: إساءة المعاملة (جسدية أو نفسية) / سوء استخدام (سلطة، مخدرات)
definitionEn: the use of something in a way that is wrong or harmful
example: The report documented cases of child abuse.
exampleAr: وثّق التقرير حالات إساءة معاملة الأطفال.

definitionEn: to make bad use of something, or to use so much of something that it harms your health
example: He was accused of abusing his employees.
exampleAr: اتُّهم بإساءة معاملة موظفيه.

definitionEn: connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities
example: He has an impressive academic record.
exampleAr: لديه سجل أكاديمي مثير للإعجاب.

definitionEn: a person who teaches and/or does research at a university or college
example: The conference was attended by academics from around the world.
exampleAr: حضر المؤتمر أكاديميون من مختلف أنحاء العالم.

definitionEn: a school or college for special training
example: She trained at a prestigious dance academy.
exampleAr: تدربت في أكاديمية رقص مرموقة.

definitionEn: to happen faster or earlier; to make something happen faster or earlier
example: The car accelerated quickly on the highway.
exampleAr: تسارعت السيارة بسرعة على الطريق السريع.

definitionEn: a way of pronouncing the words of a language that shows which country, area or social class a person comes from; how well somebody pronounces a particular language
example: She speaks English with a French accent.
exampleAr: تتحدث الإنجليزية بلكنة فرنسية.

meaningAr: يقبل (عرضًا أو هدية) / يتقبل (حقيقة أو وضعًا)
definitionEn: to take willingly something that is offered; to say ‘yes’ to an offer, invitation, etc.
example: She accepted the job offer.
exampleAr: قبلت عرض العمل.

definitionEn: agreed or approved of by most people in a society
example: This behavior is not acceptable in the workplace.
exampleAr: هذا السلوك غير مقبول في مكان العمل.

meaningAr: قبول (الموافقة على شيء) / تقبّل (فكرة أو وضع)
definitionEn: the act of accepting a gift, an invitation, an offer, etc.
example: The university sent her a letter of acceptance.
exampleAr: أرسلت الجامعة إليها خطاب قبول.

definitionEn: the opportunity or right to use something or to see somebody/something
example: Students need access to a computer for this course.
exampleAr: يحتاج الطلاب إلى إمكانية الوصول إلى حاسوب لهذه الدورة.

definitionEn: to open a computer file or use a computer system
example: You can access your account online.
exampleAr: يمكنك الوصول إلى حسابك عبر الإنترنت.

meaningAr: يمكن الوصول إليه (مكان) / سهل الفهم / متاح
definitionEn: that can be reached, entered, used, seen, etc.
example: The building is accessible to wheelchair users.
exampleAr: يمكن الوصول إلى المبنى لمستخدمي الكراسي المتحركة.

definitionEn: an unpleasant event, especially in a vehicle, that happens unexpectedly and causes injury or damage
example: He was injured in a car accident.
exampleAr: أُصيب في حادث سيارة.

definitionEn: by chance; in a way that was not planned
example: I accidentally deleted the file.
exampleAr: حذفتُ الملف عن طريق الخطأ.

meaningAr: يستوعب (مكانًا لعدد من الأشخاص) / يراعي / يلبي احتياجات
definitionEn: to provide somebody with a room or place to sleep, live or sit
example: The hotel can accommodate up to 300 guests.
exampleAr: يمكن للفندق أن يستوعب حتى 300 ضيف.

definitionEn: a place to live, work or stay in
example: The price includes flights and accommodation.
exampleAr: يشمل السعر الرحلات الجوية والإقامة.

definitionEn: to travel or go somewhere with somebody/something
example: She asked a friend to accompany her to the interview.
exampleAr: طلبت من صديقة أن ترافقها إلى المقابلة.

definitionEn: to succeed in doing or completing something
example: We accomplished all our goals for the year.
exampleAr: حققنا كل أهدافنا لهذا العام.

definitionEn: an impressive thing that is done or achieved after a lot of work
example: Graduating early was a great accomplishment for her.
exampleAr: كان التخرج المبكر إنجازًا عظيمًا بالنسبة لها.

definitionEn: according to a rule or the way that somebody says that something should be done
example: The work was done in accordance with the regulations.
exampleAr: تم تنفيذ العمل وفقًا للوائح.

definitionEn: as stated or reported by somebody/something
example: According to the report, sales rose by 10%.
exampleAr: وفقًا للتقرير، ارتفعت المبيعات بنسبة 10%.

definitionEn: in a way that is appropriate to what has been done or said in a particular situation
example: Prices vary by season, so plan your trip accordingly.
exampleAr: تتفاوت الأسعار حسب الموسم، فخطّط لرحلتك وفقًا لذلك.

meaningAr: حساب (بنكي) / رواية / وصف لحدث / حساب (على منصة إلكترونية)
definitionEn: an arrangement that somebody has with a bank, etc. to keep money there, take some out, etc.
example: I opened a new bank account.
exampleAr: فتحتُ حسابًا مصرفيًا جديدًا.

definitionEn: to have the opinion that somebody/something is a particular thing
example: How do you account for the missing money?
exampleAr: كيف تفسّر اختفاء المال؟

definitionEn: the fact of being responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked
example: There is a lack of accountability in the system.
exampleAr: هناك نقص في المساءلة داخل النظام.

definitionEn: responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked
example: Officials should be held accountable for their decisions.
exampleAr: ينبغي مساءلة المسؤولين عن قراراتهم.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to keep or check financial accounts
example: She works as an accountant for a law firm.
exampleAr: تعمل محاسبة في مكتب محاماة.

definitionEn: to gradually get more and more of something over a period of time
example: Dust had accumulated on the shelves.
exampleAr: تراكم الغبار على الرفوف.

definitionEn: the process of gradually increasing or getting more and more of something over a period of time
example: The accumulation of debt worried the family.
exampleAr: أقلق تراكم الديون العائلة.

definitionEn: the state of being exact or correct; the ability to do something with skill and without making mistakes
example: The device measures temperature with great accuracy.
exampleAr: يقيس الجهاز درجة الحرارة بدقة عالية.

definitionEn: correct and true in every detail
example: The weather forecast was accurate.
exampleAr: كانت توقعات الطقس دقيقة.

definitionEn: in a way that is correct and true in every detail
example: The results were recorded accurately.
exampleAr: سُجّلت النتائج بدقة.

definitionEn: a statement saying that you think a person is guilty of doing something wrong or illegal; the fact of accusing somebody
example: He denied the accusation of theft.
exampleAr: أنكر اتهامه بالسرقة.

definitionEn: to say that somebody has done something wrong or is guilty of something
example: She was accused of lying to the police.
exampleAr: اتُّهمت بالكذب على الشرطة.

definitionEn: a person who is on trial for committing a crime
example: The accused pleaded not guilty.
exampleAr: دفع المتهم بأنه غير مذنب.

definitionEn: to succeed in reaching a particular goal, status or standard, especially by making an effort for a long time
example: She achieved her dream of becoming a doctor.
exampleAr: حققت حلمها في أن تصبح طبيبة.

definitionEn: a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill
example: Winning the award was a major achievement.
exampleAr: كان الفوز بالجائزة إنجازًا كبيرًا.

definitionEn: a chemical, usually a liquid, that contains hydrogen and has a pH of less than seven. The hydrogen can be replaced by a metal to form a salt. Acids usually have a bitter sharp taste and can often burn holes in or damage things they touch.
example: The battery contains sulfuric acid.
exampleAr: تحتوي البطارية على حمض الكبريتيك.

definitionEn: that contains acid or has the essential characteristics of an acid; that has a pH of less than seven
example: Acid rain damages forests and lakes.
exampleAr: يُلحق المطر الحمضي الضرر بالغابات والبحيرات.

definitionEn: to accept that something is true
example: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
exampleAr: اعترف بأنه ارتكب خطأ.

definitionEn: to gain something by your own efforts, ability or behaviour
example: Children acquire language skills quickly.
exampleAr: يكتسب الأطفال المهارات اللغوية بسرعة.

definitionEn: the act of getting something, especially knowledge, a skill, etc.
example: The acquisition of the startup cost millions.
exampleAr: كلّف الاستحواذ على الشركة الناشئة ملايين.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring an area of land; 4 840 square yards or about 4 050 square metres
example: The farm covers over 200 acres.
exampleAr: تمتد المزرعة على مساحة تزيد عن 200 فدان.

meaningAr: عبر (من جانب إلى آخر) / في أنحاء (مكان واسع)
definitionEn: from one side to the other side of something
example: They walked across the bridge.
exampleAr: عبروا الجسر مشيًا.

definitionEn: from one side to the other side
example: The river was too wide to swim across.
exampleAr: كان النهر واسعًا جدًا ليُعبر سباحةً.

meaningAr: يتصرف / يفعل / يمثّل (في مسرحية أو فيلم)
definitionEn: to do something for a particular purpose or in order to deal with a situation
example: The government must act quickly to stop the crisis.
exampleAr: يجب على الحكومة أن تتصرف بسرعة لوقف الأزمة.

definitionEn: a particular thing that somebody does
example: It was an act of kindness.
exampleAr: كان ذلك عملًا لطيفًا.

meaningAr: فعل / إجراء / حركة / أحداث (في فيلم أو قصة)
definitionEn: the process of doing something in order to make something happen or to deal with a situation
example: The government took action to reduce pollution.
exampleAr: اتخذت الحكومة إجراءات للحد من التلوث.

definitionEn: to make something such as a device or chemical process start working
example: Press the button to activate the alarm.
exampleAr: اضغط الزر لتفعيل الإنذار.

definitionEn: the act of making something such as a device or chemical process start working
example: The activation of the new system took a few minutes.
exampleAr: استغرق تفعيل النظام الجديد بضع دقائق.

definitionEn: always busy doing things, especially physical activities
example: She leads an active lifestyle.
exampleAr: تحيا حياة نشطة.

definitionEn: a person who works to achieve political or social change, especially as a member of an organization with particular aims
example: She is a well-known human rights activist.
exampleAr: إنها ناشطة معروفة في مجال حقوق الإنسان.

meaningAr: نشاط (عمل يقوم به المرء) / حركة / نشاط (في مكان)
definitionEn: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure
example: Swimming is my favorite activity.
exampleAr: السباحة هي نشاطي المفضل.

definitionEn: a person who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession
example: He is a famous Hollywood actor.
exampleAr: إنه ممثل هوليودي مشهور.

definitionEn: a woman who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession
example: The actress won an award for her performance.
exampleAr: فازت الممثلة بجائزة عن أدائها.

definitionEn: used to emphasize something that is real or exists in fact
example: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
exampleAr: كانت التكلفة الفعلية أعلى مما توقعنا.

meaningAr: في الواقع / فعليًا / تُستخدم للتصحيح أو المفاجأة
definitionEn: used in speaking to emphasize a fact or a comment, or that something is really true
example: I actually enjoyed the movie.
exampleAr: في الواقع، استمتعتُ بالفيلم.

meaningAr: حاد / شديد (مشكلة، ألم) / حاد (زاوية أقل من 90 درجة)
definitionEn: very serious or severe
example: There is an acute shortage of doctors in rural areas.
exampleAr: هناك نقص حاد في الأطباء في المناطق الريفية.

definitionEn: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service
example: I saw an ad for the new phone on TV.
exampleAr: رأيتُ إعلانًا عن الهاتف الجديد على التلفاز.

definitionEn: to change your behaviour in order to deal more successfully with a new situation
example: Animals adapt to their environment over time.
exampleAr: تتكيّف الحيوانات مع بيئتها بمرور الوقت.

meaningAr: تكيّف / نسخة معدّلة / اقتباس (فيلم عن كتاب)
definitionEn: the action or process of changing something, or of being changed, to suit a new purpose or situation
example: The bird's adaptation to cold climates is remarkable.
exampleAr: تكيّف هذا الطائر مع الأجواء الباردة أمر لافت.

definitionEn: to put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.
example: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
exampleAr: أضِف رشّة من الملح إلى الحساء.

definitionEn: the condition of being unable to stop using or doing something as a habit, especially something harmful
example: He is receiving treatment for drug addiction.
exampleAr: يتلقى علاجًا من إدمان المخدرات.

meaningAr: إضافة / جمع (رياضيات) / بالإضافة إلى (in addition to)
definitionEn: a thing that is added to something else
example: The new employee is a great addition to the team.
exampleAr: الموظف الجديد إضافة رائعة إلى الفريق.

definitionEn: more than was first mentioned or is usual
example: You may need additional documents for the visa.
exampleAr: قد تحتاج إلى مستندات إضافية للتأشيرة.

definitionEn: in a way that is more than was first mentioned or is usual
example: Additionally, the report highlights safety concerns.
exampleAr: بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يسلّط التقرير الضوء على مخاوف تتعلق بالسلامة.

definitionEn: details of where somebody lives or works and where letters, etc. can be sent
example: Please write your home address here.
exampleAr: يُرجى كتابة عنوان منزلك هنا.

definitionEn: to think about a problem or a situation and decide how you are going to deal with it
example: The meeting will address budget concerns.
exampleAr: سيتناول الاجتماع المخاوف المتعلقة بالميزانية.

definitionEn: enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or need
example: The salary is adequate for a single person.
exampleAr: الراتب كافٍ لشخص أعزب.

definitionEn: in a way that is enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or need
example: The team was not adequately prepared for the exam.
exampleAr: لم يكن الفريق مستعدًا بشكل كافٍ للامتحان.

definitionEn: to stick to something
example: All employees must adhere to the safety rules.
exampleAr: يجب على جميع الموظفين الالتزام بقواعد السلامة.

definitionEn: next to something
example: The hotel is adjacent to the airport.
exampleAr: الفندق مجاور للمطار.

definitionEn: to change something slightly to make it more suitable for a new set of conditions or to make it work better
example: You can adjust the volume with this button.
exampleAr: يمكنك ضبط مستوى الصوت بهذا الزر.

definitionEn: a small change made to something in order to correct or improve it
example: The doctor made a small adjustment to her medication.
exampleAr: أجرى الطبيب تعديلًا طفيفًا على دوائها.

definitionEn: to manage and organize the affairs of a company, an organization, a country, etc.
example: The organization administers aid programs in the region.
exampleAr: تدير المنظمة برامج المساعدات في المنطقة.

definitionEn: the activities that are done in order to plan, organize and run a business, school or other institution
example: The cost of administration has increased.
exampleAr: ارتفعت تكلفة الإدارة.

definitionEn: connected with organizing the work of a business or an institution
example: She handles all the administrative tasks in the office.
exampleAr: تتولى جميع المهام الإدارية في المكتب.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to manage and organize the public or business affairs of a company or an institution, or a person who works in an office dealing with records, accounts, etc.
example: He works as a system administrator.
exampleAr: يعمل مسؤول أنظمة.

definitionEn: to respect somebody for what they have done or to respect their qualities
example: I really admire her courage.
exampleAr: أُعجَبُ حقًا بشجاعتها.

meaningAr: قبول (في جامعة أو مكان) / اعتراف / رسم دخول
definitionEn: the act of accepting somebody into an institution, organization, etc.; the right to enter a place or to join an institution or organization
example: The university's admission process is very competitive.
exampleAr: عملية القبول في الجامعة تنافسية للغاية.

definitionEn: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true
example: She admitted that she was wrong.
exampleAr: اعترفت بأنها كانت مخطئة.

definitionEn: a young person who is developing from a child into an adult
example: The clinic specializes in treating adolescents.
exampleAr: تتخصص العيادة في علاج المراهقين.

definitionEn: a young person who is developing from a child into an adult
example: Adolescent behavior can be unpredictable.
exampleAr: قد يكون سلوك المراهقين غير متوقع.

definitionEn: to take somebody else’s child into your family and become its legal parent(s)
example: They decided to adopt a child.
exampleAr: قرروا تبني طفل.

definitionEn: the act of adopting a child; the fact of being adopted
example: The adoption process took almost a year.
exampleAr: استغرقت عملية التبني قرابة عام.

definitionEn: a fully grown person who is legally responsible for their actions
example: Tickets are $10 for adults and $5 for children.
exampleAr: تبلغ تذكرة البالغين 10 دولارات وتذكرة الأطفال 5 دولارات.

definitionEn: fully grown or developed
example: This film contains adult content.
exampleAr: يحتوي هذا الفيلم على محتوى للبالغين.

definitionEn: if knowledge, technology, etc. advances, it develops and improves
example: Technology has advanced rapidly in recent years.
exampleAr: تطورت التكنولوجيا بسرعة في السنوات الأخيرة.

definitionEn: progress or a development in a particular activity or area of understanding
example: Recent advances in medicine have saved many lives.
exampleAr: أنقذت التطورات الأخيرة في الطب أرواحًا كثيرة.

definitionEn: done or given before something is going to happen
example: You should give advance notice before cancelling.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تقدّم إشعارًا مسبقًا قبل الإلغاء.

definitionEn: having the most modern and recently developed ideas, methods, etc.
example: This is an advanced course for experienced students.
exampleAr: هذه دورة متقدمة للطلاب ذوي الخبرة.

definitionEn: a thing that helps you to be better or more successful than other people
example: One advantage of working from home is saving time.
exampleAr: من مزايا العمل من المنزل توفير الوقت.

definitionEn: an unusual, exciting or dangerous experience, journey or series of events
example: They went on an exciting adventure in the mountains.
exampleAr: خاضوا مغامرة مثيرة في الجبال.

definitionEn: negative and unpleasant; not likely to produce a good result
example: The medicine can cause adverse side effects.
exampleAr: قد يسبب الدواء آثارًا جانبية ضارة.

definitionEn: to tell the public about a product or a service in order to encourage people to buy or to use it
example: The company advertises its products on social media.
exampleAr: تُعلن الشركة عن منتجاتها على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.

definitionEn: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service
example: She saw an advertisement for a new phone.
exampleAr: رأت إعلانًا عن هاتف جديد.

definitionEn: the activity and industry of advertising things to people on television, in newspapers, on the internet, etc.
example: He works in advertising.
exampleAr: يعمل في مجال الإعلان.

definitionEn: an opinion or a suggestion about what somebody should do in a particular situation
example: Can you give me some advice on this?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تقدّم لي بعض النصائح حول هذا الأمر؟

definitionEn: to tell somebody what you think they should do in a particular situation
example: The doctor advised her to rest.
exampleAr: نصحها الطبيب بالراحة.

definitionEn: to support something publicly
example: She advocates for equal pay.
exampleAr: تدعو إلى المساواة في الأجور.

definitionEn: a person who supports or speaks in favour of somebody or of a public plan or action
example: He is a strong advocate of renewable energy.
exampleAr: إنه مناصر قوي للطاقة المتجددة.

definitionEn: the tools or other pieces of equipment that are needed for a particular activity or task
example: The lab is equipped with modern apparatus.
exampleAr: المختبر مجهز بمعدات حديثة.

definitionEn: easy to see or understand

definitionEn: according to what you have heard or read; according to the way something appears

definitionEn: to make a deeply felt request, especially for something that is needed immediately

definitionEn: a deeply felt request for money, help or information that is needed immediately, especially one made by a charity or by the police

definitionEn: attractive or interesting
example: The offer sounds appealing.

definitionEn: to start to be seen

definitionEn: the way that somebody/something looks on the outside; what somebody/something seems to be

definitionEn: physical desire for food

definitionEn: to show your approval of somebody/something by clapping your hands (= hitting your open hands together several times)

definitionEn: a round fruit with shiny red or green skin that is fairly hard and white inside

definitionEn: that can be said to be true in the case of somebody/something

definitionEn: a person who makes a formal request for something (= applies for it), especially for a job, a place at a college or university, etc.

exampleAr: كان هناك خمسون متقدمًا للوظيفة.

meaningAr: طلب (توظيف أو التحاق) / تطبيق (استخدام عملي) / برنامج (تطبيق حاسوبي)
definitionEn: a formal (often written) request for something, such as a job, permission to do something or a place at a college or university
example: Please submit your application by Friday.
exampleAr: يُرجى تقديم طلبك بحلول يوم الجمعة.

meaningAr: يتقدّم بطلب (apply for) / يُطبّق (ماديًا) / ينطبق على (apply to)
definitionEn: to make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a loan, permission for something, a place at a university, etc.

definitionEn: to choose somebody for a job or position of responsibility

exampleAr: عيّن مجلس الإدارة رئيسًا تنفيذيًا جديدًا.

definitionEn: a formal arrangement to meet or visit somebody at a particular time, especially for a reason connected with their work

definitionEn: to recognize the good qualities of somebody/something

definitionEn: pleasure that you have when you recognize and enjoy the good qualities of somebody/something
example: She expressed her appreciation for the gift.
exampleAr: أعربت عن تقديرها للهدية.

definitionEn: to come near to somebody/something in distance or time

definitionEn: a way of dealing with somebody/something; a way of doing or thinking about something such as a problem or a task

definitionEn: suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances
example: Please wear appropriate clothing for the interview.
exampleAr: يُرجى ارتداء ملابس مناسبة للمقابلة.

definitionEn: in a way that is suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances

exampleAr: تأكد من ارتداء ملابس مناسبة.

definitionEn: the feeling that somebody/something is good or acceptable; a positive opinion of somebody/something

definitionEn: to think that somebody/something is good, acceptable or suitable
example: The committee approved the budget.
exampleAr: وافقت اللجنة على الميزانية.

definitionEn: used to show that something is almost, but not completely, accurate or correct
example: The journey takes approximately two hours.
exampleAr: تستغرق الرحلة نحو ساعتين.

definitionEn: the fourth month of the year, between March and May
example: Her birthday is in April.
exampleAr: عيد ميلادها في أبريل.

definitionEn: not seeming to be based on a reason, system or plan and sometimes seeming unfair
example: The decision seemed completely arbitrary.
exampleAr: بدا القرار تعسفيًا تمامًا.

definitionEn: a person whose job is designing buildings

definitionEn: relating to architecture and buildings

definitionEn: the art and study of designing buildings

definitionEn: a collection of historical documents or records of a government, a family, a place or an organization; the place where these records are stored
example: The documents are kept in the national archive.
exampleAr: تُحفظ الوثائق في الأرشيف الوطني.

definitionEn: a collection of historical documents or records of a government, a family, a place or an organization; the place where these records are stored
example: Old emails are automatically archived.
exampleAr: تُؤرشف الرسائل الإلكترونية القديمة تلقائيًا.

definitionEn: part of a place, town, etc., or a region of a country or the world
example: They live in a rural area.
exampleAr: يعيشون في منطقة ريفية.

definitionEn: a place with a flat open area in the middle and seats around it where people can watch sports and entertainment
example: The concert was held in a huge arena.
exampleAr: أُقيم الحفل الموسيقي في ساحة ضخمة.

definitionEn: used (often before a comparative or superlative adjective) when you are stating an opinion that you believe you could give reasons to support
example: She is arguably the best player in the league.
exampleAr: يمكن القول إنها أفضل لاعبة في الدوري.

definitionEn: to speak angrily to somebody because you disagree with them

definitionEn: a conversation or discussion in which two or more people disagree, often angrily

exampleAr: كان بينهما شجار الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: to happen; to start to exist

exampleAr: قد تنشأ مشكلات أثناء العملية.

definitionEn: either of the two long parts that stick out from the top of the body and connect the shoulders to the hands
example: She broke her arm skiing.
exampleAr: كسرت ذراعها أثناء التزلج.

definitionEn: to provide weapons for yourself/somebody in order to fight a battle or a war

exampleAr: كان المتمردون مسلحين ببنادق.

definitionEn: involving the use of weapons

definitionEn: weapons, especially as used by the army, navy, etc.
example: The country agreed to reduce its arms.
exampleAr: وافقت الدولة على تقليص أسلحتها.

definitionEn: a large organized group of soldiers who are trained to fight on land

exampleAr: التحق بالجيش في سن الثامنة عشرة.

definitionEn: surrounding somebody/something; on each side of something

exampleAr: جلسوا حول الطاولة.

definitionEn: approximately

exampleAr: نظرت حولها قبل العبور.

definitionEn: to plan or organize something in advance
example: We arranged a meeting for next week.
exampleAr: رتّبنا اجتماعًا للأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: a plan or preparation that you make so that something can happen
example: They made arrangements for the wedding.
exampleAr: أجروا الترتيبات اللازمة لحفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: a group or collection of things or people, often one that is large or impressive
example: The shop offers a wide array of products.
exampleAr: يقدّم المتجر مجموعة متنوعة وواسعة من المنتجات.

definitionEn: if the police arrest somebody, the person is taken to a police station and kept there because the police believe they may be guilty of a crime

definitionEn: the act of arresting somebody

exampleAr: جرى الاعتقال في وقت مبكر من هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: an act of coming or being brought to a place

exampleAr: انتظرنا وصولها إلى المطار.

definitionEn: to get to a place, especially at the end of a journey

definitionEn: a thin stick with a sharp point at one end, which is shot from a bow

definitionEn: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture

meaningAr: مقالة / أداة تعريف / تنكير (نحو) / بند / مادة (قانونية)

definitionEn: to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words

definitionEn: to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words
example: He is a very articulate speaker.

definitionEn: made or produced to copy something natural; not real

definitionEn: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings
example: She is a talented artist.
exampleAr: إنها فنانة موهوبة.

definitionEn: connected with art or artists
example: He has an artistic talent for painting.
exampleAr: لديه موهبة فنية في الرسم.

definitionEn: pictures and photographs prepared for books, magazines, etc.
example: The gallery displayed modern artwork.
exampleAr: عرض المعرض أعمالاً فنية حديثة.

definitionEn: while something else is happening

definitionEn: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else

definitionEn: the grey or black powder that is left after something, especially tobacco, wood or coal, has burnt

definitionEn: feeling shame or feeling embarrassed about somebody/something or because of something you have done
example: He felt ashamed of his behaviour.
exampleAr: شعر بالخجل من تصرفه.

definitionEn: to one side; out of the way

exampleAr: وضعت الكتاب جانبًا ووقفت.

definitionEn: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information

definitionEn: sleeping

exampleAr: الطفل نائم.

definitionEn: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem, etc.; a way in which it may be considered

definitionEn: a strong desire to have or do something

definitionEn: to have a strong desire to achieve or to become something

definitionEn: to attack somebody violently, especially when this is a crime

definitionEn: to come together as a group; to bring people or things together as a group

definitionEn: a group of people who have been elected to meet together regularly and make decisions or laws for a particular region or country

definitionEn: to state clearly and definitely that something is true

definitionEn: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of somebody/something

definitionEn: an opinion or a judgement about somebody/something that has been thought about very carefully

definitionEn: a person or thing that is valuable or useful to somebody/something

definitionEn: to give somebody something that they can use, or some work or responsibility

definitionEn: a task or piece of work that somebody is given to do, usually as part of their job or studies

definitionEn: to help somebody to do something

definitionEn: help or support

definitionEn: a person who helps or supports somebody, usually in their job

definitionEn: having a rank below that of a senior person and helping them in their work

definitionEn: to make a connection between people or things in your mind

definitionEn: to make a connection between people or things in your mind
example: He is a business associate of mine.

definitionEn: an official group of people who have joined together for a particular purpose

definitionEn: to think or accept that something is true but without having proof of it

definitionEn: a belief or feeling that something is true or that something will happen, although there is no proof

definitionEn: a statement that something will certainly be true or will certainly happen, particularly when there has been doubt about it

meaningAr: في / عند (مكان أو زمان) / نحو (موجَّه إلى)

definitionEn: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth

definitionEn: a cruel and violent act, especially in a war
example: The war was marked by terrible atrocities.

meaningAr: يُرفق / يُلصق / يُعلّق أهمية (attach importance to)

definitionEn: to use violence to try to hurt or kill somebody

definitionEn: to succeed in getting something, usually after a lot of effort

definitionEn: to make an effort or try to do something, especially something difficult

definitionEn: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult, often with no success

meaningAr: يحضر / يهتم بـ / يُعنى بـ (attend to)

definitionEn: the act of being present at a place, for example at school

definitionEn: the act of listening to, looking at or thinking about something/somebody carefully; interest that people show in somebody/something

definitionEn: the way that you think and feel about somebody/something; the way that you behave towards somebody/something that shows how you think and feel

definitionEn: if you are attracted by something, it interests you and makes you want it; if you are attracted by somebody, you like or admire them

definitionEn: pleasant to look at, especially in a sexual way

definitionEn: to say or believe that something is the result of a particular thing

definitionEn: a quality or feature of somebody/something

definitionEn: a public sale in which things are sold to the person who offers the most money for them

definitionEn: the group of people who have gathered to watch or listen to something (a play, concert, somebody speaking, etc.)

definitionEn: connected with sound that is recorded

definitionEn: connected with sound that is recorded

definitionEn: an official examination of business and financial records to see that they are true and correct

definitionEn: an official examination of business and financial records to see that they are true and correct

definitionEn: the 8th month of the year, between July and September

definitionEn: the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle or aunt

definitionEn: known to be real and what somebody claims it is and not a copy

definitionEn: a person who writes books or the person who wrote a particular book

meaningAr: سلطة / هيئة رسمية (the authorities) / خبير / مرجعية (an authority on)

definitionEn: a car

definitionEn: having controls that work without needing a person to operate them

definitionEn: without needing a person to operate controls

definitionEn: the freedom for a country, a region or an organization to govern itself independently

definitionEn: the fact that something is possible to get, buy or find

definitionEn: that you can get, buy or find
example: Tickets are still available for tonight's show.
exampleAr: لا تزال التذاكر متوفرة لعرض الليلة.

definitionEn: calculated by adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts
example: The average temperature in July is 30 degrees.
exampleAr: متوسط درجة الحرارة في يوليو هو 30 درجة.

definitionEn: the result of adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts
example: Her grades are above average.
exampleAr: درجاتها أعلى من المتوسط.

definitionEn: to prevent something bad from happening
example: Try to avoid busy roads during rush hour.
exampleAr: حاول تجنّب الطرق المزدحمة في ساعة الذروة.

definitionEn: to wait for somebody/something
example: We await your response.
exampleAr: ننتظر ردّك.

definitionEn: a prize such as money, etc. for something that somebody has done
example: She won an award for best actress.
exampleAr: فازت بجائزة أفضل ممثلة.

definitionEn: to make an official decision to give something to somebody as a payment, prize, contract, etc.
example: The judges awarded first prize to the young pianist.
exampleAr: منح الحكام الجائزة الأولى للعازف الشاب.

definitionEn: knowing or realizing something
example: Are you aware of the new policy?
exampleAr: هل أنت على علم بالسياسة الجديدة؟

definitionEn: knowing something; knowing that something exists and is important
example: The campaign aims to raise awareness about climate change.
exampleAr: تهدف الحملة إلى رفع الوعي حول تغير المناخ.

meaningAr: بعيدًا / غائب / في رحلة (away from home)
definitionEn: to or at a distance from somebody/something in space or time
example: The beach is two miles away.
exampleAr: يبعد الشاطئ ميلين.

definitionEn: very bad or unpleasant
example: The weather was awful yesterday.
exampleAr: كان الطقس فظيعًا أمس.

definitionEn: making you feel embarrassed
example: There was an awkward silence after the question.
exampleAr: ساد صمت محرج بعد السؤال.

definitionEn: a very young child or animal
example: She's expecting a baby in June.
exampleAr: تنتظر مولودًا في يونيو.

definitionEn: the part of the human body that is on the opposite side to the chest, between the neck and the tops of the legs; the part of an animal’s body that corresponds to this
example: He hurt his back lifting the box.
exampleAr: أصاب ظهره أثناء رفع الصندوق.

definitionEn: to or into the place, condition, situation or activity where somebody/something was before
example: Put the book back on the shelf.
exampleAr: أعِد الكتاب إلى الرف.

definitionEn: located behind or at the back of something
example: They sat in the back seat.
exampleAr: جلسوا في المقعد الخلفي.

definitionEn: to encourage somebody or give them help; to give financial support to somebody/something
example: The bank agreed to back the new project.
exampleAr: وافق البنك على دعم المشروع الجديد.

definitionEn: everything that can be seen around an event or scene
example: The meeting took place against a backdrop of rising tension.
exampleAr: عُقد الاجتماع على خلفية تصاعد التوتر.

definitionEn: the details of a person’s family, education, experience, etc.
example: Mountains are visible in the background.
exampleAr: تظهر الجبال في الخلفية.

definitionEn: help and support from somebody to do something; financial support for something
example: The project has the full backing of the government.
exampleAr: يحظى المشروع بدعم كامل من الحكومة.

definitionEn: extra help or support that you can get if necessary
example: Always keep a backup of your files.
exampleAr: احتفظ دائمًا بنسخة احتياطية من ملفاتك.

definitionEn: towards a place or position that is behind
example: He walked backwards into the room.
exampleAr: دخل الغرفة سائرًا إلى الوراء.

definitionEn: the simplest and smallest forms of life. Bacteria exist in large numbers in air, water and soil, and also in living and dead creatures and plants, and are often a cause of disease.
example: The infection is caused by bacteria.
exampleAr: تُسبب البكتيريا هذه العدوى.

definitionEn: unpleasant; full of problems
example: The traffic was really bad this morning.
exampleAr: كان الازدحام المروري سيئًا حقًا هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: a small piece of metal or plastic, with a design or words on it, that a person wears or carries to show that they belong to an organization, support something, have achieved something, have a particular rank, etc.
example: Employees must wear a badge at all times.
exampleAr: يجب على الموظفين ارتداء الشارة في جميع الأوقات.

definitionEn: without skill or care
example: The team played badly today.
exampleAr: لعب الفريق بشكل سيء اليوم.

definitionEn: a container made of cloth, leather, plastic or paper, used to carry things in, especially when shopping or travelling
example: She packed her bag for the trip.
exampleAr: حزمت حقيبتها للرحلة.

definitionEn: money that somebody agrees to pay if a person accused of a crime does not appear at their trial. When bail has been arranged, the accused person is allowed to go free until the trial.
example: He was released on bail.
exampleAr: أُطلق سراحه بكفالة.

definitionEn: money that somebody agrees to pay if a person accused of a crime does not appear at their trial. When bail has been arranged, the accused person is allowed to go free until the trial.
example: The government bailed out the failing bank.
exampleAr: أنقذت الحكومة البنك المتعثر ماليًا.

definitionEn: to cook food in an oven without extra fat or liquid; to be cooked in this way
example: She baked a cake for the party.
exampleAr: خبزت كعكة للحفلة.

definitionEn: a situation in which different things exist in equal, correct or good amounts
example: It's important to keep a balance between work and life.
exampleAr: من المهم الحفاظ على توازن بين العمل والحياة.

definitionEn: to put your body or something else into a position where it is steady and does not fall
example: She balanced the tray on one hand.
exampleAr: وازنت الصينية على يد واحدة.

definitionEn: keeping or showing a balance so that different things or different parts of something exist in equal or correct amounts
example: Try to eat a balanced diet.
exampleAr: حاول اتباع نظام غذائي متوازن.

definitionEn: a round object used for throwing, hitting or kicking in games and sports
example: The children played with a ball in the park.
exampleAr: لعب الأطفال بكرة في الحديقة.

definitionEn: a style of dancing that tells a dramatic story with music but no talking or singing
example: She has taken ballet lessons since she was five.
exampleAr: تأخذ دروس الباليه منذ سن الخامسة.

definitionEn: a small bag made of very thin rubber that becomes larger and rounder when you fill it with air or gas. Balloons are brightly coloured and used as decorations or toys.
example: The children released balloons into the sky.
exampleAr: أطلق الأطفال بالونات في السماء.

definitionEn: the system of voting in writing and usually in secret; an occasion on which a vote is held
example: The result will be decided by secret ballot.
exampleAr: ستُحسم النتيجة بالاقتراع السري.

definitionEn: to decide or say officially that something is not allowed
example: The city banned smoking in public parks.
exampleAr: حظرت المدينة التدخين في الحدائق العامة.

definitionEn: an official rule that says that something is not allowed
example: There's a ban on plastic bags in the country.
exampleAr: هناك حظر على الأكياس البلاستيكية في البلاد.

definitionEn: a long curved fruit with a thick yellow skin and that is soft inside, which grows on trees in hot countries
example: He ate a banana for breakfast.
exampleAr: أكل موزة على الفطور.

meaningAr: فرقة موسيقية / شريط / رباط / نطاق / فئة (a tax band)
definitionEn: a small group of musicians who play popular music together, often with a singer or singers
example: They formed a rock band in college.
exampleAr: شكّلوا فرقة روك في الكلية.

definitionEn: an organization that provides various financial services, for example keeping or lending money
example: I need to go to the bank to withdraw money.
exampleAr: أحتاج إلى الذهاب إلى البنك لسحب المال.

definitionEn: an organization that provides various financial services, for example keeping or lending money
example: She banks with a local credit union.
exampleAr: تتعامل مصرفيًا مع اتحاد ائتماني محلي.

definitionEn: a long piece of cloth with a message on it that is carried between two poles or hung in a public place to show support for something
example: Protesters carried banners through the streets.
exampleAr: حمل المتظاهرون لافتات عبر الشوارع.

meaningAr: حانة / بار / قضيب (معدني) / قطعة (صابون أو شوكولاتة)
definitionEn: a place where you can buy and drink alcoholic and other drinks
example: They met for a drink at the bar.
exampleAr: التقيا لتناول مشروب في الحانة.

definitionEn: to ban or prevent somebody from doing something
example: He was barred from entering the club.
exampleAr: مُنع من دخول النادي.

definitionEn: not covered by any clothes
example: She walked on the beach with bare feet.
exampleAr: مشت على الشاطئ حافية القدمين.

definitionEn: in a way that is just possible but only with difficulty
example: He could barely walk after the accident.
exampleAr: كان بالكاد يستطيع المشي بعد الحادث.

definitionEn: a thing bought for less than the usual price
example: This laptop is a real bargain at that price.
exampleAr: هذا الحاسوب المحمول صفقة رابحة حقًا بهذا السعر.

definitionEn: a thing bought for less than the usual price
example: She bargained with the seller over the price.
exampleAr: ساومت البائع على السعر.

definitionEn: a large round container, usually made of wood or metal, with flat ends and, usually, curved sides
example: The oil price is measured per barrel.
exampleAr: يُقاس سعر النفط بالبرميل.

definitionEn: an object like a fence that prevents people from moving forward from one place to another
example: Language can be a barrier to communication.
exampleAr: قد تكون اللغة حاجزًا أمام التواصل.

definitionEn: the lowest part of something, especially the part or surface on which it rests or stands
example: The lamp has a heavy base.
exampleAr: المصباح له قاعدة ثقيلة.

definitionEn: to use a particular city, town, etc. as the main place for a business, holiday, etc.
example: The film is based on a true story.
exampleAr: الفيلم مبني على قصة حقيقية.

definitionEn: a game played especially in the US by two teams of nine players, using a bat and ball. Each player tries to hit the ball and then run around four bases before the other team can return the ball.
example: He plays baseball every summer.
exampleAr: يلعب البيسبول كل صيف.

meaningAr: مبني على / مُستمَد من / مقرّه / يتمركز في
definitionEn: if one thing is based on another, it uses it or is developed from it
example: The movie is based on a true story.
exampleAr: الفيلم مبني على قصة حقيقية.

definitionEn: a room or rooms in a building, partly or completely below the level of the ground
example: They store old furniture in the basement.
exampleAr: يخزّنون الأثاث القديم في القبو.

definitionEn: forming the part of something that is most necessary and from which other things develop
example: Everyone deserves basic human rights.
exampleAr: يستحق الجميع حقوق الإنسان الأساسية.

definitionEn: in the most important ways, without considering things that are less important
example: Basically, the plan didn't work.
exampleAr: ببساطة، لم تنجح الخطة.

meaningAr: أساس / نمط / وتيرة (on a daily basis)
definitionEn: the way things are organized or arranged; how often something happens
example: The decision was made on the basis of the report.
exampleAr: اتُّخذ القرار على أساس التقرير.

definitionEn: a container for holding or carrying things. Baskets are made of long thin pieces of material that bends and twists easily, for example plastic, wire or wicker.
example: She put the apples in a basket.
exampleAr: وضعت التفاح في سلة.

definitionEn: a game played by two teams of five players, using a large ball which players try to throw into a high net hanging from a ring
example: They play basketball every Saturday.
exampleAr: يلعبون كرة السلة كل يوم سبت.

meaningAr: الجهير (صوت أو آلة موسيقية منخفضة النبرة)
definitionEn: the lowest tone or part in music, for instruments or voices
example: He plays bass in a jazz band.
exampleAr: يعزف الجهير في فرقة جاز.

definitionEn: a piece of wood with a handle, made in various shapes and sizes, and used for hitting the ball in games such as baseball, cricket and table tennis
example: He hit the ball with a baseball bat.
exampleAr: ضرب الكرة بمضرب بيسبول.

definitionEn: to hit a ball with a bat, especially in a game of baseball or cricket
example: She batted the ball over the fence.
exampleAr: ضربت الكرة فوق السياج.

definitionEn: a large, long container that you put water in and then get into to wash your whole body
example: She took a hot bath after the run.
exampleAr: أخذت حمامًا ساخنًا بعد الجري.

definitionEn: a room in which there is a bath, a washbasin and often a toilet
example: The house has two bathrooms.
exampleAr: يحتوي المنزل على حمامين.

definitionEn: a device that is placed inside a car engine, clock, radio, etc. and that produces the electricity that makes it work
example: The battery in my phone died.
exampleAr: نفدت بطارية هاتفي.

definitionEn: a fight between armies, ships or planes, especially during a war; a violent fight between groups of people
example: The battle lasted three days.
exampleAr: استمرت المعركة ثلاثة أيام.

definitionEn: to try very hard to achieve something difficult or to deal with something unpleasant or dangerous
example: He battled illness for years.
exampleAr: كافح المرض لسنوات.

definitionEn: a place where a battle is being fought or has been fought
example: Thousands died on the battlefield.
exampleAr: لقي الآلاف حتفهم في ساحة المعركة.

definitionEn: a part of the sea, or of a large lake, partly surrounded by a wide curve of the land
example: The boats were anchored in the bay.
exampleAr: كانت القوارب راسية في الخليج.

definitionEn: used when you are naming people or things, describing them or giving more information about them
example: She is a doctor.
exampleAr: إنها طبيبة.

definitionEn: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle), next to the sea or a lake
example: They spent the day at the beach.
exampleAr: قضوا اليوم في الشاطئ.

definitionEn: a line of light, electromagnetic waves or particles
example: The roof is supported by wooden beams.
exampleAr: يستند السقف إلى عوارض خشبية.

definitionEn: a line of light, electromagnetic waves or particles
example: She beamed with pride.
exampleAr: أشرق وجهها فخرًا.

definitionEn: a seed, or pod containing seeds, of a climbing plant, eaten as a vegetable. There are several types of bean and the plants that they grow on are also called beans.
example: We had rice and beans for dinner.
exampleAr: تناولنا الأرز والفاصولياء على العشاء.

definitionEn: to be able to accept and deal with something unpleasant
example: I can't bear the pain any longer.
exampleAr: لا أستطيع تحمل الألم بعد الآن.

definitionEn: a heavy wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws (= pointed parts on the ends of its feet). There are many types of bear.
example: A brown bear was spotted near the camp.
exampleAr: شوهد دب بني بالقرب من المخيم.

definitionEn: an animal, especially one that is large or dangerous, or one that is unusual
example: The old castle was said to be guarded by a beast.
exampleAr: يُقال إن القلعة القديمة كان يحرسها وحش.

definitionEn: to defeat somebody in a game or competition
example: Our team beat them 3-0.
exampleAr: هزم فريقنا فريقهم 3-0.

definitionEn: a single hit to something, such as a drum, or a movement of something, such as your heart; the sound that this makes
example: The song has a strong beat.
exampleAr: تتميز الأغنية بإيقاع قوي.

definitionEn: having beauty; giving pleasure to the senses or to the mind
example: She has a beautiful voice.
exampleAr: لديها صوت جميل.

definitionEn: the quality of giving pleasure to the senses or to the mind
example: The beauty of the landscape amazed us.
exampleAr: أذهلنا جمال المناظر الطبيعية.

definitionEn: for the reason that
example: She stayed home because she was sick.
exampleAr: بقيت في المنزل لأنها كانت مريضة.

definitionEn: to start to be something
example: He wants to become a doctor.
exampleAr: يريد أن يصبح طبيبًا.

definitionEn: a piece of furniture for sleeping on
example: The baby is sleeping in the bed.
exampleAr: الطفل نائم في السرير.

definitionEn: a room for sleeping in
example: The house has three bedrooms.
exampleAr: يحتوي المنزل على ثلاث غرف نوم.

definitionEn: a black and yellow flying insect that can sting (= touch your skin and make you feel a sharp pain).Bees live in large groups and make honey (= a sweet sticky substance that is good to eat).
example: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
exampleAr: تجمع النحل حبوب اللقاح من الزهور.

definitionEn: meat that comes from a cow
example: We had beef for dinner.
exampleAr: تناولنا لحم البقر على العشاء.

definitionEn: an alcoholic drink made from malt with hops added to give it taste. There are many types of beer.
example: He ordered a cold beer.
exampleAr: طلب بيرة باردة.

definitionEn: earlier than somebody/something
example: Wash your hands before eating.
exampleAr: اغسل يديك قبل الأكل.

definitionEn: earlier than the time when
example: Think carefully before you decide.
exampleAr: فكّر مليًا قبل أن تقرر.

definitionEn: at an earlier time; in the past; already
example: I've never been here before.
exampleAr: لم أكن هنا من قبل.

definitionEn: to ask somebody for something especially in an anxious way because you want or need it very much
example: She begged him not to leave.
exampleAr: توسلت إليه ألا يرحل.

definitionEn: to start doing something; to do the first part of something
example: The concert will begin at 8pm.
exampleAr: سيبدأ الحفل الموسيقي الساعة الثامنة مساءً.

definitionEn: the time when something starts; the first part of an event, a story, etc.
example: The beginning of the film was slow.
exampleAr: كانت بداية الفيلم بطيئة.

definitionEn: in order to help somebody
example: I'm speaking on behalf of the whole team.
exampleAr: أتحدث نيابة عن الفريق بأكمله.

definitionEn: to do things in a particular way
example: The children behaved well during the trip.
exampleAr: تصرف الأطفال بشكل جيد أثناء الرحلة.

definitionEn: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people
example: His behaviour has improved a lot.
exampleAr: تحسّن سلوكه كثيرًا.

definitionEn: at or towards the back of somebody/something, and often hidden by it or them
example: The cat hid behind the sofa.
exampleAr: اختبأت القطة خلف الأريكة.

definitionEn: at or towards the back of somebody/something; further back
example: She stayed behind to finish the work.
exampleAr: بقيت في الخلف لإنهاء العمل.

definitionEn: existence
example: Human beings need water to survive.
exampleAr: يحتاج البشر إلى الماء للبقاء على قيد الحياة.

definitionEn: a strong feeling that something/somebody exists or is true; confidence that something/somebody is good or right
example: It's her belief that everyone deserves a second chance.
exampleAr: تعتقد أن كل شخص يستحق فرصة ثانية.

definitionEn: to feel certain that something is true or that somebody is telling you the truth
example: I believe you're right.
exampleAr: أعتقد أنك على حق.

definitionEn: a hollow metal object, often like a cup in shape, that makes a ringing sound when hit by a small piece of metal inside it; the sound that it makes
example: The school bell rang.
exampleAr: رنّ جرس المدرسة.

meaningAr: ينتمي إلى / يخص / ملك لـ (belong to)
definitionEn: to be in the right or suitable place
example: She feels she doesn't belong here.
exampleAr: تشعر أنها لا تنتمي إلى هذا المكان.

definitionEn: loved very much
example: He dedicated the song to his beloved wife.
exampleAr: أهدى الأغنية إلى زوجته الحبيبة.

definitionEn: at or to a lower level or position than somebody/something
example: The temperature dropped below zero.
exampleAr: انخفضت درجة الحرارة إلى ما دون الصفر.

definitionEn: at or to a lower level, position or place
example: See the note below for details.
exampleAr: انظر الملاحظة أدناه للتفاصيل.

definitionEn: a long narrow piece of leather, cloth, etc. that you wear around the middle part of your body
example: He wore a leather belt.
exampleAr: ارتدى حزامًا جلديًا.

definitionEn: a long seat for two or more people, usually made of wood
example: They sat on a park bench.
exampleAr: جلسوا على مقعد في الحديقة.

definitionEn: something that can be measured and used as a standard that other things can be compared with
example: The company's service sets a benchmark for the industry.
exampleAr: تُرسي خدمة الشركة معيارًا قياسيًا للصناعة.

definitionEn: to lean, or make something lean, in a particular direction
example: Bend your knees when you lift something heavy.
exampleAr: اثنِ ركبتيك عند رفع شيء ثقيل.

definitionEn: a curve or turn, especially in a road or river
example: There's a sharp bend in the road ahead.
exampleAr: هناك منعطف حاد في الطريق أمامنا.

definitionEn: in or to a lower position than somebody/something; under somebody/something
example: They found treasure beneath the old house.
exampleAr: وجدوا كنزًا تحت المنزل القديم.

definitionEn: improving a situation; having a helpful or useful effect
example: Exercise is beneficial for your health.
exampleAr: الرياضة مفيدة لصحتك.

definitionEn: a person who gains as a result of something
example: She is the sole beneficiary of his will.
exampleAr: إنها المستفيدة الوحيدة من وصيته.

definitionEn: an advantage that something gives you; a helpful and useful effect that something has
example: One benefit of the new system is speed.
exampleAr: من فوائد النظام الجديد السرعة.

definitionEn: to be useful to somebody or improve their life in some way
example: Many people will benefit from this policy.
exampleAr: سيستفيد الكثير من الناس من هذه السياسة.

definitionEn: not straight
example: The old fence was bent and rusty.
exampleAr: كان السياج القديم معوجًا وصدئًا.

definitionEn: next to or at the side of somebody/something
example: She sat beside her brother.
exampleAr: جلست بجانب أخيها.

definitionEn: in addition to somebody/something; apart from somebody/something
example: Besides English, he speaks Spanish.
exampleAr: بالإضافة إلى الإنجليزية، يتحدث الإسبانية.

definitionEn: used for making an extra comment that adds to what you have just said
example: I don't want to go; besides, it's too late.
exampleAr: لا أريد الذهاب؛ علاوة على ذلك، الوقت متأخر جدًا.

definitionEn: of the most excellent type or quality
example: She is the best student in the class.
exampleAr: إنها الطالبة الأفضل في الصف.

definitionEn: most; to the greatest extent
example: He sang best of all the contestants.
exampleAr: غنّى بأفضل شكل بين جميع المتسابقين.

definitionEn: the most excellent thing or person
example: Do your best on the test.
exampleAr: ابذل قصارى جهدك في الاختبار.

definitionEn: to risk money on a race or an event by trying to predict the result
example: I bet you can't finish it in an hour.
exampleAr: أراهنك أنك لن تستطيع إنهاءه في ساعة.

definitionEn: an arrangement to risk money, etc. on the result of a particular event; the money that you risk in this way
example: He placed a bet on the horse race.
exampleAr: وضع رهانًا على سباق الخيل.

definitionEn: to give information about somebody/something to an enemy
example: She felt betrayed by her closest friend.
exampleAr: شعرت بأن أقرب صديقاتها قد خانتها.

definitionEn: of a higher standard or less poor quality; not as bad as something else
example: This restaurant is better than the last one.
exampleAr: هذا المطعم أفضل من السابق.

definitionEn: in a more excellent or pleasant way; not as badly
example: She sings better than her sister.
exampleAr: تغني بشكل أفضل من أختها.

definitionEn: in or into the space separating two or more points, objects, people, etc.
example: The store is between the bank and the pharmacy.
exampleAr: يقع المتجر بين البنك والصيدلية.

definitionEn: on or to the further side of something
example: The village lies beyond the mountains.
exampleAr: تقع القرية وراء الجبال.

definitionEn: a strong feeling in favour of or against one group of people, or one side in an argument, often not based on fair judgement
example: The report was criticized for its political bias.
exampleAr: انتُقد التقرير بسبب تحيّزه السياسي.

definitionEn: a road vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet
example: She rides her bicycle to work.
exampleAr: تذهب إلى العمل بدراجتها الهوائية.

definitionEn: to offer to pay a particular price for something, especially at an auction
example: Several companies bid for the contract.
