exampleAr: اشترت عنقودًا من الموز.

definitionEn: a duty, responsibility, etc. that causes worry, difficulty or hard work
example: The debt became a heavy burden on the family.
exampleAr: أصبح الدين عبئًا ثقيلاً على العائلة.

definitionEn: a duty, responsibility, etc. that causes worry, difficulty or hard work
example: He didn't want to burden her with his problems.
exampleAr: لم يرد أن يُثقل كاهلها بمشاكله.

definitionEn: the system of official rules and ways of doing things that a government or an organization has, especially when these seem to be too complicated
example: Getting a visa involves a lot of bureaucracy.
exampleAr: يتطلب الحصول على تأشيرة الكثير من الإجراءات البيروقراطية.

definitionEn: the act or ceremony of burying a dead body
example: The burial took place at the local cemetery.
exampleAr: جرى الدفن في المقبرة المحلية.

definitionEn: to produce flames and heat
example: The paper burned quickly.
exampleAr: احترقت الورقة بسرعة.

definitionEn: an injury or a mark caused by fire, heat or acid
example: She suffered a minor burn on her hand.
exampleAr: أُصيبت بحرق طفيف في يدها.

definitionEn: to break open or apart, especially because of pressure from inside; to make something break in this way
example: The balloon burst with a loud noise.
exampleAr: انفجر البالون بصوت عالٍ.

definitionEn: to break open or apart, especially because of pressure from inside; to make something break in this way
example: There was a sudden burst of applause.
exampleAr: دوّت موجة مفاجئة من التصفيق.

definitionEn: to place a dead body in the ground
example: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
exampleAr: دفن الكلب عظمة في الحديقة.

definitionEn: a large road vehicle that carries passengers, especially one that travels along a fixed route and stops regularly to let people get on and off
example: She takes the bus to work.
exampleAr: تستقل الحافلة إلى العمل.

definitionEn: a plant that grows thickly with several hard stems coming up from the root
example: They planted a rose bush in the garden.
exampleAr: زرعوا شجيرة ورد في الحديقة.

definitionEn: the activity of making, buying, selling or supplying goods or services for money
example: He runs a small business.
exampleAr: يدير عملاً تجاريًا صغيرًا.

definitionEn: a man who works in business, especially at a high level
example: He is a successful businessman.
exampleAr: إنه رجل أعمال ناجح.

definitionEn: having a lot to do; perhaps not free to do something else because you are working on something
example: I'm busy this afternoon.
exampleAr: أنا مشغول بعد ظهر اليوم.

definitionEn: used to introduce a word or phrase that contrasts with what was said before
example: She wanted to go, but it was too late.
exampleAr: أرادت الذهاب، لكن الوقت كان متأخرًا جدًا.

definitionEn: except; apart from
example: Everyone but Sarah agreed.
exampleAr: وافق الجميع باستثناء سارة.

definitionEn: a soft yellow food made from cream, used in cooking and for spreading on bread
example: She spread butter on the toast.
exampleAr: دهنت الخبز المحمص بالزبدة.

definitionEn: a small round piece of metal, plastic, etc. that is sewn onto a piece of clothing and used for fastening two parts together
example: Press the button to start the machine.
exampleAr: اضغط الزر لتشغيل الآلة.

definitionEn: to obtain something by paying money for it
example: I need to buy some milk.
exampleAr: أحتاج إلى شراء بعض الحليب.

definitionEn: used for showing how or in what way something is done
example: The book was written by a famous author.
exampleAr: كُتب الكتاب بواسطة مؤلف مشهور.

definitionEn: goodbye
example: Bye! See you tomorrow.
exampleAr: مع السلامة! أراك غدًا.

definitionEn: a small room on a ship in which you live or sleep
example: They stayed in a log cabin in the mountains.
exampleAr: أقاموا في كوخ خشبي في الجبال.

definitionEn: a group of senior members of a government that is responsible for advising and deciding on government policy
example: She keeps the dishes in the kitchen cabinet.
exampleAr: تحتفظ بالأطباق في خزانة المطبخ.

definitionEn: a set of wires, covered in plastic or rubber, that carries electricity, phone signals, etc.
example: The TV is connected with a cable.
exampleAr: التلفاز موصول بكابل.

definitionEn: a place where you can buy drinks and simple meals. Alcohol is not usually served in British or American cafes.
example: We had coffee at a small cafe.
exampleAr: شربنا القهوة في مقهى صغير.

definitionEn: a sweet food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, butter, sugar, etc. that is baked in an oven. Cakes are made in various shapes and sizes and are often decorated, for example with cream or icing.
example: She baked a chocolate cake.
exampleAr: خبزت كعكة شوكولاتة.

definitionEn: to use numbers to find out a total number, amount, distance, etc.
example: Calculate the total cost before you buy.
exampleAr: احسب التكلفة الإجمالية قبل الشراء.

definitionEn: the act or process of using numbers to find out an amount
example: His calculations were wrong.
exampleAr: كانت حساباته خاطئة.

meaningAr: يتصل (هاتفيًا) / يُسمّي / يدعو / يستدعي / يطلب (call for)
definitionEn: to give somebody/something a particular name; to use a particular name or title when you are talking to somebody
example: I'll call you tomorrow.
exampleAr: سأتصل بك غدًا.

definitionEn: the act of speaking to somebody on the phone
example: She received an important call this morning.
exampleAr: تلقّت مكالمة مهمة هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: not excited, nervous or upset
example: Stay calm during the exam.
exampleAr: ابقَ هادئًا أثناء الامتحان.

definitionEn: to make somebody/something become quiet and more relaxed, especially after strong emotion or excitement
example: She tried to calm the crying baby.
exampleAr: حاولت تهدئة الطفل الباكي.

definitionEn: a piece of equipment for taking photographs, moving pictures or television pictures. It can be a separate item or part of another device.
example: He took a photo with his camera.
exampleAr: التقط صورة بكاميرته.

definitionEn: a place where people live temporarily in tents or temporary buildings
example: They set up camp near the river.
exampleAr: أقاموا مخيمًا قرب النهر.

definitionEn: to put up a tent and live in it for a short time
example: We camped in the forest for three nights.
exampleAr: خيّمنا في الغابة لثلاث ليالٍ.

definitionEn: a series of planned activities that are intended to achieve a particular social, commercial or political aim
example: The company launched a new advertising campaign.
exampleAr: أطلقت الشركة حملة إعلانية جديدة.

definitionEn: to take part in or lead a campaign, for example to achieve social or political change, or in order to win an election
example: She campaigned for equal rights.
exampleAr: شنّت حملة من أجل المساواة في الحقوق.

definitionEn: living in a tent, etc. on holiday
example: They went camping in the mountains.
exampleAr: ذهبوا للتخييم في الجبال.

definitionEn: the buildings of a university or college and the land around them
example: Students live on campus during the semester.
exampleAr: يعيش الطلاب في الحرم الجامعي خلال الفصل الدراسي.

definitionEn: used to say that it is possible for somebody/something to do something, or for something to happen
example: She can swim very well.
exampleAr: تستطيع السباحة بمهارة عالية.

definitionEn: a metal container in which food and drink is sold
example: He opened a can of soup.
exampleAr: فتح علبة حساء.

definitionEn: a long straight passage dug in the ground and filled with water for boats and ships to travel along; a smaller passage used for carrying water to fields, crops, etc.
example: Ships pass through the Suez Canal.
exampleAr: تمر السفن عبر قناة السويس.

definitionEn: to decide that something that has been arranged will not now take place
example: They had to cancel the flight due to weather.
exampleAr: اضطروا إلى إلغاء الرحلة بسبب الطقس.

definitionEn: a serious disease in which growths of cells, also called cancers, form in the body and kill normal body cells. The disease often causes death.
example: She was diagnosed with cancer last year.
exampleAr: شُخّصت إصابتها بالسرطان العام الماضي.

definitionEn: a person who is trying to be elected or is applying for a job
example: There are five candidates for the position.
exampleAr: هناك خمسة مرشحين لهذا المنصب.

definitionEn: a round stick of wax with a piece of string (called a wick) through the middle that is lit to give light as it burns
example: She lit a candle for dinner.
exampleAr: أشعلت شمعة للعشاء.

definitionEn: the negative of can; can not
example: I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.
exampleAr: لا أستطيع حضور الاجتماع غدًا.

definitionEn: a strong heavy rough material used for making tents, sails, etc. and by artists for painting on
example: The artist painted on a large canvas.
exampleAr: رسم الفنان على قماش كبير.

definitionEn: a type of soft flat hat with a peak (= a hard curved part sticking out in front). Caps are worn especially by men and boys, often as part of a uniform
example: He wore a baseball cap.
exampleAr: ارتدى قبعة بيسبول.

definitionEn: a type of soft flat hat with a peak (= a hard curved part sticking out in front). Caps are worn especially by men and boys, often as part of a uniform
example: The government capped rent increases at 5%.
exampleAr: حدّدت الحكومة سقفًا لزيادات الإيجار عند 5%.

definitionEn: the ability or qualities necessary to do something
example: The new phone has impressive capability.
exampleAr: يتمتع الهاتف الجديد بإمكانيات مثيرة للإعجاب.

definitionEn: having the ability or qualities necessary for doing something
example: She is capable of handling the project alone.
exampleAr: إنها قادرة على إدارة المشروع بمفردها.

meaningAr: سعة / طاقة استيعابية / قدرة (على فعل شيء)
definitionEn: the number of things or people that a container or space can hold
example: The stadium has a capacity of 50,000.
exampleAr: يتسع الملعب لـ 50,000 متفرج.

definitionEn: the most important town or city of a country or region, where the government operates from
example: Paris is the capital of France.
exampleAr: باريس هي عاصمة فرنسا.

definitionEn: an economic system in which a country’s businesses and industry are controlled and run for profit by private owners rather than by the government
example: The country moved from communism to capitalism.
exampleAr: انتقلت البلاد من الشيوعية إلى الرأسمالية.

definitionEn: based on the principles of capitalism
example: They live in a capitalist society.
exampleAr: يعيشون في مجتمع رأسمالي.

definitionEn: based on the principles of capitalism
example: He is a wealthy capitalist.
exampleAr: إنه رأسمالي ثري.

definitionEn: the person in charge of a ship or commercial aircraft
example: She is the captain of the football team.
exampleAr: إنها قائدة فريق كرة القدم.

definitionEn: to catch a person or an animal and keep them as a prisoner or shut them in a space that they cannot escape from
example: The soldiers captured the enemy camp.
exampleAr: استولى الجنود على معسكر العدو.

definitionEn: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels that can carry a small number of passengers
example: He drives a red car.
exampleAr: يقود سيارة حمراء.

definitionEn: a chemical element. Carbon is found in all living things, existing in a pure state as diamond and graphite.
example: The factory is trying to reduce its carbon emissions.
exampleAr: يحاول المصنع تقليل انبعاثاته الكربونية.

definitionEn: thick, stiff paper; a piece of this for writing on
example: She paid with a credit card.
exampleAr: دفعت ببطاقة ائتمان.

definitionEn: the process of caring for somebody/something and providing what they need for their health or protection
example: The elderly need special care.
exampleAr: يحتاج كبار السن إلى رعاية خاصة.

definitionEn: to feel that something is important and worth worrying about
example: She really cares about her students.
exampleAr: تهتم حقًا بطلابها.

definitionEn: the series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes
example: She had a long career in journalism.
exampleAr: كانت لها مسيرة مهنية طويلة في الصحافة.

definitionEn: giving attention or thought to what you are doing so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong
example: Be careful when crossing the street.
exampleAr: كن حذرًا عند عبور الشارع.

definitionEn: with a lot of attention or thought, so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong
example: Read the instructions carefully.
exampleAr: اقرأ التعليمات بعناية.

definitionEn: not giving enough attention and thought to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes
example: The accident was caused by a careless driver.
exampleAr: تسبّب سائق مهمل في الحادث.

definitionEn: the goods carried in a ship, an aircraft or a motor vehicle
example: The ship carried cargo across the ocean.
exampleAr: حملت السفينة شحنة عبر المحيط.

definitionEn: a piece of thick woven material made of wool, etc., used to cover the floor of a room or stairs; the material used for carpets
example: They laid a new carpet in the living room.
exampleAr: فرشوا سجادة جديدة في غرفة المعيشة.

definitionEn: a separate section of a train for carrying passengers
example: She travelled in a first-class carriage.
exampleAr: سافرت في عربة درجة أولى.

definitionEn: a long pointed orange root vegetable
example: Rabbits love eating carrots.
exampleAr: تحب الأرانب أكل الجزر.

definitionEn: to support the weight of somebody/something and take them or it from place to place; to take somebody/something from one place to another
example: He carried the boxes upstairs.
exampleAr: حمل الصناديق إلى الطابق العلوي.

definitionEn: a humorous drawing in a newspaper or magazine, especially one about politics or events in the news
example: The children watched cartoons on Saturday morning.
exampleAr: شاهد الأطفال الرسوم المتحركة صباح السبت.

definitionEn: to make objects, patterns, etc. by cutting away material from a piece of wood or stone, or another hard material
example: He carved a figure out of wood.
exampleAr: نحت تمثالاً من الخشب.

definitionEn: a particular situation or a situation of a particular type
example: In this case, we need more information.
exampleAr: في هذه الحالة، نحتاج إلى مزيد من المعلومات.

definitionEn: money in the form of coins or notes
example: He paid in cash.
exampleAr: دفع نقدًا.

definitionEn: a public building or room where people play gambling games for money
example: They spent the night at the casino.
exampleAr: قضوا الليلة في الكازينو.

definitionEn: all the people who act in a play or film
example: The film has an all-star cast.
exampleAr: يضم الفيلم طاقم تمثيل من النجوم.

definitionEn: to look, smile, etc. in a particular direction
example: She was cast in the leading role.
exampleAr: اختيرت لأداء الدور الرئيسي.

definitionEn: a large strong building with thick, high walls and towers, built in the past by kings or queens, or other important people, to defend themselves against attack
example: They visited an old castle in Scotland.
exampleAr: زاروا قلعة قديمة في اسكتلندا.

definitionEn: not formal
example: He wore casual clothes to the party.
exampleAr: ارتدى ملابس غير رسمية إلى الحفلة.

definitionEn: a person who is killed or injured in war or in an accident
example: There were several casualties in the crash.
exampleAr: كان هناك عدة ضحايا في الحادث.

definitionEn: a small animal with soft fur that people often keep as a pet. Cats catch and kill birds and mice.
example: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
exampleAr: القطة نائمة على الأريكة.

definitionEn: a complete list of items, for example of things that people can look at or buy
example: She ordered a dress from the catalogue.
exampleAr: طلبت فستانًا من الكتالوج.

meaningAr: يمسك / يلتقط / يلحق بـ (وسيلة نقل) / يُصاب بـ (مرض)
definitionEn: to stop and hold a moving object or person, especially in your hands
example: He caught the ball with one hand.
exampleAr: أمسك الكرة بيد واحدة.

definitionEn: an act of catching something, for example a ball
example: The fisherman had a good catch today.
exampleAr: حظي الصياد بصيد وفير اليوم.

definitionEn: a group of people or things with particular features in common
example: The books are organized into categories.
exampleAr: الكتب مرتبة في فئات.

definitionEn: to provide food and drinks for a social event
example: The hotel caters to business travellers.
exampleAr: يُلبّي الفندق احتياجات المسافرين لأغراض العمل.

definitionEn: cows and bulls that are kept as farm animals for their milk or meat
example: The farmer raises cattle for beef.
exampleAr: يربّي المزارع الماشية لإنتاج اللحم.

definitionEn: to make something happen, especially something bad or unpleasant; to make somebody do something
example: Heavy rain caused the flooding.
exampleAr: تسبّبت الأمطار الغزيرة في الفيضانات.

definitionEn: the person or thing that makes something happen
example: Doctors are trying to find the cause of the illness.
exampleAr: يحاول الأطباء إيجاد سبب المرض.

definitionEn: care that you take in order to avoid danger or mistakes; the fact of not taking any risks
example: Drive with caution in icy conditions.
exampleAr: قُد بحذر في الظروف الجليدية.

definitionEn: being careful about what you say or do, especially to avoid danger or mistakes; not taking any risks
example: Investors are cautious about the market.
exampleAr: يتوخى المستثمرون الحذر تجاه السوق.

definitionEn: a large hole in the side of a hill or cliff or under the ground
example: They explored a cave in the mountains.
exampleAr: استكشفوا كهفًا في الجبال.

definitionEn: a small disc on which sound or information is recorded. CDs can be played or read on various types of machines, including CD players and computers. (the abbreviation for ‘compact disc’)
example: She bought his latest album on CD.
exampleAr: اشترت أحدث ألبوماته على قرص مضغوط.

definitionEn: to stop happening or existing; to stop something from happening or existing
example: The two sides agreed to cease fighting.
exampleAr: اتفق الطرفان على وقف القتال.

definitionEn: the top inside surface of a room
example: There's a crack in the ceiling.
exampleAr: هناك شرخ في السقف.

definitionEn: to show that a day or an event is important by doing something special on it
example: They celebrated her birthday with a party.
exampleAr: احتفلوا بعيد ميلادها بحفلة.

definitionEn: a special event that people organize in order to celebrate something
example: The wedding celebration lasted all night.
exampleAr: استمر احتفال الزفاف طوال الليل.

definitionEn: a famous person
example: The event was attended by several celebrities.
exampleAr: حضر الفعالية عدد من المشاهير.

definitionEn: the smallest unit of living matter that can exist on its own. All plants and animals are made up of cells.
example: The human body is made of trillions of cells.
exampleAr: يتكون جسم الإنسان من تريليونات الخلايا.

definitionEn: an area of land used for burying dead people, especially one that is not next to a church
example: They visited the family grave at the cemetery.
exampleAr: زاروا قبر العائلة في المقبرة.

definitionEn: a coin and unit of money worth 1% of the main unit of money in many countries, for example of the US dollar or of the euro
example: The candy costs fifty cents.
exampleAr: تكلّف الحلوى خمسين سنتًا.

definitionEn: in the centre of an area or object
example: The hotel is in a central location.
exampleAr: يقع الفندق في موقع مركزي.

definitionEn: the middle point or part of something
example: The bank is in the centre of town.
exampleAr: يقع البنك في وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: a period of 100 years
example: The castle was built in the 12th century.
exampleAr: بُنيت القلعة في القرن الثاني عشر.

definitionEn: a public or religious occasion that includes a series of formal or traditional actions
example: The graduation ceremony was held outdoors.
exampleAr: أُقيمت مراسم التخرج في الهواء الطلق.

definitionEn: strongly believing something; having no doubts
example: I'm certain she will come.
exampleAr: أنا متأكد من أنها ستأتي.

definitionEn: without doubt
example: This will certainly help improve results.
exampleAr: سيساعد هذا بالتأكيد في تحسين النتائج.

definitionEn: the state of being certain
example: No one can predict the future with certainty.
exampleAr: لا أحد يستطيع التنبؤ بالمستقبل بيقين.

definitionEn: an official document that may be used to prove that the facts it states are true
example: She received a certificate for completing the course.
exampleAr: حصلت على شهادة لإتمامها الدورة.

definitionEn: a series of connected metal rings, used for pulling or fastening things; a length of chain used for a particular purpose
example: The dog was tied with a chain.
exampleAr: كان الكلب مربوطًا بسلسلة.

definitionEn: to fasten something with a chain; to fasten somebody/something to another person or thing with a chain, so that they do not escape or get stolen
example: The bike was chained to the fence.
exampleAr: كانت الدراجة مقيّدة بسلسلة إلى السياج.

definitionEn: a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back, a seat and four legs
example: Please take a chair and sit down.
exampleAr: يُرجى أخذ كرسي والجلوس.

definitionEn: the person in charge of a meeting, who tells people when they can speak, etc.
example: He is the chairman of the board.
exampleAr: إنه رئيس مجلس الإدارة.

definitionEn: a new or difficult task that tests somebody’s ability and skill
example: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
exampleAr: تعلّم لغة جديدة تحدٍ كبير.

definitionEn: to question whether a statement or an action is right, legal, etc.; to refuse to accept something
example: She challenged him to a race.
exampleAr: تحدّته في سباق.

definitionEn: difficult in an interesting way that tests your ability
example: The exam was quite challenging.
exampleAr: كان الامتحان صعبًا للغاية.

definitionEn: a hall in a public building that is used for formal meetings
example: The heart has four chambers.
exampleAr: يحتوي القلب على أربع حجرات.

definitionEn: a person, team, etc. that has won a competition, especially in a sport
example: She became the world champion in swimming.
exampleAr: أصبحت بطلة العالم في السباحة.

definitionEn: a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport
example: The team won the national championship.
exampleAr: فاز الفريق بالبطولة الوطنية.

definitionEn: a possibility of something happening, especially something that you want
example: This is your chance to prove yourself.
exampleAr: هذه فرصتك لإثبات نفسك.

definitionEn: to become different
example: She changed her mind at the last minute.
exampleAr: غيّرت رأيها في اللحظة الأخيرة.

definitionEn: the act or result of something becoming different
example: There have been many changes in the company.
exampleAr: حدثت تغييرات كثيرة في الشركة.

definitionEn: a television station
example: She switched to a news channel.
exampleAr: بدّلت إلى قناة إخبارية.

definitionEn: a television station
example: He channelled his anger into his work.
exampleAr: وجّه غضبه نحو عمله.

definitionEn: a complete lack of order
example: The storm caused chaos across the city.
exampleAr: تسبّبت العاصفة في فوضى عارمة في أنحاء المدينة.

definitionEn: a separate section of a book, usually with a number or title
example: Read the first chapter for homework.
exampleAr: اقرأ الفصل الأول كواجب منزلي.

definitionEn: a person or an animal in a book, play or film
example: He has a strong character.
exampleAr: يتمتع بشخصية قوية.

definitionEn: a typical feature or quality that something/somebody has
example: Patience is one of her key characteristics.
exampleAr: الصبر إحدى سماتها الأساسية.

definitionEn: very typical of something or of somebody’s character
example: He answered with his characteristic honesty.
exampleAr: أجاب بصدقه المعهود.

definitionEn: to be typical of a person, place or thing
example: The era was characterized by rapid change.
exampleAr: تميّزت تلك الحقبة بالتغير السريع.

meaningAr: رسم / تكلفة / تهمة (قانونية) / مسؤولية (in charge of)
definitionEn: the amount of money that somebody asks for goods and services
example: There's an extra charge for delivery.
exampleAr: هناك رسم إضافي للتوصيل.

definitionEn: to ask an amount of money for goods or a service
example: The hotel charges $100 a night.
exampleAr: يفرض الفندق 100 دولار في الليلة.

definitionEn: an organization for helping people in need
example: She donates to a local charity.
exampleAr: تتبرع لجمعية خيرية محلية.

definitionEn: the power of pleasing or attracting people
example: The old town has a lot of charm.
exampleAr: تتمتع البلدة القديمة بسحر كبير.

definitionEn: the power of pleasing or attracting people
example: He charmed everyone at the party.

example: The film is a romantic comedy.

definitionEn: the state of being physically relaxed and free from pain; the state of having a pleasant life, with everything that you need

definitionEn: making you feel physically relaxed; pleasant to wear, sit on, etc.

definitionEn: to tell somebody to do something

definitionEn: trade, especially between countries; the buying and selling of goods and services

definitionEn: an advertisement on television, on the radio or on a website

definitionEn: to do something wrong or illegal

definitionEn: a promise to do something or to behave in a particular way; a promise to support somebody/something; the fact of committing yourself

definitionEn: a group of people who are chosen, usually by a larger group, to make decisions or to deal with a particular subject

definitionEn: a product or a raw material that can be bought and sold

definitionEn: happening often; existing in large numbers or in many places

definitionEn: usually; very often; by most people

definitionEn: to share or exchange information, news, ideas, feelings, etc.

definitionEn: the activity or process of expressing ideas and feelings or of giving people information

definitionEn: similar to somebody/something else and able to be compared

definitionEn: to examine people or things to see how they are similar and how they are different

definitionEn: a strong feeling of sympathy for people or animals who are suffering and a desire to help them

definitionEn: to provide something good to balance or reduce the bad effects of damage, loss, etc.

definitionEn: to take part in a contest or game

definitionEn: a person who takes part in a competition

definitionEn: in every way possible; in every part

definitionEn: the act or process of finishing something; the state of being finished and complete

definitionEn: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand

definitionEn: the state of being formed of many parts; the state of being difficult to understand

definitionEn: the practice of obeying rules or requests made by people in authority

definitionEn: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand

definitionEn: a thing that makes a situation more complicated or difficult

definitionEn: to obey a rule, an order, etc.; to meet particular standards

definitionEn: one of several parts of which something is made

definitionEn: to write music

definitionEn: a person who writes music, especially classical music

definitionEn: the different parts that something is made of; the way in which the different parts are organized

definitionEn: a thing consisting of two or more separate things combined together

definitionEn: a thing consisting of two or more separate things combined together

definitionEn: including all, or almost all, the items, details, facts, information, etc., that may be involved

definitionEn: to have somebody/something as parts or members

definitionEn: to give up some of your demands in order to reach an agreement after disagreeing with somebody

definitionEn: that must be done because of a law or a rule

definitionEn: to calculate something

definitionEn: an electronic machine that can store, organize and find information, do processes with numbers and other data, and control other machines

definitionEn: to hide somebody/something

definitionEn: to give all your attention to something and not think about anything else

definitionEn: the ability to direct all your effort and attention on one thing, without thinking of other things

definitionEn: an idea or a principle that is connected with something abstract

definitionEn: an understanding or a belief of what something/somebody is or what something/somebody should be

definitionEn: a feeling of worry, especially one that is shared by many people

definitionEn: worried and feeling concern about something/somebody

definitionEn: a public performance of music

definitionEn: building material that is made by mixing together cement, sand, small stones and water

definitionEn: made of concrete

definitionEn: to say very strongly that you think something is bad, usually for moral reasons

definitionEn: the state that something is in

definitionEn: to organize and/or do a particular activity

definitionEn: a person’s behaviour in a particular place or in a particular situation

definitionEn: to discuss something with somebody, in order to exchange opinions or get advice

definitionEn: a statement that a person makes, admitting that they are guilty of a crime; the act of making such a statement

definitionEn: the feeling that you can trust, believe in and be sure about the abilities or good qualities of somebody/something

definitionEn: feeling sure about your own ability to do things and be successful

definitionEn: an arrangement of the parts of something or a group of things; the form or shape that this arrangement produces

definitionEn: a statement, letter, etc. that shows that something is true, correct or definite

definitionEn: a situation in which people, groups or countries disagree strongly or are involved in a serious argument

definitionEn: if two ideas, beliefs, stories, etc. conflict, it is not possible for them to exist together or for them both to be true

definitionEn: to appear and need to be dealt with by somebody

definitionEn: a situation in which there is anger between people or groups who disagree because they have different opinions

definitionEn: to make somebody unable to think clearly or understand something

definitionEn: unable to think clearly or to understand what is happening or what somebody is saying

definitionEn: difficult to understand; not clear

definitionEn: a state of not being certain about what is happening, what you should do, what something means, etc.

definitionEn: to tell somebody that you are pleased about their success or achievements

definitionEn: a group of people who are gathered together in a church for a religious service, not including the priest and choir

definitionEn: to join together two or more things; to be joined together

definitionEn: (of two or more things or people) having a link between them

definitionEn: something that connects two facts, ideas, etc.

meaningAr: يغزو / يقهر / يتغلّب على (خوف أو صعوبة)

definitionEn: the part of your mind that tells you whether your actions are right or wrong

meaningAr: واعٍ (مدرك حسيًا) / مدرك لـ / منتبه لـ

definitionEn: following one after another in a continuous series

definitionEn: an opinion that all members of a group agree with

definitionEn: opposed to great or sudden social change; showing that you prefer traditional styles and values

definitionEn: the act of thinking carefully about something

example: The team consists of ten players.

definitionEn: the quality of always behaving in the same way or of having the same opinions, standard, etc.; the quality of being consistent
example: Consistency is important when training a dog.
exampleAr: الاتساق مهم عند تدريب الكلب.

definitionEn: always behaving in the same way, or having the same opinions, standards, etc.
example: Her performance has been consistent all season.
exampleAr: كان أداؤها ثابتًا طوال الموسم.

definitionEn: always the same
example: He consistently arrives on time.
exampleAr: يصل دائمًا في الموعد.

definitionEn: to make a position of power or success stronger so that it is more likely to continue
example: The company consolidated its position in the market.
exampleAr: عزّزت الشركة مكانتها في السوق.

definitionEn: a secret plan by a group of people to do something harmful or illegal
example: Police uncovered a conspiracy to commit fraud.
exampleAr: كشفت الشرطة عن مؤامرة لارتكاب احتيال.

definitionEn: happening all the time or repeatedly
example: She lived in constant fear of losing her job.
exampleAr: عاشت في خوف مستمر من فقدان وظيفتها.

definitionEn: all the time; repeatedly
example: He is constantly checking his phone.
exampleAr: يتفقد هاتفه باستمرار.

definitionEn: a district that elects its own representative to parliament
example: The MP represents a large rural constituency.
exampleAr: يمثّل النائب دائرة انتخابية ريفية كبيرة.

definitionEn: to be considered to be something
example: These actions constitute a breach of contract.
exampleAr: تُشكّل هذه الأفعال خرقًا للعقد.

definitionEn: the system of laws and basic principles that a state, a country or an organization is governed by
example: The constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
exampleAr: يضمن الدستور حرية التعبير.

example: It's a constitutional right.
exampleAr: إنه حق دستوري.

definitionEn: a thing that limits something, or limits your freedom to do something
example: Budget constraints limited what they could do.
exampleAr: حدّت قيود الميزانية مما يمكنهم فعله.

definitionEn: to build or make something such as a road, building or machine
example: Workers constructed a new bridge.
exampleAr: بنى العمال جسرًا جديدًا.

definitionEn: the process or method of building or making something, especially roads, buildings, bridges, etc.
example: The building is still under construction.
exampleAr: لا يزال المبنى قيد الإنشاء.

definitionEn: to go to somebody for information or advice
example: You should consult a doctor about that pain.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تستشير طبيبًا بشأن ذلك الألم.

definitionEn: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject and is employed to give advice about it to other people
example: She works as a business consultant.
exampleAr: تعمل مستشارة أعمال.

definitionEn: the act of discussing something with somebody or with a group of people before making a decision about it
example: The decision was made after consultation with experts.
exampleAr: اتُّخذ القرار بعد استشارة الخبراء.

definitionEn: to use something, especially fuel, energy or time
example: The factory consumes a lot of energy.
exampleAr: يستهلك المصنع الكثير من الطاقة.

definitionEn: a person who buys goods or uses services
example: Consumers are demanding more eco-friendly products.
exampleAr: يطالب المستهلكون بمزيد من المنتجات الصديقة للبيئة.

definitionEn: the act of using energy, food or materials; the amount used
example: Water consumption increases in summer.
exampleAr: يزداد استهلاك المياه في الصيف.

definitionEn: the act of communicating with somebody, especially regularly
example: Please stay in contact with us.
exampleAr: يُرجى البقاء على تواصل معنا.

definitionEn: to communicate with somebody, for example by phone, letter or email
example: Contact me if you have any questions.
exampleAr: اتصل بي إذا كانت لديك أي أسئلة.

definitionEn: if something contains something else, it has that thing inside it or as part of it
example: The box contains old photographs.
exampleAr: يحتوي الصندوق على صور قديمة.

definitionEn: a box, bottle, etc. in which something can be stored or transported
example: Store the leftovers in a plastic container.
exampleAr: احفظ البقايا في وعاء بلاستيكي.

definitionEn: to think about whether you should do something, or how you should do something
example: She contemplated quitting her job.
exampleAr: فكّرت مليًا في ترك وظيفتها.

definitionEn: belonging to the same time
example: The museum features contemporary art.
exampleAr: يعرض المتحف فنًا معاصرًا.

definitionEn: belonging to the same time
example: Shakespeare and his contemporaries.
exampleAr: شكسبير ومعاصروه.

definitionEn: the feeling that somebody/something is without value and deserves no respect at all
example: He looked at the offer with contempt.
exampleAr: نظر إلى العرض باحتقار.

definitionEn: to say that something is true, especially in an argument
example: She contends that the policy is unfair.
exampleAr: تدّعي أن السياسة غير عادلة.

definitionEn: a person or team with a chance of winning a competition
example: He is a strong contender for the championship.
exampleAr: إنه منافس قوي على البطولة.

definitionEn: the things that are contained in something
example: The website has a lot of useful content.
exampleAr: يحتوي الموقع الإلكتروني على الكثير من المحتوى المفيد.

definitionEn: happy and satisfied with what you have
example: She seemed content with her simple life.
exampleAr: بدت راضية عن حياتها البسيطة.

definitionEn: anger between people who disagree
example: His main contention is that the law is unfair.
exampleAr: حجته الرئيسية هي أن القانون غير عادل.

definitionEn: a competition in which people try to win something
example: She won first prize in the writing contest.
exampleAr: فازت بالجائزة الأولى في مسابقة الكتابة.

definitionEn: to take part in a competition, election, etc. and try to win it
example: He plans to contest the election result.
exampleAr: يخطط للطعن في نتيجة الانتخابات.

definitionEn: the situation in which something happens and that helps you to understand it
example: You need to understand the context of the statement.
exampleAr: عليك أن تفهم سياق التصريح.

definitionEn: one of the large land masses of the earth such as Europe, Asia or Africa
example: Africa is the second-largest continent.
exampleAr: أفريقيا ثاني أكبر قارة.

definitionEn: in a way that is repeated many times so that it is annoying
example: The rules are continually changing.
exampleAr: تتغير القواعد باستمرار.

definitionEn: to keep existing or happening without stopping
example: Please continue with your work.
exampleAr: يُرجى الاستمرار في عملك.

definitionEn: happening or existing for a period of time without being interrupted
example: There has been continuous rain since morning.
exampleAr: هطل مطر متواصل منذ الصباح.

definitionEn: an official written agreement
example: She signed a two-year contract.
exampleAr: وقّعت عقدًا لمدة عامين.

definitionEn: to become less or smaller; to make something become less or smaller
example: The company contracted a local firm to do the work.
exampleAr: تعاقدت الشركة مع شركة محلية للقيام بالعمل.

definitionEn: a person or company that has a contract to do work or provide goods or services for another company
example: They hired a contractor to renovate the house.
exampleAr: استأجروا مقاولاً لتجديد المنزل.

definitionEn: a lack of agreement between facts, opinions, actions, etc.
example: There's a contradiction between his two statements.
exampleAr: هناك تناقض بين تصريحيه.

example: Contrary to popular belief, the plan worked well.
exampleAr: خلافًا للاعتقاد الشائع، نجحت الخطة بشكل جيد.

definitionEn: the opposite fact, event or situation
example: I'm not upset — on the contrary, I'm delighted.
exampleAr: لست منزعجًا — بل على العكس، أنا مسرور.

definitionEn: a difference between two or more people or things that you can see clearly when they are compared or put close together; the fact of comparing two or more things in order to show the differences between them
example: There's a sharp contrast between the two cities.
exampleAr: هناك تباين حاد بين المدينتين.

definitionEn: to compare two things in order to show the differences between them
example: Her calm attitude contrasted with his anxiety.
exampleAr: تباين هدوؤها مع توتره.

definitionEn: to give something, especially money or goods, to help achieve or provide something
example: Everyone was asked to contribute ideas.
exampleAr: طُلب من الجميع المساهمة بأفكار.

definitionEn: a gift or payment that is made to a person or an organization in order to help pay for something
example: Her contribution to the project was significant.
exampleAr: كانت مساهمتها في المشروع كبيرة.

definitionEn: a person who writes articles for a magazine, book or website, or who talks on a radio or television programme or at a meeting
example: He is a regular contributor to the magazine.
exampleAr: إنه مساهم منتظم في المجلة.

definitionEn: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run
example: The pilot lost control of the plane.
exampleAr: فقد الطيار السيطرة على الطائرة.

definitionEn: to have power over a person, company, country, etc. so that you are able to decide what they must do or how it is run
example: She controls the company's finances.
exampleAr: تتحكم في الشؤون المالية للشركة.

definitionEn: causing a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement
example: It was a controversial decision.
exampleAr: كان قرارًا مثيرًا للجدل.

definitionEn: public discussion and argument about something that many people strongly disagree about, think is bad, or are shocked by
example: The plan sparked a lot of controversy.
exampleAr: أثارت الخطة جدلاً كبيرًا.

definitionEn: the quality of being useful, easy or suitable for somebody
example: Online shopping offers great convenience.
exampleAr: يوفر التسوق عبر الإنترنت راحة كبيرة.

definitionEn: useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems
example: Is this a convenient time to talk?
exampleAr: هل هذا وقت مناسب للحديث؟

definitionEn: the way in which something is done that most people in a society expect and consider to be polite or the right way to do it
example: It's a convention to shake hands when meeting someone.
exampleAr: من الأعراف المصافحة عند لقاء شخص ما.

definitionEn: tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
example: They rejected conventional methods of teaching.
exampleAr: رفضوا الأساليب التقليدية في التدريس.

definitionEn: an informal talk involving a small group of people or only two; the activity of talking in this way
example: We had a long conversation about the future.
exampleAr: أجرينا محادثة طويلة عن المستقبل.

definitionEn: the act or process of changing something from one form, use or system to another
example: The conversion of the barn into a house took months.
exampleAr: استغرق تحويل الحظيرة إلى منزل شهورًا.

definitionEn: to change or make something change from one form, purpose, system, etc. to another
example: The app converts files to PDF format.
exampleAr: يُحوّل التطبيق الملفات إلى صيغة PDF.

definitionEn: to make ideas, feelings, etc. known to somebody
example: Her letter conveyed deep gratitude.
exampleAr: نقلت رسالتها امتنانًا عميقًا.

definitionEn: to decide and state officially in court that somebody is guilty of a crime
example: The jury convicted him of theft.
exampleAr: أدانته هيئة المحلفين بالسرقة.

definitionEn: to decide and state officially in court that somebody is guilty of a crime
example: The convict was released after ten years.
exampleAr: أُطلق سراح السجين بعد عشر سنوات.

definitionEn: the act of finding somebody guilty of a crime in court; the fact of having been found guilty
example: He has a previous conviction for fraud.
exampleAr: لديه إدانة سابقة بتهمة الاحتيال.

definitionEn: to make somebody/yourself believe that something is true
example: He convinced her to join the team.
exampleAr: أقنعها بالانضمام إلى الفريق.

definitionEn: completely sure about something
example: I'm convinced she's telling the truth.
exampleAr: أنا مقتنع بأنها تقول الحقيقة.

definitionEn: that makes somebody believe that something is true
example: The lawyer gave a convincing argument.
exampleAr: قدّم المحامي حجة مقنعة.

definitionEn: to prepare food by heating it, for example by boiling, baking or frying it
example: He cooks dinner every night.
exampleAr: يطبخ العشاء كل ليلة.

definitionEn: a person who cooks food or whose job is cooking
example: She works as a cook in a busy restaurant.
exampleAr: تعمل طاهية في مطعم مزدحم.

definitionEn: a large piece of equipment for cooking food, containing an oven and gas or electric rings on top
example: Put the pot on the cooker.
exampleAr: ضع القدر على الموقد.

definitionEn: the process of preparing food by heating it
example: She loves cooking Italian food.
exampleAr: تحب طبخ الطعام الإيطالي.

meaningAr: بارد قليلاً / هادئ الأعصاب / رائع / عصري (عامية)
definitionEn: fairly cold; not hot or warm
example: It's nice and cool in the shade.
exampleAr: الجو لطيف وبارد في الظل.

definitionEn: to become cool or cooler; to make somebody/something become cool or cooler
example: Let the soup cool before serving.
exampleAr: دع الحساء يبرد قبل التقديم.

meaningAr: يتعاون (يعمل مع آخرين لتحقيق هدف مشترك)
definitionEn: to work together with somebody else in order to achieve something
example: The two departments agreed to cooperate on the budget plan.
exampleAr: اتفقت الإدارتان على التعاون بشأن خطة الميزانية.

definitionEn: involving doing something together or working together with others towards a shared aim
example: The staff were cooperative throughout the audit.
exampleAr: كان الموظفون متعاونين طوال عملية التدقيق.

definitionEn: involving doing something together or working together with others towards a shared aim
example: The farmers set up a cooperative to sell their produce.
exampleAr: أسّس المزارعون تعاونية لبيع محصولهم.

meaningAr: ينسق (ينظم عمل عدة أطراف معاً) / يتناسق (يتلاءم من حيث اللون أو التصميم)
definitionEn: to organize the different parts of an activity and the people involved in it so that it works well
example: She coordinates volunteers for the charity event.
exampleAr: تنسّق أعمال المتطوعين في الفعالية الخيرية.

meaningAr: إحداثيات جغرافية (لتحديد موقع على خريطة) / إحداثيات رياضية (نقطة على رسم بياني)
definitionEn: to organize the different parts of an activity and the people involved in it so that it works well
example: Type the coordinates into the GPS device.
exampleAr: أدخل الإحداثيات في جهاز تحديد المواقع (GPS).

meaningAr: تنسيق (تنظيم جهود أطراف مختلفة معاً) / تناسق حركي (انسجام حركات الجسم)
definitionEn: the act of making parts of something, groups of people, etc. work together in an efficient and organized way
example: Good coordination between teams saved a lot of time.
exampleAr: وفّر التنسيق الجيد بين الفرق الكثير من الوقت.

meaningAr: منسّق (شخص مسؤول عن تنظيم نشاط أو مجموعة)
definitionEn: a person who organizes the different parts of an activity and the people involved in it so that it works well
example: She was hired as the volunteer coordinator.
exampleAr: تم تعيينها منسّقة للمتطوعين.

definitionEn: a police officer
example: A cop was directing traffic at the intersection.
exampleAr: كان شرطي ينظّم حركة المرور عند التقاطع.

meaningAr: يتحمل / يتأقلم (يتعامل بنجاح مع موقف أو ضغط صعب)
definitionEn: to deal successfully with something difficult
example: It's hard to cope with so much stress at once.
exampleAr: من الصعب التأقلم مع هذا القدر الكبير من الضغط دفعة واحدة.

meaningAr: نحاس (فلز أحمر اللون موصل للكهرباء) / شرطي (تعبير عامي بريطاني)
definitionEn: a chemical element. Copper is a soft red-brown metal used for making electric wires, pipes and coins.
example: The pipes in old houses are often made of copper.
exampleAr: كثيراً ما تُصنع الأنابيب في المنازل القديمة من النحاس.

meaningAr: نسخة (مطابقة لأصل ما) / نص إعلاني أو صحفي (مادة مكتوبة معدة للنشر)
definitionEn: a thing that is made to be the same as something else, especially a document or a work of art
example: I made a copy of the contract for my records.
exampleAr: أخذتُ نسخة من العقد لأحتفظ بها في سجلاتي.

meaningAr: ينسخ (يعيد إنتاج نفس الشيء) / يقلّد (يحاكي تصرفات أو أسلوب شخص آخر)
definitionEn: to make something that is exactly like something else
example: Copy the file onto a USB drive.
exampleAr: انسخ الملف إلى ذاكرة USB.

meaningAr: حقوق النشر أو التأليف (الحق القانوني في عمل إبداعي)
definitionEn: if a person or an organization holds the copyright on a piece of writing, music, etc., they are the only people who have the legal right to publish, broadcast, perform it, etc., and other people must ask their permission to use it or any part of it
example: You can't use the song without permission because of copyright.
exampleAr: لا يمكنك استخدام الأغنية دون إذن بسبب حقوق النشر.

meaningAr: نواة / لب (الجزء المركزي الداخلي لشيء) / قلب الفاكهة (الجزء الصلب الداخلي كما في التفاح)
definitionEn: the most important or central part of something
example: Scientists study the heat of the Earth's core.
exampleAr: يدرس العلماء حرارة نواة الأرض.

meaningAr: أساسي / جوهري (يمثل الجزء الرئيسي أو الأهم)
definitionEn: most important; main or essential
example: Respect is one of our core values as a team.
exampleAr: يُعدّ الاحترام إحدى قيمنا الأساسية كفريق.

meaningAr: زاوية الشارع (تقاطع طريقين) / حافة أو ركن سطح / ضربة ركنية (في كرة القدم)
definitionEn: a part of something where two or more sides, lines or edges join
example: The café is just around the corner.
exampleAr: يقع المقهى عند الزاوية مباشرة.

meaningAr: يحاصر (يجبر شخصاً أو حيواناً على التوقف بلا مهرب)
definitionEn: a part of something where two or more sides, lines or edges join
example: The dog cornered the cat behind the fence.
exampleAr: حاصر الكلبُ القطةَ خلف السياج.

meaningAr: خاص بالشركات (متعلق بشركة كبيرة أو عالم الأعمال)
definitionEn: connected with a large business company
example: The building houses the company's corporate headquarters.
exampleAr: يضم المبنى المقر الرئيسي للشركة.

definitionEn: a large business company
example: He works for a large multinational corporation.
exampleAr: يعمل في شركة كبرى متعددة الجنسيات.

definitionEn: accurate or true, without any mistakes
example: Make sure all the figures in the report are correct.
exampleAr: تأكّد من أن جميع الأرقام في التقرير صحيحة.

definitionEn: to make something right or accurate, for example by changing it or removing mistakes
example: The teacher corrected the students' essays.
exampleAr: صحّح المعلم مقالات الطلاب.

definitionEn: a change that makes something more accurate than it was before
example: The editor made several corrections to the article.
exampleAr: أجرى المحرر عدة تصحيحات على المقال.

definitionEn: in a way that is accurate or true, without any mistakes
example: Did I spell your name correctly?
exampleAr: هل تهجّأتُ اسمك بشكل صحيح؟

meaningAr: يرتبط (يتغير بشكل مرتبط مع شيء آخر)
definitionEn: if two or more facts, figures, etc. correlate or if a fact, figure, etc. correlates with another, the facts are closely connected and affect or depend on each other
example: Higher education levels often correlate with higher income.
exampleAr: غالباً ما ترتبط المستويات التعليمية العالية بدخل أعلى.

definitionEn: a connection between two things in which one thing changes as the other does
example: The study found a correlation between diet and heart disease.
exampleAr: وجدت الدراسة ارتباطاً بين النظام الغذائي وأمراض القلب.

meaningAr: يتوافق / يطابق (يتماثل مع شيء آخر) / يتراسل (يتبادل الرسائل مع شخص)
definitionEn: to be the same as or match something
example: The numbers on the map correspond to locations on the list.
exampleAr: تتوافق الأرقام على الخريطة مع المواقع الواردة في القائمة.

definitionEn: the letters, emails, etc. a person sends and receives
example: All correspondence should be sent to this address.
exampleAr: ينبغي إرسال جميع المراسلات إلى هذا العنوان.

meaningAr: مراسل (صحفي يغطي أخباراً من مكان معين)
definitionEn: a person who reports news from a particular country or on a particular subject for a newspaper or a television or radio station
example: Our correspondent in Paris filed this report.
exampleAr: أعدّ مراسلنا في باريس هذا التقرير.

definitionEn: matching or connected with something that you have just mentioned
example: Each question has a corresponding answer on the next page.
exampleAr: لكل سؤال إجابة مقابلة له في الصفحة التالية.

definitionEn: a long narrow passage in a building, with doors that open into rooms on either side
example: His office is at the end of the corridor.
exampleAr: يقع مكتبه في نهاية الممر.

meaningAr: فاسد (يستغل السلطة لمصلحة شخصية غير مشروعة)
definitionEn: willing to use their power to do dishonest or illegal things in return for money or to get an advantage
example: The report accused several corrupt officials of bribery.
exampleAr: اتهم التقرير عدة مسؤولين فاسدين بتلقي الرشاوى.

meaningAr: يفسد (يفقد النزاهة، غير متعدٍ) / يُفسد (بياناً أو نظاماً، متعدٍ)
definitionEn: willing to use their power to do dishonest or illegal things in return for money or to get an advantage
example: Power can corrupt even well-intentioned leaders.
exampleAr: قد تُفسد السلطة حتى القادة حسني النية.

meaningAr: فساد (سوء استخدام السلطة لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية)
definitionEn: dishonest or illegal behaviour, especially of people in authority
example: The new government promised to fight corruption.
exampleAr: وعدت الحكومة الجديدة بمكافحة الفساد.

definitionEn: the amount of money that you need in order to buy, make or do something
example: The cost of living has risen sharply this year.
exampleAr: ارتفعت تكلفة المعيشة بشكل حاد هذا العام.

meaningAr: يكلّف (يتطلب دفع مبلغ معين) / يكلّف (يتسبب بخسارة غير مالية)
definitionEn: if something costs a particular amount of money, you need to pay that amount in order to buy, make or do it
example: The repairs cost more than we expected.
exampleAr: كلّفت الإصلاحات أكثر مما توقعنا.

meaningAr: مكلف / باهظ الثمن (يتطلب مالاً أو جهداً كبيراً)
definitionEn: costing a lot of money, especially more than you want to pay
example: Fixing the roof turned out to be very costly.
exampleAr: تبيّن أن إصلاح السقف كان مكلفاً جداً.

meaningAr: زي (ملابس تُلبس للتنكر أو في المسرح)
definitionEn: the clothes worn by people from a particular place or during a particular historical period
example: She wore a witch costume for Halloween.
exampleAr: ارتدت زي ساحرة في عيد الهالوين.

definitionEn: a small house, especially in the country
example: They rented a cottage by the lake for the summer.
exampleAr: استأجروا كوخاً بجانب البحيرة لقضاء الصيف.

definitionEn: a plant grown in warm countries for the soft white hairs around its seeds that are used to make cloth and thread
example: Cotton is grown widely in hot, dry climates.
exampleAr: يُزرع القطن على نطاق واسع في المناخات الحارة والجافة.

meaningAr: فعل مساعد يفيد القدرة في الماضي / فعل مساعد للطلب المؤدب / فعل مساعد يفيد الاحتمال
definitionEn: used as the past tense of ‘can’
example: She could swim before she was five.
exampleAr: كانت تستطيع السباحة قبل أن تبلغ الخامسة.

meaningAr: مجلس منتخب (بلدي أو محلي) / مجلس معيّن (استشاري)
definitionEn: a group of people who are elected to govern an area such as a city or county
example: The city council approved the new budget.
exampleAr: أقرّ المجلس البلدي الميزانية الجديدة.

definitionEn: a member of a city or county council
example: She was elected as a local councillor.
exampleAr: انتُخبت عضواً في المجلس المحلي.

definitionEn: professional advice about a problem
example: He's receiving counselling to help with his anxiety.
exampleAr: يتلقى إرشاداً نفسياً للمساعدة في التعامل مع قلقه.

definitionEn: a person who has been trained to advise people with problems, especially personal problems
example: The school counsellor spoke with the students about stress.
exampleAr: تحدث مرشد المدرسة مع الطلاب عن التوتر.

meaningAr: يعدّ (يحسب عدداً) / يُحتسب / له أهمية (يعتبر ذا قيمة أو صحيحاً)
definitionEn: to say numbers in the correct order
example: She counted the coins one by one.
exampleAr: عدّت القطع النقدية واحدة تلو الأخرى.

definitionEn: an act of counting to find the total number of somebody/something
example: The final count showed 300 votes in favor.
exampleAr: أظهر الإحصاء النهائي 300 صوت مؤيد.

meaningAr: منضدة / طاولة عرض (في متجر أو مطبخ)
definitionEn: a long flat surface over which goods are sold or business is done in a shop, bank, etc.
example: She placed the bag on the kitchen counter.
exampleAr: وضعت الحقيبة على منضدة المطبخ.

definitionEn: to reply to somebody by trying to prove that what they said is not true
example: The company countered the criticism with new data.
exampleAr: ردّت الشركة على الانتقادات ببيانات جديدة.

meaningAr: نظير (شخص أو شيء يشغل نفس الدور في مكان آخر)
definitionEn: a person or thing that has the same position or function as somebody/something else in a different place or situation
example: The minister met with her counterpart from the neighboring country.
exampleAr: التقت الوزيرة بنظيرتها من الدولة المجاورة.

definitionEn: very many; too many to be counted or mentioned
example: I've told him countless times to be careful.
exampleAr: طلبتُ منه أن يتوخى الحذر مرات لا تُحصى.

definitionEn: an area of land that has or used to have its own government and laws
example: France is a beautiful country to visit.
exampleAr: فرنسا بلد جميل تستحق الزيارة.

definitionEn: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, etc.
example: We spent the weekend walking in the countryside.
exampleAr: أمضينا عطلة نهاية الأسبوع نتمشى في الريف.

meaningAr: مقاطعة (وحدة إدارية داخل دولة أو ولاية)
definitionEn: one of a number of areas that some countries are divided into, each with its own local government
example: Yorkshire is the largest county in England.
exampleAr: يوركشاير أكبر مقاطعة في إنجلترا.

definitionEn: a sudden change of government that is illegal and often violent
example: The military staged a coup and seized control of the government.
exampleAr: نفّذ الجيش انقلاباً واستولى على مقاليد الحكم.

definitionEn: two people or things
example: A young couple was walking hand in hand.
exampleAr: كان زوجان شابان يسيران ممسكين بأيدي بعضهما.

meaningAr: يقترن (يرتبط أو يجتمع مع شيء آخر)
definitionEn: two people or things
example: Low pay, coupled with long hours, led many to quit.
exampleAr: دفع تدني الأجور، مقترناً بطول ساعات العمل، كثيرين إلى الاستقالة.

definitionEn: the ability to do something dangerous, or to face pain or opposition, without showing fear
example: It took a lot of courage to speak up in front of everyone.
exampleAr: تطلّب الأمر شجاعة كبيرة للتحدث أمام الجميع.

meaningAr: دورة (تعليمية) / مسار / مجرى (اتجاه حركة شيء) / طبق (جزء من وجبة)
definitionEn: a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject
example: She's taking a course in graphic design.
exampleAr: تلتحق بدورة في التصميم الجرافيكي.

meaningAr: محكمة / ملعب (لبعض الرياضات كالتنس وكرة السلة)
definitionEn: the place where legal trials take place and where crimes, etc. are judged
example: The case will go to court next month.
exampleAr: ستُعرض القضية على المحكمة الشهر المقبل.

meaningAr: يسعى لكسب دعم أو ود (جهة أو رأي عام) / يغازل / يسعى لكسب ود (شخص، رومانسياً)
definitionEn: the place where legal trials take place and where crimes, etc. are judged
example: The company is courting investors for its new project.
exampleAr: تسعى الشركة لاستمالة المستثمرين لمشروعها الجديد.

definitionEn: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people
example: He held the door open as a courtesy to the elderly woman.
exampleAr: أمسك الباب مفتوحاً من باب اللياقة تجاه السيدة المسنّة.

definitionEn: a child of your aunt or uncle
example: My cousin is visiting us from Canada next week.
exampleAr: سيزورنا ابن عمي من كندا الأسبوع المقبل.

meaningAr: يغطي (يضع شيئاً فوق آخر لحمايته) / يستر / يخفي / يتناول (موضوعاً في تقرير أو درس) / يغطي (يكفي لدفع تكلفة)
definitionEn: to place something over or in front of something in order to hide, protect or decorate it
example: She covered the baby with a warm blanket.
exampleAr: غطّت الطفل ببطانية دافئة.

meaningAr: غطاء (شيء يوضع فوق آخر) / غلاف (لكتاب أو مجلة)
definitionEn: a thing that is put over or on another thing, usually to protect it or to decorate it
example: Put the cover back on the pot.
exampleAr: أعد الغطاء إلى القدر.

definitionEn: the reporting of news and sport in the media
example: The election received extensive media coverage.
exampleAr: حظيت الانتخابات بتغطية إعلامية واسعة.

definitionEn: having a layer or amount of something on it
example: The ground was covered in snow.
exampleAr: كانت الأرض مغطاة بالثلج.

definitionEn: a large animal kept on farms to produce milk or beef
example: The farmer milks the cows every morning.
exampleAr: يحلب المزارع الأبقار كل صباح.

definitionEn: to break without dividing into separate parts; to break something in this way
example: The ice began to crack under his weight.
exampleAr: بدأ الجليد يتشقق تحت ثقله.

definitionEn: a line on the surface of something where it has broken but not split into separate parts
example: There's a crack in the wall.
exampleAr: يوجد شق في الجدار.

definitionEn: an activity involving a special skill at making things with your hands
example: Pottery is a traditional craft in this village.
exampleAr: صناعة الفخار حرفة تقليدية في هذه القرية.

definitionEn: to make something using special skills, especially with your hands
example: The team carefully crafted a new strategy.
exampleAr: صاغ الفريق استراتيجية جديدة بعناية فائقة.

meaningAr: يتحطم / يصطدم / يتعطل فجأة (نظام حاسوب أو برنامج) / ينهار (سوق مالي)
definitionEn: if a vehicle crashes or the driver crashes it, it hits an object or another vehicle, causing damage
example: The car crashed into a tree.
exampleAr: اصطدمت السيارة بشجرة.

definitionEn: an accident in which a vehicle hits something, for example another vehicle, usually causing damage and often injuring or killing the passengers
example: Three people were injured in the crash.
exampleAr: أُصيب ثلاثة أشخاص في حادث التصادم.

definitionEn: to move forward on your hands and knees or with your body close to the ground
example: The baby crawled across the floor.
exampleAr: زحف الطفل عبر الأرضية.

meaningAr: مجنون / جنوني (غريب أو غير معقول) / مهووس بشيء (عامية)
definitionEn: not sensible; stupid
example: It's crazy how fast time passes.
exampleAr: من الجنون كيف يمر الوقت بهذه السرعة.

definitionEn: the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid that rises to the top of milk, used in cooking or as a type of sauce to put on fruit, etc.
example: He added a spoon of cream to his coffee.
exampleAr: أضاف ملعقة من القشدة إلى قهوته.

definitionEn: between yellow and white in colour
example: She wore a cream dress to the wedding.
exampleAr: ارتدت فستاناً بلون كريمي في حفل الزفاف.

meaningAr: يخلق / ينشئ (يصنع شيئاً جديداً) / يحدث / يولّد (يتسبب في نشوء شيء كفرصة أو مشكلة)
definitionEn: to make something happen or exist
example: The artist created a beautiful mural on the wall.
exampleAr: أبدع الفنان جدارية جميلة على الحائط.

meaningAr: إنشاء / خلق (عملية صنع شيء جديد) / إبداع / عمل مبتكر (الشيء الذي تم صنعه)
definitionEn: the act or process of making something that is new, or of causing something to exist that did not exist before
example: The creation of the new department took months of planning.
exampleAr: استغرق إنشاء القسم الجديد أشهراً من التخطيط.

definitionEn: involving the use of skill and the imagination to produce something new or a work of art
example: She has a very creative approach to problem-solving.
exampleAr: تتبع أسلوباً إبداعياً جداً في حل المشكلات.

definitionEn: the use of skill and imagination to produce something new or to produce art
example: The workshop is designed to boost employees' creativity.
exampleAr: صُممت ورشة العمل لتعزيز إبداع الموظفين.

definitionEn: a person who has made or invented a particular thing
example: He is the creator of one of the most popular apps.
exampleAr: هو مبدع أحد أكثر التطبيقات شعبية.

definitionEn: a living thing, real or imaginary, that can move around, such as an animal
example: The documentary showed strange creatures living deep in the ocean.
exampleAr: عرض الفيلم الوثائقي مخلوقات غريبة تعيش في أعماق المحيط.

definitionEn: the quality that somebody/something has that makes people believe or trust them
example: The scandal damaged the politician's credibility.
exampleAr: أضرّت الفضيحة بمصداقية السياسي.

definitionEn: that can be believed or trusted
example: We need credible evidence before making an accusation.
exampleAr: نحتاج إلى أدلة موثوقة قبل توجيه أي اتهام.

meaningAr: ائتمان / دين (تسهيلات مالية) / فضل / تقدير (الاعتراف بإنجاز شخص)
definitionEn: an arrangement that you make, with a shop for example, to pay later for something you buy
example: She paid for the trip using credit.
exampleAr: دفعت تكلفة الرحلة عن طريق الائتمان.

definitionEn: to add an amount of money to somebody’s bank account
example: The success is credited to the whole team's hard work.
exampleAr: يُنسب هذا النجاح إلى الجهد الكبير الذي بذله الفريق بأكمله.

definitionEn: to move slowly, quietly and carefully, because you do not want to be seen or heard
example: Fear began to creep into her voice.
exampleAr: بدأ الخوف يتسلل إلى صوتها.

meaningAr: طاقم (سفينة أو طائرة) / طاقم (تصوير أو إنتاج)
definitionEn: all the people working on a ship, plane, etc.
example: The ship's crew worked together to repair the damaged sail.
exampleAr: عمل طاقم السفينة معاً على إصلاح الشراع التالف.

definitionEn: activities that involve breaking the law
example: Crime rates have dropped in the city center.
exampleAr: انخفضت معدلات الجريمة في وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: a person who commits a crime
example: The criminal was arrested a week after the robbery.
exampleAr: قُبض على المجرم بعد أسبوع من السرقة.

definitionEn: connected with or involving crime
example: He was charged with criminal activity.
exampleAr: وُجّهت إليه تهمة ممارسة نشاط إجرامي.

definitionEn: a time of great danger, difficulty or doubt when problems must be solved or important decisions must be made
example: The country is facing a serious economic crisis.
exampleAr: تواجه البلاد أزمة اقتصادية خطيرة.

definitionEn: a standard or principle by which something is judged, or with the help of which a decision is made
example: Originality was the main criterion the judges used to pick a winner.
exampleAr: كانت الأصالة المعيار الرئيسي الذي اعتمده الحكام لاختيار الفائز.

definitionEn: a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, music, etc.
example: The film critic gave the movie a poor review.
exampleAr: أعطى ناقد الأفلام الفيلم تقييماً ضعيفاً.

definitionEn: saying what you think is bad about somebody/something
example: The next few hours are critical for the patient's recovery.
exampleAr: الساعات القليلة القادمة حرجة بالنسبة لتعافي المريض.

meaningAr: بشكل حرج / خطير / بشكل نقدي (بتحليل ودقة)
definitionEn: in a way that says what you think is bad about somebody/something
example: He was critically injured in the accident.
exampleAr: أُصيب بجروح خطيرة في الحادث.

definitionEn: the act of expressing disapproval of somebody/something and opinions about their faults or bad qualities; a statement showing this disapproval
example: The new policy has faced a lot of criticism.
exampleAr: واجهت السياسة الجديدة الكثير من النقد.

definitionEn: to say that you think somebody/something is bad; to say what you do not like or think is wrong about somebody/something
example: The plan was criticized for being too expensive.
exampleAr: انتُقدت الخطة لكونها باهظة التكلفة.

definitionEn: a piece of written criticism of a set of ideas, a work of art, etc.
example: The professor wrote a detailed critique of the paper.
exampleAr: كتب الأستاذ نقداً مفصلاً للبحث.

definitionEn: a piece of written criticism of a set of ideas, a work of art, etc.
example: The panel critiqued each design carefully.
exampleAr: نقدت اللجنة كل تصميم بعناية فائقة.

definitionEn: a plant that is grown in large quantities, especially as food
example: Farmers lost most of their crop to the drought.
exampleAr: خسر المزارعون معظم محصولهم بسبب الجفاف.

definitionEn: a plant that is grown in large quantities, especially as food
example: She cropped the photo to remove the background.
exampleAr: قصّت الصورة لإزالة الخلفية.

definitionEn: to go across; to pass or stretch from one side to the other
example: Look both ways before you cross the street.
exampleAr: انظر في الاتجاهين قبل أن تعبر الشارع.

definitionEn: a mark or an object formed by two lines crossing each other (X or +); the mark (X) is often used on paper to show something
example: She wore a small gold cross around her neck.
exampleAr: ارتدت صليباً ذهبياً صغيراً حول عنقها.

definitionEn: a mark or an object formed by two lines crossing each other (X or +); the mark (X) is often used on paper to show something
example: He looked cross when I arrived late.
exampleAr: بدا غاضباً عندما وصلتُ متأخراً.

definitionEn: a large number of people gathered together in a public place, for example in the streets or at a sports game
example: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium.
exampleAr: تجمّع حشد كبير خارج الملعب.

definitionEn: a large number of people gathered together in a public place, for example in the streets or at a sports game
example: Fans crowded around the singer after the show.
exampleAr: ازدحم المعجبون حول المغني بعد العرض.

definitionEn: having a lot of people or too many people
example: The train was too crowded to find a seat.
exampleAr: كان القطار مزدحماً جداً بحيث تعذّر إيجاد مقعد.

definitionEn: an object in the shape of a circle, usually made of gold and precious stones, that a king or queen wears on his or her head on official occasions
example: The queen wore a golden crown.
exampleAr: ارتدت الملكة تاجاً ذهبياً.

definitionEn: an object in the shape of a circle, usually made of gold and precious stones, that a king or queen wears on his or her head on official occasions
example: He was crowned champion after winning the final match.
exampleAr: تُوِّج بطلاً بعد فوزه في المباراة النهائية.

definitionEn: extremely important, because it will affect other things
example: Getting enough sleep is crucial for good health.
exampleAr: النوم الكافي أمر حاسم للصحة الجيدة.

meaningAr: خام (غير مكرر أو معالج) / فظ / بذيء (غير مهذب)
definitionEn: in its natural state, before it has been processed or refined
example: Crude oil prices rose sharply this week.
exampleAr: ارتفعت أسعار النفط الخام بشكل حاد هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: having a desire to cause physical or mental pain and make somebody suffer
example: It seems cruel to keep the dog locked up all day.
exampleAr: يبدو قاسياً أن يُحبَس الكلب طوال اليوم.

definitionEn: a journey by sea, visiting different places, especially as a holiday
example: They went on a cruise around the Mediterranean.
exampleAr: قاموا برحلة بحرية حول البحر الأبيض المتوسط.

meaningAr: يبحر برحلة سياحية / يسير بسرعة ثابتة
definitionEn: to travel in a ship or boat visiting different places, especially as a holiday
example: The ship cruised slowly along the coast.
exampleAr: أبحرت السفينة ببطء على طول الساحل.

definitionEn: to press something so hard that it is damaged or injured, or loses its shape
example: The machine crushes the cans before recycling them.
exampleAr: تسحق الآلة العلب قبل إعادة تدويرها.

definitionEn: to press something so hard that it is damaged or injured, or loses its shape
example: She's had a crush on him since school.
exampleAr: أُعجبت به إعجاباً عابراً منذ أيام المدرسة.

definitionEn: to produce tears from your eyes because you are unhappy or hurt
example: The baby started to cry when she woke up.
exampleAr: بدأت الرضيعة تبكي عندما استيقظت.

definitionEn: a loud sound without words that expresses a strong feeling
example: She let out a cry of relief.
exampleAr: أطلقت صرخة ارتياح.

definitionEn: a small piece of a substance with many even sides, that is formed naturally when the substance becomes solid
example: Salt forms small crystals when it dries.
exampleAr: يشكّل الملح بلورات صغيرة عند جفافه.

definitionEn: an action or event that is a signal for somebody to do something
example: The actor waited for his cue to enter the stage.
exampleAr: انتظر الممثل إشارته لدخول خشبة المسرح.

definitionEn: an action or event that is a signal for somebody to do something
example: The director cued the music to start.
exampleAr: أعطى المخرج إشارة ببدء الموسيقى.

meaningAr: طائفة دينية / تعصب لشخص أو فكرة (خارج السياق الديني) / ظاهرة شعبية محدودة (أتباع متحمسون)
definitionEn: a way of life, an attitude, an idea, etc. that has become very popular
example: The documentary investigated a religious cult.
exampleAr: حقق الفيلم الوثائقي في طائفة دينية.

definitionEn: to prepare and use land for growing plants or crops
example: Farmers cultivate rice in these fields.
exampleAr: يزرع المزارعون الأرز في هذه الحقول.

definitionEn: connected with the culture of a particular society or group, its customs, beliefs, etc.
example: The festival celebrates the region's cultural heritage.
exampleAr: يحتفي المهرجان بالتراث الثقافي للمنطقة.

definitionEn: the customs and beliefs, art, way of life and social organization of a particular country or group
example: Learning the language helped her understand the local culture better.
exampleAr: ساعدها تعلم اللغة على فهم الثقافة المحلية بشكل أفضل.

definitionEn: a small container that is like a bowl in shape, usually with a handle, used for drinking tea, coffee, etc.
example: He poured himself a cup of tea.
exampleAr: صبّ لنفسه فنجاناً من الشاي.

definitionEn: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves used for storing dishes, food, clothes, etc.
example: The plates are kept in the kitchen cupboard.
exampleAr: تُحفظ الأطباق في خزانة المطبخ.

definitionEn: a medicine or medical treatment that cures an illness
example: Scientists are still searching for a cure for the disease.
exampleAr: لا يزال العلماء يبحثون عن علاج لهذا المرض.

definitionEn: to make a person or an animal healthy again after an illness
example: The new drug cured most patients within weeks.
exampleAr: شفى الدواء الجديد معظم المرضى خلال أسابيع.

definitionEn: a strong desire to know about something
example: Her curiosity led her to explore the abandoned house.
exampleAr: دفعها فضولها إلى استكشاف المنزل المهجور.

definitionEn: having a strong desire to know about something
example: The children were curious about the strange noise.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال فضوليين حيال الضجيج الغريب.

definitionEn: having a lot of curls or a curved shape
example: She has long, curly hair.
exampleAr: لديها شعر طويل ومجعد.

definitionEn: the system of money that a country uses
example: The euro is the currency used in most of the EU.
exampleAr: اليورو هو العملة المستخدمة في معظم دول الاتحاد الأوروبي.

definitionEn: happening now; of the present time
example: What is your current address?
exampleAr: ما هو عنوانك الحالي؟

definitionEn: the movement of water in the sea or a river; the movement of air in a particular direction
example: The swimmers struggled against the strong current.
exampleAr: كافح السباحون ضد التيار المائي القوي.

definitionEn: at the present time
example: She is currently studying abroad.
exampleAr: هي تدرس حالياً في الخارج.

definitionEn: the subjects that are included in a course of study or taught in a school, college, etc.
example: The school updated its curriculum to include coding classes.
exampleAr: حدّثت المدرسة منهجها الدراسي ليشمل دروساً في البرمجة.

definitionEn: a piece of cloth that is hung to cover a window
example: She closed the curtains before going to bed.
exampleAr: أغلقت الستائر قبل الذهاب إلى النوم.

definitionEn: a line or surface that bends gradually; a smooth bend
example: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
exampleAr: يوجد منحنى حاد في الطريق أمامك.

definitionEn: to move or make something move in the shape of a curve; to be in the shape of a curve
example: The path curves around the lake.
exampleAr: يتقوس المسار حول البحيرة.

definitionEn: having a round shape
example: The building has a curved glass front.
exampleAr: يمتلك المبنى واجهة زجاجية منحنية.

definitionEn: the legal right or duty to take care of or keep somebody/something; the act of taking care of something/somebody
example: After the divorce, she was granted custody of the children.
exampleAr: مُنحت حضانة الأطفال بعد الطلاق.

definitionEn: an accepted way of behaving or of doing things in a society or a community
example: It's a local custom to remove your shoes before entering a home.
exampleAr: من العادات المحلية خلع الحذاء قبل دخول المنزل.

definitionEn: a person or an organization that buys goods or services from a shop or business
example: The store always tries to keep its customers happy.
exampleAr: يحاول المتجر دائماً إبقاء زبائنه راضين.

meaningAr: يقطع / يخفّض (يقلل من كمية أو مدة)
definitionEn: to make an opening or a wound in something, especially with a sharp tool such as a knife or scissors
example: She cut the cake into eight pieces.
exampleAr: قطّعت الكعكة إلى ثماني قطع.

definitionEn: a wound caused by something sharp
example: He had a small cut on his finger.
exampleAr: كان لديه جرح صغير في إصبعه.

definitionEn: pretty and attractive
example: The puppy looked really cute in its little sweater.
exampleAr: بدا الجرو لطيفاً جداً بسترته الصغيرة.

definitionEn: an article or a story that you cut from a newspaper or magazine and keep
example: He made a cutting remark about her work.
exampleAr: أطلق تعليقاً لاذعاً عن عملها.

definitionEn: an article or a story that you cut from a newspaper or magazine and keep
example: She kept a newspaper cutting about the event.
exampleAr: احتفظت بقصاصة صحفية عن الحدث.

definitionEn: a bicycle or motorcycle
example: The water cycle includes evaporation and rainfall.
exampleAr: تشمل دورة الماء التبخر وهطول الأمطار.

definitionEn: to ride a bicycle; to travel by bicycle
example: They cycled through the countryside all afternoon.
exampleAr: ركبوا دراجاتهم عبر الريف طوال بعد الظهر.

definitionEn: believing that people only do things to help themselves rather than for good or honest reasons
example: He's become quite cynical about politicians' promises.
exampleAr: أصبح متشائماً جداً تجاه وعود السياسيين.

meaningAr: أبي / بابا (تعبير غير رسمي عن الأب)
definitionEn: father
example: My dad picks me up from school every day.
exampleAr: بابا يقلّني من المدرسة كل يوم.

definitionEn: happening, done or produced every day
example: She reads the daily newspaper over breakfast.
exampleAr: تقرأ الجريدة اليومية أثناء تناول الفطور.

definitionEn: every day
example: The medication should be taken twice daily.
exampleAr: يجب تناول الدواء مرتين يومياً.

definitionEn: milk, cheese and other milk products
example: He's allergic to dairy, so he avoids milk and cheese.
exampleAr: لديه حساسية من الألبان، لذا يتجنب الحليب والجبن.

definitionEn: made from milk
example: They run a small dairy farm in the countryside.
exampleAr: يديرون مزرعة ألبان صغيرة في الريف.

definitionEn: a barrier that is built across a river in order to stop the water from flowing, used especially to make a reservoir (= a lake for storing water) or to produce electricity
example: The dam provides electricity for the entire region.
exampleAr: يوفر السد الكهرباء لكامل المنطقة.

definitionEn: a barrier that is built across a river in order to stop the water from flowing, used especially to make a reservoir (= a lake for storing water) or to produce electricity
example: Engineers dammed the river to create a reservoir.
exampleAr: بنى المهندسون سداً على النهر لإنشاء خزان مياه.

definitionEn: physical harm caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful or valuable
example: The storm caused severe damage to the coastline.
exampleAr: تسببت العاصفة بأضرار جسيمة للساحل.

definitionEn: to have a bad or harmful effect on something/somebody
example: The scandal damaged his reputation.
exampleAr: أضرّت الفضيحة بسمعته.

definitionEn: causing damage; having a bad effect on somebody/something
example: The report had a damaging effect on the company's image.
exampleAr: كان للتقرير أثر ضار على صورة الشركة.

definitionEn: to move your body to the sound and rhythm of music
example: They danced all night at the wedding.
exampleAr: رقصوا طوال الليل في حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: a series of movements and steps that are usually performed to music; a particular example of these movements and steps
example: The couple's first dance was to their favorite song.
exampleAr: كانت رقصة العروسين الأولى على أغنيتهما المفضلة.

definitionEn: a person who dances or whose job is dancing
example: She's been a professional dancer for ten years.
exampleAr: تعمل راقصة محترفة منذ عشر سنوات.

definitionEn: moving your body to music
example: Dancing is her favorite way to exercise.
exampleAr: الرقص هو طريقتها المفضلة لممارسة الرياضة.
