definitionEn: the possibility of something happening that will injure, harm or kill somebody, or damage or destroy something
example: The hikers were warned of the danger of sudden storms.
exampleAr: حُذّر المتنزهون من خطر العواصف المفاجئة.

definitionEn: likely to injure or harm somebody, or to damage or destroy something
example: Swimming in that river can be dangerous.
exampleAr: قد تكون السباحة في ذلك النهر أمراً خطيراً.

definitionEn: to be brave enough to do something
example: She didn't dare to speak up in the meeting.
exampleAr: لم تجرؤ على التحدث في الاجتماع.

definitionEn: to be brave enough to do something
example: He accepted the dare and jumped into the cold lake.
exampleAr: قبل التحدي وقفز إلى البحيرة الباردة.

definitionEn: with no or very little light, especially because it is night
example: It gets dark very early in winter.
exampleAr: يحل الظلام مبكراً جداً في الشتاء.

definitionEn: the lack of light in a place, especially because it is night
example: The children were afraid of the dark.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال يخافون من الظلام.

definitionEn: the state of being dark, without any light
example: The power cut left the whole street in darkness.
exampleAr: ترك انقطاع الكهرباء الشارع بأكمله في ظلام دامس.

definitionEn: facts or information, especially when examined and used to find out things or to make decisions
example: The scientists collected data over several years.
exampleAr: جمع العلماء بيانات على مدى عدة سنوات.

definitionEn: an organized set of data that is stored in a computer and can be looked at and used in various ways
example: All customer information is stored in the database.
exampleAr: تُخزَّن جميع معلومات العملاء في قاعدة البيانات.

meaningAr: تاريخ (يوم من الشهر) / موعد غرامي / تمر (فاكهة)
definitionEn: a particular day of the month, sometimes in a particular year, given in numbers and words
example: What's the date of the meeting?
exampleAr: ما هو تاريخ الاجتماع؟

definitionEn: to write or print the date on something
example: They've been dating for almost a year.
exampleAr: ما زالا يتواعدان منذ قرابة عام.

definitionEn: a person’s female child
example: Their daughter just started university.
exampleAr: بدأت ابنتهما لتوها الدراسة الجامعية.

definitionEn: the time of day when light first appears
example: We left the hotel before dawn to catch the sunrise.
exampleAr: غادرنا الفندق قبل الفجر لنشهد شروق الشمس.

definitionEn: a period of 24 hours
example: I'll see you in three days.
exampleAr: سأراك بعد ثلاثة أيام.

definitionEn: no longer alive
example: The plant has been dead for weeks.
exampleAr: النبتة ميتة منذ أسابيع.

definitionEn: a point in time by which something must be done
example: The deadline for submitting the report is Friday.
exampleAr: الموعد النهائي لتسليم التقرير هو يوم الجمعة.

definitionEn: causing or likely to cause death
example: The snake's bite can be deadly.
exampleAr: قد تكون لدغة هذا الثعبان مميتة.

definitionEn: an agreement, especially in business, on particular conditions for buying or doing something
example: The two companies signed a deal worth millions.
exampleAr: وقّعت الشركتان صفقة بملايين الدولارات.

meaningAr: يتعامل / يتصرف (مع مشكلة أو موقف) / يتاجر
definitionEn: to give cards to each player in a game of cards
example: She had to deal with an angry customer.
exampleAr: اضطرت إلى التعامل مع زبون غاضب.

definitionEn: a person whose business is buying and selling a particular product
example: He's a used-car dealer.
exampleAr: هو تاجر سيارات مستعملة.

definitionEn: used at the beginning of a letter before the name or title of the person that you are writing to
example: She's a dear friend of mine.
exampleAr: إنها صديقة عزيزة لي.

definitionEn: the fact of somebody dying or being killed
example: His death was a shock to everyone who knew him.
exampleAr: كانت وفاته صدمة لكل من عرفه.

definitionEn: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposite views and then there is often a vote on the issue.
example: There was a heated debate about the new policy.
exampleAr: دار نقاش حاد حول السياسة الجديدة.

definitionEn: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution
example: The candidates debated for two hours on live television.
exampleAr: تناقش المرشحون لمدة ساعتين على الهواء مباشرة.

definitionEn: pieces of wood, metal, building materials, etc. that are left after something has been destroyed
example: Debris from the crash was scattered across the road.
exampleAr: تناثر حطام الحادث على الطريق.

definitionEn: a sum of money that somebody owes
example: The company is struggling to pay off its debt.
exampleAr: تكافح الشركة لسداد ديونها.

definitionEn: the first public appearance of a performer or sports player
example: The singer's debut album was a huge success.
exampleAr: حقق ألبوم المغني الأول نجاحاً كبيراً.

definitionEn: a period of ten years, especially a continuous period, such as 1910–1919 or 2000–2009
example: The city has changed a lot over the past decade.
exampleAr: تغيّرت المدينة كثيراً خلال العقد الماضي.

definitionEn: the 12th and last month of the year
example: The conference is scheduled for December.
exampleAr: من المقرر عقد المؤتمر في شهر ديسمبر.

definitionEn: of a good enough standard or quality
example: He earns a decent salary at his new job.
exampleAr: يتقاضى راتباً لائقاً في وظيفته الجديدة.

definitionEn: to think carefully about the different possibilities that are available and choose one of them
example: They haven't decided where to go on vacation yet.
exampleAr: لم يقرروا بعد إلى أين سيذهبون في إجازتهم.

definitionEn: a choice or judgement that you make after thinking and talking about what is the best thing to do
example: It was a difficult decision to make.
exampleAr: كان قراراً صعب اتخاذه.

definitionEn: the process of deciding about something important, especially in a group of people or in an organization
example: Good decision-making requires careful analysis.
exampleAr: يتطلب اتخاذ القرار الجيد تحليلاً دقيقاً.

definitionEn: very important for the final result of a particular situation
example: Her decisive leadership helped the team through the crisis.
exampleAr: ساعدت قيادتها الحاسمة الفريق على تجاوز الأزمة.

meaningAr: سطح السفينة / شرفة خشبية (في منزل أو حديقة) / مجموعة أوراق لعب
definitionEn: the top outside floor of a ship or boat
example: Passengers gathered on the ship's deck to watch the coastline.
exampleAr: تجمّع الركاب على سطح السفينة لمشاهدة الساحل.

definitionEn: an official or formal statement, especially about the plans of a government or an organization; the act of making such a statement
example: The country signed a declaration of independence.
exampleAr: وقّعت الدولة إعلان استقلال.

definitionEn: to say something officially or publicly
example: The government declared a state of emergency.
exampleAr: أعلنت الحكومة حالة الطوارئ.

definitionEn: to become smaller, fewer, weaker, etc.
example: She declined the invitation to the party.
exampleAr: اعتذرت عن قبول دعوة الحفلة.

definitionEn: a continuous decrease in the number, value, quality, etc. of something
example: The report noted a decline in exports.
exampleAr: أشار التقرير إلى تراجع في الصادرات.

definitionEn: to make something look more attractive by putting things on it
example: They decorated the house for the holidays.
exampleAr: زينوا المنزل استعداداً للعطلات.

definitionEn: a thing that makes something look more attractive on special occasions
example: The shop sells Christmas decorations.
exampleAr: يبيع المتجر زينة عيد الميلاد.

definitionEn: to become smaller in size, number, etc.; to make something smaller in size, number, etc.
example: Pollution levels decreased after the factory closed.
exampleAr: انخفضت مستويات التلوث بعد إغلاق المصنع.

definitionEn: the process of reducing something; the amount that something is reduced by
example: There was a slight decrease in unemployment last month.
exampleAr: سُجّل انخفاض طفيف في معدل البطالة الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: working hard at something because it is very important to you
example: She's a dedicated teacher who always helps her students.
exampleAr: إنها معلمة متفانية تساعد طلابها دائماً.

definitionEn: the hard work and effort that somebody puts into an activity or a purpose because they think it is important
example: His dedication to the project impressed everyone.
exampleAr: أثار تفانيه في المشروع إعجاب الجميع.

definitionEn: a thing that somebody does that is usually very good or very bad
example: It was a kind deed to help the stranger.
exampleAr: كانت مساعدة الغريب عملاً طيباً.

definitionEn: to have a particular opinion about somebody/something
example: The building was deemed unsafe and was closed.
exampleAr: اعتُبر المبنى غير آمن فأُغلق.

definitionEn: having a large distance from the top or surface to the bottom
example: The lake is very deep in the middle.
exampleAr: البحيرة عميقة جداً في وسطها.

definitionEn: a long way below the surface of something or a long way inside or into something
example: The roots go deep into the ground.
exampleAr: تمتد الجذور بعمق في الأرض.

definitionEn: very; very much
example: She was deeply affected by the news.
exampleAr: تأثرت بشدة بهذا الخبر.

definitionEn: what happens or appears if you do not make any other choice or change, especially in a computer program
example: The printer settings were reset to default.
exampleAr: أُعيدت إعدادات الطابعة إلى وضعها الافتراضي.

definitionEn: what happens or appears if you do not make any other choice or change, especially in a computer program
example: The company defaulted on its loan payments.
exampleAr: تخلفت الشركة عن سداد أقساط قرضها.

definitionEn: to win against somebody in a war, competition, sports game, etc.
example: The team defeated their rivals in the final.
exampleAr: هزم الفريق منافسيه في المباراة النهائية.

definitionEn: failure to win or to be successful
example: It was a humiliating defeat for the champions.
exampleAr: كانت هزيمة مذلة للأبطال.

definitionEn: a fault in something or in the way it has been made that means that it is not perfect
example: The car was recalled due to a manufacturing defect.
exampleAr: سُحبت السيارة بسبب عيب في التصنيع.

meaningAr: ينشق (يترك بلده أو حزبه للانضمام لجهة معادية)
definitionEn: a fault in something or in the way it has been made that means that it is not perfect
example: The scientist defected to another country during the war.
exampleAr: انشق العالِم والتحق بدولة أخرى أثناء الحرب.

definitionEn: the act of protecting somebody/something from attack, criticism, etc.
example: The army is responsible for the country's defence.
exampleAr: يتولى الجيش مسؤولية الدفاع عن البلاد.

definitionEn: to protect somebody/something from attack
example: She defended her decision in front of the board.
exampleAr: دافعت عن قرارها أمام مجلس الإدارة.

meaningAr: مدافع (لاعب دفاع رياضي) / مدافع / مناصر (بشكل عام)
definitionEn: a player who must stop the other team from scoring in games such as football (soccer), hockey, etc.
example: He plays as a defender for the national team.
exampleAr: يلعب في مركز المدافع في المنتخب الوطني.

definitionEn: protecting somebody/something against attack
example: He became defensive when asked about the mistake.
exampleAr: أصبح في موقف دفاعي عندما سُئل عن الخطأ.

definitionEn: the state of not having, or not having enough of, something that is essential
example: The doctor diagnosed a vitamin D deficiency.
exampleAr: شخّص الطبيب نقصاً في فيتامين د.

definitionEn: the amount by which money spent or owed is greater than money earned in a particular period of time
example: The government is trying to reduce the budget deficit.
exampleAr: تحاول الحكومة خفض عجز الميزانية.

definitionEn: to say or explain what the meaning of a word or phrase is
example: Can you define what success means to you?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تُعرّف ما يعنيه النجاح بالنسبة لك؟

definitionEn: sure or certain; unlikely to change
example: We need a definite answer by tomorrow.
exampleAr: نحتاج إلى إجابة أكيدة بحلول الغد.

definitionEn: a way of emphasizing that something is true and that there is no doubt about it
example: I will definitely come to your party.
exampleAr: سأحضر حفلتك بالتأكيد.

definitionEn: an explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase, especially in a dictionary
example: Look up the definition of the word in the dictionary.
exampleAr: ابحث عن تعريف الكلمة في القاموس.

definitionEn: to refuse to obey or show respect for somebody in authority, a law, a rule, etc.
example: The protesters defied the government's ban on gatherings.
exampleAr: تحدى المتظاهرون حظر الحكومة على التجمعات.

meaningAr: درجة حرارة / درجة (زاوية) / شهادة جامعية / درجة / مدى (مقدار شيء)
definitionEn: a unit for measuring temperature
example: The temperature dropped to five degrees overnight.
exampleAr: انخفضت درجة الحرارة إلى خمس درجات بين ليلة وضحاها.

definitionEn: a period of time when somebody/something has to wait because of a problem that makes something slow or late
example: The flight delay lasted almost three hours.
exampleAr: استمر تأخير الرحلة قرابة ثلاث ساعات.

definitionEn: to make somebody/something late or force them to do something more slowly
example: Bad weather delayed our departure.
exampleAr: أخّر الطقس السيئ موعد مغادرتنا.

definitionEn: a person who is chosen or elected to represent the views of a group of people and vote and make decisions for them
example: Each country sent a delegate to the summit.
exampleAr: أرسلت كل دولة مندوباً إلى القمة.

definitionEn: a person who is chosen or elected to represent the views of a group of people and vote and make decisions for them
example: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks.
exampleAr: يعرف المدير الجيد كيف يفوض المهام إلى الآخرين.

definitionEn: a group of people who represent the views of an organization, a country, etc.
example: A delegation from the UN visited the refugee camp.
exampleAr: زار وفد من الأمم المتحدة مخيم اللاجئين.

definitionEn: to remove something that has been written or printed, or that has been stored on a computer
example: She accidentally deleted an important file.
exampleAr: حذفت عن طريق الخطأ ملفاً مهماً.

definitionEn: done on purpose rather than by accident
example: It was a deliberate attempt to mislead investors.
exampleAr: كانت محاولة متعمدة لتضليل المستثمرين.

definitionEn: done in a way that was planned, not by chance
example: He deliberately ignored her messages.
exampleAr: تجاهل رسائلها عمداً.

meaningAr: رقيق / حساس (سهل الكسر أو التأثر) / دقيق / حساس (موقف يتطلب حذراً)
definitionEn: easily damaged or broken
example: Handle the vase carefully; it's very delicate.
exampleAr: تعامل مع المزهرية بحذر؛ فهي رقيقة جداً.

definitionEn: having a very pleasant taste or smell
example: The soup smells absolutely delicious.
exampleAr: رائحة الحساء لذيذة للغاية.

definitionEn: a feeling of great pleasure
example: Her face lit up with delight when she saw the gift.
exampleAr: أشرق وجهها بالبهجة عندما رأت الهدية.

definitionEn: to give somebody a lot of pleasure and joy
example: The performance delighted the audience.
exampleAr: أبهج العرض الجمهور.

definitionEn: very pleased
example: We were delighted to hear the good news.
exampleAr: كنا مسرورين لسماع الخبر السار.

meaningAr: يوصّل / يسلّم / يفي بـ (وعد أو نتيجة) / يلقي (خطاباً)
definitionEn: to take goods, letters, etc. to the person or people they have been sent to
example: The company delivers packages within 24 hours.
exampleAr: توصّل الشركة الطرود خلال 24 ساعة.

definitionEn: the act of taking goods, letters, etc. to the people they have been sent to
example: The delivery arrived earlier than expected.
exampleAr: وصلت الشحنة أبكر مما كان متوقعاً.

definitionEn: a very strong request for something; something that somebody needs
example: Demand for electric cars has increased sharply.
exampleAr: ازداد الطلب على السيارات الكهربائية بشكل حاد.

definitionEn: to make a very strong request for something
example: The workers demanded better pay and conditions.
exampleAr: طالب العمال بأجور وظروف عمل أفضل.

definitionEn: a system of government in which the people of a country can vote to elect their representatives
example: The country transitioned to democracy after the revolution.
exampleAr: انتقلت الدولة إلى الديمقراطية بعد الثورة.

definitionEn: controlled by representatives who are elected by the people of a country; connected with this system
example: They held free and democratic elections.
exampleAr: أجروا انتخابات حرة وديمقراطية.

definitionEn: an evil spirit
example: In the film, the hero must fight an ancient demon.
exampleAr: في الفيلم، يتوجب على البطل أن يقاتل شيطاناً قديماً.

definitionEn: to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence
example: The experiment demonstrates how gravity works.
exampleAr: تُظهر التجربة كيفية عمل الجاذبية.

definitionEn: a public meeting or a march (= an organized walk by many people) at which people show that they are protesting against or supporting somebody/something
example: The salesman gave a demonstration of the new vacuum cleaner.
exampleAr: قدّم البائع عرضاً توضيحياً للمكنسة الكهربائية الجديدة.

definitionEn: a statement that something is not true or does not exist; the action of denying something
example: His denial of the accusations surprised no one.
exampleAr: لم يفاجئ أحداً إنكاره للاتهامات.

definitionEn: to strongly criticize somebody/something that you think is wrong, illegal, etc.
example: Leaders denounced the attack as an act of terrorism.
exampleAr: أدان القادة الهجوم ووصفوه بأنه عمل إرهابي.

definitionEn: containing a lot of people, things, plants, etc. with little space between them
example: They walked through a dense forest for hours.
exampleAr: ساروا عبر غابة كثيفة لساعات.

definitionEn: the quality of being dense; the degree to which something is dense
example: The city has a high population density.
exampleAr: تتمتع المدينة بكثافة سكانية عالية.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to take care of people’s teeth
example: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
exampleAr: لدي موعد مع طبيب الأسنان غداً.

definitionEn: to say that something is not true
example: She denied any involvement in the scandal.
exampleAr: أنكرت أي تورط لها في الفضيحة.

definitionEn: to leave a place, especially to start a trip
example: The train departs from platform 3 at noon.
exampleAr: يغادر القطار من الرصيف 3 عند الظهر.

definitionEn: a section of a large organization such as a government, business, university, etc.
example: She works in the marketing department.
exampleAr: تعمل في قسم التسويق.

definitionEn: an act of leaving a place
example: Please arrive two hours before your departure.
exampleAr: يُرجى الحضور قبل موعد مغادرتك بساعتين.

definitionEn: according to
example: Whether we go depends on the weather.
exampleAr: ذهابنا من عدمه يعتمد على الطقس.

definitionEn: the state of needing the help and support of somebody/something in order to survive or be successful
example: The country is trying to reduce its dependence on oil.
exampleAr: تحاول الدولة تقليل اعتمادها على النفط.

definitionEn: needing somebody/something in order to survive or be successful
example: Children are financially dependent on their parents.
exampleAr: يعتمد الأطفال مادياً على والديهم.

definitionEn: to show an image of somebody/something in a picture
example: The painting depicts a peaceful village scene.
exampleAr: تصوّر اللوحة مشهداً هادئاً لقرية.

meaningAr: ينشر (قوات عسكرية) / ينشر / يوزّع (موارد أو تقنية)
definitionEn: to move soldiers or weapons into a position where they are ready for military action
example: The army deployed troops to the border.
exampleAr: نشر الجيش قوات على الحدود.

definitionEn: the act of moving soldiers or weapons into a position where they are ready for military action
example: The soldier's deployment lasted six months.
exampleAr: استمرت فترة انتشار الجندي في مهمته ستة أشهر.

definitionEn: a sum of money that is given as the first part of a larger payment
example: You'll need to pay a deposit to secure the apartment.
exampleAr: ستحتاج إلى دفع عربون لحجز الشقة.

definitionEn: to put money into a bank account
example: She deposited the check at the bank.
exampleAr: أودعت الشيك في البنك.

definitionEn: very sad and without hope
example: He's been feeling depressed since he lost his job.
exampleAr: ما زال يشعر بالاكتئاب منذ أن فقد وظيفته.

definitionEn: making you feel very sad and without enthusiasm
example: The news about the war was really depressing.
exampleAr: كانت أخبار الحرب محبطة حقاً.

definitionEn: a medical condition in which a person feels very sad, anxious and without hope and often has physical symptoms such as being unable to sleep, etc.
example: She sought therapy to help with her depression.
exampleAr: لجأت إلى العلاج النفسي للتعامل مع اكتئابها.

example: Lack of sleep can deprive you of energy the next day.
exampleAr: قد يحرمك قلة النوم من الطاقة في اليوم التالي.

definitionEn: the distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something; a particular distance down from the surface of something
example: The submarine can dive to great depths.
exampleAr: يمكن للغواصة أن تغوص إلى أعماق كبيرة.

definitionEn: a person who is the next most important person below a business manager, a head of a school, a political leader, etc. and who does that person’s job when they are away
example: The deputy manager took charge while the boss was away.
exampleAr: تولى نائب المدير المسؤولية أثناء غياب الرئيس.

example: The word 'biology' derives from Greek.
exampleAr: كلمة «biology» مُشتقة من اليونانية.

definitionEn: to come or go down from a higher to a lower level
example: The plane began to descend as it approached the airport.
exampleAr: بدأت الطائرة بالهبوط عندما اقتربت من المطار.

definitionEn: an action of coming or going down
example: The plane's descent was smooth despite the storm.
exampleAr: كان هبوط الطائرة سلساً رغم العاصفة.

definitionEn: to say what somebody/something is like
example: Can you describe what happened during the meeting?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تصف ما حدث خلال الاجتماع؟

definitionEn: a piece of writing or speech that says what somebody/something is like; the act of writing or saying in words what somebody/something is like
example: The witness gave a detailed description of the suspect.
exampleAr: قدّم الشاهد وصفاً مفصلاً للمشتبه به.

definitionEn: a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand.
example: Very little rain falls in the desert.
exampleAr: تهطل كمية قليلة جداً من الأمطار في الصحراء.

definitionEn: to leave somebody without help or support
example: Many soldiers deserted during the long war.
exampleAr: هجر كثير من الجنود صفوفهم خلال الحرب الطويلة.

definitionEn: to do something or show qualities that mean a particular reaction, reward or punishment is appropriate
example: She deserves a promotion after all her hard work.
exampleAr: تستحق ترقية بعد كل هذا الجهد الذي بذلته.

definitionEn: the general arrangement of the different parts of something that is made, such as a building, book, machine, etc.
example: The design of the new building won several awards.
exampleAr: فاز تصميم المبنى الجديد بعدة جوائز.

definitionEn: to decide how something will look, work, etc., by drawing plans, making computer models, etc.
example: She designs websites for small businesses.
exampleAr: تصمم مواقع إلكترونية للشركات الصغيرة.

definitionEn: to say officially that somebody/something has a particular character or name; to describe somebody/something in a particular way
example: The park has been designated as a protected area.
exampleAr: تم تخصيص الحديقة كمنطقة محمية.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to decide how things such as clothes, furniture, tools, etc. will look or work by making drawings, plans or patterns
example: She's a fashion designer based in Milan.
exampleAr: هي مصممة أزياء تقيم في ميلانو.

definitionEn: that you would like to have or do; worth having or doing
example: A quiet neighborhood is a desirable feature for many buyers.
exampleAr: يُعد الحي الهادئ ميزة مرغوبة لدى كثير من المشترين.

definitionEn: a strong wish to have or do something
example: He has a strong desire to travel the world.
exampleAr: لديه رغبة قوية في السفر حول العالم.

definitionEn: to want something; to wish for something
example: Many young professionals desire a better balance between work and life.
exampleAr: يرغب كثير من المهنيين الشباب في تحقيق توازن أفضل بين العمل والحياة.

definitionEn: a piece of furniture like a table, often with drawers (= parts like boxes in it with handles on the front for pulling them open), that you sit at to read, write, work, etc.
example: She keeps her documents neatly organized on her desk.
exampleAr: تحتفظ بأوراقها منظمة بعناية على مكتبها.

definitionEn: a screen on a computer that shows the icons of programs and files that can be used
example: He saved the file to the desktop for quick access.
exampleAr: حفظ الملف على سطح المكتب لسهولة الوصول إليه.

definitionEn: feeling or showing that you have little hope and are ready to do anything without worrying about danger to yourself or others
example: They were desperate for any news about the missing hikers.
exampleAr: كانوا في أمسّ الحاجة لأي خبر عن المتنزهين المفقودين.

definitionEn: in a way that shows you have little hope and are ready to do anything without worrying about danger to yourself or others
example: She desperately wanted to pass the exam.
exampleAr: أرادت بشدة أن تنجح في الامتحان.

definitionEn: used to show that something happened or is true although something else might have happened to prevent it
example: Despite the rain, they went ahead with the picnic.
exampleAr: رغم المطر، مضوا قدماً في نزهتهم.

definitionEn: a place to which somebody/something is going or being sent
example: Paris remains a popular tourist destination.
exampleAr: لا تزال باريس وجهة سياحية شهيرة.

definitionEn: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists, works, etc.
example: The fire destroyed several homes in the village.
exampleAr: دمّر الحريق عدة منازل في القرية.

definitionEn: the act of destroying something; the process of being destroyed
example: The earthquake caused widespread destruction.
exampleAr: تسبب الزلزال في دمار واسع النطاق.

definitionEn: causing destruction or damage
example: The hurricane's destructive winds tore roofs off houses.
exampleAr: اقتلعت رياح الإعصار المدمرة أسقف المنازل.

definitionEn: a small individual fact or item; a less important fact or item
example: She explained the plan in great detail.
exampleAr: شرحت الخطة بتفصيل كبير.

definitionEn: to give a list of facts or all the available information about something
example: The report details the causes of the accident.
exampleAr: يفصّل التقرير أسباب الحادث.

definitionEn: giving many details and a lot of information; paying great attention to details
example: He gave a detailed account of what happened.
exampleAr: قدّم رواية مفصلة لما حدث.

definitionEn: to keep somebody in an official place, such as a police station, a prison or a hospital, and prevent them from leaving
example: Police detained the suspect for questioning.
exampleAr: احتجزت الشرطة المشتبه به للتحقيق معه.

definitionEn: to discover or notice something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc.
example: The sensor can detect even small changes in temperature.
exampleAr: يستطيع المستشعر رصد أدق التغيرات في درجة الحرارة.

definitionEn: the process of discovering or noticing something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc.; the fact of being discovered or noticed
example: Early detection of cancer greatly improves survival rates.
exampleAr: يحسّن الكشف المبكر عن السرطان معدلات البقاء على قيد الحياة بشكل كبير.

definitionEn: a person, especially a police officer, whose job is to investigate crimes and catch criminals
example: The detective examined the crime scene carefully.
exampleAr: فحص المحقق مسرح الجريمة بعناية.

definitionEn: the state of being kept in a place, especially a prison, and prevented from leaving
example: He was held in detention for two days.
exampleAr: احتُجز لمدة يومين.

definitionEn: to become worse
example: His health began to deteriorate rapidly.
exampleAr: بدأت صحته تتدهور بسرعة.

definitionEn: the quality that makes you continue trying to do something even when this is difficult
example: Her determination helped her overcome many obstacles.
exampleAr: ساعدتها عزيمتها على تجاوز عقبات كثيرة.

definitionEn: to discover the facts about something; to calculate something exactly
example: Tests will determine the cause of the illness.
exampleAr: ستحدد الفحوصات سبب المرض.

definitionEn: having made a definite decision to do something and not letting anyone prevent you
example: She's determined to finish the marathon this year.
exampleAr: هي مصممة على إنهاء سباق الماراثون هذا العام.

meaningAr: يدمر / يخرّب (بشكل كامل) / يصدم / يحطّم نفسياً
definitionEn: to completely destroy a place or an area
example: The flood devastated entire communities.
exampleAr: دمّر الفيضان مجتمعات بأكملها.

definitionEn: to gradually grow or become bigger, more advanced, stronger, etc.; to make something do this
example: The company is developing a new app.
exampleAr: تعمل الشركة على تطوير تطبيق جديد.

definitionEn: the steady growth of something so that it becomes more advanced, stronger, etc.
example: The region has seen rapid economic development.
exampleAr: شهدت المنطقة تطوراً اقتصادياً سريعاً.

definitionEn: an object or a piece of equipment that has been designed to do a particular job
example: She charges her devices overnight.
exampleAr: تشحن أجهزتها طوال الليل.

definitionEn: the most powerful evil being
example: In the story, the devil tempts the young man.
exampleAr: في القصة، يغوي الشيطان الشاب.

definitionEn: to invent something new or a new way of doing something
example: The team devised a new strategy to increase sales.
exampleAr: ابتكر الفريق استراتيجية جديدة لزيادة المبيعات.

example: She devotes most of her time to charity work.
exampleAr: تكرّس معظم وقتها للعمل الخيري.

definitionEn: to say exactly what an illness or the cause of a problem is
example: The doctor diagnosed him with a mild infection.
exampleAr: شخّص الطبيب حالته بأنها عدوى خفيفة.

definitionEn: the act of discovering or identifying the exact cause of an illness or a problem
example: The early diagnosis allowed for quick treatment.
exampleAr: أتاح التشخيص المبكر علاجاً سريعاً.

definitionEn: a simple drawing using lines to explain where something is, how something works, etc.
example: The diagram shows how the engine works.
exampleAr: يوضح المخطط كيفية عمل المحرك.

definitionEn: a conversation in a book, play or film or in language teaching materials
example: The film is known for its clever dialogue.
exampleAr: يشتهر الفيلم بحواره الذكي.

definitionEn: a clear precious stone of pure carbon, the hardest substance known. Diamonds are used in jewellery and also in industry, especially for cutting glass.
example: She received a diamond ring for her anniversary.
exampleAr: تلقت خاتماً من الألماس بمناسبة ذكرى زواجها.

definitionEn: a book in which you can write down the experiences you have each day, your private thoughts, etc.
example: She writes in her diary every night before bed.
exampleAr: تكتب في مذكراتها كل ليلة قبل النوم.

meaningAr: يملي (يفرض شروطاً) / يملي (كلاماً ليكتبه شخص آخر)
definitionEn: to tell somebody what to do, especially in an annoying way
example: The winning team gets to dictate the terms.
exampleAr: يحق للفريق الفائز أن يملي الشروط.

definitionEn: a political leader who has complete power over a country, especially one who has gained it using military force
example: The country was ruled by a brutal dictator for decades.
exampleAr: حكم البلاد ديكتاتور وحشي لعقود.

definitionEn: a book or electronic resource that gives a list of the words of a language in alphabetical order and explains what they mean, or gives a word for them in a foreign language
example: Look up any unfamiliar words in the dictionary.
exampleAr: ابحث عن أي كلمة غير مألوفة في القاموس.

definitionEn: to stop living
example: The old man died peacefully in his sleep.
exampleAr: مات الرجل العجوز بسلام أثناء نومه.

definitionEn: the food and drink that you eat and drink regularly
example: A balanced diet includes fruits and vegetables.
exampleAr: يشمل النظام الغذائي المتوازن الفواكه والخضراوات.

definitionEn: the food and drink that you eat and drink regularly
example: She's been dieting to lose weight before the wedding.
exampleAr: تتّبع حمية غذائية لإنقاص وزنها قبل حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: to be different from somebody/something
example: Opinions differ on how to solve the problem.
exampleAr: تختلف الآراء حول كيفية حل المشكلة.

definitionEn: the way in which two people or things are not like each other; the way in which somebody/something has changed
example: There's a big difference between the two designs.
exampleAr: هناك فرق كبير بين التصميمين.

definitionEn: not the same as somebody/something; not like somebody/something else
example: Each student has a different learning style.
exampleAr: لكل طالب أسلوب تعلّم مختلف.

definitionEn: to recognize or show that two things are not the same
example: It's hard to differentiate between the two brands.
exampleAr: من الصعب التمييز بين العلامتين التجاريتين.

definitionEn: in a different way from somebody/something
example: He sees the situation differently than I do.
exampleAr: ينظر إلى الموقف بشكل مختلف عني.

definitionEn: not easy; needing effort or skill to do or to understand
example: The exam was more difficult than expected.
exampleAr: كان الامتحان أصعب مما كان متوقعاً.

definitionEn: a problem; a thing or situation that causes problems
example: She had difficulty finding a job after graduating.
exampleAr: واجهت صعوبة في إيجاد وظيفة بعد تخرجها.

definitionEn: to make a hole in the ground or to move soil from one place to another using your hands, a tool or a machine
example: They dug a hole to plant the tree.
exampleAr: حفروا حفرة لغرس الشجرة.

definitionEn: using a system of receiving and sending information as a series of the numbers one and zero, showing that an electronic signal is there or is not there
example: Most photography today is digital.
exampleAr: معظم التصوير الفوتوغرافي اليوم رقمي.

definitionEn: a calm and serious manner that deserves respect
example: The nurses treated every patient with dignity.
exampleAr: عاملت الممرضات كل مريض بكرامة.

definitionEn: a situation that makes problems, often one in which you have to make a very difficult choice between things of equal importance
example: She faced a difficult dilemma about which job offer to accept.
exampleAr: واجهت معضلة صعبة بشأن أي عرض عمل تقبله.

definitionEn: a measurement in space, for example how high, wide or long something is
example: Please measure every dimension of the package before you ship it.
exampleAr: يُرجى قياس جميع أبعاد الطرد قبل شحنه.

definitionEn: to become smaller, weaker, etc.; to make something become smaller, weaker, etc.
example: Her enthusiasm for the project began to diminish.
exampleAr: بدأ حماسها للمشروع يتضاءل.

definitionEn: the main meal of the day, eaten either in the middle of the day or in the evening
example: We usually have dinner at seven o'clock.
exampleAr: نتناول العشاء عادة في الساعة السابعة.

definitionEn: to put something quickly into a liquid and take it out again
example: He dipped the bread into the olive oil.
exampleAr: غمس الخبز في زيت الزيتون.

definitionEn: to put something quickly into a liquid and take it out again
example: There was a slight dip in sales last month.
exampleAr: سُجّل انخفاض طفيف في المبيعات الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to represent his or her country in a foreign country, for example, in an embassy
example: The diplomat was sent to negotiate the peace treaty.
exampleAr: أُرسل الدبلوماسي للتفاوض على معاهدة السلام.

definitionEn: connected with managing relations between countries (= diplomacy)
example: The two countries resolved the issue through diplomatic channels.
exampleAr: حلّت الدولتان المسألة عبر القنوات الدبلوماسية.

definitionEn: going in the straightest line between two places without stopping or changing direction
example: There's a direct flight from London to Tokyo.
exampleAr: توجد رحلة مباشرة من لندن إلى طوكيو.

definitionEn: to control or be in charge of somebody/something
example: Could you direct me to the nearest station?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن ترشدني إلى أقرب محطة؟

definitionEn: the general position a person or thing moves or points towards
example: We were driving in the wrong direction.
exampleAr: كنا نقود السيارة في الاتجاه الخاطئ.

definitionEn: without stopping or changing direction
example: You can contact her directly by email.
exampleAr: يمكنك التواصل معها مباشرة عبر البريد الإلكتروني.

definitionEn: one of a group of senior managers who run a company
example: The director won an award for best picture.
exampleAr: فاز المخرج بجائزة أفضل فيلم.

definitionEn: a book or electronic resource containing lists of information, usually in alphabetical order, for example people’s phone numbers or the names and addresses of businesses in a particular area
example: You can find the number in the online directory.
exampleAr: يمكنك إيجاد الرقم في الدليل الإلكتروني.

definitionEn: any substance that makes something dirty, for example dust, soil or mud
example: The children came home covered in dirt.
exampleAr: عاد الأطفال إلى المنزل مغطّين بالتراب.

definitionEn: not clean
example: Please put your dirty clothes in the laundry basket.
exampleAr: يُرجى وضع ملابسك المتسخة في سلة الغسيل.

definitionEn: a physical or mental condition that makes it difficult for somebody to do some things that most other people can do
example: The building has ramps for people with disabilities.
exampleAr: يحتوي المبنى على منحدرات لذوي الإعاقة.

definitionEn: having a condition that makes it difficult for you to do some things that most other people can do
example: The hotel has special rooms for disabled guests.
exampleAr: يوفر الفندق غرفاً خاصة للنزلاء ذوي الإعاقة.

definitionEn: something that causes problems and tends to stop somebody/something from succeeding or making progress
example: One disadvantage of the plan is its high cost.
exampleAr: من عيوب الخطة تكلفتها المرتفعة.

definitionEn: if two people disagree or one person disagrees with another about something, they have a different opinion about it
example: I disagree with your assessment of the situation.
exampleAr: أنا لا أوافق على تقييمك للموقف.

definitionEn: a situation where people have different opinions about something and often argue
example: There was a disagreement over how to divide the profits.
exampleAr: نشب خلاف حول كيفية توزيع الأرباح.

definitionEn: to become impossible to see
example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
exampleAr: اختفت الشمس خلف الغيوم.

definitionEn: to make somebody feel sad because something that they hope for or expect to happen does not happen or is not as good as they hoped
example: The team's performance disappointed their fans.
exampleAr: خيّب أداء الفريق آمال جمهوره.

definitionEn: upset because something you hoped for has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected
example: She was disappointed when the trip was cancelled.
exampleAr: شعرت بخيبة أمل عندما أُلغيت الرحلة.

definitionEn: not as good, successful, etc. as you had hoped; making you feel disappointed
example: The film's ending was disappointing.
exampleAr: كانت نهاية الفيلم مخيبة للآمال.

definitionEn: the feeling of being sad because something has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected or hoped
example: Losing the match was a huge disappointment for the players.
exampleAr: كانت خسارة المباراة خيبة أمل كبيرة للاعبين.

definitionEn: an unexpected event, such as a very bad accident, a flood or a fire, that kills a lot of people or causes a lot of damage
example: The flood was the worst natural disaster in the region's history.
exampleAr: كان الفيضان أسوأ كارثة طبيعية في تاريخ المنطقة.

definitionEn: very bad, harmful or unsuccessful
example: The decision had disastrous consequences for the company.
exampleAr: كانت لهذا القرار عواقب كارثية على الشركة.

definitionEn: a thin flat round object
example: The songs were saved on a disc.
exampleAr: حُفظت الأغاني على قرص.

definitionEn: to get rid of something that you no longer want or need
example: She discarded the old newspapers.
exampleAr: تخلصت من الصحف القديمة.

meaningAr: يُخرج / يُطلق سراح (من المستشفى أو الخدمة) / يفرغ / يطلق (مادة أو نفايات)
definitionEn: to give somebody official permission to leave the police or the armed forces; to make somebody leave the police or the armed forces
example: He was discharged from the hospital after a week.
exampleAr: خرج من المستشفى بعد أسبوع.

definitionEn: to give somebody official permission to leave the police or the armed forces; to make somebody leave the police or the armed forces
example: The wound had some discharge and needed cleaning.
exampleAr: كان في الجرح بعض الإفرازات واحتاج إلى تنظيف.

definitionEn: the practice of training people to obey rules and orders and punishing them if they do not; the controlled behaviour or situation that is the result of this training
example: Success in sports requires discipline and hard work.
exampleAr: يتطلب النجاح في الرياضة انضباطاً وجهداً كبيراً.

definitionEn: the practice of training people to obey rules and orders and punishing them if they do not; the controlled behaviour or situation that is the result of this training
example: Parents should discipline their children calmly and consistently.
exampleAr: ينبغي على الآباء تأديب أطفالهم بهدوء وثبات.

definitionEn: to give somebody information about something, especially something that was previously secret
example: The company failed to disclose the financial risks.
exampleAr: أخفقت الشركة في الإفصاح عن المخاطر المالية.

definitionEn: the act of making something known or public that was previously secret or private
example: The disclosure of the documents caused a public outcry.
exampleAr: أثار الكشف عن الوثائق استياءً عاماً.

definitionEn: an amount of money that is taken off the usual cost of something
example: Students get a 10% discount at the bookstore.
exampleAr: يحصل الطلاب على خصم 10% في المكتبة.

definitionEn: to take an amount of money off the usual cost of something; to sell something at a discount
example: We shouldn't discount the possibility of failure.
exampleAr: ينبغي ألا نستبعد احتمال الفشل.

definitionEn: to try to prevent something or to prevent somebody from doing something, especially by making it difficult to do or by showing that you do not approve of it
example: Don't let one failure discourage you from trying again.
exampleAr: لا تدع فشلاً واحداً يثبطك عن المحاولة مجدداً.

definitionEn: a long and serious treatment or discussion of a subject in speech or writing
example: Social media has changed the nature of public discourse.
exampleAr: غيّرت وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي طبيعة الخطاب العام.

definitionEn: to be the first person to become aware that a particular place or thing exists
example: Scientists discovered a new species of frog.
exampleAr: اكتشف العلماء نوعاً جديداً من الضفادع.

definitionEn: an act or the process of finding somebody/something, or learning about something that was not known about before
example: The discovery of penicillin changed modern medicine.
exampleAr: غيّر اكتشاف البنسلين وجه الطب الحديث.

definitionEn: the freedom or power to decide what should be done in a particular situation
example: The manager has full discretion over hiring decisions.
exampleAr: يتمتع المدير بتقدير كامل في قرارات التوظيف.

definitionEn: the practice of treating somebody or a particular group in society less fairly than others
example: The law protects workers from discrimination.
exampleAr: يحمي القانون العمال من التمييز.

definitionEn: to talk about something with somebody, especially in order to decide something
example: Let's discuss the details over lunch.
exampleAr: لنناقش التفاصيل خلال الغداء.

definitionEn: a conversation about somebody/something; the process of discussing somebody/something
example: The meeting included a long discussion about the budget.
exampleAr: تضمّن الاجتماع نقاشاً طويلاً حول الميزانية.

definitionEn: an illness affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection
example: The disease spreads through contaminated water.
exampleAr: ينتشر المرض عبر المياه الملوثة.

definitionEn: a flat shallow container for cooking food in or serving it from
example: She washed the dishes after dinner.
exampleAr: غسلت الأطباق بعد العشاء.

definitionEn: not honest; intending to trick people
example: It would be dishonest to hide the mistake from the client.
exampleAr: سيكون من غير الأمانة إخفاء الخطأ عن العميل.

definitionEn: to not like somebody/something
example: He dislikes waking up early.
exampleAr: لا يحب الاستيقاظ باكراً.

definitionEn: a feeling of not liking somebody/something
example: She has a strong dislike of crowded places.
exampleAr: لديها كراهية شديدة للأماكن المزدحمة.

definitionEn: to decide that somebody/something is not important and not worth thinking or talking about
example: He was dismissed from his job after the incident.
exampleAr: فُصل من عمله بعد الحادثة.

definitionEn: the act of dismissing somebody from their job; an example of this
example: His dismissal came as a shock to his colleagues.
exampleAr: جاء فصله من العمل صدمة لزملائه.

meaningAr: اضطراب نفسي / اضطراب صحي / عضوي / فوضى / اضطراب (اجتماعي)
definitionEn: a condition or illness that causes problems with the way part of the body or brain works
example: He was diagnosed with an anxiety disorder.
exampleAr: شُخّصت حالته باضطراب القلق.

definitionEn: to take the place of somebody/something
example: The war displaced thousands of families.
exampleAr: هجّرت الحرب آلاف العائلات.

definitionEn: to put something in a place where people can see it easily; to show something to people
example: The museum displays artifacts from ancient Egypt.
exampleAr: يعرض المتحف قطعاً أثرية من مصر القديمة.

definitionEn: an arrangement of things in a public place to inform or entertain people or advertise something for sale
example: The fireworks display lasted twenty minutes.
exampleAr: استمر عرض الألعاب النارية عشرين دقيقة.

definitionEn: the act of getting rid of something
example: The city improved its waste disposal system.
exampleAr: طوّرت المدينة نظام التخلص من النفايات لديها.

definitionEn: to arrange things or people in a particular way or position
example: Please dispose of the batteries safely.
exampleAr: يُرجى التخلص من البطاريات بطريقة آمنة.

definitionEn: an argument between two people, groups or countries; discussion about a subject on which people disagree
example: The border dispute between the two countries continues.
exampleAr: لا يزال النزاع الحدودي بين البلدين مستمراً.

definitionEn: to question whether something is true or legally or officially acceptable
example: He disputed the referee's decision.
exampleAr: اعترض على قرار الحكم.

definitionEn: to make it difficult for something to continue in the normal way
example: The strike disrupted train services across the country.
exampleAr: عطّل الإضراب خدمات القطارات في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

definitionEn: a situation in which it is difficult for something to continue in the normal way; the act of stopping something from continuing in the normal way
example: Heavy snow caused major disruption to flights.
exampleAr: تسببت الثلوج الكثيفة في تعطيل كبير لرحلات الطيران.

definitionEn: to mix with a liquid and become part of it
example: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
exampleAr: يذوب السكر بسرعة في الماء الساخن.

definitionEn: the amount of space between two places or things
example: The distance between the two cities is about 300 kilometers.
exampleAr: تبلغ المسافة بين المدينتين نحو 300 كيلومتر.

definitionEn: far away in space or time
example: They could see distant mountains from the hotel window.
exampleAr: استطاعوا رؤية جبال بعيدة من نافذة الفندق.

definitionEn: easily or clearly heard, seen, felt, etc.
example: The two proposals have distinct advantages.
exampleAr: يتمتع الاقتراحان بمزايا واضحة ومتمايزة.

definitionEn: a clear difference or contrast especially between people or things that are similar or related
example: There's an important distinction between the two terms.
exampleAr: هناك فرق مهم بين المصطلحين.

definitionEn: having a quality or characteristic that makes something different and easily noticed
example: The bird has a distinctive red patch on its head.
exampleAr: يمتلك الطائر بقعة حمراء مميزة على رأسه.

definitionEn: to recognize the difference between two people or things
example: It's important to distinguish between fact and opinion.
exampleAr: من المهم التمييز بين الحقيقة والرأي.

definitionEn: to change the shape, appearance or sound of something so that it is strange or not clear
example: The article distorted the facts to support its argument.
exampleAr: شوّه المقال الحقائق لدعم وجهة نظره.

definitionEn: to take somebody’s attention away from what they are trying to do
example: Loud noises distracted the students during the exam.
exampleAr: شتّتت الضوضاء العالية انتباه الطلاب أثناء الامتحان.

definitionEn: a feeling of great worry or unhappiness; great mental pain
example: The news caused her great distress.
exampleAr: سبّب لها الخبر ضيقاً شديداً.

definitionEn: to give things to a large number of people; to share something between a number of people
example: Volunteers distributed food to the flood victims.
exampleAr: وزّع المتطوعون الطعام على ضحايا الفيضان.

definitionEn: the way that something is spread or exists over a particular area or among a particular group of people
example: The company improved its distribution network.
exampleAr: طوّرت الشركة شبكة التوزيع الخاصة بها.

definitionEn: an area of a country or town, especially one that has particular features
example: The financial district is home to many banks.
exampleAr: يضم الحي المالي عدداً كبيراً من البنوك.

definitionEn: to interrupt somebody when they are trying to work, sleep, etc.
example: Please don't disturb the baby while she's sleeping.
exampleAr: يُرجى عدم إزعاج الطفلة أثناء نومها.

definitionEn: making you feel anxious and upset or shocked
example: The report contained disturbing details about the conditions.
exampleAr: تضمّن التقرير تفاصيل مقلقة عن الأوضاع.

definitionEn: to jump into water with your head and arms going in first
example: He dived into the pool to save the drowning child.
exampleAr: غطس في المسبح لإنقاذ الطفل الغريق.

definitionEn: a jump into deep water with your head first and your arms in front of you
example: She performed a perfect dive from the high board.
exampleAr: أدّت غطسة مثالية من المنصة العالية.

definitionEn: very different from each other and of various kinds
example: The city has a diverse population from many cultures.
exampleAr: تضم المدينة سكاناً متنوعين من ثقافات عديدة.

definitionEn: a range of many people or things that are very different from each other
example: The company values diversity in its workforce.
exampleAr: تقدّر الشركة التنوع في قوتها العاملة.

definitionEn: to make somebody/something change direction
example: The flight was diverted due to bad weather.
exampleAr: حُوِّلت الرحلة بسبب سوء الأحوال الجوية.

definitionEn: to separate into parts; to make something separate into parts
example: They divided the cake into six equal pieces.
exampleAr: قسّموا الكعكة إلى ست قطع متساوية.

definitionEn: a difference between two groups of people or two things that separates them from each other
example: There's a growing divide between rich and poor.
exampleAr: توجد فجوة متنامية بين الأغنياء والفقراء.

definitionEn: coming from or connected with God or a god
example: Many cultures believe in divine intervention during crises.
exampleAr: تؤمن ثقافات كثيرة بالتدخل الإلهي في أوقات الأزمات.

meaningAr: قسم (وحدة تنظيمية في شركة) / قسمة (رياضيات) / انقسام / خلاف
definitionEn: the process or result of dividing into separate parts; the process or result of dividing something or sharing it out
example: She works in the sales division of the company.
exampleAr: تعمل في قسم المبيعات في الشركة.

definitionEn: the legal ending of a marriage
example: They finalized their divorce last year.
exampleAr: أتما إجراءات طلاقهما العام الماضي.

definitionEn: to end your marriage to somebody legally
example: She divorced her husband after ten years of marriage.
exampleAr: طلّقت زوجها بعد عشر سنوات من الزواج.

definitionEn: no longer married because your marriage has been legally ended
example: He's been divorced for about five years.
exampleAr: هو مطلّق منذ نحو خمس سنوات.

meaningAr: يفعل / يقوم بـ (فعل عام) / فعل مساعد (للأسئلة والنفي) / يكفي / يفي بالغرض
definitionEn: used to refer to actions that you do not mention by name or do not know about
example: What are you doing this weekend?
exampleAr: ماذا ستفعل في نهاية هذا الأسبوع؟

definitionEn: a person who has been trained in medical science, whose job is to treat people who are ill or injured
example: You should see a doctor about that cough.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تراجع طبيباً بشأن هذا السعال.

definitionEn: a belief or set of beliefs held and taught by a Church, a political party, etc.
example: The book explains the basic doctrines of the religion.
exampleAr: يشرح الكتاب العقائد الأساسية للدين.

definitionEn: an official paper, book or electronic file that gives information about something, or that can be used as evidence or proof of something
example: Please sign the document before you leave.
exampleAr: يُرجى توقيع المستند قبل مغادرتك.

definitionEn: to record something in the form of a written document, photograph, film, etc.
example: The journalist documented the effects of the war.
exampleAr: وثّق الصحفي آثار الحرب.

definitionEn: a film or a radio or television programme giving facts about something
example: We watched a documentary about climate change.
exampleAr: شاهدنا فيلماً وثائقياً عن تغيّر المناخ.

definitionEn: the documents that are required for something, or that give evidence or proof of something
example: Make sure you keep all the documentation for your visa application.
exampleAr: تأكد من الاحتفاظ بجميع الوثائق الخاصة بطلب تأشيرتك.

definitionEn: an animal with four legs and a tail, often kept as a pet or trained for work, for example hunting or guarding buildings. There are many types of dog, some of which are wild.
example: She takes her dog for a walk every morning.
exampleAr: تصطحب كلبها في نزهة كل صباح.

definitionEn: the unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia and several other countries
example: The ticket costs about fifty dollars.
exampleAr: تبلغ تكلفة التذكرة نحو خمسين دولاراً.

definitionEn: an area of knowledge or activity; especially one that somebody is responsible for
example: Marketing falls outside her domain of expertise.
exampleAr: يقع التسويق خارج مجال خبرتها.

definitionEn: of or inside a particular country; not foreign or international
example: The airline offers both domestic and international flights.
exampleAr: تقدّم شركة الطيران رحلات داخلية ودولية على حد سواء.

definitionEn: the fact of being more important, powerful or easy to notice than somebody/something else
example: The team's dominance in the league was undisputed.
exampleAr: كانت هيمنة الفريق على الدوري لا جدال فيها.

definitionEn: more important, powerful or easy to notice than other things
example: English is the dominant language in international business.
exampleAr: الإنجليزية هي اللغة المهيمنة في عالم الأعمال الدولية.

definitionEn: to control or have a lot of influence over somebody/something, especially in an unpleasant way
example: The home team dominated the match from the start.
exampleAr: هيمن الفريق المضيف على المباراة منذ البداية.

definitionEn: to give money, food, clothes, etc. to somebody/something, especially a charity
example: She donates blood every few months.
exampleAr: تتبرع بالدم كل بضعة أشهر.

definitionEn: something that is given to a person or an organization such as a charity, in order to help them; the act of giving something in this way
example: The charity relies on public donations.
exampleAr: تعتمد الجمعية الخيرية على تبرعات الجمهور.

definitionEn: a person or an organization that makes a gift of money, clothes, food, etc. to a charity, etc.
example: He became a regular blood donor after his surgery.
exampleAr: أصبح متبرعاً منتظماً بالدم بعد عمليته الجراحية.

definitionEn: a piece of wood, glass, etc. that is opened and closed so that people can get in and out of a room, building, car, etc.; a similar thing in a cupboard
example: Please close the door behind you.
exampleAr: يُرجى إغلاق الباب خلفك.

definitionEn: an amount of a medicine or a drug that is taken once, or regularly over a period of time
example: The doctor increased his dose of medication.
exampleAr: زاد الطبيب جرعة دوائه.

definitionEn: a small round mark, especially one that is printed
example: Draw a small dot where the road forks.
exampleAr: ارسم نقطة صغيرة عند تفرّع الطريق.

definitionEn: a small round mark, especially one that is printed
example: Small islands dot the coastline.
exampleAr: تنتشر جزر صغيرة على طول الساحل كنقاط متفرقة.

definitionEn: twice as much or as many as usual
example: The hotel room has a double bed.
exampleAr: تحتوي غرفة الفندق على سرير مزدوج.

definitionEn: to become, or make something become, twice as much or as many
example: Sales doubled after the new advertising campaign.
exampleAr: تضاعفت المبيعات بعد الحملة الإعلانية الجديدة.

definitionEn: a feeling of being uncertain about something or not believing something
example: There's some doubt about whether he'll recover in time.
exampleAr: هناك بعض الشك حول ما إذا كان سيتعافى في الوقت المناسب.

definitionEn: to feel uncertain about something; to feel that something is not true, will probably not happen, etc.
example: I doubt she'll arrive on time.
exampleAr: أشك في أنها ستصل في الموعد.

definitionEn: to or at a lower place or position
example: Please sit down and relax.
exampleAr: يُرجى الجلوس والاسترخاء.

definitionEn: from a high or higher point on something to a lower one
example: They walked down the street together.
exampleAr: مشيا معاً على طول الشارع.

definitionEn: to get data from another computer, usually using the internet
example: You can download the app for free.
exampleAr: يمكنك تحميل التطبيق مجاناً.

definitionEn: data that is downloaded from another computer system
example: The song is available as a digital download.
exampleAr: الأغنية متوفرة كتنزيل رقمي.

definitionEn: down the stairs; on or to a floor of a house or building lower than the one you are on, especially the one at ground level
example: She went downstairs to answer the door.
exampleAr: نزلت إلى الطابق السفلي لتفتح الباب.

definitionEn: the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: We spent the afternoon shopping downtown.
exampleAr: أمضينا بعد الظهر في التسوق في وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: in or towards the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: They drove downtown to see the new mall.
exampleAr: قادوا السيارة إلى وسط المدينة لرؤية المركز التجاري الجديد.

definitionEn: towards the ground; towards a lower place or position
example: The path leads downwards toward the river.
exampleAr: يؤدي المسار نحو الأسفل باتجاه النهر.

definitionEn: a group of twelve of the same thing
example: She bought a dozen eggs from the market.
exampleAr: اشترت دزينة بيض من السوق.

definitionEn: a rough written version of something that is not yet in its final form
example: He sent me the first draft of the report.
exampleAr: أرسل لي المسودة الأولى للتقرير.

definitionEn: to write the first rough version of something such as a letter, speech, book or law
example: The lawyer drafted a new contract.
exampleAr: صاغ المحامي عقداً جديداً.

definitionEn: to pull somebody/something along with effort and difficulty
example: He dragged the heavy suitcase up the stairs.
exampleAr: جرّ الحقيبة الثقيلة صعوداً على الدرج.

definitionEn: to make something empty or dry by removing the liquid from it; to become empty or dry in this way
example: The long journey drained all her energy.
exampleAr: استنزفت الرحلة الطويلة كل طاقتها.

definitionEn: to make something empty or dry by removing the liquid from it; to become empty or dry in this way
example: Leaves had blocked the drain.
exampleAr: سدّت الأوراق البالوعة.

meaningAr: دراما (مسرحية أو تلفزيونية) / إثارة / توتر (في الحياة اليومية)
definitionEn: a play for the theatre, television or radio
example: She stars in a popular TV drama.
exampleAr: تلعب دور البطولة في مسلسل درامي تلفزيوني شهير.

definitionEn: sudden, very great and often surprising
example: There was a dramatic increase in sales last quarter.
exampleAr: سُجّلت زيادة كبيرة ومفاجئة في المبيعات الربع الماضي.

definitionEn: very suddenly and to a very great and often surprising degree
example: Prices have risen dramatically over the past year.
exampleAr: ارتفعت الأسعار بشكل كبير وملحوظ خلال العام الماضي.

definitionEn: to make pictures, or a picture of something, with a pencil, pen or chalk (but not paint)
example: She loves to draw pictures of animals.
exampleAr: تحب رسم صور الحيوانات.

definitionEn: to make pictures, or a picture of something, with a pencil, pen or chalk (but not paint)
example: The match ended in a draw.
exampleAr: انتهت المباراة بالتعادل.

definitionEn: a picture made using a pencil or pen rather than paint
example: He made a quick drawing of the building.
exampleAr: رسم رسماً سريعاً للمبنى.

definitionEn: a series of images, events and feelings that happen in your mind while you are asleep
example: It was always her dream to become a doctor.
exampleAr: كان حلمها دائماً أن تصبح طبيبة.

definitionEn: to experience a series of images, events and feelings in your mind while you are asleep
example: I dreamed about flying last night.
exampleAr: حلمتُ بالطيران الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing that is made in one piece and hangs down to cover the body as far as the legs, sometimes reaching to below the knees, or to the ankles
example: She wore a red dress to the party.
exampleAr: ارتدت فستاناً أحمر إلى الحفلة.

definitionEn: to put clothes on yourself/somebody
example: He dressed quickly and left for work.
exampleAr: ارتدى ملابسه بسرعة وغادر إلى العمل.

definitionEn: wearing clothes and not naked or wearing clothes for sleeping
example: She was nicely dressed for the interview.
exampleAr: كانت ترتدي ملابس أنيقة لمقابلة العمل.

definitionEn: to move along smoothly and slowly in water or air
example: The boat drifted slowly away from the shore.
exampleAr: انجرف القارب ببطء بعيداً عن الشاطئ.

definitionEn: to take liquid into your mouth and then down your throat into your stomach
example: She drinks a glass of water every morning.
exampleAr: تشرب كوباً من الماء كل صباح.

definitionEn: a liquid for drinking; an amount of a liquid that you drink
example: Can I get you a drink?
exampleAr: هل يمكنني إحضار مشروب لك؟

definitionEn: to operate a vehicle so that it goes in a particular direction
example: He drives to work every day.
exampleAr: يقود سيارته إلى العمل كل يوم.

definitionEn: a journey in a car or other vehicle
example: It's a two-hour drive to the coast.
exampleAr: تستغرق الرحلة بالسيارة إلى الساحل ساعتين.

definitionEn: a person who drives a vehicle
example: The taxi driver knew a shortcut through the city.
exampleAr: كان سائق سيارة الأجرة يعرف طريقاً مختصراً عبر المدينة.

definitionEn: the way that somebody drives a vehicle; the act of driving
example: He took driving lessons before the test.
exampleAr: أخذ دروساً في القيادة قبل الاختبار.

definitionEn: strong and powerful; having a strong influence in making something happen
example: Passion was the driving force behind her success.
exampleAr: كان الشغف القوة الدافعة وراء نجاحها.

definitionEn: to allow something to fall by accident; to fall by accident
example: She dropped her phone on the floor.
exampleAr: أسقطت هاتفها على الأرض.

definitionEn: a very small amount of liquid that forms a round shape
example: A drop of rain fell on her cheek.
exampleAr: سقطت قطرة مطر على خدها.

definitionEn: a long period of time when there is little or no rain
example: The drought destroyed most of the region's crops.
exampleAr: دمّر الجفاف معظم محاصيل المنطقة.

definitionEn: to die because you have been underwater too long and you cannot breathe; to kill somebody by holding them underwater
example: The lifeguard saved a boy from drowning.
exampleAr: أنقذ منقذ الغرقى صبياً من الغرق.

definitionEn: an illegal substance that some people smoke, inject, etc. for the physical and mental effects it has
example: The drug is used to treat high blood pressure.
exampleAr: يُستخدم هذا الدواء لعلاج ارتفاع ضغط الدم.

definitionEn: a musical instrument made of a hollow round frame with plastic or skin stretched tightly across one or both ends. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.
example: He plays the drum in a local band.
exampleAr: يعزف على الطبل في فرقة محلية.

definitionEn: having drunk so much alcohol that it is impossible to think or speak clearly
example: He was too drunk to drive home.
exampleAr: كان سكراناً لدرجة أنه عجز عن قيادة سيارته إلى المنزل.

definitionEn: not wet or sticky; without water or moisture
example: The weather has been very dry this summer.
exampleAr: كان الطقس جافاً جداً هذا الصيف.

definitionEn: to become dry; to make something dry
example: Hang the clothes outside to dry.
exampleAr: علّق الملابس في الخارج لتجف.

definitionEn: having two parts or aspects
example: She holds dual citizenship in France and Canada.
exampleAr: تحمل جنسية مزدوجة بين فرنسا وكندا.

definitionEn: to give somebody/something a particular name, often in a humorous or critical way
example: The press dubbed him 'the miracle worker'.
exampleAr: لقّبته الصحافة بـ«صانع المعجزات».

definitionEn: caused by somebody/something; because of somebody/something
example: The rent is due on the first of the month.
exampleAr: يُستحق دفع الإيجار في اليوم الأول من الشهر.

definitionEn: not interesting or exciting
example: It was a long, dull lecture.
exampleAr: كانت محاضرة طويلة ومملة.

definitionEn: stupid
example: That was a pretty dumb mistake to make.
exampleAr: كان ذلك خطأً غبياً جداً.

definitionEn: to get rid of something you do not want, especially in a place that is not suitable
example: They were fined for dumping garbage in the river.
exampleAr: غُرِّموا لإلقائهم القمامة في النهر.

definitionEn: to get rid of something you do not want, especially in a place that is not suitable
example: The old fridge was taken to the dump.
exampleAr: نُقلت الثلاجة القديمة إلى مكب النفايات.

definitionEn: two people who perform together or are often seen or thought of together
example: The comedy duo has performed together for over a decade.
exampleAr: يعمل الثنائي الكوميدي معاً منذ أكثر من عقد.

definitionEn: the length of time that something lasts or continues
example: The duration of the flight is about six hours.
exampleAr: تبلغ مدة الرحلة نحو ست ساعات.

definitionEn: all through a period of time
example: She fell asleep during the movie.
exampleAr: غفت أثناء مشاهدة الفيلم.

definitionEn: a fine powder that consists of very small pieces of sand, earth, etc.
example: The shelves were covered in dust.
exampleAr: كانت الرفوف مغطاة بالغبار.

definitionEn: a fine powder that consists of very small pieces of sand, earth, etc.
example: She dusted the furniture before the guests arrived.
exampleAr: نفضت الغبار عن الأثاث قبل وصول الضيوف.

definitionEn: something that you feel you have to do because it is your moral or legal responsibility
example: It's every citizen's duty to vote.
exampleAr: التصويت واجب على كل مواطن.

definitionEn: a disk on which large amounts of information, especially films, photographs and video, can be stored, for use on a DVD player or computer (the abbreviation for ‘digital versatile disc’ or ‘digital videodisc’)
example: We watched an old DVD of our favorite movie.
exampleAr: شاهدنا قرص دي في دي قديماً لفيلمنا المفضل.

definitionEn: having a lot of energy and a strong personality
example: She has a dynamic personality that energizes the whole team.
exampleAr: تتمتع بشخصية نشطة تبعث الحيوية في الفريق بأكمله.

definitionEn: the way in which people or things behave and react to each other in a particular situation
example: Understanding group dynamics helps managers lead better.
exampleAr: يساعد فهم ديناميكيات المجموعة المديرين على القيادة بشكل أفضل.

definitionEn: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: Each student received a certificate.
exampleAr: حصل كل طالب على شهادة.

definitionEn: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: The teacher gave each of them a book.
exampleAr: أعطى المعلم كلاً منهم كتاباً.

definitionEn: very interested and excited by something that is going to happen or about something that you want to do; showing this
example: She's eager to start her new job.

definitionEn: either of the organs on the sides of the head that you hear with

exampleAr: همس بشيء في أذنها.

definitionEn: near the beginning of a period of time, an event etc.
example: We caught an early train to avoid the traffic.

definitionEn: near the beginning of a period of time, an event, a piece of work, etc.

definitionEn: to get money for work that you do

definitionEn: the money that you earn for the work that you do

definitionEn: the world; the planet that we live on

definitionEn: a sudden, violent shaking of the earth’s surface

definitionEn: lack of difficulty

definitionEn: to become less unpleasant, painful or severe; to make something less unpleasant, etc.

definitionEn: without problems or difficulty

definitionEn: the direction that you look towards to see the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass

definitionEn: towards the east

definitionEn: located in the east or facing east

definitionEn: not difficult; done or obtained without a lot of effort or problems

definitionEn: to put food in your mouth, bite it and swallow it

definitionEn: the reflecting of sound off a wall or inside a particular space so that a noise appears to be repeated; a sound that is reflected back in this way

definitionEn: connected with the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their environment

definitionEn: connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society

definitionEn: the study of how a society organizes its money, trade and industry

definitionEn: a person who studies or writes about economics

definitionEn: the relationship between production, trade and the supply of money in a particular country or region

definitionEn: the outside limit of an object, a surface or an area; the part furthest from the centre

definitionEn: to prepare a piece of writing, a book, etc. to be published by correcting the mistakes, making improvements to it, etc.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to teach or educate people

definitionEn: the fact of producing the result that is wanted or intended; the fact of producing a successful result

definitionEn: your sense of your own value and importance

definitionEn: used as a polite word for ‘old’

definitionEn: in addition to something already mentioned

meaningAr: يشرع في رحلة (حرفياً) / يشرع في مشروع (مجازياً)

definitionEn: to put your arms around somebody as a sign of love or friendship
