example: The new features enhance the app's performance.
exampleAr: تعزز الميزات الجديدة أداء التطبيق.

definitionEn: to get pleasure from something
example: They enjoyed their vacation in Spain.
exampleAr: استمتعوا بعطلتهم في إسبانيا.

definitionEn: giving pleasure
example: It was a very enjoyable evening.
exampleAr: كانت أمسية ممتعة جداً.

definitionEn: extremely large
example: The company made an enormous profit last year.
exampleAr: حققت الشركة ربحاً هائلاً العام الماضي.

definitionEn: used before plural or uncountable nouns to mean ‘as many or as much as somebody needs or wants’
example: We don't have enough chairs for everyone.
exampleAr: ليس لدينا كراسٍ كافية للجميع.

definitionEn: to the necessary degree
example: Is the soup hot enough?
exampleAr: هل الحساء ساخن بما فيه الكفاية؟

definitionEn: to ask somebody for some information
example: She enquired about the price of the tickets.
exampleAr: استفسرت عن سعر التذاكر.

definitionEn: an official process to find out the cause of something or to find out information about something
example: We received several enquiries about the job opening.
exampleAr: تلقينا عدة استفسارات بخصوص الوظيفة الشاغرة.

definitionEn: to improve the quality of something, often by adding something to it
example: Travel enriches our understanding of other cultures.
exampleAr: يُثري السفر فهمنا للثقافات الأخرى.

definitionEn: to arrange for yourself or for somebody else to officially join a course, school, etc.
example: She enrolled in an evening course at the college.
exampleAr: سجّلت في دورة مسائية بالكلية.

definitionEn: to happen after or as a result of another event
example: A heated argument ensued after the announcement.
exampleAr: نشب جدال محتدم عقب الإعلان.

definitionEn: to make sure that something happens or is definite
example: Please ensure all doors are locked before you leave.
exampleAr: يُرجى التأكد من إغلاق جميع الأبواب قبل المغادرة.

definitionEn: to come or go into something
example: Please knock before you enter the room.
exampleAr: يُرجى الطرق قبل دخول الغرفة.

definitionEn: a company or business
example: The government supports small enterprises with grants.
exampleAr: تدعم الحكومة المشاريع الصغيرة بمنح مالية.

definitionEn: to interest somebody or make somebody laugh in order to please them
example: The clown entertained the children at the party.
exampleAr: سلّى المهرج الأطفال في الحفلة.

definitionEn: that you enjoy watching, listening to, doing or experiencing
example: The movie was funny and entertaining.
exampleAr: كان الفيلم مضحكاً وممتعاً.

definitionEn: films, music, etc. used to entertain people; an example of this
example: The cruise ship offers live entertainment every night.
exampleAr: تقدّم السفينة السياحية ترفيهاً حياً كل ليلة.

definitionEn: a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it
example: She approached the new project with great enthusiasm.
exampleAr: تعاملت مع المشروع الجديد بحماس كبير.

definitionEn: a person who is very interested in something and spends a lot of time doing it
example: He's a keen car enthusiast.
exampleAr: إنه هاوٍ شغوف بالسيارات.

definitionEn: feeling or showing a lot of excitement and interest about somebody/something
example: The students were enthusiastic about the field trip.
exampleAr: كان الطلاب متحمسين للرحلة الميدانية.

definitionEn: including everything, everyone or every part
example: She spent the entire day cleaning the house.
exampleAr: أمضت اليوم بأكمله في تنظيف المنزل.

definitionEn: in every way possible; completely
example: The decision is entirely up to you.
exampleAr: القرار يعود إليك بالكامل.

definitionEn: to give somebody the right to have or to do something
example: This ticket entitles you to a free drink.
exampleAr: تخوّلك هذه التذكرة الحصول على مشروب مجاني.

definitionEn: something that exists separately from other things and has its own identity
example: The new company will operate as a separate legal entity.
exampleAr: ستعمل الشركة الجديدة ككيان قانوني مستقل.

definitionEn: a door, gate, passage, etc. used for entering a room, building or place
example: The main entrance is around the corner.
exampleAr: يقع المدخل الرئيسي عند الزاوية.

definitionEn: a person who makes money by starting or running businesses, especially when this involves taking financial risks
example: She became a successful entrepreneur at a young age.
exampleAr: أصبحت رائدة أعمال ناجحة في سن مبكرة.

definitionEn: an act of going into or getting into a place
example: Entry to the museum is free on Sundays.
exampleAr: الدخول إلى المتحف مجاني أيام الأحد.

definitionEn: a flat paper container used for sending letters in, with a part that you stick down to close it
example: She sealed the letter in an envelope.
exampleAr: وضعت الرسالة في ظرف وأغلقته.

definitionEn: the natural world in which people, animals and plants live
example: We must protect the environment for future generations.
exampleAr: يجب أن نحمي البيئة من أجل الأجيال القادمة.

definitionEn: connected with the natural conditions in which people, animals and plants live; connected with the environment
example: The factory was fined for environmental violations.
exampleAr: غُرِّم المصنع بسبب مخالفات بيئية.

definitionEn: a large number of cases of a particular disease or medical condition happening at the same time in a particular community
example: The city struggled to contain the flu epidemic.
exampleAr: كافحت المدينة لاحتواء وباء الإنفلونزا.

meaningAr: حلقة (مسلسل) / نوبة صحية / طبية / نوبة نفسية / عاطفية
definitionEn: one part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts
example: Have you watched the latest episode of the show?
exampleAr: هل شاهدت أحدث حلقة من المسلسل؟

definitionEn: the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else
example: All employees should have equal opportunities.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن يحظى جميع الموظفين بفرص متساوية.

definitionEn: to be the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else
example: Two plus two equals four.
exampleAr: اثنان زائد اثنين يساوي أربعة.

definitionEn: the fact of being equal in rights, status, advantages, etc.
example: The movement fights for gender equality.
exampleAr: تناضل الحركة من أجل المساواة بين الجنسين.

definitionEn: to the same degree; in the same or in a similar way
example: The prize money was split equally among the winners.
exampleAr: قُسّمت الجائزة المالية بالتساوي بين الفائزين.

definitionEn: a statement showing that two amounts or values are equal, for example 2x + y = 54
example: She solved the equation in a few seconds.
exampleAr: حلّت المعادلة في ثوانٍ معدودة.

definitionEn: to provide yourself/somebody/something with the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity
example: The course equips students with practical skills.
exampleAr: تجهّز الدورة الطلاب بمهارات عملية.

definitionEn: the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity
example: The gym has modern exercise equipment.
exampleAr: يحتوي النادي الرياضي على معدات تمرين حديثة.

definitionEn: equal in value, amount, meaning, importance, etc.
example: One mile is roughly equivalent to 1.6 kilometers.
exampleAr: يعادل الميل الواحد تقريباً 1.6 كيلومتر.

definitionEn: a thing, amount, word, etc. that is equal in value, meaning or purpose to something else
example: There's no direct equivalent of this word in English.
exampleAr: لا يوجد ما يعادل هذه الكلمة مباشرة في الإنجليزية.

definitionEn: a period of time, usually in history, that is different from other periods because of particular characteristics or events
example: The internet marked the start of a new era.
exampleAr: كان الإنترنت بداية حقبة جديدة.

definitionEn: to build something
example: Workers erected a statue in the town square.
exampleAr: أقام العمال تمثالاً في ساحة البلدة.

definitionEn: a mistake, especially one that causes problems or affects the result of something
example: The document contained several spelling errors.
exampleAr: تضمّنت الوثيقة عدة أخطاء إملائية.

meaningAr: يثور / ينفجر (بركان) / يندلع فجأة (غضب أو عنف)
definitionEn: when a volcano erupts or burning rocks, smoke, etc. erupt or are erupted, the burning rocks, etc. are thrown out from the volcano
example: The volcano erupted after decades of silence.
exampleAr: ثار البركان بعد عقود من الهدوء.

definitionEn: to become greater, worse, more serious, etc.; to make something greater, worse, more serious, etc.
example: Tensions between the two countries began to escalate.
exampleAr: بدأت التوترات بين البلدين تتصاعد.

definitionEn: to get away from a place where you have been kept as a prisoner or not allowed to leave
example: The prisoner escaped through a tunnel.
exampleAr: هرب السجين عبر نفق.

definitionEn: the act or a method of escaping from a place or an unpleasant or dangerous situation
example: Their escape from the burning building was miraculous.
exampleAr: كان هروبهم من المبنى المحترق أشبه بالمعجزة.

definitionEn: more with one person, thing, etc. than with others, or more in particular circumstances than in others
example: I love all fruits, especially mangoes.
exampleAr: أحب جميع الفواكه، وخاصة المانجو.

definitionEn: a short piece of writing by a student as part of a course of study
example: She wrote an essay on climate change for class.
exampleAr: كتبت مقالاً عن التغير المناخي لأجل الصف.

definitionEn: the most important quality or feature of something, that makes it what it is
example: Honesty is the essence of a good relationship.
exampleAr: الصدق هو جوهر أي علاقة جيدة.

definitionEn: completely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation or for a particular activity
example: Water is essential for survival.
exampleAr: الماء ضروري للبقاء على قيد الحياة.

definitionEn: when you think about the true, important or basic nature of somebody/something
example: The two plans are essentially the same.
exampleAr: الخطتان متماثلتان أساساً.

definitionEn: to start or create an organization, a system, etc. that is meant to last for a long time
example: The company was established in 1990.
exampleAr: تأسست الشركة عام 1990.

definitionEn: an organization, a large institution or a hotel
example: The establishment of the new school took two years.
exampleAr: استغرق تأسيس المدرسة الجديدة عامين.

definitionEn: an area of land with a lot of houses or factories of the same type on it
example: He inherited a large estate from his grandfather.
exampleAr: ورث عقاراً كبيراً عن جده.

definitionEn: to form an idea of the cost, size, value etc. of something, but without calculating it exactly
example: Experts estimate the cost at around one million dollars.
exampleAr: يقدّر الخبراء التكلفة بنحو مليون دولار.

definitionEn: a judgement that you make without having the exact details or figures about the size, amount, cost, etc. of something
example: The builder gave us an estimate for the repairs.
exampleAr: قدّم لنا المقاول تقديراً لتكلفة الإصلاحات.

definitionEn: without an end; existing or continuing forever
example: The couple promised each other eternal love.
exampleAr: تعاهد الزوجان على حب أبدي.

definitionEn: moral principles that control or influence a person’s behaviour
example: She has a strong work ethic.
exampleAr: تتمتع بأخلاقيات عمل قوية.

definitionEn: connected with beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
example: The company faced questions about its ethical practices.
exampleAr: واجهت الشركة تساؤلات حول ممارساتها الأخلاقية.

definitionEn: connected with or belonging to a group of people that share a cultural tradition
example: The city is known for its ethnic diversity.
exampleAr: تشتهر المدينة بتنوعها العرقي.

definitionEn: the unit of money of some countries of the European Union
example: The meal cost about twenty euros.
exampleAr: كلفت الوجبة نحو عشرين يورو.

definitionEn: to move people from a place of danger to a safer place
example: Residents were evacuated before the hurricane hit.
exampleAr: أُخلي السكان قبل وصول الإعصار.

definitionEn: to form an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully
example: Teachers evaluate students' progress every semester.
exampleAr: يقيّم المعلمون تقدّم الطلاب كل فصل دراسي.

definitionEn: the act of forming an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully
example: The manager conducts an annual performance evaluation.
exampleAr: يُجري المدير تقييماً سنوياً للأداء.

definitionEn: used to emphasize something unexpected or surprising
example: Even the experts were surprised by the results.
exampleAr: حتى الخبراء فوجئوا بالنتائج.

definitionEn: that can be divided exactly by two
example: Make sure the shelf is even before you fix it.
exampleAr: تأكد من أن الرف مستوٍ قبل تثبيته.

definitionEn: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed
example: We're having dinner with friends this evening.
exampleAr: سنتناول العشاء مع الأصدقاء هذا المساء.

definitionEn: a thing that happens, especially something important
example: The wedding was a memorable event.
exampleAr: كان حفل الزفاف حدثاً لا يُنسى.

definitionEn: at the end of a period of time or a series of events
example: After months of searching, she eventually found a job.
exampleAr: بعد أشهر من البحث، وجدت أخيراً وظيفة.

definitionEn: used in negative sentences and questions, or sentences with if to mean ‘at any time’
example: Have you ever been to Japan?
exampleAr: هل سبق أن زرت اليابان؟

definitionEn: used with singular nouns to refer to all the members of a group of things or people
example: She calls her mother every day.
exampleAr: تتصل بأمها كل يوم.

definitionEn: every person; all people
example: Everybody enjoyed the concert.
exampleAr: استمتع الجميع بالحفل الموسيقي.

definitionEn: used or happening every day or regularly; ordinary
example: These are just everyday problems we all face.
exampleAr: هذه مجرد مشكلات يومية نواجهها جميعاً.

definitionEn: every person; all people
example: Everyone was invited to the party.
exampleAr: دُعي الجميع إلى الحفلة.

definitionEn: all things
example: She lost everything in the fire.
exampleAr: فقدت كل شيء في الحريق.

definitionEn: in, to or at every place; all places
example: We looked everywhere for the missing keys.
exampleAr: بحثنا في كل مكان عن المفاتيح المفقودة.

definitionEn: the facts, signs or objects that make you believe that something is true
example: There's no evidence to support the claim.
exampleAr: لا توجد أدلة تدعم هذا الادعاء.

definitionEn: clear; easily seen
example: It was evident that she hadn't slept well.
exampleAr: كان واضحاً أنها لم تنم جيداً.

definitionEn: enjoying harming others; morally bad and cruel
example: The story tells of an evil king who ruled the land.
exampleAr: تروي القصة عن ملك شرير حكم البلاد.

definitionEn: a force that causes bad things to happen; morally bad behaviour
example: The film explores the battle between good and evil.
exampleAr: يستكشف الفيلم الصراع بين الخير والشر.

definitionEn: to bring a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind
example: The smell of bread evoked memories of her childhood.
exampleAr: استحضرت رائحة الخبز ذكريات طفولتها.

definitionEn: the slow steady development of plants, animals, etc. during the history of the earth, as they adapt to changes in their environment
example: Darwin's theory of evolution changed biology forever.
exampleAr: غيّرت نظرية داروين في التطور علم الأحياء إلى الأبد.

definitionEn: connected with evolution; connected with slow steady development and change
example: Scientists study the evolutionary history of birds.
exampleAr: يدرس العلماء التاريخ التطوري للطيور.

definitionEn: to develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complicated form; to develop something in this way
example: Language evolves constantly over time.
exampleAr: تتطور اللغة باستمرار مع مرور الزمن.

definitionEn: correct in every detail
example: I don't know the exact time she'll arrive.
exampleAr: لا أعرف الوقت الدقيق لوصولها.

definitionEn: used to emphasize that something is correct in every way or in every detail
example: That's exactly what I was thinking.
exampleAr: هذا بالضبط ما كنت أفكر فيه.

definitionEn: to make something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is
example: He tends to exaggerate when telling stories.
exampleAr: يميل إلى المبالغة عند سرد القصص.

definitionEn: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
example: She's studying hard for her final exams.
exampleAr: تدرس بجد استعداداً لامتحاناتها النهائية.

definitionEn: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
example: The doctor performed a thorough examination.
exampleAr: أجرى الطبيب فحصاً شاملاً.

definitionEn: to consider or study an idea, a subject, etc. very carefully
example: The professor examined the data carefully.
exampleAr: فحص الأستاذ البيانات بعناية.

definitionEn: something such as an object, a fact or a situation that shows, explains or supports what you say
example: Can you give me an example of what you mean?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تعطيني مثالاً على ما تقصده؟

definitionEn: to be greater than a particular number or amount
example: The results exceeded all our expectations.
exampleAr: تجاوزت النتائج كل توقعاتنا.

definitionEn: the quality of being extremely good
example: The school is known for its academic excellence.
exampleAr: تشتهر المدرسة بتميّزها الأكاديمي.

definitionEn: extremely good
example: She did an excellent job on the presentation.
exampleAr: أدّت عرضها التقديمي بشكل ممتاز.

definitionEn: used before you mention the only thing or person about which a statement is not true
example: Everyone came to the party except Tom.
exampleAr: حضر الجميع الحفلة باستثناء توم.

definitionEn: a person or thing that is not included in a general statement
example: There's always an exception to the rule.
exampleAr: توجد دائماً استثناءات للقاعدة.

definitionEn: unusually good
example: She showed exceptional talent at a young age.
exampleAr: أظهرت موهبة استثنائية في سن مبكرة.

definitionEn: more than is necessary, reasonable or acceptable
example: Any excess luggage will incur a fee.
exampleAr: سيُفرض رسم على أي أمتعة زائدة.

definitionEn: in addition to an amount that is necessary, usual or legal
example: You'll be charged for excess weight.
exampleAr: سيُفرض عليك رسم مقابل الوزن الزائد.

definitionEn: greater than what seems reasonable or appropriate
example: The fine seemed excessive for such a minor offense.
exampleAr: بدت الغرامة مفرطة بالنسبة لمخالفة بسيطة كهذه.

definitionEn: to give something to somebody and at the same time receive the same type of thing from them
example: They exchanged phone numbers before leaving.
exampleAr: تبادلا أرقام الهواتف قبل المغادرة.

definitionEn: an act of giving something to somebody or doing something for somebody and receiving something in return
example: There was a brief exchange of ideas during the meeting.
exampleAr: جرى تبادل موجز للأفكار خلال الاجتماع.

definitionEn: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm
example: The kids were excited about the trip to the zoo.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال متحمسين لرحلة حديقة الحيوان.

definitionEn: the state of feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm
example: There was a lot of excitement before the game.
exampleAr: ساد حماس كبير قبل المباراة.

definitionEn: causing great interest or excitement
example: It was an exciting match right to the final whistle.
exampleAr: كانت مباراة مثيرة حتى صافرة النهاية.

definitionEn: to deliberately not include something in what you are doing or considering
example: The price excludes tax and delivery fees.
exampleAr: لا يشمل السعر الضريبة ورسوم التوصيل.

definitionEn: the act of preventing somebody/something from entering a place or taking part in something
example: The report criticized the exclusion of certain groups.
exampleAr: انتقد التقرير استبعاد بعض الفئات.

definitionEn: only to be used by one particular person or group; only given to one particular person or group
example: The magazine published an exclusive interview with the singer.
exampleAr: نشرت المجلة مقابلة حصرية مع المغني.

definitionEn: for only one particular person, group or use
example: The product is sold exclusively online.
exampleAr: يُباع المنتج حصرياً عبر الإنترنت.

definitionEn: a reason, either true or invented, that you give to explain or defend your behaviour
example: He always has an excuse for being late.
exampleAr: لديه دائماً عذر لتأخره.

definitionEn: to forgive somebody for something that they have done, for example not being polite or making a small mistake
example: Please excuse the mess; we're still unpacking.
exampleAr: يُرجى المعذرة على الفوضى؛ فما زلنا نفرغ الأمتعة.

definitionEn: to kill somebody, especially as a legal punishment
example: The plan was executed perfectly.
exampleAr: نُفّذت الخطة بشكل مثالي.

definitionEn: the act of killing somebody, especially as a legal punishment
example: The success of the project depends on careful execution.
exampleAr: يعتمد نجاح المشروع على تنفيذه بعناية.

definitionEn: a person who has an important job as a manager of a company or an organization
example: She's a senior executive at a tech company.
exampleAr: هي مديرة تنفيذية كبيرة في شركة تقنية.

definitionEn: connected with managing a business or an organization, and with making plans and decisions
example: The board holds executive power over major decisions.
exampleAr: يتمتع مجلس الإدارة بسلطة تنفيذية على القرارات الكبرى.

meaningAr: تمرين (رياضي) / تمرين دراسي (واجب) / تمرين / تدريب (عسكري أو مهني)
definitionEn: physical or mental activity that you do to stay healthy or become stronger
example: Regular exercise improves both physical and mental health.
exampleAr: تحسّن التمارين الرياضية المنتظمة الصحة الجسدية والنفسية معاً.

definitionEn: to do sports or other physical activities in order to stay healthy or become stronger; to make an animal do this
example: She exercises every morning before work.
exampleAr: تمارس الرياضة كل صباح قبل العمل.

definitionEn: to use power or influence to affect somebody/something
example: Parents shouldn't exert too much pressure on their children.
exampleAr: لا ينبغي للآباء ممارسة ضغط مفرط على أطفالهم.

definitionEn: to show something in a public place for people to enjoy or to give them information
example: The gallery exhibits works by local artists.
exampleAr: تعرض القاعة أعمالاً لفنانين محليين.

definitionEn: an object or a collection of objects put in a public place, for example a museum, so that people can see it
example: The museum's new exhibit features ancient pottery.
exampleAr: تضم معروضات المتحف الجديدة فخاراً قديماً.

definitionEn: a collection of things, for example works of art, that are shown to the public
example: They visited an art exhibition at the gallery.
exampleAr: زاروا معرضاً فنياً في القاعة.

definitionEn: the state of being sent to live in another country that is not your own, especially for political reasons or as a punishment
example: The writer spent twenty years in exile.
exampleAr: أمضى الكاتب عشرين عاماً في المنفى.

definitionEn: the state of being sent to live in another country that is not your own, especially for political reasons or as a punishment
example: The king was exiled after the revolution.
exampleAr: نُفي الملك بعد الثورة.

definitionEn: to be real; to be present in a place or situation
example: Does life exist on other planets?
exampleAr: هل توجد حياة على كواكب أخرى؟

definitionEn: the state or fact of being real or living or of being present
example: The company has been in existence for fifty years.
exampleAr: الشركة موجودة منذ خمسين عاماً.

definitionEn: a way out of a public building or vehicle
example: The emergency exit is at the back of the building.
exampleAr: يقع مخرج الطوارئ في الجزء الخلفي من المبنى.

definitionEn: to go out; to leave a building, stage, vehicle, etc.
example: Please exit through the side door.
exampleAr: يُرجى الخروج من الباب الجانبي.

definitionEn: from or in another country, especially a tropical one; seeming exciting and unusual because it seems to be connected with foreign countries
example: The market sells exotic fruits from around the world.
exampleAr: يبيع السوق فواكه استوائية غريبة من مختلف أنحاء العالم.

definitionEn: to become greater in size, number or importance; to make something greater in size, number or importance
example: The company plans to expand into new markets.
exampleAr: تخطط الشركة للتوسع في أسواق جديدة.

exampleAr: يجب حفظ التقرير بصيغة PDF.

definitionEn: the general arrangement, plan, design, etc. of something
example: She formatted the document before printing it.
exampleAr: نسّقت المستند قبل طباعته.

definitionEn: the action of forming something; the process of being formed
example: The formation of the new government took months.
exampleAr: استغرق تشكيل الحكومة الجديدة أشهراً.

definitionEn: that existed in earlier times
example: The former president gave a speech at the event.
exampleAr: ألقى الرئيس السابق كلمة في الفعالية.

definitionEn: in the past
example: The building was formerly a factory.
exampleAr: كان المبنى سابقاً مصنعاً.

definitionEn: a series of letters, numbers or symbols that represent a rule or law
example: Students memorized the formula for calculating area.
exampleAr: حفظ الطلاب معادلة حساب المساحة.

definitionEn: to create or prepare something carefully, giving particular attention to the details
example: The team formulated a new strategy for the campaign.
exampleAr: صاغ الفريق استراتيجية جديدة للحملة.

definitionEn: away from a place; out
example: They set forth on their journey at dawn.
exampleAr: انطلقوا في رحلتهم عند الفجر.

definitionEn: going to happen, be published, etc. very soon
example: Details about the forthcoming election will be announced soon.
exampleAr: ستُعلن تفاصيل الانتخابات القادمة قريباً.

definitionEn: having or bringing an advantage, an opportunity, a piece of good luck, etc.
example: We were fortunate to find a parking spot nearby.
exampleAr: كنا محظوظين بإيجاد موقف سيارات قريب.

definitionEn: by good luck
example: Fortunately, nobody was injured in the accident.
exampleAr: لحسن الحظ، لم يُصب أحد في الحادث.

definitionEn: a large amount of money
example: He made his fortune in real estate.
exampleAr: جمع ثروته من العقارات.

example: She's turning forty next week.
exampleAr: ستبلغ الأربعين الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: an event or medium where people can exchange opinions and ideas on a particular issue; a meeting organized for this purpose
example: They discussed the issue in an online forum.
exampleAr: ناقشوا المسألة في منتدى عبر الإنترنت.

definitionEn: towards a place or position that is in front
example: She leaned forward to hear better.
exampleAr: انحنت إلى الأمام لتسمع بشكل أفضل.

definitionEn: directed or moving towards the front
example: The car has a forward-facing camera.
exampleAr: تحتوي السيارة على كاميرا أمامية.

definitionEn: the parts of a dead animal or a plant that have become hard and turned into rock
example: Scientists discovered a dinosaur fossil in the desert.
exampleAr: اكتشف العلماء أحفورة ديناصور في الصحراء.

definitionEn: to encourage something to develop
example: The teacher fosters creativity in her students.
exampleAr: تعزز المعلمة الإبداع لدى طلابها.

definitionEn: to encourage something to develop
example: They became foster parents to two young children.
exampleAr: أصبحا أبوين حاضنين لطفلين صغيرين.

definitionEn: to start something, such as an organization or an institution, especially by providing money
example: The company was founded in 1998 by two friends.
exampleAr: تأسست الشركة عام 1998 على يد صديقين.

definitionEn: a principle, an idea or a fact that something is based on and that it grows from
example: Trust is the foundation of any good relationship.
exampleAr: الثقة هي أساس أي علاقة جيدة.

definitionEn: a person who starts an organization, institution, etc. or causes something to be built
example: She is the founder of a successful tech startup.
exampleAr: هي مؤسسة شركة ناشئة تقنية ناجحة.

example: They have four children.
exampleAr: لديهم أربعة أطفال.

example: The bridge is fourteen kilometers long.
exampleAr: يبلغ طول الجسر أربعة عشر كيلومتراً.

definitionEn: 4th
example: This is his fourth attempt at the exam.
exampleAr: هذه محاولته الرابعة في الامتحان.

definitionEn: a small part or amount of something
example: Children learn to add fractions in third grade.
exampleAr: يتعلم الأطفال جمع الكسور في الصف الثالث.

definitionEn: easily broken or damaged
example: Please handle the package carefully; it's fragile.
exampleAr: يُرجى التعامل مع الطرد بحذر؛ فهو قابل للكسر.

definitionEn: a small part of something that has broken off or comes from something larger
example: Archaeologists found fragments of ancient pottery.
exampleAr: عثر علماء الآثار على شظايا من الفخار القديم.

definitionEn: a small part of something that has broken off or comes from something larger
example: The country fragmented into several smaller states.
exampleAr: تجزأت الدولة إلى عدة دويلات أصغر.

definitionEn: a strong border or structure of wood, metal, etc. that holds a picture, door, piece of glass, etc. in position
example: She put the photo in a wooden frame.
exampleAr: وضعت الصورة في إطار خشبي.

definitionEn: to put or make a frame or border around something
example: The question was framed in a misleading way.
exampleAr: صيغ السؤال بطريقة مضللة.

definitionEn: the parts of a building or an object that support its weight and give it shape
example: The report outlines a framework for reducing emissions.
exampleAr: يحدد التقرير إطار عمل لخفض الانبعاثات.

definitionEn: formal permission given by a company to somebody who wants to sell its goods or services in a particular area; formal permission given by a government to somebody who wants to operate a public service as a business
example: The restaurant chain operates as a franchise.
exampleAr: تعمل سلسلة المطاعم بنظام الامتياز التجاري.

definitionEn: in an honest and direct way that people might not like
example: Frankly, I don't think the plan will work.
exampleAr: بصراحة، لا أعتقد أن الخطة ستنجح.

definitionEn: the crime of cheating somebody in order to get money or goods illegally
example: He was arrested for tax fraud.
exampleAr: اعتُقل بتهمة الاحتيال الضريبي.

definitionEn: without particular plans or arrangements; not busy
example: Entry to the park is free on weekends.
exampleAr: الدخول إلى الحديقة مجاني في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع.

definitionEn: to allow somebody to leave prison or somewhere they have been kept against their will
example: The hostages were freed after negotiations.
exampleAr: أُطلق سراح الرهائن بعد المفاوضات.

definitionEn: the power or right to do or say what you want without anyone stopping you
example: The constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
exampleAr: يضمن الدستور حرية التعبير.

definitionEn: without anyone trying to prevent or control something
example: Citizens can travel freely between the two countries.
exampleAr: يمكن للمواطنين التنقل بحرية بين البلدين.

definitionEn: to become hard, and often turn to ice, as a result of extreme cold; to make something do this
example: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
exampleAr: يتجمد الماء عند درجة صفر مئوية.

definitionEn: the rate at which something happens or is repeated
example: The frequency of storms has increased in recent years.
exampleAr: ازداد تواتر العواصف في السنوات الأخيرة.

definitionEn: happening or doing something often
example: He's a frequent visitor to the museum.
exampleAr: إنه زائر متكرر للمتحف.

definitionEn: often
example: She frequently travels for work.
exampleAr: تسافر بشكل متكرر لأغراض العمل.

definitionEn: recently produced or picked and not frozen, dried or preserved in tins or cans
example: We bought fresh vegetables from the market.
exampleAr: اشترينا خضروات طازجة من السوق.

definitionEn: the day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday
example: The report is due this Friday.
exampleAr: موعد تسليم التقرير هذا الجمعة.

definitionEn: a piece of electrical equipment in which food is kept cold so that it stays fresh
example: Put the milk back in the fridge.
exampleAr: أعد الحليب إلى الثلاجة.

definitionEn: a person you know well and like, and who is not usually a member of your family
example: She met her best friend in primary school.
exampleAr: تعرفت على صديقتها المقربة في المدرسة الابتدائية.

definitionEn: behaving in a kind and pleasant way because you like somebody or want to help them
example: Our neighbors are very friendly.
exampleAr: جيراننا ودودون جداً.

definitionEn: a relationship between friends
example: Their friendship has lasted over twenty years.
exampleAr: استمرت صداقتهما لأكثر من عشرين عاماً.

definitionEn: to make somebody suddenly feel afraid
example: The loud thunder frightened the dog.
exampleAr: أخاف الرعد العالي الكلب.

definitionEn: afraid; feeling fear
example: She was frightened by the strange noise outside.
exampleAr: شعرت بالخوف من الضجيج الغريب في الخارج.

definitionEn: making you feel afraid
example: It was a frightening experience for everyone on board.
exampleAr: كانت تجربة مخيفة لجميع من كان على متنها.

definitionEn: a small animal with smooth skin, that lives both on land and in water (= is an amphibian). Frogs have very long back legs for jumping, and no tail.
example: The children caught a frog by the pond.
exampleAr: أمسك الأطفال بضفدع بالقرب من البركة.

definitionEn: used to show where somebody/something starts
example: She comes from a small town in Italy.
exampleAr: هي من بلدة صغيرة في إيطاليا.

definitionEn: the part or side of something that faces forward; the side of something that you look at first
example: Park the car at the front of the building.
exampleAr: اركن السيارة أمام المبنى.

definitionEn: on or at the front of something
example: Please take a seat in the front row.
exampleAr: يُرجى الجلوس في الصف الأمامي.

definitionEn: kept at a very low temperature in order to preserve it
example: We bought some frozen vegetables for dinner.
exampleAr: اشترينا بعض الخضروات المجمدة لتحضير العشاء.

definitionEn: the part of a plant that consists of one or more seeds and a soft inner part, can be eaten as food and usually tastes sweet
example: She eats fruit every morning for breakfast.
exampleAr: تأكل الفاكهة كل صباح في وجبة الفطور.

definitionEn: feeling annoyed and impatient because you cannot do or achieve what you want
example: He felt frustrated after failing the test twice.
exampleAr: شعر بالإحباط بعد رسوبه في الاختبار مرتين.

definitionEn: causing you to feel annoyed and impatient because you cannot do or achieve what you want
example: It's frustrating when the internet keeps disconnecting.
exampleAr: من المحبط أن ينقطع الإنترنت باستمرار.

definitionEn: the feeling of being frustrated
example: She expressed her frustration with the slow progress.
exampleAr: عبّرت عن إحباطها من بطء التقدم.

definitionEn: to cook something in hot fat or oil; to be cooked in hot fat or oil
example: She fried the onions until golden brown.
exampleAr: قلت البصل حتى اكتسب لوناً ذهبياً.

definitionEn: any material that produces heat or power, usually when it is burnt
example: The car ran out of fuel on the highway.
exampleAr: نفد وقود السيارة على الطريق السريع.

definitionEn: to supply something with material that can be burnt to produce heat or power
example: Rising prices fueled public anger.
exampleAr: غذّى ارتفاع الأسعار غضب الجمهور.

definitionEn: to do or achieve what was hoped for or expected
example: She worked hard to fulfil her dream of becoming a doctor.
exampleAr: عملت بجد لتحقيق حلمها بأن تصبح طبيبة.

definitionEn: containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space
example: The bus was completely full during rush hour.
exampleAr: كانت الحافلة ممتلئة تماماً في ساعة الذروة.

definitionEn: for all the hours of a week during which people normally work or study, rather than just for a part of it
example: She just started a full-time job at the hospital.
exampleAr: بدأت للتو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المستشفى.

definitionEn: completely
example: The patient has fully recovered from surgery.
exampleAr: تعافى المريض بشكل كامل من الجراحة.

definitionEn: the feeling of enjoying yourself; activities that you enjoy
example: We had a lot of fun at the beach.
exampleAr: استمتعنا كثيراً في الشاطئ.

definitionEn: that you enjoy
example: It was a fun way to spend the afternoon.
exampleAr: كانت طريقة ممتعة لقضاء فترة بعد الظهر.

definitionEn: a special activity or purpose of a person or thing
example: The main function of the heart is to pump blood.
exampleAr: الوظيفة الرئيسية للقلب هي ضخ الدم.

definitionEn: to work in the correct way
example: The old machine still functions well.
exampleAr: ما زالت الآلة القديمة تعمل جيداً.

definitionEn: practical and useful; with little or no decoration
example: The design is simple but highly functional.
exampleAr: التصميم بسيط لكنه عملي جداً.

definitionEn: an amount of money that has been saved or has been made available for a particular purpose
example: The charity set up a fund to help refugees.
exampleAr: أنشأت الجمعية الخيرية صندوقاً لمساعدة اللاجئين.

definitionEn: to provide money for something, usually something official
example: The research is funded by the government.
exampleAr: تموّل الحكومة هذا البحث.

definitionEn: serious and very important; affecting the most central and important parts of something
example: Trust is fundamental to any relationship.
exampleAr: الثقة أساسية في أي علاقة.

definitionEn: in every way that is important; completely
example: The two approaches are fundamentally different.
exampleAr: يختلف الأسلوبان اختلافاً جذرياً.

definitionEn: money for a particular purpose; the act of providing money for such a purpose
example: The project lost its funding last year.
exampleAr: فقد المشروع تمويله العام الماضي.

definitionEn: the activity of collecting money for a charity or organization, often by organizing social events or entertainments
example: The school organized a fundraising event for new books.
exampleAr: نظّمت المدرسة فعالية لجمع التبرعات لشراء كتب جديدة.

definitionEn: a ceremony, often a religious one, for burying or cremating (= burning) a dead person
example: Family and friends gathered for the funeral.
exampleAr: اجتمع الأهل والأصدقاء لحضور الجنازة.

definitionEn: making you laugh
example: He told a really funny joke at dinner.
exampleAr: روى نكتة مضحكة جداً على العشاء.

definitionEn: the soft thick mass of hair that grows on the body of some animals
example: The cat's fur was soft and warm.
exampleAr: كان فرو القطة ناعماً ودافئاً.

definitionEn: very angry
example: She was furious when she found out about the lie.
exampleAr: غضبت جداً عندما اكتشفت الكذبة.

definitionEn: objects that can be moved, such as tables, chairs and beds, that are put into a house or an office to make it suitable for living or working in
example: They bought new furniture for the living room.
exampleAr: اشتروا أثاثاً جديداً لغرفة المعيشة.

definitionEn: more; additional
example: Please contact us if you need further information.
exampleAr: يُرجى التواصل معنا إذا احتجت إلى معلومات إضافية.

definitionEn: at or to a greater distance
example: The village is a few miles further along this road.
exampleAr: تقع القرية على بعد أميال أخرى على طول هذا الطريق.

definitionEn: in addition to what has just been stated. Furthermore is used especially to add a point to an argument.
example: The plan is expensive; furthermore, it may not even work.
exampleAr: الخطة مكلفة؛ علاوة على ذلك، قد لا تنجح أصلاً.

definitionEn: the time that will come after the present or the events that will happen then
example: She's optimistic about the future of the company.
exampleAr: إنها متفائلة بشأن مستقبل الشركة.

definitionEn: taking place or existing at a time after the present
example: They discussed future plans for expansion.
exampleAr: ناقشوا الخطط المستقبلية للتوسع.

definitionEn: to obtain or win something, especially something that you need or want
example: She gained a lot of experience during her internship.
exampleAr: اكتسبت خبرة كبيرة خلال فترة تدريبها.

definitionEn: an increase in the amount of something, especially in wealth or weight
example: The company reported strong gains this quarter.
exampleAr: أعلنت الشركة عن مكاسب قوية هذا الربع.

definitionEn: a room or building for showing works of art, especially to the public
example: They spent the afternoon in an art gallery.
exampleAr: أمضوا فترة بعد الظهر في معرض فني.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring liquid. In the UK, Canada and other countries it is equal to about 4.5 litres; in the US it is equal to about 3.8 litres. There are four quarts in a gallon.
example: The tank holds about ten gallons of fuel.
exampleAr: يتسع الخزان لنحو عشرة غالونات من الوقود.

definitionEn: the activity of playing games of chance for money and of betting on horses, etc.
example: He lost a lot of money through gambling.
exampleAr: خسر مبلغاً كبيراً من المال بسبب القمار.

definitionEn: an activity that you do to have fun, often one that has rules and that you can win or lose; the equipment for a game
example: The kids played a game of chess after dinner.
exampleAr: لعب الأطفال لعبة شطرنج بعد العشاء.

definitionEn: playing computer games
example: He spends most weekends gaming with friends online.
exampleAr: يقضي معظم عطلات نهاية الأسبوع في لعب ألعاب الفيديو مع أصدقائه عبر الإنترنت.

definitionEn: an organized group of criminals
example: The police broke up a gang involved in car theft.
exampleAr: فككت الشرطة عصابة متورطة في سرقة السيارات.

definitionEn: a space where something is missing
example: There's a growing gap between rich and poor.
exampleAr: توجد فجوة متزايدة بين الأغنياء والفقراء.

definitionEn: a building for keeping one or more cars or other vehicles in
example: They parked the car in the garage.
exampleAr: أوقفوا السيارة في المرآب.

definitionEn: a piece of land next to or around your house where you can grow flowers, fruit, vegetables, etc., usually with a lawn (= an area of grass)
example: She grows tomatoes in her garden.
exampleAr: تزرع الطماطم في حديقتها.

definitionEn: any substance like air that is neither a solid nor a liquid, for example hydrogen or oxygen
example: Natural gas is used to heat many homes.
exampleAr: يُستخدم الغاز الطبيعي لتدفئة كثير من المنازل.

definitionEn: a barrier like a door that is used to close an opening in a fence or a wall outside a building
example: Passengers should proceed to gate 12 for boarding.
exampleAr: على الركاب التوجه إلى البوابة رقم 12 للصعود إلى الطائرة.

definitionEn: to come together, or bring people together, in one place to form a group
example: She gathered all the papers into a folder.
exampleAr: جمعت كل الأوراق في ملف.

definitionEn: a meeting of people for a particular purpose
example: They held a small family gathering for the holidays.
exampleAr: أقاموا تجمعاً عائلياً صغيراً بمناسبة العطلات.

definitionEn: sexually attracted to people of the same sex
example: He came out as gay to his family last year.
exampleAr: أعلن لعائلته أنه مثلي الجنس العام الماضي.

definitionEn: to look steadily at somebody/something for a long time, either because you are very interested or surprised, or because you are thinking of something else
example: She gazed out of the window, lost in thought.
exampleAr: حدّقت من النافذة، شاردة الذهن.

definitionEn: a long, steady look at somebody/something
example: His steady gaze made her a little nervous.
exampleAr: جعلها تحديقه الثابت متوترة قليلاً.

definitionEn: equipment in a vehicle that changes the relation between engine speed (or pedal speed on a bicycle) and the speed of the wheels moving forwards or backwards
example: He shifted into second gear.
exampleAr: بدّل إلى السرعة الثانية.

definitionEn: the fact of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, rather than differences in biology; members of a particular gender as a group
example: The form asks for your name, age, and gender.
exampleAr: تطلب الاستمارة اسمك وعمرك ونوعك الاجتماعي.

definitionEn: a unit inside a cell that controls a particular quality in a living thing that has been passed on from its parents
example: Scientists identified the gene responsible for the disease.
exampleAr: حدّد العلماء الجين المسؤول عن هذا المرض.

definitionEn: affecting all or most people, places or things
example: The report gives a general overview of the market.
exampleAr: يقدّم التقرير لمحة عامة عن السوق.

definitionEn: affecting all or most people, places or things
example: The general led his troops into battle.
exampleAr: قاد الجنرال قواته إلى المعركة.

definitionEn: by or to most people
example: Generally, prices are higher in the city center.
exampleAr: عموماً، تكون الأسعار أعلى في وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: to produce energy, especially electricity
example: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight.
exampleAr: تولّد الألواح الشمسية الكهرباء من ضوء الشمس.

definitionEn: all the people who were born at about the same time
example: This tradition has been passed down through generations.
exampleAr: توارثت الأجيال هذا التقليد.

meaningAr: عام / غير مخصص / جنيس (دواء بدون علامة تجارية)
definitionEn: shared by, including or typical of a whole group of things; not specific
example: He gave a rather generic answer to the question.
exampleAr: قدّم إجابة عامة إلى حد ما عن السؤال.

definitionEn: giving or willing to give freely; given freely
example: It was very generous of her to donate so much.
exampleAr: كان تبرعها بهذا المبلغ الكبير أمراً في غاية السخاء.

definitionEn: connected with genes (= the units in the cells of a living thing that control its physical characteristics) or genetics (= the study of genes)
example: The disease is caused by a genetic mutation.
exampleAr: يسبب هذا المرض طفرة وراثية.

definitionEn: unusually great intelligence, skill or artistic ability
example: Einstein is widely regarded as a genius.
exampleAr: يُعدّ آينشتاين عبقرياً في نظر الكثيرين.

definitionEn: the murder of a large number of people from a particular nation or ethnic group, with the aim of destroying that nation or group
example: The tribunal was set up to investigate the genocide.
exampleAr: أُنشئت المحكمة للتحقيق في الإبادة الجماعية.

definitionEn: a particular type or style of literature, art, film or music that you can recognize because of its special features
example: Science fiction is her favorite literary genre.
exampleAr: الخيال العلمي هو نوعها الأدبي المفضل.

definitionEn: calm and kind; doing things in a quiet and careful way
example: She gave the baby a gentle pat on the back.
exampleAr: ربّتت على ظهر الطفل برفق.

definitionEn: a man who is polite and well educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well
example: A gentleman held the door open for her.
exampleAr: أمسك رجل محترم الباب مفتوحاً لها.

definitionEn: real; exactly what it appears to be; not artificial
example: He showed genuine concern for her wellbeing.
exampleAr: أبدى قلقاً حقيقياً على سلامتها.

definitionEn: truly; in a way that is exactly what it appears to be and is not artificial
example: I'm genuinely happy for you.
exampleAr: أنا سعيد حقاً من أجلك.

definitionEn: the scientific study of the earth’s surface, physical features, divisions, products, population, etc.
example: She studied geography at university.
exampleAr: درست الجغرافيا في الجامعة.

definitionEn: a movement that you make with your hands, your head or your face to show a particular meaning
example: He made a gesture for her to sit down.
exampleAr: أشار إليها بإيماءة لتجلس.

definitionEn: a movement that you make with your hands, your head or your face to show a particular meaning
example: She gestured toward the door.
exampleAr: أشارت نحو الباب.

meaningAr: يحصل على / يصبح / يصل / يذهب / يفهم / يُحضر
definitionEn: to receive something
example: She got a new job last month.
exampleAr: حصلت على وظيفة جديدة الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: the spirit of a dead person that a living person believes they can see or hear
example: The old house is said to be haunted by a ghost.
exampleAr: يُقال إن المنزل القديم مسكون بشبح.

definitionEn: very large; much larger or more important than similar things usually are
example: A giant billboard advertised the new movie.
exampleAr: أعلنت لوحة إعلانية عملاقة عن الفيلم الجديد.

definitionEn: (in stories) a very large strong person who is often cruel and stupid
example: In the story, a giant lived at the top of the beanstalk.
exampleAr: في القصة، كان عملاق يعيش أعلى ساق الفول.

definitionEn: a thing that you give to somebody, especially on a special occasion or to say thank you
example: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
exampleAr: أعطته هدية بمناسبة عيد ميلاده.

meaningAr: حفلة موسيقية (غير رسمية) / عمل مؤقت (اقتصاد المهن الحرة)
definitionEn: a performance by musicians playing popular music or jazz in front of an audience; a similar performance by a comedian
example: The band played a gig at a small local bar.
exampleAr: أحيت الفرقة حفلة موسيقية في حانة محلية صغيرة.

definitionEn: a female child
example: The girl smiled and waved at her friend.
exampleAr: ابتسمت الفتاة ولوّحت لصديقتها.

definitionEn: a girl or a woman that somebody is having a romantic relationship with
example: He introduced his girlfriend to his parents.
exampleAr: قدّم صديقته لوالديه.

meaningAr: يعطي / يقدّم (خطاباً أو عرضاً) / ينهار / يتراخى (مادياً)
definitionEn: to hand something to somebody so that they can look at it, use it or keep it for a time
example: She gave him a book for his birthday.
exampleAr: أعطته كتاباً بمناسبة عيد ميلاده.

definitionEn: pleased; happy
example: I'm so glad you could make it to the party.
exampleAr: أنا سعيد جداً لأنك تمكنت من حضور الحفلة.

definitionEn: to look quickly at something/somebody
example: She glanced at her watch during the meeting.
exampleAr: ألقت نظرة سريعة على ساعتها أثناء الاجتماع.

definitionEn: a quick look
example: One glance at his face told her something was wrong.
exampleAr: كفتها نظرة سريعة على وجهه لتدرك أن هناك خطأ ما.

definitionEn: a hard, usually clear, substance used, for example, for making windows and bottles
example: The window was made of thick glass.
exampleAr: كانت النافذة مصنوعة من زجاج سميك.

definitionEn: a sight of somebody/something for a very short time, when you do not see the person or thing completely
example: We caught a glimpse of the mountains through the clouds.
exampleAr: التقطنا لمحة من الجبال بين الغيوم.

definitionEn: a sight of somebody/something for a very short time, when you do not see the person or thing completely
example: She glimpsed a familiar face in the crowd.
exampleAr: لمحت وجهاً مألوفاً بين الحشد.

definitionEn: covering or affecting the whole world
example: Climate change is a global issue.
exampleAr: التغير المناخي قضية عالمية.

example: Globalization has increased trade between countries.
exampleAr: زادت العولمة من التبادل التجاري بين الدول.

definitionEn: the world (used especially to emphasize its size)
example: The company has offices across the globe.
exampleAr: تمتلك الشركة مكاتب في مختلف أنحاء العالم.

definitionEn: deserving or bringing great success and making somebody/something famous
example: It was a glorious sunny day for the wedding.
exampleAr: كان يوماً مشمساً رائعاً لحفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: great success that brings somebody praise and honour and makes them famous
example: The team basked in the glory of their victory.
exampleAr: استمتع الفريق بمجد انتصاره.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing for the hand, made of wool, leather, etc. with separate parts for each finger and the thumb
example: She wore warm gloves to protect her hands from the cold.
exampleAr: ارتدت قفازين دافئين لحماية يديها من البرد.

definitionEn: to move or travel from one place to another
example: They went to the market to buy vegetables.
exampleAr: ذهبوا إلى السوق لشراء الخضروات.

definitionEn: a person’s turn to move or play in a game or an activity
example: She had a go at fixing the printer herself.
exampleAr: قامت بمحاولة إصلاح الطابعة بنفسها.

definitionEn: a frame with a net into which players must kick or hit the ball in order to score a point
example: Her goal is to finish the marathon in under four hours.
exampleAr: هدفها إنهاء الماراثون في أقل من أربع ساعات.

definitionEn: the being or spirit that is worshipped and is believed to have created the universe
example: Many religions teach that God created the universe.
exampleAr: تعلّم كثير من الأديان أن الله خلق الكون.

definitionEn: a chemical element. Gold is a yellow precious metal used for making coins, jewellery, beautiful objects, etc.
example: The ring is made of pure gold.
exampleAr: هذا الخاتم مصنوع من الذهب الخالص.

definitionEn: bright yellow in colour, like gold
example: He gave her a gold necklace.
exampleAr: أهداها قلادة ذهبية.

definitionEn: made of gold
example: The sun cast a golden glow over the fields.
exampleAr: ألقت الشمس وهجًا ذهبيًا على الحقول.

definitionEn: a game played over a large area of ground using sticks with a special shape to hit a small hard ball (a golf ball) into a series of 9 or 18 holes, using as few shots as possible
example: He plays golf every Saturday morning.
exampleAr: يلعب الغولف كل صباح سبت.

meaningAr: جيد / حسن / ماهر / بارع في / طيب / لطيف (شخص) / مفيد / صحي
definitionEn: of high quality or an acceptable standard
example: This is a good restaurant.
exampleAr: هذا مطعم جيد.

definitionEn: behaviour that is morally right or acceptable
example: She did it for the good of her family.
exampleAr: فعلت ذلك من أجل مصلحة عائلتها.

definitionEn: used when you are leaving somebody or when somebody else is leaving
example: She hugged him and said goodbye.
exampleAr: عانقته وقالت وداعًا.

definitionEn: the quality of being good
example: He is a man of great goodness.
exampleAr: إنه رجل يتمتع بطيبة كبيرة.

definitionEn: the quality of being good
example: Goodness, I didn't expect you so soon!
exampleAr: يا إلهي، لم أكن أتوقع قدومك بهذه السرعة!

definitionEn: things that are produced to be sold
example: The store sells a wide range of electrical goods.
exampleAr: يبيع المتجر مجموعة واسعة من السلع الكهربائية.

definitionEn: very beautiful and attractive; giving great pleasure
example: She looked gorgeous at the wedding.
exampleAr: بدت جميلة جدًا في حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: to legally control a country or its people and be responsible for introducing new laws, organizing public services, etc.
example: The country has been governed by the same party for a decade.
exampleAr: يحكم الحزب نفسه البلاد منذ عقد من الزمن.

definitionEn: the activity of governing a country or controlling a company or an organization; the way in which a country is governed or a company or institution is controlled
example: The company improved its corporate governance.
exampleAr: حسّنت الشركة من حوكمتها المؤسسية.

definitionEn: the group of people who are responsible for controlling a country or a state
example: The government announced new economic reforms.
exampleAr: أعلنت الحكومة عن إصلاحات اقتصادية جديدة.

definitionEn: a person who is the official head of a country or region that is governed by another country
example: The governor signed the new bill into law.
exampleAr: وقّع الحاكم على مشروع القانون الجديد ليصبح نافذًا.

meaningAr: يخطف / يمسك بسرعة / يحصل على شيء بسرعة (عامي) / يجذب (الانتباه)
definitionEn: to take or hold somebody/something with your hand suddenly or roughly
example: He grabbed his coat and ran out the door.
exampleAr: خطف معطفه واندفع خارجًا من الباب.

meaningAr: رشاقة / أناقة الحركة / نعمة إلهية / فضل / مهلة إضافية
definitionEn: an attractive quality of movement that is smooth and done with control; a simple and beautiful quality
example: The dancer moved across the stage with grace.
exampleAr: تحركت الراقصة على المسرح برشاقة.

meaningAr: درجة / علامة دراسية / مستوى / فئة (جودة) / صف دراسي (أمريكي)
definitionEn: a mark given in an exam or for a piece of school work
example: She got the highest grade in the class.
exampleAr: حصلت على أعلى درجة في الصف.

definitionEn: to give a grade to a student or to a piece of their written work
example: The teacher spent the weekend grading essays.
exampleAr: قضى المعلم عطلة نهاية الأسبوع في تصحيح المقالات.

definitionEn: slowly, over a long period of time
example: The pain gradually faded over the next few days.
exampleAr: تلاشى الألم تدريجيًا خلال الأيام التالية.

definitionEn: to get a degree, especially your first degree, from a university or college
example: She graduated from medical school last spring.
exampleAr: تخرجت من كلية الطب في الربيع الماضي.

definitionEn: a person who has a university degree
example: He is a recent graduate looking for his first job.
exampleAr: هو خريج حديث يبحث عن وظيفته الأولى.

definitionEn: the small hard seeds of food plants such as wheat, rice, etc.; a single seed of such a plant
example: The region exports large amounts of grain.
exampleAr: تصدّر المنطقة كميات كبيرة من الحبوب.

definitionEn: impressive and large or important
example: They got married in a grand old cathedral.
exampleAr: تزوجا في كاتدرائية قديمة فخمة.

definitionEn: impressive and large or important
example: The used car cost him five grand.
exampleAr: كلفته السيارة المستعملة خمسة آلاف دولار.

definitionEn: the father of your father or mother
example: My grandfather fought in the war.
exampleAr: قاتل جدي في الحرب.

definitionEn: the mother of your father or mother
example: She learned to cook from her grandmother.
exampleAr: تعلمت الطهي من جدتها.

definitionEn: the father or mother of your father or mother
example: Both of her grandparents came to the graduation.
exampleAr: حضر جداها كلاهما حفل تخرجها.

definitionEn: to agree to give somebody what they ask for, especially formal or legal permission to do something
example: The court granted him full custody of the children.
exampleAr: منحته المحكمة الحضانة الكاملة للأطفال.

definitionEn: a sum of money that is given by the government or by another organization to be used for a particular purpose
example: She was awarded a government grant to fund her research.
exampleAr: حصلت على منحة حكومية لتمويل بحثها.

meaningAr: بياني / متعلق بالرسم / صريح / مفصل بشكل صادم
definitionEn: connected with drawings and design, especially in the production of books, magazines, websites, etc.
example: He studied graphic design at university.
exampleAr: درس التصميم الجرافيكي في الجامعة.

definitionEn: designs, drawings or pictures that are used especially in the production of books, magazines, websites, etc.
example: The new game has incredibly realistic graphics.
exampleAr: تتمتع اللعبة الجديدة برسومات واقعية بشكل مذهل.

definitionEn: to take a strong hold of somebody/something
example: She grasped the handrail as she climbed the stairs.
exampleAr: أمسكت بالدرابزين بإحكام وهي تصعد الدرج.

definitionEn: a strong hold of somebody/something or control over somebody/something
example: He has a solid grasp of world history.
exampleAr: لديه فهم متين للتاريخ العالمي.

definitionEn: a common wild plant with narrow green leaves and stems that are eaten by cows, horses, sheep, etc.
example: The kids were playing on the grass in the park.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال يلعبون على العشب في الحديقة.

definitionEn: feeling or showing thanks because somebody has done something kind for you or has done as you asked
example: I'm so grateful for everything you've done.
exampleAr: أنا ممتن جدًا لكل ما فعلته.

definitionEn: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried
example: They visited their grandfather's grave every year.
exampleAr: كانوا يزورون قبر جدهم كل عام.

definitionEn: very serious and important; giving you a reason to feel worried
example: The doctor's expression suggested the news was grave.
exampleAr: أوحت ملامح الطبيب بأن الخبر كان خطيرًا.

definitionEn: the force that attracts objects in space towards each other, and that on the earth pulls them towards the centre of the planet, so that things fall to the ground when they are dropped
example: Gravity causes objects to fall toward the earth.
exampleAr: تتسبب الجاذبية في سقوط الأجسام نحو الأرض.

meaningAr: عظيم / رائع / كبير جدًا (في الدرجة أو الحجم) / عظيم / بارز (شخصية أو إنجاز)
definitionEn: very good or pleasant
example: That's a great idea, let's do it.
exampleAr: هذه فكرة رائعة، فلنطبّقها.

definitionEn: very much
example: Her health has greatly improved since the surgery.
exampleAr: تحسنت صحتها كثيرًا منذ الجراحة.

definitionEn: having the colour of grass or the leaves of most plants and trees
example: She was wearing a green dress.
exampleAr: كانت ترتدي فستانًا أخضر.

definitionEn: the colour of grass and the leaves of most plants and trees
example: They set up a market stall on the village green.
exampleAr: أقاموا كشك سوق على الساحة الخضراء بالقرية.

example: She grows tomatoes and peppers in her greenhouse.
exampleAr: تزرع الطماطم والفلفل في بيتها الزجاجي.

meaningAr: يحيي / يرحب بـ / يُقابَل بـ (رد فعل)
definitionEn: to say hello to somebody or to welcome them
example: He greeted every guest personally at the door.
exampleAr: رحّب بكل ضيف شخصيًا عند الباب.

definitionEn: having the colour of smoke or ashes
example: His hair has turned grey over the past few years.
exampleAr: تحول شعره إلى اللون الرمادي خلال السنوات القليلة الماضية.

meaningAr: شبكة (كهرباء أو إمداد) / شبكة من الخطوط المتقاطعة
definitionEn: a pattern of straight lines, usually crossing each other to form squares
example: The storm knocked out power to the entire grid.
exampleAr: قطعت العاصفة الكهرباء عن الشبكة بأكملها.

definitionEn: a very sad feeling, especially when somebody dies
example: She was consumed by grief after her mother's death.
exampleAr: استحوذ عليها حزن شديد بعد وفاة والدتها.

definitionEn: to smile widely
example: He grinned broadly as he opened his gift.
exampleAr: ابتسم ابتسامة عريضة وهو يفتح هديته.

definitionEn: a wide smile
example: She had a wide grin on her face all day.
exampleAr: ظلت ابتسامة عريضة ترتسم على وجهها طوال اليوم.

definitionEn: to break or press something into very small pieces between two hard surfaces or using a special machine
example: She ground the coffee beans fresh every morning.
exampleAr: كانت تطحن حبوب القهوة طازجة كل صباح.

definitionEn: to break or press something into very small pieces between two hard surfaces or using a special machine
example: He was worn out by the daily grind of commuting.
exampleAr: أنهكه الروتين اليومي المضني للتنقل إلى العمل.

definitionEn: an act of holding somebody/something tightly; a particular way of doing this
example: He kept a firm grip on the ladder.
exampleAr: أبقى على قبضة محكمة على السلم.

definitionEn: to hold something tightly
example: She gripped his arm as they crossed the busy street.
exampleAr: أمسكت بذراعه بإحكام وهما يعبران الشارع المزدحم.

definitionEn: a shop that sells food and other things used in the home. In American English ‘grocery store’ is often used to mean ‘supermarket’.
example: I need to do the grocery shopping this afternoon.
exampleAr: يجب أن أقوم بتسوق البقالة بعد ظهر اليوم.

definitionEn: being the total amount of something before anything is taken away
example: Her gross salary is fifty thousand dollars a year.
exampleAr: راتبها الإجمالي خمسون ألف دولار سنويًا.

definitionEn: the solid surface of the earth
example: Ripe apples had fallen all over the ground.
exampleAr: سقطت تفاحات ناضجة في كل مكان على الأرض.

meaningAr: يمنع من الطيران (طائرة) / يمنع من الخروج (عقاب مراهق)
definitionEn: the solid surface of the earth
example: All flights were grounded because of the storm.
exampleAr: مُنعت جميع الرحلات الجوية من الإقلاع بسبب العاصفة.

definitionEn: a number of people or things that are together in the same place or that are connected in some way
example: A group of tourists gathered around the guide.
exampleAr: تجمعت مجموعة من السياح حول المرشد.

definitionEn: a number of people or things that are together in the same place or that are connected in some way
example: The students were grouped according to their age.
exampleAr: قُسّم الطلاب إلى مجموعات بحسب أعمارهم.

definitionEn: to increase in size, number, strength or quality
example: The plant grew quickly in the warm sunlight.
exampleAr: نمت النبتة بسرعة تحت أشعة الشمس الدافئة.

definitionEn: the process in people, animals or plants of growing physically, mentally or emotionally
example: The company reported strong growth this quarter.
exampleAr: أعلنت الشركة عن نمو قوي هذا الربع.

definitionEn: a formal promise that you will do something or that something will happen
example: The washing machine comes with a two-year guarantee.
exampleAr: تأتي الغسالة مع ضمان لمدة سنتين.

definitionEn: to promise to do something; to promise something will happen
example: I can't guarantee the delivery will arrive on time.
exampleAr: لا أستطيع أن أضمن وصول الشحنة في الموعد المحدد.

definitionEn: a person, such as a soldier, a police officer or a prison officer, who protects a place or people, or prevents prisoners from escaping
example: A security guard checked our bags at the entrance.
exampleAr: فحص حارس أمن حقائبنا عند المدخل.

definitionEn: to protect property, places or people from attack or danger
example: Soldiers guarded the border around the clock.
exampleAr: حرس الجنود الحدود على مدار الساعة.

definitionEn: a member of a small group of soldiers who are not part of an official army and who fight against official soldiers, usually to try to change the government
example: Guerrillas ambushed the military convoy in the hills.
exampleAr: نصب مقاتلو العصابات كمينًا للقافلة العسكرية في التلال.

definitionEn: a member of a small group of soldiers who are not part of an official army and who fight against official soldiers, usually to try to change the government
example: The rebels relied on guerrilla warfare against the larger army.
exampleAr: اعتمد المتمردون على حرب العصابات ضد الجيش الأكبر حجمًا.

definitionEn: to try and give an answer or make a judgement about something without being sure of all the facts
example: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
exampleAr: أظن أنها ستمطر غدًا.

definitionEn: an attempt to give an answer or an opinion when you cannot be certain if you are right
example: Take a guess at how many candies are in the jar.
exampleAr: خمّن عدد قطع الحلوى الموجودة في الجرة.

definitionEn: a person that you have invited to your house or to a particular event that you are paying for
example: We have twenty guests coming to the wedding.
exampleAr: سيحضر عشرون ضيفًا حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: a person that you have invited to your house or to a particular event that you are paying for
example: The guest speaker gave a fascinating talk on climate change.
exampleAr: قدّم المتحدث الضيف محاضرة رائعة عن تغيّر المناخ.

definitionEn: help or advice that is given to somebody, especially by somebody older or with more experience
example: Students receive career guidance from their teachers.
exampleAr: يتلقى الطلاب إرشادًا مهنيًا من معلميهم.

definitionEn: a person who shows other people the way to a place, especially somebody employed to show tourists around interesting places
example: Our tour guide showed us around the old city.
exampleAr: اصطحبنا مرشدنا السياحي في جولة حول المدينة القديمة.

definitionEn: to show somebody the way to a place, often by going with them; to show somebody a place that you know well
example: He guided us safely through the storm.
exampleAr: أرشدنا بأمان خلال العاصفة.

definitionEn: a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult
example: The government issued new guidelines on food safety.
exampleAr: أصدرت الحكومة إرشادات جديدة بشأن سلامة الغذاء.

definitionEn: the unhappy feelings caused by knowing or thinking that you have done something wrong
example: He was overwhelmed by guilt after lying to her.
exampleAr: انتابه شعور شديد بالذنب بعد أن كذب عليها.

definitionEn: feeling ashamed because you have done something that you know is wrong or have not done something that you should have done
example: She felt guilty for forgetting his birthday.
exampleAr: شعرت بالذنب لأنها نسيت عيد ميلاده.

definitionEn: a musical instrument that usually has six strings and that you play with your fingers or with a plectrum
example: He taught himself to play the guitar.
exampleAr: تعلّم العزف على الجيتار بنفسه.

definitionEn: a weapon that is used for firing bullets or shells
example: Police found a gun hidden under the car seat.
exampleAr: عثرت الشرطة على مسدس مخبأ تحت مقعد السيارة.

definitionEn: the tube in the body through which food passes when it leaves the stomach
example: Spicy food always upsets my gut.
exampleAr: الطعام الحار يزعج معدتي دائمًا.

definitionEn: the tube in the body through which food passes when it leaves the stomach
example: The fire gutted the old warehouse.
exampleAr: دمّر الحريق المستودع القديم من الداخل.

meaningAr: رجل / شاب (عامي) / يا جماعة (خطاب لمجموعة، عامي)
definitionEn: a man
example: He's a really nice guy once you get to know him.
exampleAr: إنه شاب لطيف جدًا بمجرد أن تتعرف عليه.

definitionEn: a room or hall with equipment for doing physical exercise, for example in a school
example: She goes to the gym three times a week.
exampleAr: تذهب إلى صالة الرياضة ثلاث مرات في الأسبوع.

definitionEn: a thing that you do often and almost without thinking, especially something that is hard to stop doing
example: Smoking is a hard habit to break.
exampleAr: التدخين عادة يصعب الإقلاع عنها.

definitionEn: the place where a particular type of animal or plant is normally found
example: Deforestation is destroying the animals' natural habitat.
exampleAr: تدمر إزالة الغابات الموطن الطبيعي للحيوانات.

definitionEn: to describe somebody/something as being very good or special, especially in newspapers, etc.
example: She hailed a taxi outside the station.
exampleAr: استوقفت سيارة أجرة خارج المحطة.

definitionEn: to describe somebody/something as being very good or special, especially in newspapers, etc.
example: The storm brought heavy hail and strong winds.
exampleAr: جلبت العاصفة بَرَدًا كثيفًا ورياحًا قوية.

definitionEn: the substance that looks like a mass of fine threads growing on a person's head
example: She has long brown hair.
exampleAr: لديها شعر بني طويل.

definitionEn: either of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided
example: He ate half of the sandwich and saved the rest.
exampleAr: أكل نصف الشطيرة واحتفظ بالباقي.

definitionEn: an amount equal to half of something/somebody
example: It took half an hour to get there.
exampleAr: استغرق الوصول إلى هناك نصف ساعة.

definitionEn: at an equal distance between two points; in the middle of a period of time
example: We stopped for lunch halfway through the journey.
exampleAr: توقفنا لتناول الغداء في منتصف الرحلة.

definitionEn: at an equal distance between two points; in the middle of a period of time
example: They reached the halfway point of the marathon.
exampleAr: بلغوا نقطة منتصف الماراثون.

definitionEn: a space or passage inside the entrance or front door of a building
example: The wedding reception was held in the town hall.
exampleAr: أُقيم حفل استقبال الزفاف في قاعة البلدية.

definitionEn: to stop; to make somebody/something stop
example: Production was halted due to a shortage of parts.
exampleAr: توقف الإنتاج بسبب نقص القطع.

definitionEn: an act of stopping the movement or progress of somebody/something
example: The train came to a sudden halt in the middle of the tunnel.
exampleAr: توقف القطار فجأة في منتصف النفق.

definitionEn: the part of the body at the end of the arm, including the fingers and thumb
example: She held the baby gently in her hands.
exampleAr: حملت الرضيع برفق بين يديها.

definitionEn: to pass or give something to somebody
example: She handed him the keys to the car.
exampleAr: سلّمته مفاتيح السيارة.

definitionEn: the amount of something that can be held in one hand
example: She added a handful of raisins to the mix.
exampleAr: أضافت حفنة من الزبيب إلى الخليط.

meaningAr: يتعامل مع / يتصرف في / يمسك بـ / يلمس
definitionEn: to deal with a situation, a person, an area of work or a strong emotion
example: She handled the customer's complaint very professionally.
exampleAr: تعاملت مع شكوى الزبون بمهنية عالية.

definitionEn: the part of a door, window, etc. that you use to open it
example: The handle on the door was broken.
exampleAr: كان مقبض الباب مكسورًا.

definitionEn: the way that somebody deals with or treats a situation, a person, an animal, etc.
example: The company was criticized for its handling of the crisis.
exampleAr: تعرضت الشركة للانتقاد بسبب طريقة تعاملها مع الأزمة.

meaningAr: مفيد / عملي / قريب المتناول / ماهر بيديه
definitionEn: easy to use or to do
example: This little tool is really handy for small repairs.
exampleAr: هذه الأداة الصغيرة مفيدة جدًا للإصلاحات البسيطة.

definitionEn: to attach something, or to be attached, at the top so that the lower part is free or loose
example: She hung the painting on the living room wall.
exampleAr: علّقت اللوحة على جدار غرفة المعيشة.

definitionEn: to take place, especially without being planned
example: Nobody knows exactly what happened that night.
exampleAr: لا أحد يعرف بالضبط ما الذي حدث تلك الليلة.

definitionEn: in a cheerful way; with feelings of pleasure
example: The children played happily in the garden all afternoon.
exampleAr: لعب الأطفال بسعادة في الحديقة طوال فترة بعد الظهر.

definitionEn: the state of feeling or showing pleasure
example: Money can't buy true happiness.
exampleAr: المال لا يستطيع شراء السعادة الحقيقية.

definitionEn: feeling or showing pleasure; pleased
example: She looked happy when she heard the good news.
exampleAr: بدت سعيدة عندما سمعت الخبر السار.

definitionEn: the act of annoying or worrying somebody by putting pressure on them or saying or doing unpleasant things to them
example: The company introduced a strict policy against workplace harassment.
exampleAr: أدخلت الشركة سياسة صارمة لمكافحة التحرش في مكان العمل.

definitionEn: an area of water on the coast, protected from the open sea by strong walls, where ships can shelter
example: The fishing boats returned to the harbour at dusk.
exampleAr: عادت قوارب الصيد إلى الميناء عند الغسق.

definitionEn: an area of water on the coast, protected from the open sea by strong walls, where ships can shelter
example: He harboured a grudge against his former boss for years.
exampleAr: أضمر حقدًا تجاه رئيسه السابق لسنوات.

meaningAr: صعب / صلب (قاسي الملمس) / قاسٍ (شخص أو موقف)
definitionEn: difficult to do, understand or answer
example: The exam was harder than she expected.
exampleAr: كان الامتحان أصعب مما توقعت.

definitionEn: with great effort; with difficulty
example: She worked hard to pass the exam.
exampleAr: عملت بجد لتجتاز الامتحان.

definitionEn: almost no; almost not; almost none
example: I hardly know him; we've only met once.
exampleAr: بالكاد أعرفه؛ لم نلتقِ سوى مرة واحدة.

definitionEn: the machines and electronic parts in a computer or other electronic system
example: The company sells both computer hardware and software.
exampleAr: تبيع الشركة الأجهزة والبرمجيات الحاسوبية على حد سواء.

definitionEn: damage or injury that is caused by a person or an event
example: The chemicals can cause serious harm to the environment.
exampleAr: يمكن أن تسبب المواد الكيميائية ضررًا بالغًا للبيئة.

definitionEn: to hurt or injure somebody or to damage something
example: Too much sun can harm your skin.
exampleAr: يمكن أن تؤذي الشمس المفرطة بشرتك.

definitionEn: causing damage or injury to somebody/something, especially to a person’s health or to the environment
example: Smoking is harmful to your health.
exampleAr: التدخين ضار بصحتك.

definitionEn: a state of peaceful existence and agreement
example: The two communities have lived in harmony for generations.
exampleAr: عاش المجتمعان في وئام على مدى أجيال.

meaningAr: قاسٍ (ظروف أو طقس) / قاسٍ (كلام أو عقاب)
definitionEn: cruel, severe and unkind
example: They had to survive the harsh winter with little food.
exampleAr: اضطروا للنجاة من الشتاء القاسي بقليل من الطعام.

definitionEn: the time of year when the crops are gathered in on a farm, etc.; the act of cutting and gathering crops
example: Farmers were pleased with this year's wheat harvest.
exampleAr: سُرّ المزارعون بحصاد القمح هذا العام.

definitionEn: to cut and gather a crop; to catch a number of animals or fish to eat
example: The grapes are harvested in early autumn.
exampleAr: يُحصد العنب في أوائل الخريف.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing made to fit the head, often with a brim (= a flat edge that sticks out), usually worn out of doors
example: She wore a wide-brimmed hat to protect her from the sun.
exampleAr: ارتدت قبعة واسعة الحواف لتقيها من الشمس.

definitionEn: to dislike somebody/something very much
example: I hate waiting in long queues.
exampleAr: أكره الانتظار في الطوابير الطويلة.

definitionEn: a very strong feeling of dislike for somebody
example: The crime was motivated by racial hate.
exampleAr: كانت الكراهية العنصرية الدافع وراء الجريمة.

definitionEn: a very strong feeling of dislike for somebody/something
example: The war left a legacy of hatred between the two nations.
exampleAr: خلّفت الحرب إرثًا من الكراهية الشديدة بين الأمتين.

definitionEn: if the ghost of a dead person haunts a place, people say that they have seen it there
example: Locals believe the old house is haunted by a ghost.
exampleAr: يعتقد السكان المحليون أن المنزل القديم مسكون بشبح.

meaningAr: يملك / فعل مساعد لتكوين الأزمنة التامة / يتناول / يقوم بـ
definitionEn: to own, hold or possess something
example: They have a beautiful house by the sea.
exampleAr: يملكون منزلًا جميلًا على البحر.

definitionEn: used to show that you must do something
example: I have to leave early tomorrow morning.
exampleAr: يجب أن أغادر باكرًا صباح الغد.

definitionEn: something that can be dangerous or cause damage
example: Wet floors are a serious safety hazard.
exampleAr: الأرضيات المبللة تشكل خطرًا جسيمًا على السلامة.

definitionEn: a male person or animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified
example: He works at the hospital downtown.
exampleAr: يعمل في المستشفى وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: the part of the body on top of the neck containing the eyes, nose, mouth and brain
example: She hit her head on the low doorway.
exampleAr: ضربت رأسها بالباب المنخفض.

definitionEn: to move in a particular direction
example: The ship headed north toward the coast.
exampleAr: اتجهت السفينة شمالًا نحو الساحل.

definitionEn: a continuous pain in the head
example: I have a terrible headache today.
exampleAr: أعاني من صداع رهيب اليوم.

definitionEn: the title of a news article printed in large letters, especially at the top of the front page on a newspaper or the home page on a news website
example: The scandal made headlines across the country.
exampleAr: تصدرت الفضيحة عناوين الصحف في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

definitionEn: the title of a news article printed in large letters, especially at the top of the front page on a newspaper or the home page on a news website
example: The band will headline the festival this year.
exampleAr: ستتصدر الفرقة حفل المهرجان هذا العام.

definitionEn: a place from which an organization or a military operation is controlled; the people who work there
example: The company's headquarters are located in New York.
exampleAr: يقع المقر الرئيسي للشركة في نيويورك.

definitionEn: to become healthy again; to make something healthy again
example: The wound healed within two weeks.
exampleAr: التأم الجرح خلال أسبوعين.

definitionEn: the condition of a person’s body or mind
example: Regular exercise is good for your health.
exampleAr: ممارسة الرياضة بانتظام مفيدة لصحتك.

definitionEn: the service of providing medical care
example: The government is investing more in public healthcare.
exampleAr: تستثمر الحكومة أكثر في الرعاية الصحية العامة.

meaningAr: صحي / بصحة جيدة / كبير / جيد (مجازي، أرباح مثلًا)
definitionEn: having good health and not likely to become ill
example: She eats a healthy diet full of vegetables.
exampleAr: تتبع نظامًا غذائيًا صحيًا مليئًا بالخضروات.

definitionEn: to be aware of sounds with your ears
example: I can hear the birds singing outside.
