exampleAr: أستطيع سماع تغريد الطيور في الخارج.

definitionEn: the ability to hear
example: His hearing has gotten worse with age.
exampleAr: ساءت حاسة سمعه مع تقدمه في السن.

meaningAr: القلب (عضو) / جوهر / صميم الأمر / المشاعر / العاطفة
definitionEn: the organ in the chest that sends blood around the body, usually on the left in humans
example: Her heart was racing after the run.
exampleAr: كان قلبها يخفق بسرعة بعد الجري.

definitionEn: the quality of being hot
example: The heat in summer here is unbearable.
exampleAr: الحرارة هنا في الصيف لا تُطاق.

definitionEn: to make something hot or warm; to become hot or warm
example: Heat the oil in a large pan before adding the onions.
exampleAr: سخّن الزيت في مقلاة كبيرة قبل إضافة البصل.

definitionEn: the process of supplying heat to a room or building; a system used to do this
example: We need to turn on the heating; it's freezing in here.
exampleAr: يجب أن نشغّل التدفئة؛ الجو بارد جدًا هنا.

definitionEn: the place believed to be the home of God where good people go when they die, sometimes imagined to be in the sky
example: Many religions teach that good people go to heaven.
exampleAr: تُعلّم أديان كثيرة أن الصالحين يذهبون إلى الجنة.

definitionEn: to a great degree; in large amounts
example: It rained heavily throughout the night.
exampleAr: أمطرت بغزارة طوال الليل.

meaningAr: ثقيل (الوزن) / شديد / كثيف / مُفرط في شيء (تدخين، شرب)
definitionEn: weighing a lot; difficult to lift or move
example: This suitcase is too heavy to carry up the stairs.
exampleAr: هذه الحقيبة ثقيلة جدًا بحيث يتعذر حملها صعودًا على الدرج.

definitionEn: the back part of the foot below the ankle
example: She got a blister on her heel from the new shoes.
exampleAr: أصيبت بنفطة في كعب قدمها بسبب الحذاء الجديد.

definitionEn: the measurement of how tall a person or thing is
example: What is the height of that building?
exampleAr: ما ارتفاع ذلك المبنى؟

definitionEn: if a feeling or an effect heightens, or something heightens it, it becomes stronger or increases
example: The dim lighting heightened the sense of mystery.
exampleAr: عززت الإضاءة الخافتة الشعور بالغموض.

definitionEn: an aircraft without wings that has large blades (= long flat parts) on top that go round. It can fly straight up from the ground and can also stay in one position in the air.
example: The helicopter landed on the hospital roof.
exampleAr: هبطت طائرة الهليكوبتر على سطح المستشفى.

definitionEn: the place believed to be the home of devils and where bad people go after death
example: In many religions, sinners are said to go to hell.
exampleAr: يُقال في كثير من الأديان إن المذنبين يذهبون إلى الجحيم.

definitionEn: used as a greeting when you meet somebody, in an email, when you answer the phone or when you want to attract somebody’s attention
example: She said hello to everyone as she walked in.
exampleAr: قالت مرحبًا للجميع وهي تدخل.

definitionEn: a type of hard hat that protects the head, worn, for example, by a police officer, a soldier or a person riding a bike or motorbike or playing some sports
example: Cyclists should always wear a helmet.
exampleAr: يجب على راكبي الدراجات ارتداء خوذة دائمًا.

definitionEn: to make it easier or possible for somebody to do something by doing something for them or by giving them something that they need
example: Could you help me carry these bags?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك مساعدتي في حمل هذه الحقائب؟

definitionEn: the act of helping somebody to do something
example: Thank you for all your help this week.
exampleAr: شكرًا لك على كل مساعدتك هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: able to improve a particular situation
example: The staff at the hotel were extremely helpful.
exampleAr: كان طاقم الفندق متعاونًا للغاية.

definitionEn: for this reason
example: The bridge is closed for repairs, hence the traffic delays.
exampleAr: الجسر مغلق للصيانة، ومن ثم حدثت تأخيرات في حركة المرور.

definitionEn: used as the object of a verb, after the verb be or after a preposition to refer to a woman or girl who has already been mentioned or is easily identified
example: I saw her at the mall yesterday.
exampleAr: رأيتها في المركز التجاري بالأمس.

definitionEn: of or belonging to a woman or girl who has already been mentioned or is easily identified
example: She forgot her umbrella at home.
exampleAr: نسيت مظلتها في المنزل.

definitionEn: a plant whose leaves, flowers or seeds are used to add taste to food, in medicines or for their pleasant smell. parsley, mint and oregano are all herbs.
example: She grows fresh herbs like basil and mint in her garden.
exampleAr: تزرع أعشابًا طازجة كالريحان والنعناع في حديقتها.

definitionEn: used after a verb or preposition to mean ‘in, at or to this position or place’
example: Please sit here while I get the documents.
exampleAr: تفضل بالجلوس هنا بينما أحضر المستندات.

definitionEn: the history, traditions, buildings and objects that a country or society has had for many years and that are considered an important part of its character
example: The old town is known for its rich cultural heritage.
exampleAr: تشتهر البلدة القديمة بتراثها الثقافي الغني.

definitionEn: a person who is admired by many people for doing something brave or good
example: The firefighter was hailed as a hero for saving the child.
exampleAr: أُشيد برجل الإطفاء باعتباره بطلًا لإنقاذه الطفل.

definitionEn: of or belonging to her
example: This umbrella isn't mine, it's hers.
exampleAr: هذه المظلة ليست لي، إنها لها.

definitionEn: used when the woman or girl who performs an action is also affected by it
example: She made the cake herself.
exampleAr: صنعت الكعكة بنفسها.

definitionEn: to be slow to speak or act because you feel uncertain or nervous
example: Don't hesitate to call me if you need anything.
exampleAr: لا تتردد في الاتصال بي إذا احتجت إلى أي شيء.

definitionEn: used to attract somebody’s attention or to express interest, surprise or anger
example: Hey, look over there!
exampleAr: مهلًا، انظر إلى هناك!

definitionEn: used to say hello
example: Hi, how are you doing today?
exampleAr: مرحبًا، كيف حالك اليوم؟

definitionEn: something that is hidden is kept or located in a place where it cannot be seen
example: The map led them to a hidden treasure.
exampleAr: قادتهم الخريطة إلى كنز مخفي.

definitionEn: to put or keep somebody/something in a place where they/it cannot be seen or found
example: The children hid behind the sofa during the game.
exampleAr: اختبأ الأطفال خلف الأريكة أثناء اللعبة.

definitionEn: a system, especially in a society or an organization, in which people are organized into different levels of importance from highest to lowest
example: The company has a strict management hierarchy.
exampleAr: تتبع الشركة تسلسلًا هرميًا إداريًا صارمًا.

meaningAr: عالٍ (الارتفاع) / مرتفع (الدرجة أو الكمية) / رفيع (المستوى أو المنصب)
definitionEn: measuring a long distance from the bottom to the top
example: The wall around the garden is very high.
exampleAr: الجدار المحيط بالحديقة عالٍ جدًا.

definitionEn: at or to a position or level that is a long way up from the ground or from the bottom
example: The kite flew high above the trees.
exampleAr: حلّقت الطائرة الورقية عاليًا فوق الأشجار.

definitionEn: the highest level or number
example: The stock market hit a new high this week.
exampleAr: بلغت سوق الأسهم مستوى قياسيًا جديدًا هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: receiving or involving a lot of attention and discussion in the media
example: She worked on several high-profile cases as a lawyer.
exampleAr: عملت على عدة قضايا بارزة حظيت باهتمام إعلامي واسع بصفتها محامية.

definitionEn: to emphasize something, especially so that people give it more attention
example: The report highlights the risks of climate change.
exampleAr: يسلط التقرير الضوء على مخاطر تغير المناخ.

definitionEn: the best, most interesting or most exciting part of something
example: The highlight of the trip was visiting the pyramids.
exampleAr: كانت زيارة الأهرامات أبرز لحظة في الرحلة.

definitionEn: very
example: She is a highly skilled surgeon.
exampleAr: هي جراحة ماهرة للغاية.

definitionEn: a main road for travelling long distances, especially one connecting and going through cities and towns
example: The accident caused a huge traffic jam on the highway.
exampleAr: تسبب الحادث في ازدحام مروري هائل على الطريق السريع.

definitionEn: extremely funny
example: The comedian's jokes were absolutely hilarious.
exampleAr: كانت نكات الكوميديان مضحكة جدًا حقًا.

definitionEn: an area of land that is higher than the land around it, but not as high as a mountain
example: They hiked up the hill to watch the sunset.
exampleAr: تسلقوا التلة سيرًا على الأقدام لمشاهدة غروب الشمس.

definitionEn: used as the object of a verb, after the verb be or after a preposition to refer to a male person or animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified
example: I gave him the book yesterday.
exampleAr: أعطيته الكتاب بالأمس.

definitionEn: used when the man or boy who performs an action is also affected by it
example: He blamed himself for the mistake.
exampleAr: لام نفسه على الخطأ.

definitionEn: something that you say or do in an indirect way in order to show somebody what you are thinking
example: She gave him a hint about her surprise party.
exampleAr: أعطته تلميحًا عن حفلة المفاجأة الخاصة بها.

definitionEn: to suggest something in an indirect way
example: He hinted that he might resign soon.
exampleAr: لمّح إلى أنه قد يستقيل قريبًا.

definitionEn: the area at either side of the body between the top of the leg and the middle part of the body; the joint at the top of the leg that connects it with the top part of the body
example: She broke her hip in the fall.
exampleAr: كسرت وركها في السقوط.

definitionEn: the area at either side of the body between the top of the leg and the middle part of the body; the joint at the top of the leg that connects it with the top part of the body
example: That new cafe is a really hip place to hang out.
exampleAr: ذلك المقهى الجديد مكان عصري حقًا للتسكع فيه.

definitionEn: to give somebody a job
example: The company plans to hire ten new engineers.
exampleAr: تخطط الشركة لتوظيف عشرة مهندسين جدد.

definitionEn: the act of paying to use something for a short time
example: She's our newest hire in the sales team.
exampleAr: هي أحدث موظفة لدينا في فريق المبيعات.

definitionEn: of or belonging to a man or boy who has already been mentioned or is easily identified
example: He parked his car outside the house.
exampleAr: أوقف سيارته أمام المنزل.

definitionEn: of or belonging to him
example: This book isn't mine, it's his.
exampleAr: هذا الكتاب ليس لي، إنه له.

definitionEn: a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history
example: The historian spent years researching ancient Rome.
exampleAr: أمضى المؤرخ سنوات في البحث عن روما القديمة.

definitionEn: important in history; likely to be thought of as important at some time in the future
example: They signed a historic peace agreement.
exampleAr: وقّعوا اتفاقية سلام تاريخية.

definitionEn: connected with the past
example: The museum has a large collection of historical artifacts.
exampleAr: يضم المتحف مجموعة كبيرة من القطع الأثرية التاريخية.

definitionEn: all the events that happened in the past
example: She studies history at university.
exampleAr: تدرس التاريخ في الجامعة.

definitionEn: to bring your hand, or an object you are holding, against somebody/something quickly and with force
example: The car hit a tree on the icy road.
exampleAr: اصطدمت السيارة بشجرة على الطريق المتجمد.

definitionEn: an act of hitting somebody/something with your hand or with an object held in your hand
example: She took a hard hit during the game.
exampleAr: تلقت ضربة قوية أثناء المباراة.

definitionEn: an activity that you do for pleasure when you are not working
example: Photography is one of my favorite hobbies.
exampleAr: التصوير الفوتوغرافي واحد من هواياتي المفضلة.

definitionEn: a game played on a field by two teams of 11 players, with curved sticks and a small hard ball. Teams try to hit the ball into the other team’s goal.
example: They watched a hockey game on Saturday night.
exampleAr: شاهدوا مباراة هوكي مساء السبت.

meaningAr: يمسك / يعقد (اجتماعًا أو حدثًا) / يتسع لـ (سعة) / يعتنق (رأيًا أو موقفًا)
definitionEn: to have somebody/something in your hand, arms, etc.
example: She held the baby carefully in her arms.
exampleAr: حملت الرضيع بحرص بين ذراعيها.

meaningAr: قبضة (إمساك جسدي) / سيطرة / نفوذ على شخص
definitionEn: the action of holding somebody/something; the way you are holding somebody/something
example: She struggled to get hold of the rope.
exampleAr: كافحت للإمساك بالحبل.

definitionEn: a hollow space in something solid or in the surface of something
example: There's a hole in my sock.
exampleAr: يوجد ثقب في جوربي.

definitionEn: a period of time when you are not at work or school
example: We're going to Spain for our summer holiday.
exampleAr: سنذهب إلى إسبانيا في عطلتنا الصيفية.

meaningAr: أجوف (فارغ من الداخل) / زائف / بلا معنى
definitionEn: having a hole or empty space inside
example: The old tree trunk was completely hollow.
exampleAr: كان جذع الشجرة القديمة أجوف تمامًا.

definitionEn: connected with God or a particular religion
example: Mecca is a holy city for Muslims.
exampleAr: مكة مدينة مقدسة للمسلمين.

definitionEn: the house or flat that you live in, especially with your family
example: She finally felt at home in her new city.
exampleAr: شعرت أخيرًا وكأنها في وطنها في مدينتها الجديدة.

definitionEn: to or at the place where you live
example: I usually get home around six in the evening.
exampleAr: عادةً ما أصل إلى المنزل حوالي الساعة السادسة مساءً.

definitionEn: the country where a person was born
example: Many refugees dream of returning to their homeland.
exampleAr: يحلم كثير من اللاجئين بالعودة إلى وطنهم الأم.

definitionEn: having no home, and therefore typically living on the streets
example: The charity provides shelter for homeless people.
exampleAr: توفر الجمعية الخيرية مأوى للأشخاص المشردين.

definitionEn: work that is given by teachers for students to do at home
example: She always does her homework right after school.
exampleAr: تقوم دائمًا بواجبها المدرسي فور انتهاء الدوام.

definitionEn: always telling the truth, and never stealing or cheating
example: He's always honest with his customers.
exampleAr: إنه دائمًا صادق مع زبائنه.

definitionEn: the quality of being honest
example: Honesty is the most important quality in a friend.
exampleAr: الصدق أهم صفة في الصديق.

definitionEn: great respect for somebody
example: It was a great honour to meet the president.
exampleAr: كان شرفًا عظيمًا مقابلة الرئيس.

definitionEn: to do something that shows great respect for somebody/something
example: The company honoured its contract despite the losses.
exampleAr: وفت الشركة بالتزاماتها التعاقدية رغم الخسائر.

definitionEn: a curved piece of metal, plastic or wire for hanging things on, catching fish with, etc.
example: She hung her bag on the hook by the door.
exampleAr: علّقت حقيبتها على الخطاف بجانب الباب.

definitionEn: to fasten or hang something on something else using a hook; to be fastened or hanging in this way
example: He hooked a large fish within minutes.
exampleAr: اصطاد سمكة كبيرة خلال دقائق.

definitionEn: to want something to happen and think that it is possible
example: I hope you feel better soon.
exampleAr: أتمنى أن تتحسن حالتك قريبًا.

definitionEn: a feeling of wanting and expecting a particular thing to happen; something that you wish for
example: She hasn't lost hope of finding a cure.
exampleAr: لم تفقد الأمل في إيجاد علاج.

definitionEn: believing that something you want will happen
example: Doctors are hopeful that he will make a full recovery.
exampleAr: الأطباء متفائلون بأنه سيتعافى تمامًا.

definitionEn: used to express what you hope will happen
example: Hopefully, the weather will be nice this weekend.
exampleAr: نأمل أن يكون الطقس جميلًا في نهاية هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: the furthest that you can see, where the sky seems to meet the land or the sea
example: The sun dipped below the horizon.
exampleAr: غابت الشمس خلف الأفق.

meaningAr: قرن (حيوان) / بوق / منبه السيارة / آلة نفخ موسيقية
definitionEn: a hard pointed part that grows, usually in pairs, on the heads of some animals, such as sheep and cows. Horns are often curved.
example: The bull charged with its horns lowered.
exampleAr: هجم الثور خافضًا قرنيه.

definitionEn: very bad or unpleasant; used to describe something that you do not like
example: The car crash was a horrible sight.
exampleAr: كان حادث تصادم السيارة منظرًا فظيعًا.

definitionEn: a feeling of great shock or fear
example: She watched the accident unfold in horror.
exampleAr: شاهدت الحادث يتكشف أمامها برعب.

definitionEn: a large animal with four legs, a mane (= long thick hair on its neck) and a tail. Horses are used for riding on, pulling carriages, etc.
example: He rides his horse every morning.
exampleAr: يمتطي حصانه كل صباح.

definitionEn: a large building where people who are ill or injured are given medical treatment and care
example: She was rushed to the hospital after the accident.
exampleAr: نُقلت إلى المستشفى بسرعة بعد الحادث.

definitionEn: a person who invites guests to a meal, a party, etc. or who has people staying at their house
example: Our host greeted us warmly at the door.
exampleAr: رحّب بنا مضيفنا بحرارة عند الباب.

definitionEn: to organize an event to which others are invited and make all the arrangements for them
example: The city will host the next World Cup.
exampleAr: ستستضيف المدينة كأس العالم القادم.

definitionEn: a person who is captured and held prisoner by a person or group, and who may be injured or killed if people do not do what the person or group is asking
example: The gunman took several employees hostage.
exampleAr: أخذ المسلح عدة موظفين رهائن.

definitionEn: aggressive or unfriendly and ready to argue or fight
example: The crowd grew hostile toward the referee.
exampleAr: أصبح الحشد عدائيًا تجاه الحكم.

definitionEn: aggressive or unfriendly feelings or behaviour
example: There was clear hostility between the two rival groups.
exampleAr: كان هناك عداء واضح بين المجموعتين المتنافستين.

meaningAr: حار / ساخن / حار (توابل) / رائج / مثير للاهتمام
definitionEn: having a high temperature; producing heat
example: Be careful, the pan is very hot.
exampleAr: انتبه، المقلاة ساخنة جدًا.

definitionEn: a building where people stay, usually for a short time, paying for their rooms and meals
example: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
exampleAr: أقمنا في فندق صغير قرب الشاطئ.

definitionEn: 60 minutes; one of the 24 parts that a day is divided into
example: The flight takes about three hours.
exampleAr: تستغرق الرحلة نحو ثلاث ساعات.

definitionEn: a building for people to live in, usually for one family
example: They bought a house in the suburbs.
exampleAr: اشتروا منزلًا في الضواحي.

definitionEn: to provide a place for a person or an animal to live
example: The building houses the national art collection.
exampleAr: يضم المبنى مجموعة الفنون الوطنية.

definitionEn: all the people living together in a house or flat
example: The average household spends a lot on groceries.
exampleAr: تنفق الأسرة المعيشية المتوسطة الكثير على البقالة.

definitionEn: all the people living together in a house or flat
example: She became a household name after the show aired.
exampleAr: أصبحت اسمًا معروفًا للجميع بعد بث البرنامج.

definitionEn: houses, flats, etc. that people live in, especially when referring to their type, price or condition
example: The city is facing a shortage of affordable housing.
exampleAr: تواجه المدينة نقصًا في الإسكان الميسور التكلفة.

definitionEn: in what way or manner
example: How did you solve this problem?
exampleAr: كيف حللت هذه المشكلة؟

definitionEn: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with something that has just been said
example: The plan sounded good; however, it was too expensive.
exampleAr: بدت الخطة جيدة؛ لكنها كانت مكلفة جدًا مع ذلك.

definitionEn: extremely large in size or amount; great in degree
example: They live in a huge house with ten bedrooms.
exampleAr: يعيشون في منزل ضخم يضم عشر غرف نوم.

definitionEn: of or connected with people rather than animals, machines or gods
example: Human error was blamed for the accident.
exampleAr: أُرجع سبب الحادث إلى خطأ بشري.

definitionEn: a person rather than an animal or a machine
example: Humans have lived on this land for thousands of years.
exampleAr: عاش البشر على هذه الأرض منذ آلاف السنين.

definitionEn: connected with helping people who are suffering and improving the conditions that they are living in
example: The organization provides humanitarian aid to refugees.
exampleAr: تقدم المنظمة مساعدات إنسانية للاجئين.

definitionEn: people in general
example: The discovery could benefit all of humanity.
exampleAr: يمكن أن يفيد هذا الاكتشاف البشرية جمعاء.

definitionEn: showing you do not think that you are as important as other people
example: Despite his success, he remained humble.
exampleAr: رغم نجاحه، ظل متواضعًا.

definitionEn: funny; showing a sense of humour
example: She gave a humorous speech at the wedding.
exampleAr: ألقت خطابًا فكاهيًا في حفل الزفاف.

meaningAr: الفكاهة / خفة الدم / الطابع الفكاهي في شيء
definitionEn: the quality in something that makes it funny; the ability to laugh at things that are funny
example: He has a great sense of humour.
exampleAr: يتمتع بحس فكاهي رائع.

example: About a hundred people attended the event.
exampleAr: حضر الفعالية نحو مئة شخص.

definitionEn: the state of not having enough food to eat, especially when this causes illness or death
example: The charity works to end hunger in the region.
exampleAr: تعمل الجمعية الخيرية على إنهاء الجوع في المنطقة.

definitionEn: feeling that you want to eat something
example: The children were hungry after playing outside all day.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال جائعين بعد اللعب في الخارج طوال اليوم.

definitionEn: to go after wild animals in order to catch or kill them for food, sport or to make money
example: Wolves hunt in packs.
exampleAr: تصطاد الذئاب في قطعان.

definitionEn: an act of looking for somebody/something that is difficult to find
example: Police launched a manhunt for the suspect.
exampleAr: أطلقت الشرطة عملية مطاردة للمشتبه به.

definitionEn: going after and killing wild animals as a sport or for food
example: Hunting is banned in this nature reserve.
exampleAr: الصيد ممنوع في هذه المحمية الطبيعية.

definitionEn: a violent storm with very strong winds, especially in the western Atlantic Ocean
example: The hurricane caused massive flooding along the coast.
exampleAr: تسبب الإعصار في فيضانات هائلة على طول الساحل.

definitionEn: to move or act quickly because there is not much time
example: We need to hurry or we'll miss the train.
exampleAr: يجب أن نسرع وإلا فاتنا القطار.

definitionEn: the need or wish to get something done quickly
example: She left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
exampleAr: غادرت على عجلة من دون أن تودّع أحدًا.

definitionEn: to cause physical pain to somebody/yourself; to injure somebody/yourself
example: My back hurts after lifting those boxes.
exampleAr: يؤلمني ظهري بعد حمل تلك الصناديق.

definitionEn: injured physically
example: She looked hurt when he didn't call her back.
exampleAr: بدت مجروحة المشاعر عندما لم يعاود الاتصال بها.

definitionEn: the man that somebody is married to; a married man
example: Her husband works as an engineer.
exampleAr: يعمل زوجها مهندسًا.

example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
exampleAr: يتكون الماء من الهيدروجين والأكسجين.

definitionEn: an idea or explanation of something that is based on a few known facts but that has not yet been proved to be true or correct
example: The scientist tested her hypothesis with a series of experiments.
exampleAr: اختبرت العالمة فرضيتها من خلال سلسلة من التجارب.

definitionEn: used as the subject of a verb when the speaker or writer is referring to himself/herself
example: I am going to the market later.
exampleAr: سأذهب إلى السوق لاحقًا.

definitionEn: water that has frozen and become solid
example: Put some ice in your drink to keep it cold.
exampleAr: ضع بعض الثلج في مشروبك ليبقى باردًا.

definitionEn: a type of sweet frozen food made from milk fat, tasting of fruit, chocolate, etc. and often eaten as a dessert; a small amount of this food intended for one person, often served in a container made of biscuit that is like a cone in shape
example: The kids had chocolate ice cream for dessert.
exampleAr: تناول الأطفال الآيس كريم بالشوكولاتة كحلوى.

meaningAr: أيقونة (رمز رقمي على الشاشة) / شخصية مؤثرة / رمز ثقافي
definitionEn: a small symbol on a computer or smartphone screen that represents a program or a file
example: Click the printer icon to start printing.
exampleAr: انقر على أيقونة الطابعة لبدء الطباعة.

definitionEn: an official way of showing who you are, for example a document with your name, date of birth and often a photograph on it (the abbreviation for ‘identity’ or ‘identification’)
example: You need to show your ID to enter the building.
exampleAr: يجب أن تُظهر بطاقة هويتك لدخول المبنى.

definitionEn: a plan, thought or suggestion, especially about what to do in a particular situation
example: She had a great idea for the project.
exampleAr: كانت لديها فكرة رائعة للمشروع.

definitionEn: perfect; most suitable
example: This location is ideal for a family holiday.
exampleAr: هذا الموقع مثالي لعطلة عائلية.

definitionEn: an idea or standard that seems perfect, and worth trying to achieve or obtain
example: They fought their whole lives for their political ideals.
exampleAr: ناضلوا طوال حياتهم من أجل مبادئهم السياسية.

definitionEn: similar in every detail
example: The twins are identical in almost every way.
exampleAr: التوأمان متطابقان في كل شيء تقريبًا.

definitionEn: the process of showing, proving or recognizing who or what somebody/something is
example: The identification of the body took several days.
exampleAr: استغرقت عملية تحديد هوية الجثة عدة أيام.

meaningAr: يتعرف على / يحدد الهوية / يتماهى مع
definitionEn: to recognize somebody/something and be able to say who or what they are
example: Witnesses identified the man from a photograph.
exampleAr: تعرّف الشهود على الرجل من خلال صورة.

definitionEn: who or what somebody/something is
example: The thief stole her identity and opened credit cards in her name.
exampleAr: سرق اللص هويتها وفتح بطاقات ائتمان باسمها.

definitionEn: based on or connected with an ideology
example: There are deep ideological differences between the two parties.
exampleAr: توجد خلافات أيديولوجية عميقة بين الحزبين.

definitionEn: a set of ideas that an economic or political system is based on
example: The party's ideology is based on social equality.
exampleAr: تقوم أيديولوجية الحزب على المساواة الاجتماعية.

definitionEn: a rude way to refer to somebody who you think is very stupid
example: I felt like an idiot after making that mistake.
exampleAr: شعرت بأنني أحمق بعد ارتكاب ذلك الخطأ.

definitionEn: used to say that one thing can, will or might happen or be true, depending on another thing happening or being true
example: If it rains, we'll stay inside.
exampleAr: إذا أمطرت، سنبقى في الداخل.

definitionEn: a lack of knowledge or information about something
example: Ignorance of the law is no excuse.
exampleAr: الجهل بالقانون ليس عذرًا.

definitionEn: to pay no attention to something
example: She ignored his phone calls all week.
exampleAr: تجاهلت مكالماته الهاتفية طوال الأسبوع.

definitionEn: suffering from an illness or disease; not feeling well
example: He's been ill with the flu since Monday.
exampleAr: إنه مريض بالإنفلونزا منذ يوم الاثنين.

definitionEn: not allowed by the law
example: It's illegal to drive without a license.
exampleAr: القيادة من دون رخصة غير قانونية.

definitionEn: the state of being physically or mentally ill
example: She's recovering from a serious illness.
exampleAr: إنها تتعافى من مرض خطير.

definitionEn: a false idea or belief, especially about somebody or about a situation
example: He was under the illusion that he could finish the project alone.
exampleAr: كان واهمًا بأنه يستطيع إنهاء المشروع بمفرده.

definitionEn: to use pictures, photographs, diagrams, etc. in a book, etc.
example: Let me illustrate this point with a simple example.
exampleAr: دعني أوضح هذه النقطة بمثال بسيط.

definitionEn: a drawing or picture in a book, magazine, for decoration or to explain something
example: The children's book is full of colorful illustrations.
exampleAr: كتاب الأطفال مليء برسوم توضيحية ملونة.

definitionEn: a picture, photograph or statue that represents somebody/something
example: The satellite captured a clear image of the storm.
exampleAr: التقط القمر الصناعي صورة واضحة للعاصفة.

definitionEn: language that produces pictures in the minds of people reading or listening
example: The poem is rich in vivid imagery.
exampleAr: القصيدة غنية بالصور البلاغية الحية.

definitionEn: existing only in your mind or imagination
example: As a child, she had an imaginary friend.
exampleAr: كان لديها صديق خيالي عندما كانت طفلة.

definitionEn: the ability to create pictures in your mind; the part of your mind that does this
example: The story really captures a child's imagination.
exampleAr: تأسر القصة خيال الطفل حقًا.

definitionEn: to form a picture in your mind of what something might be like
example: Imagine living on a tropical island.
exampleAr: تخيل أن تعيش في جزيرة استوائية.

definitionEn: happening or done without delay
example: The doctor recommended immediate surgery.
exampleAr: أوصى الطبيب بإجراء جراحة فورية.

definitionEn: without delay
example: Please call me immediately if anything changes.
exampleAr: يُرجى الاتصال بي فورًا إذا تغيّر أي شيء.

definitionEn: extremely large or great
example: The project requires an immense amount of resources.
exampleAr: يتطلب المشروع كمًا هائلًا من الموارد.

definitionEn: a person who has come to live permanently in a different country from the one they were born in
example: Many immigrants have contributed greatly to the country's economy.
exampleAr: أسهم كثير من المهاجرين إسهامًا كبيرًا في اقتصاد البلاد.

definitionEn: the process of coming to live permanently in a different country from the one you were born in; the number of people who do this
example: The government introduced stricter immigration policies.
exampleAr: أدخلت الحكومة سياسات هجرة أكثر صرامة.

definitionEn: likely to happen very soon
example: Forecasters warned that the storm was imminent.
exampleAr: حذر خبراء الأرصاد الجوية من أن العاصفة كانت وشيكة.

definitionEn: that cannot catch or be affected by a particular disease or illness
example: The vaccine helps make you immune to the virus.
exampleAr: يساعد اللقاح على تحصينك ضد الفيروس.

definitionEn: the powerful effect that something has on somebody/something
example: The new policy had a big impact on small businesses.
exampleAr: كان للسياسة الجديدة تأثير كبير على الشركات الصغيرة.

definitionEn: to have an effect on somebody/something
example: Climate change will impact agriculture worldwide.
exampleAr: سيؤثر تغير المناخ على الزراعة في جميع أنحاء العالم.

definitionEn: annoyed by somebody/something, especially because you have to wait for a long time
example: He grew impatient waiting in the long queue.
exampleAr: نفد صبره وهو ينتظر في الطابور الطويل.

definitionEn: to make something that has been officially decided start to happen or be used
example: The company plans to implement the new policy next month.
exampleAr: تخطط الشركة لتنفيذ السياسة الجديدة الشهر المقبل.

definitionEn: the act of making something that has been officially decided start to happen or be used
example: The implementation of the new system took several months.
exampleAr: استغرق تنفيذ النظام الجديد عدة أشهر.

definitionEn: a possible effect or result of an action or a decision
example: We need to consider the implications of this decision.
exampleAr: يجب أن ننظر في تبعات هذا القرار.

definitionEn: to suggest that something is true or that you feel or think something, without saying so directly
example: Her tone implied that she disagreed with the plan.
exampleAr: أوحت نبرتها بأنها لا توافق على الخطة.

definitionEn: to bring a product, a service, an idea, etc. into one country from another
example: The country imports most of its oil.
exampleAr: تستورد الدولة معظم نفطها.

definitionEn: a product or service that is brought into one country from another
example: Oil imports account for a large part of the trade deficit.
exampleAr: تشكل واردات النفط جزءًا كبيرًا من العجز التجاري.

definitionEn: the quality of being important
example: She stressed the importance of getting enough sleep.
exampleAr: شددت على أهمية الحصول على قسط كافٍ من النوم.

definitionEn: having a great effect on people or things; of great value
example: It's important to arrive on time for the interview.
exampleAr: من المهم الحضور في الموعد المحدد للمقابلة.

meaningAr: يفرض (قانونًا أو عقوبة) / يفرض نفسه أو رأيه
definitionEn: to introduce a new law, rule, tax, etc.; to order that a rule, punishment, etc. be used
example: The government imposed new taxes on imported goods.
exampleAr: فرضت الحكومة ضرائب جديدة على السلع المستوردة.

definitionEn: that cannot exist or be done; not possible
example: It's impossible to finish this project by tomorrow.
exampleAr: من المستحيل إنهاء هذا المشروع بحلول الغد.

definitionEn: if a person or thing impresses you, you admire them or it
example: She impressed the interviewers with her confidence.
exampleAr: أثارت إعجاب القائمين على المقابلة بثقتها بنفسها.

definitionEn: admiring somebody/something because you think they are particularly good, interesting, etc.
example: I was really impressed by his presentation.
exampleAr: أُعجبت حقًا بعرضه التقديمي.

definitionEn: an idea, a feeling or an opinion that you get about somebody/something, or that somebody/something gives you
example: He made a good first impression on his new colleagues.
exampleAr: ترك انطباعًا أوليًا جيدًا لدى زملائه الجدد.

definitionEn: making you admire them, because they are very large, good, skilful, etc.
example: Her academic record is very impressive.
exampleAr: سجلها الأكاديمي مثير للإعجاب جدًا.

definitionEn: to put somebody in a prison or another place from which they cannot escape
example: He was imprisoned for ten years for fraud.
exampleAr: سُجن عشر سنوات بتهمة الاحتيال.

definitionEn: the act of putting somebody in a prison or another place from which they cannot escape; the state of being there
example: He was sentenced to five years' imprisonment.
exampleAr: حُكم عليه بالسجن خمس سنوات.

definitionEn: to become better than before; to make something/somebody better than before
example: Her English has improved a lot since she moved to London.
exampleAr: تحسنت لغتها الإنجليزية كثيرًا منذ انتقالها إلى لندن.

definitionEn: the act of making something better; the process of something becoming better
example: There's been a big improvement in his grades this semester.
exampleAr: طرأ تحسن كبير على درجاته هذا الفصل الدراسي.

definitionEn: at a point within an area or a space
example: The keys are in the top drawer.
exampleAr: المفاتيح في الدرج العلوي.

definitionEn: into an object, an area or a substance
example: Please come in and sit down.
exampleAr: تفضل بالدخول والجلوس.

definitionEn: the fact of not being able to do something
example: His inability to make decisions frustrated his team.
exampleAr: أحبط عدم قدرته على اتخاذ القرارات فريقه.

definitionEn: not enough; not good enough
example: The old equipment was inadequate for the new project.
exampleAr: كانت المعدات القديمة غير كافية للمشروع الجديد.

definitionEn: not suitable or appropriate in a particular situation
example: His comments were inappropriate for a professional meeting.
exampleAr: كانت تعليقاته غير لائقة لاجتماع مهني.

definitionEn: something that encourages you to do something
example: The company offers financial incentives for top performers.
exampleAr: تقدم الشركة حوافز مالية لأصحاب الأداء المتميز.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring length or height, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.
example: The screen measures six inches diagonally.
exampleAr: تبلغ قياسات الشاشة قطريًا ست بوصات.

definitionEn: the extent to which something happens or has an effect
example: There's a high incidence of diabetes in this population.
exampleAr: يوجد معدل مرتفع لحدوث مرض السكري بين هذه الفئة السكانية.

definitionEn: something that happens, especially something unusual or unpleasant
example: Police are investigating the incident that occurred last night.
exampleAr: تحقق الشرطة في الحادثة التي وقعت الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: wanting to do something
example: I'm inclined to agree with her proposal.
exampleAr: أميل إلى الموافقة على اقتراحها.

definitionEn: if one thing includes another, it has the second thing as one of its parts
example: The price includes breakfast and all taxes.
exampleAr: يشمل السعر الإفطار وجميع الضرائب.

definitionEn: contained as part of something
example: Delivery is included in the total price.
exampleAr: التوصيل مشمول في السعر الإجمالي.

definitionEn: having something as part of a group or set
example: Everyone was invited, including the neighbors.
exampleAr: دُعي الجميع، بما في ذلك الجيران.

definitionEn: the fact of including somebody/something; the fact of being included
example: The school promotes the inclusion of children with disabilities.
exampleAr: تشجع المدرسة على إدماج الأطفال ذوي الإعاقة.

definitionEn: the money that a person, a region, a country, etc. earns from work, from investing money, from business, etc.
example: Her monthly income barely covers her rent.
exampleAr: بالكاد يغطي دخلها الشهري إيجارها.

definitionEn: to include something so that it forms a part of something
example: The new design incorporates several safety features.
exampleAr: يدمج التصميم الجديد عدة ميزات أمان.

definitionEn: not accurate or true
example: Several answers on the test were incorrect.
exampleAr: كانت عدة إجابات في الاختبار غير صحيحة.

definitionEn: to become greater in amount, number, value, etc.; to make something greater in amount, number, value, etc.
example: Sales increased by twenty percent last year.
exampleAr: ارتفعت المبيعات بنسبة عشرين بالمئة العام الماضي.

definitionEn: a rise in the amount, number or value of something
example: There's been a sharp increase in house prices.
exampleAr: طرأت زيادة حادة على أسعار المنازل.

definitionEn: more and more all the time
example: Remote work has become increasingly common.
exampleAr: أصبح العمل عن بُعد شائعًا بشكل متزايد.

definitionEn: impossible or very difficult to believe
example: She has an incredible talent for painting.
exampleAr: تتمتع بموهبة مذهلة في الرسم.

definitionEn: extremely
example: The exam was incredibly difficult this year.
exampleAr: كان الامتحان صعبًا للغاية هذا العام.

definitionEn: if you incur something unpleasant, you are in a situation in which you have to deal with it
example: The company incurred huge losses last quarter.
exampleAr: تكبدت الشركة خسائر ضخمة في الربع الماضي.

definitionEn: used after very and an adjective or adverb to emphasize a statement, description, etc.
example: It was, indeed, one of the best meals I've ever had.
exampleAr: كانت بالفعل واحدة من أفضل الوجبات التي تناولتها في حياتي.

definitionEn: freedom from political control by other countries
example: The country gained independence in 1960.
exampleAr: نالت الدولة استقلالها عام 1960.

definitionEn: having its own government
example: She's very independent and prefers to work alone.
exampleAr: هي مستقلة جدًا وتفضل العمل بمفردها.

definitionEn: a list of names or topics that are referred to in a book, etc., usually arranged at the end of a book in alphabetical order or listed in a separate file or book
example: You can find the topic in the index at the back of the book.
exampleAr: يمكنك إيجاد الموضوع في الفهرس الموجود في نهاية الكتاب.

definitionEn: to show that something is true or exists
example: The results indicate a clear improvement in performance.
exampleAr: تشير النتائج إلى تحسن واضح في الأداء.

definitionEn: a remark or sign that shows that something is happening or what somebody is thinking or feeling
example: There's no indication that the situation will improve soon.
exampleAr: لا توجد أي إشارة إلى أن الوضع سيتحسن قريبًا.

definitionEn: a sign that shows you what something is like or how a situation is changing
example: Unemployment is a key economic indicator.
exampleAr: تُعد البطالة مؤشرًا اقتصاديًا رئيسيًا.

definitionEn: a sign that a system, society, etc. is very bad or very wrong
example: A grand jury issued an indictment against the former official.
exampleAr: أصدرت هيئة محلفين كبرى لائحة اتهام بحق المسؤول السابق.

definitionEn: coming from a particular place and having lived there for a long time before other people came there; relating to, belonging to or developed by these people
example: The government is working to protect indigenous communities.
exampleAr: تعمل الحكومة على حماية مجتمعات السكان الأصليين.

definitionEn: happening not as the main aim, cause or result of a particular action, but in addition to it
example: The company faced significant indirect costs from the delay.
exampleAr: واجهت الشركة تكاليف غير مباشرة كبيرة بسبب التأخير.

definitionEn: considered separately rather than as part of a group
example: Each student receives individual attention from the teacher.
exampleAr: يحصل كل طالب على اهتمام فردي من المعلم.

definitionEn: a person considered separately rather than as part of a group
example: Every individual has the right to express their opinion.
exampleAr: لكل فرد الحق في التعبير عن رأيه.

definitionEn: located, done or used inside a building
example: They have an indoor swimming pool.
exampleAr: لديهم مسبح داخلي.

definitionEn: inside or into a building
example: It's raining, so let's stay indoors.
exampleAr: إنها تمطر، فلنبقَ في الداخل.

definitionEn: to persuade or influence somebody to do something
example: The medication is used to induce sleep.
exampleAr: يُستخدم الدواء لإحداث النوم.

definitionEn: to allow yourself to have or do something that you like, especially something that is considered bad for you
example: She indulged in a piece of chocolate cake after dinner.
exampleAr: دللت نفسها بقطعة من كعكة الشوكولاتة بعد العشاء.

definitionEn: connected with industry
example: The city has a large industrial zone on its outskirts.
exampleAr: تضم المدينة منطقة صناعية كبيرة في ضواحيها.

definitionEn: the production of goods from raw materials, especially in factories
example: The tourism industry employs thousands of people in this region.
exampleAr: توظف صناعة السياحة آلاف الأشخاص في هذه المنطقة.

definitionEn: the unfair difference between groups of people in society, when some have more wealth, status or opportunities than others
example: The report highlights growing income inequality.
exampleAr: يسلط التقرير الضوء على تنامي عدم المساواة في الدخل.

definitionEn: that you cannot avoid or prevent
example: Change was inevitable given the circumstances.
exampleAr: كان التغيير حتميًا في ظل هذه الظروف.

definitionEn: as is certain to happen
example: Prices will inevitably rise after the tax increase.
exampleAr: سترتفع الأسعار حتمًا بعد زيادة الضرائب.

definitionEn: well known for being bad or evil
example: The city is infamous for its high crime rate.
exampleAr: تُعرف المدينة بسمعتها السيئة بسبب ارتفاع معدل الجريمة فيها.

definitionEn: a baby or very young child
example: The infant slept peacefully in her crib.
exampleAr: نام الرضيع بسلام في سريره.

definitionEn: to make a disease or an illness spread to a person, an animal or a plant
example: The virus can infect anyone who comes into contact with it.
exampleAr: يمكن أن يصيب الفيروس أي شخص يتلامس معه بالعدوى.

definitionEn: the act or process of causing or getting a disease
example: She developed an ear infection last week.
exampleAr: أصيبت بالتهاب في الأذن الأسبوع الماضي.

definitionEn: to reach an opinion or decide that something is true on the basis of information that is available
example: From his tone, I inferred that he was upset.
exampleAr: استنتجت من نبرته أنه كان منزعجًا.

definitionEn: a general rise in the prices of services and goods in a particular country, resulting in a fall in the value of money; the rate at which this happens
example: Inflation has pushed up the price of basic goods.
exampleAr: دفع التضخم أسعار السلع الأساسية إلى الارتفاع.

definitionEn: to make somebody/something suffer something unpleasant
example: The storm inflicted severe damage on the coastline.
exampleAr: ألحقت العاصفة أضرارًا جسيمة بالساحل.

definitionEn: the effect that somebody/something has on the way a person thinks or behaves or on the way that something works or develops
example: Her parents had a strong influence on her career choice.
exampleAr: كان لوالديها تأثير قوي على اختيارها المهني.

definitionEn: to have an effect on the way that somebody behaves or thinks, especially by giving them an example to follow
example: Social media can influence how people vote.
exampleAr: يمكن أن تؤثر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي على كيفية تصويت الناس.

definitionEn: having a lot of influence on somebody/something
example: He's one of the most influential figures in the industry.
exampleAr: هو أحد أكثر الشخصيات نفوذًا في هذا القطاع.

definitionEn: information
example: Can you send me more info about the event?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن ترسل لي المزيد من المعلومات عن الفعالية؟

definitionEn: to tell somebody about something, especially in an official way
example: Please inform us of any changes to your schedule.
exampleAr: يُرجى إعلامنا بأي تغييرات في جدولك.

definitionEn: relaxed and friendly; not following strict rules of how to behave or do something
example: The meeting was quite informal, with everyone sitting on the floor.
exampleAr: كان الاجتماع غير رسمي إلى حد كبير، إذ جلس الجميع على الأرض.

definitionEn: facts or details about somebody/something
example: The website provides useful information about local attractions.
exampleAr: يوفر الموقع الإلكتروني معلومات مفيدة عن المعالم السياحية المحلية.

example: The government is investing heavily in roads and other infrastructure.
exampleAr: تستثمر الحكومة بكثافة في الطرق وغيرها من مرافق البنية التحتية.

definitionEn: one of the things from which something is made, especially one of the foods that are used together to make a particular dish
example: Flour is the main ingredient in bread.
exampleAr: الدقيق هو المكوّن الرئيسي في الخبز.

definitionEn: a person or an animal that lives in a particular place
example: The city has over a million inhabitants.
exampleAr: يزيد عدد سكان المدينة عن مليون نسمة.

definitionEn: that is a basic or permanent part of somebody/something and that cannot be removed
example: There are inherent risks in any investment.
exampleAr: توجد مخاطر متأصلة في أي استثمار.

definitionEn: to receive money, property, etc. from somebody when they die
example: She inherited the house from her grandmother.
exampleAr: ورثت المنزل عن جدتها.

definitionEn: to prevent something from happening or make it happen more slowly or less frequently than normal
example: Fear can inhibit a person's ability to speak in public.
exampleAr: يمكن أن يعيق الخوف قدرة الشخص على التحدث أمام الجمهور.

definitionEn: happening at the beginning; first
example: Our initial reaction was one of surprise.
exampleAr: كان رد فعلنا الأولي هو الاندهاش.

definitionEn: happening at the beginning; first
example: She signed the document with her initials.
exampleAr: وقّعت المستند بأحرف اسمها الأولى.

definitionEn: at the beginning
example: Initially, the plan seemed too risky to approve.
exampleAr: بدت الخطة في البداية محفوفة بالمخاطر بحيث يتعذر إقرارها.

definitionEn: to make something begin
example: The company initiated a new marketing campaign.
exampleAr: أطلقت الشركة حملة تسويقية جديدة.

definitionEn: a new plan for dealing with a particular problem or for achieving a particular purpose
example: The city launched a new recycling initiative.
exampleAr: أطلقت المدينة مبادرة جديدة لإعادة التدوير.

definitionEn: to put a drug or other substance into a person’s or an animal’s body using a syringe
example: The nurse injected the medicine into his arm.
exampleAr: حقنت الممرضة الدواء في ذراعه.

definitionEn: an act of injecting somebody with a drug or other substance
example: The doctor gave her a flu injection.
exampleAr: أعطاها الطبيب حقنة للإنفلونزا.

definitionEn: to harm yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident
example: He injured his knee playing football.
exampleAr: أصيب في ركبته أثناء لعب كرة القدم.

definitionEn: physically hurt; having an injury
example: Two passengers were injured in the crash.
exampleAr: أُصيب راكبان في الحادث.

definitionEn: harm done to a person’s or an animal’s body, for example in an accident
example: She suffered a serious injury during training.
exampleAr: تعرضت لإصابة خطيرة أثناء التدريب.

definitionEn: the fact of a situation being unfair and of people not being treated equally; an unfair act or an example of unfair treatment
example: The protesters were demonstrating against social injustice.
exampleAr: كان المحتجون يتظاهرون ضد الظلم الاجتماعي.

definitionEn: coloured liquid for writing, drawing and printing
example: The printer is out of ink again.
exampleAr: نفد حبر الطابعة مجددًا.

definitionEn: one of the people living in an institution such as a prison or a psychiatric hospital
example: The prison holds over a thousand inmates.
exampleAr: يضم السجن أكثر من ألف نزيل.

definitionEn: inside; towards or close to the centre of a place
example: She kept her inner feelings hidden from everyone.
exampleAr: أخفت مشاعرها الداخلية عن الجميع.

definitionEn: not guilty of a crime, etc.; not having done something wrong
example: The jury found him innocent of all charges.
exampleAr: قررت هيئة المحلفين براءته من جميع التهم.

definitionEn: the introduction of new things, ideas or ways of doing something
example: The company is known for its innovation in technology.
exampleAr: تشتهر الشركة بابتكارها في مجال التكنولوجيا.

definitionEn: introducing or using new ideas, ways of doing something, etc.
example: She came up with an innovative solution to the problem.
exampleAr: توصلت إلى حل مبتكر للمشكلة.

definitionEn: time, knowledge, ideas, etc. that you put into work, a project, etc. in order to make it succeed; the act of putting something in
example: We'd love to get your input on the new design.
exampleAr: يسعدنا الحصول على رأيك في التصميم الجديد.

definitionEn: any small creature with six legs and a body divided into three parts. Insects usually also have wings. Ants, bees and flies are all insects.
example: The garden is full of insects like bees and butterflies.
exampleAr: الحديقة مليئة بالحشرات كالنحل والفراشات.

definitionEn: to put something into something else or between two things
example: Insert the card into the machine to start the transaction.
exampleAr: أدخل البطاقة في الجهاز لبدء المعاملة.

definitionEn: the act of putting something inside something else; a thing that is put inside something else
example: The insertion of the new clause changed the contract's meaning.
exampleAr: غيّر إدراج البند الجديد معنى العقد.

definitionEn: on or to the inner part of something/somebody; within something/somebody
example: There's a note inside the envelope.
exampleAr: توجد رسالة داخل المظروف.

definitionEn: the inner part, side or surface of something
example: The inside of the house was beautifully decorated.
exampleAr: كان داخل المنزل مزينًا بشكل جميل.

definitionEn: a person who knows a lot about a group or an organization, because they are part of it
example: The insider leaked confidential documents to the press.
exampleAr: سرّب الشخص المطلع وثائق سرية إلى الصحافة.

definitionEn: an understanding of what something is like
example: The book offers valuable insight into ancient Egyptian culture.
exampleAr: يقدم الكتاب رؤية متعمقة وقيّمة عن الحضارة المصرية القديمة.

definitionEn: to demand that something happen or that somebody agree to do something
example: She insisted on paying for dinner.
exampleAr: أصرّت على دفع ثمن العشاء.

definitionEn: to look closely at something/somebody, especially to check that everything is as it should be
example: Officials inspected the factory for safety violations.
exampleAr: تفقد المسؤولون المصنع بحثًا عن مخالفات السلامة.

definitionEn: an official visit to a school, factory, etc. in order to check that rules are being obeyed and that standards are acceptable
example: The building passed its annual safety inspection.
exampleAr: اجتاز المبنى فحص السلامة السنوي.

definitionEn: an officer of middle rank in the police force
example: A health inspector visited the restaurant yesterday.
exampleAr: زار مفتش صحي المطعم بالأمس.

definitionEn: the process that takes place when somebody sees or hears something that causes them to have exciting new ideas or makes them want to create something, especially in art, music or literature
example: The mountains were a great source of inspiration for the artist.
exampleAr: كانت الجبال مصدر إلهام كبير للفنان.

definitionEn: to give somebody the desire, confidence or enthusiasm to do something well
example: Her courage inspired everyone around her.
exampleAr: ألهمت شجاعتها كل من حولها.

definitionEn: to fix equipment or furniture into position so that it can be used
example: We need to install the new software before the update.
exampleAr: يجب أن نثبّت البرنامج الجديد قبل التحديث.

definitionEn: the act of fixing equipment or furniture in position so that it can be used
example: The installation of the new system took a whole day.
exampleAr: استغرق تركيب النظام الجديد يومًا كاملًا.

definitionEn: a particular example or case of something
example: For instance, many students struggle with time management.
exampleAr: على سبيل المثال، يواجه كثير من الطلاب صعوبة في إدارة الوقت.

definitionEn: happening immediately
example: The app gives you instant access to your account.
exampleAr: يمنحك التطبيق وصولًا فوريًا إلى حسابك.

definitionEn: happening immediately
example: In an instant, the whole room went silent.
exampleAr: في لحظة، ساد الصمت الغرفة بأكملها.

definitionEn: immediately
example: He instantly recognized her voice on the phone.
exampleAr: تعرّف على صوتها فورًا عبر الهاتف.

definitionEn: in the place of somebody/something
example: She didn't go to the party; she stayed home instead.
exampleAr: لم تذهب إلى الحفلة؛ بل بقيت في المنزل بدلًا من ذلك.

definitionEn: a natural quality that makes people and animals tend to behave in a particular way using the knowledge and abilities that they were born with rather than thought or training
example: Her first instinct was to run.
exampleAr: كانت غريزتها الأولى أن تركض.

definitionEn: an organization that has a particular purpose, especially one that is connected with education or a particular profession; the building used by this organization
example: He studied at a research institute in Geneva.
exampleAr: درس في معهد أبحاث في جنيف.

definitionEn: an organization that has a particular purpose, especially one that is connected with education or a particular profession; the building used by this organization
example: The company instituted new safety procedures after the accident.
exampleAr: استحدثت الشركة إجراءات سلامة جديدة بعد الحادث.

definitionEn: a large important organization that has a particular purpose, for example a university or bank
example: The university is one of the oldest institutions in the country.
exampleAr: تُعد الجامعة واحدة من أقدم المؤسسات في البلاد.

definitionEn: connected with a large important organization, for example a university or bank
example: The report criticized institutional racism within the police force.
exampleAr: انتقد التقرير العنصرية المؤسسية داخل جهاز الشرطة.

definitionEn: to tell somebody to do something, especially in a formal or official way
example: The manager instructed staff to lock the doors at closing time.
exampleAr: أمر المدير الموظفين بإغلاق الأبواب عند وقت الإغلاق.

definitionEn: detailed information on how to do or use something
example: Follow the instructions carefully before assembling the furniture.
exampleAr: اتبع التعليمات بعناية قبل تركيب الأثاث.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to teach somebody a practical skill or sport
example: She works as a swimming instructor at the local pool.
exampleAr: تعمل مدربة سباحة في المسبح المحلي.

definitionEn: an object used for producing musical sounds, for example a piano or a drum
example: The violin is a beautiful instrument.
exampleAr: الكمان آلة موسيقية جميلة.

meaningAr: أساسي / مهم في تحقيق شيء / آلي (موسيقى بلا غناء)
definitionEn: important in making something happen
example: She was instrumental in securing the funding for the project.
exampleAr: كان لها دور أساسي في تأمين التمويل للمشروع.

definitionEn: not large, strong or important enough for a particular purpose
example: There was insufficient evidence to convict him.
exampleAr: لم تكن هناك أدلة كافية لإدانته.

definitionEn: to say or do something that offends somebody
example: He felt insulted by her rude comment.
exampleAr: شعر بالإهانة من تعليقها الوقح.

definitionEn: a remark or an action that is said or done in order to offend somebody
example: She took his joke as a personal insult.
exampleAr: اعتبرت نكتته إهانة شخصية.

definitionEn: an arrangement with a company in which you pay them regular amounts of money and they agree to pay the costs, for example, if you die or are ill, or if you lose or damage something
example: You should get travel insurance before your trip.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تحصل على تأمين سفر قبل رحلتك.

definitionEn: complete and not damaged
example: Despite the earthquake, the old building remained intact.
exampleAr: رغم الزلزال، ظل المبنى القديم سليمًا.

meaningAr: كمية مأخوذة (طعام أو دواء) / دفعة (طلاب أو موظفين جدد)
definitionEn: the amount of food, drink, etc. that you take into your body
example: You should reduce your sugar intake.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تقلل من كمية السكر التي تتناولها.

definitionEn: being an essential part of something
example: Trust is an integral part of any relationship.
exampleAr: الثقة جزء لا يتجزأ من أي علاقة.

definitionEn: to combine two or more things so that they work together; to combine with something else in this way
example: The new software integrates smoothly with existing systems.
exampleAr: يندمج البرنامج الجديد بسلاسة مع الأنظمة الحالية.

definitionEn: in which many different parts are closely connected and work successfully together
example: The school offers an integrated curriculum combining science and art.
exampleAr: تقدم المدرسة منهجًا متكاملًا يجمع بين العلوم والفنون.

definitionEn: the act or process of combining two or more things so that they work together
example: The integration of refugees into society requires community support.
exampleAr: يتطلب اندماج اللاجئين في المجتمع دعمًا مجتمعيًا.

definitionEn: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles
example: He is known for his honesty and integrity.
exampleAr: يُعرف بصدقه ونزاهته.

definitionEn: connected with or using a person’s ability to think in a logical way and understand things
example: The debate raised some interesting intellectual questions.
exampleAr: أثار النقاش بعض الأسئلة الفكرية المثيرة للاهتمام.

definitionEn: a person who is well educated and enjoys activities in which they have to think seriously about things
example: The book was written by a leading intellectual of his time.
exampleAr: كتب الكتاب أحد أبرز مثقفي عصره.

definitionEn: the ability to learn, understand and think in a logical way about things; the ability to do this well
example: Her intelligence was obvious from a very young age.
exampleAr: كان ذكاؤها واضحًا منذ سن مبكرة جدًا.

definitionEn: good at learning, understanding and thinking in a logical way about things; showing this ability
example: She's one of the most intelligent people I know.
exampleAr: هي واحدة من أذكى الأشخاص الذين أعرفهم.

definitionEn: to have a plan, result or purpose in your mind when you do something
example: They intend to move to Canada next year.
exampleAr: ينوون الانتقال إلى كندا العام المقبل.

definitionEn: that you are trying to achieve or reach
example: The message wasn't intended to offend anyone.
exampleAr: لم تكن الرسالة مقصودة لإهانة أحد.

definitionEn: very great; very strong
example: The heat was intense during the summer months.
exampleAr: كانت الحرارة شديدة خلال أشهر الصيف.

definitionEn: to increase in degree or strength; to make something increase in degree or strength
example: Fighting intensified along the border overnight.
exampleAr: اشتد القتال على طول الحدود بين عشية وضحاها.

definitionEn: the state or quality of being intense
example: The intensity of the storm caught everyone by surprise.
exampleAr: فاجأت شدة العاصفة الجميع.

definitionEn: involving a lot of work or activity done in a short time
example: She took an intensive language course over the summer.
exampleAr: التحقت بدورة لغة مكثفة خلال الصيف.

definitionEn: what you intend to do
example: He was arrested on suspicion of intent to commit fraud.
exampleAr: قُبض عليه للاشتباه في نيته ارتكاب عملية احتيال.

definitionEn: what you intend to do
example: She was intent on finishing the marathon.
exampleAr: كانت مصممة على إنهاء الماراثون.

definitionEn: what you intend or plan to do; your aim
example: It was never her intention to hurt anyone.
exampleAr: لم تكن نيتها يومًا إيذاء أحد.

definitionEn: to communicate with somebody, especially while you work, play or spend time with them
example: Children learn a lot by interacting with each other.
exampleAr: يتعلم الأطفال الكثير من خلال التفاعل مع بعضهم البعض.

definitionEn: the act of communicating with somebody, especially while you work, play or spend time with them
example: Social interaction is important for mental health.
exampleAr: التفاعل الاجتماعي مهم للصحة النفسية.

definitionEn: that allows information to be passed continuously and in both directions between a computer or other device and the person who uses it
example: The museum has an interactive exhibit for kids.
exampleAr: يضم المتحف معرضًا تفاعليًا للأطفال.

definitionEn: the feeling that you have when you want to know or learn more about somebody/something
example: She has a keen interest in astronomy.
exampleAr: لديها اهتمام شديد بعلم الفلك.

definitionEn: to attract your attention and make you feel interested; to make yourself give your attention to something
example: The job offer might interest you.
exampleAr: قد يثير عرض العمل اهتمامك.

definitionEn: giving your attention to something because you enjoy finding out about it or doing it; showing interest in something and finding it exciting
example: She's very interested in learning Spanish.
exampleAr: هي مهتمة جدًا بتعلم اللغة الإسبانية.

definitionEn: attracting your attention because it is/they are special, exciting or unusual
example: That's a really interesting theory.
exampleAr: هذه نظرية مثيرة للاهتمام حقًا.

definitionEn: the way a computer program presents information to a user or receives information from a user, in particular the layout of the screen and the menus
example: The app has a simple, user-friendly interface.
exampleAr: يتميز التطبيق بواجهة بسيطة وسهلة الاستخدام.

definitionEn: to get involved in and try to influence a situation that should not really involve you, in a way that annoys other people
example: Please don't interfere in matters that don't concern you.
exampleAr: يُرجى عدم التدخل في أمور لا تعنيك.

definitionEn: the act of getting involved in and trying to influence a situation that should not really involve you, in a way that annoys other people
example: The company complained about government interference in the market.
exampleAr: اشتكت الشركة من تدخل الحكومة في السوق.

definitionEn: intended to last for only a short time until somebody/something more permanent is found
example: She was appointed as interim CEO until a replacement was found.
exampleAr: عُيّنت رئيسة تنفيذية مؤقتة إلى حين إيجاد بديل.

definitionEn: the inside part of something
example: The car has a leather interior.
exampleAr: تحتوي السيارة على تجهيزات داخلية جلدية.

definitionEn: connected with the inside part of something
example: She works as an interior designer.
exampleAr: تعمل مصممة ديكور داخلي.

definitionEn: located between two places, things, states, etc.
example: This course is designed for intermediate learners.
exampleAr: صُممت هذه الدورة للمتعلمين ذوي المستوى المتوسط.

definitionEn: connected with the inside of something
example: The company launched an internal investigation into the complaint.
exampleAr: أطلقت الشركة تحقيقًا داخليًا في الشكوى.

definitionEn: connected with or involving two or more countries
example: She works for an international organization.
exampleAr: تعمل لدى منظمة دولية.

definitionEn: an international computer network connecting other networks and computers that allows people to share information around the world
example: We don't have internet access in this remote village.
exampleAr: لا تتوفر لدينا خدمة الإنترنت في هذه القرية النائية.

definitionEn: to explain the meaning of something
example: How do you interpret this poem?
exampleAr: كيف تفسر هذه القصيدة؟

definitionEn: the particular way in which something is understood or explained
example: Different critics have offered different interpretations of the novel.
exampleAr: قدّم نقاد مختلفون تفسيرات متباينة للرواية.

definitionEn: to say or do something that makes somebody stop what they are saying or doing
example: Sorry to interrupt, but there's an urgent call for you.
exampleAr: آسف على المقاطعة، لكن هناك مكالمة عاجلة لك.

definitionEn: a period of time between two events
example: There was a short interval between the two acts of the play.
exampleAr: كان هناك فاصل زمني قصير بين فصلي المسرحية.

definitionEn: to become involved in a situation in order to improve or help it
example: The UN decided to intervene in the conflict.
exampleAr: قررت الأمم المتحدة التدخل في النزاع.

definitionEn: action taken to improve or help a situation
example: Without medical intervention, his condition would have worsened.
exampleAr: لولا التدخل الطبي، لكانت حالته قد ساءت.

definitionEn: a formal meeting at which somebody is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a particular job, or for a course of study at a college, university, etc.
example: She has a job interview tomorrow morning.
exampleAr: لديها مقابلة عمل صباح الغد.

definitionEn: to talk to somebody and ask them questions at a formal meeting to find out if they are suitable for a job, course of study, etc.
example: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new policy.
exampleAr: أجرى الصحفي مقابلة مع العمدة حول السياسة الجديدة.

definitionEn: having a close and friendly relationship
example: They shared an intimate friendship for many years.
exampleAr: جمعتهما صداقة حميمة لسنوات عديدة.

definitionEn: to a position in or inside something
example: She walked into the room and sat down.
exampleAr: دخلت الغرفة وجلست.

definitionEn: very interesting because of being unusual or not having an obvious answer
example: The mystery novel has a truly intriguing plot.
exampleAr: تتمتع رواية الغموض بحبكة مثيرة للفضول حقًا.

definitionEn: to tell two or more people who have not met before what each other’s names are; to tell somebody what your name is
example: Let me introduce you to my colleague.
exampleAr: دعني أقدمك إلى زميلي.

meaningAr: تقديم (شخص لآخر) / مقدمة (كتاب أو موضوع) / استحداث / إدخال
definitionEn: the first part of a book or speech that gives a general idea of what is to follow
example: Allow me to make the introductions before we begin.
exampleAr: اسمحوا لي بتقديم الحضور قبل أن نبدأ.

definitionEn: to enter a country, town, etc. using military force in order to take control of it
example: The army invaded the neighboring country.
exampleAr: غزا الجيش الدولة المجاورة.

definitionEn: the act of an army entering another country by force in order to take control of it
example: The invasion led to years of conflict.
exampleAr: أدى الغزو إلى سنوات من النزاع.

definitionEn: to produce or design something that has not existed before
example: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone.
exampleAr: اخترع ألكسندر غراهام بيل الهاتف.

definitionEn: a thing or an idea that has been invented
example: The printing press was a revolutionary invention.
exampleAr: كانت المطبعة اختراعًا ثوريًا.

definitionEn: to buy property, shares in a company, etc. in the hope of making a profit
example: She invested a large part of her savings in stocks.
exampleAr: استثمرت جزءًا كبيرًا من مدخراتها في الأسهم.

definitionEn: to carefully examine the facts of a situation, an event, a crime, etc. to find out the truth about it or how it happened
example: Police are investigating the cause of the fire.
exampleAr: تحقق الشرطة في سبب الحريق.

definitionEn: an official examination of the facts about a situation, crime, etc.
example: The investigation is still ongoing.
exampleAr: لا يزال التحقيق جاريًا.

definitionEn: a person who examines a situation such as an accident or a crime to find out the truth
example: A private investigator was hired to find the missing documents.
exampleAr: استُؤجر محقق خاص للعثور على المستندات المفقودة.

definitionEn: the act of investing money in something
example: Buying a house is a major investment.
exampleAr: شراء منزل استثمار كبير.

definitionEn: a person or an organization that invests money in something
example: The startup attracted several foreign investors.
exampleAr: استقطبت الشركة الناشئة عدة مستثمرين أجانب.

definitionEn: that cannot be seen
example: The virus is invisible to the naked eye.
exampleAr: الفيروس غير مرئي بالعين المجردة.

definitionEn: a spoken or written request to somebody to do something or to go somewhere
example: She sent out invitations for her birthday party.
exampleAr: أرسلت دعوات لحفلة عيد ميلادها.

definitionEn: to ask somebody to come to a social event
example: They invited us to their wedding.
exampleAr: دعونا إلى حفل زفافهم.

definitionEn: to mention or use a law, rule, etc. as a reason for doing something
example: The lawyer invoked a rarely used clause in the contract.
exampleAr: احتج المحامي ببند نادر الاستخدام في العقد.

definitionEn: if a situation, an event or an activity involves something, that thing is an important or necessary part or result of it
example: The project involves several different departments.
exampleAr: يشرك المشروع عدة أقسام مختلفة.

definitionEn: taking part in something; being part of something or connected with something
example: She's deeply involved in local politics.
exampleAr: هي منخرطة بعمق في السياسة المحلية.

definitionEn: the act of taking part in something or dealing with somebody
example: His involvement in the scandal ended his career.
exampleAr: أنهى تورطه في الفضيحة مسيرته المهنية.

definitionEn: a chemical element. Iron is a hard strong metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.
example: The gate is made of wrought iron.
exampleAr: البوابة مصنوعة من الحديد المطاوع.

definitionEn: to make clothes, etc. smooth by using an iron
example: He ironed his shirt before the interview.
exampleAr: كوى قميصه قبل المقابلة.

definitionEn: showing that you really mean the opposite of what you are saying; expressing irony
example: It's ironic that the fire station itself burned down.
exampleAr: من المفارقة أن محطة الإطفاء نفسها احترقت.

definitionEn: in a way that shows that you really mean the opposite of what you are saying; in a way that expresses irony
example: Ironically, the safety inspector's own office failed the inspection.
exampleAr: من المفارقات، أن مكتب مفتش السلامة نفسه رسب في التفتيش.

definitionEn: the funny or strange aspect of a situation that is very different from what you expect; a situation like this
example: The irony of the situation wasn't lost on anyone.
exampleAr: لم تفت مفارقة الموقف على أحد.

definitionEn: not important to or connected with a situation
example: His comment was completely irrelevant to the discussion.
exampleAr: كان تعليقه غير ذي صلة تمامًا بالنقاش.

definitionEn: a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water
example: They spent their honeymoon on a small island.
exampleAr: قضيا شهر عسلهما في جزيرة صغيرة.

definitionEn: to separate somebody/something physically or socially from other people or things
example: The patient was isolated to prevent the spread of infection.
exampleAr: عُزل المريض لمنع انتشار العدوى.

definitionEn: far away from any others
example: They live in an isolated village high in the mountains.
exampleAr: يعيشون في قرية معزولة عاليًا في الجبال.

definitionEn: the act of separating somebody/something; the state of being separate
example: Many elderly people suffer from isolation.
exampleAr: يعاني كثير من كبار السن من العزلة.

definitionEn: an important topic that people are discussing or arguing about
example: Climate change is a major global issue.
exampleAr: تغير المناخ قضية عالمية كبرى.

definitionEn: to make something known formally
example: The government issued a warning about the storm.
exampleAr: أصدرت الحكومة تحذيرًا بشأن العاصفة.

definitionEn: used to refer to an animal or a thing that has already been mentioned or that is being talked about now
example: The book is on the table; it belongs to my sister.
exampleAr: الكتاب على الطاولة؛ إنه يعود لأختي.

definitionEn: the study and use of electronic processes and equipment to store and send information of all kinds, including words, pictures and numbers (the abbreviation for ‘information technology’)
example: She works in the IT department.
exampleAr: تعمل في قسم تقنية المعلومات.

definitionEn: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc.
example: Each item in the store is clearly priced.
exampleAr: كل قطعة في المتجر مُسعّرة بوضوح.

definitionEn: belonging to or connected with a thing, an animal or a baby
example: The dog wagged its tail happily.
exampleAr: هزّ الكلب ذيله بسعادة.

definitionEn: used when the animal or thing that does an action is also affected by it
example: The cat cleaned itself after eating.
exampleAr: نظف القط نفسه بعد الأكل.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing worn on the top half of the body over a shirt, etc. that has arms and fastens down the front; a short, light coat
example: He put on his jacket before going outside.
exampleAr: ارتدى سترته قبل الخروج.

definitionEn: a prison
example: He spent five years in jail for robbery.
exampleAr: أمضى خمس سنوات في السجن بتهمة السرقة.

definitionEn: to put somebody in prison
example: He was jailed for tax evasion.
exampleAr: سُجن بتهمة التهرب الضريبي.

definitionEn: a thick sweet substance made by boiling fruit with sugar, often sold in jars and spread on bread
example: She spread strawberry jam on her toast.
exampleAr: وضعت مربى الفراولة على خبزها المحمص.

definitionEn: a thick sweet substance made by boiling fruit with sugar, often sold in jars and spread on bread
example: The printer jammed again this morning.
exampleAr: علقت الطابعة مجددًا هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: the 1st month of the year, between December and February
example: School starts again in January.
exampleAr: تبدأ المدرسة مجددًا في يناير.

definitionEn: a type of music with strong rhythms, in which the players often improvise (= make up the music as they are playing), originally created by African American musicians at the beginning of the 20th century
example: She loves listening to jazz on Sunday mornings.
exampleAr: تحب الاستماع إلى موسيقى الجاز صباح كل أحد.

definitionEn: trousers made of denim (= a type of strong cotton)
example: He wore a pair of blue jeans and a t-shirt.
exampleAr: ارتدى بنطال جينز أزرق مع قميص تي شيرت.

definitionEn: a plane driven by jet engines
example: The private jet landed at a small airport.
exampleAr: هبطت الطائرة النفاثة الخاصة في مطار صغير.

definitionEn: objects such as rings and necklaces that people wear as decoration
example: She keeps her jewellery in a locked box.
exampleAr: تحتفظ بمجوهراتها في صندوق مقفل.

definitionEn: work for which you receive regular payment
example: He got a new job at a tech company.
exampleAr: حصل على وظيفة جديدة في شركة تقنية.

definitionEn: to fix or connect two or more things together
example: She joined the swimming club last month.
exampleAr: انضمت إلى نادي السباحة الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: involving two or more people together
example: They made a joint decision to sell the house.
exampleAr: اتخذا قرارًا مشتركًا ببيع المنزل.

definitionEn: a place where two bones are joined together in the body in a way that enables them to bend and move
example: Arthritis affects the joints, especially in older age.
exampleAr: يؤثر التهاب المفاصل في المفاصل، خصوصًا في سن متقدمة.

definitionEn: something that you say or do to make people laugh, for example a funny story that you tell
example: He told a joke that made everyone laugh.
exampleAr: روى نكتة أضحكت الجميع.

definitionEn: to say something to make people laugh; to tell a funny story
example: I was just joking, don't take it seriously.
exampleAr: كنت أمزح فقط، لا تأخذ الأمر على محمل الجد.

definitionEn: a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or profession
example: Her research was published in a leading medical journal.
exampleAr: نُشر بحثها في مجلة طبية رائدة.

definitionEn: the work of collecting and writing news stories for newspapers, magazines, radio, television or online news sites; the news stories that are written
example: He studied journalism at university.
exampleAr: درس الصحافة في الجامعة.

definitionEn: a person whose job is to collect and write news stories for newspapers, magazines, radio, television or online news sites
example: The journalist interviewed several witnesses.
exampleAr: أجرى الصحفي مقابلات مع عدة شهود.

definitionEn: an act of travelling from one place to another, especially when they are far apart
example: The journey from London to Edinburgh takes about five hours.
exampleAr: تستغرق الرحلة من لندن إلى إدنبرة نحو خمس ساعات.

definitionEn: a feeling of great happiness
example: Her face lit up with joy when she saw the puppy.
exampleAr: أشرق وجهها بالفرح عندما رأت الجرو.

definitionEn: a person in a court who has the authority to decide how criminals should be punished or to make legal decisions
example: The judge sentenced him to two years in prison.
exampleAr: حكم عليه القاضي بالسجن سنتين.

definitionEn: to form an opinion about somebody/something, based on the information you have
example: Don't judge people based on their appearance.
exampleAr: لا تحكم على الناس بناءً على مظهرهم.

definitionEn: the ability to make sensible decisions after carefully considering the best thing to do
example: The court's judgement will be announced next week.
exampleAr: سيُعلن حكم المحكمة الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: connected with a court, a judge or legal judgement
example: The case will go through a judicial review.
exampleAr: ستخضع القضية لمراجعة قضائية.

definitionEn: the liquid that comes from fruit or vegetables; a drink made from this
example: She drank a glass of orange juice with breakfast.
exampleAr: شربت كوبًا من عصير البرتقال مع الإفطار.

definitionEn: the 7th month of the year, between June and August
example: We're going on holiday in July.
exampleAr: سنذهب في عطلة خلال يوليو.

definitionEn: to move quickly off the ground or away from a surface by pushing yourself with your legs and feet
example: The cat jumped onto the table.
exampleAr: قفز القط فوق الطاولة.

definitionEn: an act of jumping
example: He made a huge jump over the fence.
exampleAr: قفز قفزة هائلة فوق السياج.

definitionEn: the place where two or more roads or railway lines meet
example: Turn left at the next junction.
exampleAr: انعطف يسارًا عند التقاطع التالي.

definitionEn: the 6th month of the year, between May and July
example: Her birthday is in June.
exampleAr: عيد ميلادها في يونيو.

definitionEn: having a low rank in an organization or a profession
example: She started her career as a junior accountant.
exampleAr: بدأت مسيرتها المهنية محاسبة مبتدئة.

definitionEn: having a low rank in an organization or a profession
example: The junior team won their match on Saturday.
exampleAr: فاز الفريق الأصغر سنًا بمباراته يوم السبت.
