definitionEn: the authority that an official organization has to make legal decisions about somebody/something
example: This case falls outside the court's jurisdiction.
exampleAr: تقع هذه القضية خارج نطاق الاختصاص القضائي للمحكمة.

definitionEn: a group of members of the public who listen to the facts of a case in a court and decide whether or not somebody is guilty of a crime, or whether a claim has been proved
example: The jury found the defendant not guilty.
exampleAr: قررت هيئة المحلفين براءة المتهم.

definitionEn: only
example: I just want to say thank you.
exampleAr: أريد فقط أن أقول شكرًا لك.

definitionEn: that most people consider to be morally fair and reasonable
example: The judge is known for being fair and just.
exampleAr: يُعرف القاضي بأنه نزيه وعادل.

definitionEn: the fair treatment of people
example: They are fighting for social justice.
exampleAr: يناضلون من أجل العدالة الاجتماعية.

definitionEn: a good reason why something exists or is done
example: He couldn't provide any justification for his actions.
exampleAr: لم يستطع تقديم أي تبرير لتصرفاته.

definitionEn: to show that somebody/something is right or reasonable
example: How do you justify spending so much money on a car?
exampleAr: كيف تبرر إنفاق كل هذا المال على سيارة؟

meaningAr: متحمس / راغب بشدة / حاد / قوي (حس أو اهتمام)
definitionEn: wanting to do something or wanting something to happen very much
example: She's keen to start her new job.
exampleAr: هي متحمسة لبدء وظيفتها الجديدة.

meaningAr: يحتفظ بـ / يستمر في / يبقي على حالة معينة
definitionEn: to continue to have something and not give it back or throw it away
example: You can keep the extra change.
exampleAr: يمكنك الاحتفاظ بالباقي.

definitionEn: a piece of metal with a special shape used for locking a door, starting a car, etc.
example: I lost my house key yesterday.
exampleAr: فقدت مفتاح منزلي بالأمس.

definitionEn: most important; essential
example: Trust is a key factor in any relationship.
exampleAr: الثقة عامل أساسي في أي علاقة.

definitionEn: the set of keys for operating a computer or typewriter, or the set of letters that you can touch to write on a smartphone or tablet
example: She types very fast on the keyboard.
exampleAr: تكتب بسرعة كبيرة على لوحة المفاتيح.

definitionEn: to hit somebody/something with your foot
example: He kicked the ball into the goal.
exampleAr: ركل الكرة داخل المرمى.

definitionEn: a movement with the foot or the leg, usually to hit something with the foot
example: She gave the door a hard kick.
exampleAr: وجّهت ركلة قوية للباب.

definitionEn: a child or young person
example: The kids were playing in the yard.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال يلعبون في الفناء.

definitionEn: a child or young person
example: I'm just kidding, don't worry about it.
exampleAr: أنا أمزح فقط، لا تقلق بشأن ذلك.

definitionEn: to take somebody away illegally and keep them as a prisoner, especially in order to get money or something else for returning them
example: The gang kidnapped the businessman for ransom.
exampleAr: اختطفت العصابة رجل الأعمال طلبًا للفدية.

definitionEn: either of the two organs in the body that remove waste products from the blood and produce urine
example: He donated one of his kidneys to his brother.
exampleAr: تبرع بإحدى كليتيه لأخيه.

definitionEn: to make somebody/something die
example: The disease killed thousands of people.
exampleAr: قتل المرض آلاف الأشخاص.

definitionEn: an act of killing somebody deliberately
example: The killing shocked the entire community.
exampleAr: صدمت عملية القتل المجتمع بأسره.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring distance; 1 000 metres
example: The nearest town is ten kilometres away.
exampleAr: تبعد أقرب بلدة عشرة كيلومترات.

definitionEn: a group of people or things that are the same in some way; a particular variety or type
example: What kind of music do you like?
exampleAr: ما نوع الموسيقى الذي تحبه؟

definitionEn: caring about others; gentle, friendly and generous
example: She's always kind to strangers.
exampleAr: هي دائمًا لطيفة مع الغرباء.

definitionEn: the male ruler of an independent state that has a royal family
example: The king ruled the country for over forty years.
exampleAr: حكم الملك البلاد لأكثر من أربعين عامًا.

definitionEn: a country that has a king or queen as head of state (= official leader of the country)
example: The United Kingdom consists of four nations.
exampleAr: تتألف المملكة المتحدة من أربع أمم.

definitionEn: to touch somebody with your lips as a sign of love or sexual desire or when saying hello or goodbye
example: She kissed her son goodnight.
exampleAr: قبّلت ابنها قبل النوم وتمنت له ليلة سعيدة.

definitionEn: the act of kissing somebody/something
example: He gave her a kiss on the cheek.
exampleAr: منحها قبلة على خدها.

definitionEn: a set of tools or equipment that you use for a particular purpose
example: He bought a first-aid kit for the car.
exampleAr: اشترى طقم إسعافات أولية للسيارة.

definitionEn: a room in which meals are cooked or prepared
example: She spends most of her time cooking in the kitchen.
exampleAr: تقضي معظم وقتها في الطهي في المطبخ.

definitionEn: the joint between the top and bottom parts of the leg where it bends in the middle
example: He fell and hurt his knee.
exampleAr: سقط وأصاب ركبته.

definitionEn: a sharp blade (= metal edge) with a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon
example: Be careful with that knife, it's very sharp.
exampleAr: كن حذرًا مع تلك السكين، فهي حادة جدًا.

definitionEn: to hit a door, etc. in order to attract attention
example: Someone knocked on the door late at night.
exampleAr: طرق أحدهم الباب في وقت متأخر من الليل.

definitionEn: the sound of somebody hitting a door, window, etc. with their hand or with something hard to attract attention
example: She heard a loud knock at the window.
exampleAr: سمعت طرقة عالية على النافذة.

definitionEn: to have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it
example: Do you know what time the train leaves?
exampleAr: هل تعرف في أي وقت يغادر القطار؟

definitionEn: the information, understanding and skills that you gain through education or experience
example: She has a deep knowledge of European history.
exampleAr: لديها معرفة عميقة بالتاريخ الأوروبي.

definitionEn: a laboratory
example: The students conducted the experiment in the lab.
exampleAr: أجرى الطلاب التجربة في المختبر.

meaningAr: ملصق / بطاقة على منتج / تصنيف / وصف لشخص
definitionEn: a piece of paper, etc. that is attached to something and that gives information about it
example: Check the label to see the ingredients.
exampleAr: تحقق من الملصق لمعرفة المكونات.

definitionEn: to fix a label on something or write information on something
example: The bottle was labeled poison in bold red letters.
exampleAr: وُضع على الزجاجة ملصق مكتوب عليه "سم" بأحرف حمراء بارزة.

definitionEn: a room or building used for scientific research, experiments, testing, etc.
example: The vaccine was developed in a laboratory in Oxford.
exampleAr: طُوّر اللقاح في مختبر في أكسفورد.

definitionEn: work, especially physical work
example: The factory relies on cheap labour.
exampleAr: يعتمد المصنع على عمالة رخيصة.

definitionEn: the state of not having something or not having enough of something
example: The project failed due to a lack of funding.
exampleAr: فشل المشروع بسبب نقص التمويل.

definitionEn: to have none or not enough of something
example: The plan lacks any clear timeline.
exampleAr: تفتقر الخطة إلى أي جدول زمني واضح.

definitionEn: a boy or young man
example: He's a good lad who always helps his neighbors.
exampleAr: إنه شاب طيب يساعد جيرانه دائمًا.

definitionEn: a piece of equipment for climbing up and down a wall, the side of a building, etc., consisting of two lengths of wood or metal that are joined together by steps or rungs
example: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
exampleAr: تسلق السلم لإصلاح السقف.

definitionEn: a word used to mean ‘woman’ that some people, especially older people, consider is more polite
example: An elderly lady was sitting on the bench.
exampleAr: كانت سيدة مسنة تجلس على المقعد.

definitionEn: a large area of water that is surrounded by land
example: They went fishing at the lake last weekend.
exampleAr: ذهبوا لصيد السمك في البحيرة نهاية الأسبوع الماضي.

definitionEn: a device that uses electricity, oil or gas to produce light
example: She turned on the lamp to read her book.
exampleAr: شغّلت المصباح لتقرأ كتابها.

definitionEn: the surface of the earth that is not sea
example: The land here is very fertile.
exampleAr: الأرض هنا خصبة جدًا.

definitionEn: to come down through the air onto the ground or another surface
example: The plane landed safely despite the storm.
exampleAr: هبطت الطائرة بأمان رغم العاصفة.

definitionEn: an act of bringing an aircraft or a spacecraft down to the ground after a journey
example: The pilot made a smooth landing despite the strong winds.
exampleAr: نفذ الطيار هبوطًا سلسًا رغم الرياح القوية.

definitionEn: a person or company from whom you rent a room, a house, an office, etc.
example: The landlord raised the rent this year.
exampleAr: رفع مالك العقار الإيجار هذا العام.

definitionEn: something, such as a large building, that you can see clearly from a distance and that will help you to know where you are
example: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
exampleAr: برج إيفل معلم بارز مشهور في باريس.

definitionEn: everything you can see when you look across a large area of land, especially in the country
example: The landscape was covered in rolling green hills.
exampleAr: كانت المناظر الطبيعية مغطاة بتلال خضراء متموجة.

meaningAr: حارة (طريق ضيق) / مسار (طريق سريع أو مسبح)
definitionEn: a narrow road in the country
example: They walked down a narrow country lane.
exampleAr: ساروا في حارة ريفية ضيقة.

definitionEn: the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area
example: She speaks four languages fluently.
exampleAr: تتحدث أربع لغات بطلاقة.

meaningAr: الحضن (فوق الفخذين) / شوط / دورة في سباق
definitionEn: the top part of your legs that forms a flat surface when you are sitting down
example: The cat curled up on her lap.
exampleAr: تكوّر القط في حضنها.

definitionEn: a small computer that can work with a battery and be easily carried
example: She works from home on her laptop.
exampleAr: تعمل من المنزل على حاسوبها المحمول.

definitionEn: big in size or quantity
example: They live in a large house with a big garden.
exampleAr: يعيشون في منزل كبير له حديقة واسعة.

definitionEn: involving many people or things, especially over a wide area
example: The company launched a large-scale marketing campaign.
exampleAr: أطلقت الشركة حملة تسويقية واسعة النطاق.

definitionEn: to a great extent; mostly or mainly
example: The success of the project was largely due to good planning.
exampleAr: يُعزى نجاح المشروع إلى حد كبير إلى التخطيط الجيد.

definitionEn: a device that gives out light in which all the waves oscillate (= change direction and strength) together, typically producing a powerful beam of light that can be used for cutting metal, in medical operations, etc.
example: Doctors used a laser to correct her vision.
exampleAr: استخدم الأطباء الليزر لتصحيح نظرها.

definitionEn: after anyone or anything else; at the end
example: This is the last chapter of the book.
exampleAr: هذا هو الفصل الأخير من الكتاب.

definitionEn: to continue for a particular period of time
example: The meeting lasted almost two hours.
exampleAr: استمر الاجتماع نحو ساعتين.

definitionEn: arriving, happening or done after the expected, arranged or usual time
example: She was late for the meeting again.
exampleAr: تأخرت عن الاجتماع مرة أخرى.

definitionEn: after the expected, arranged or usual time
example: He arrived late last night.
exampleAr: وصل متأخرًا الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: recently; in the recent past
example: Have you seen him lately?
exampleAr: هل رأيته مؤخرًا؟

definitionEn: at a time in the future; after the time you are talking about
example: I'll call you later this afternoon.
exampleAr: سأتصل بك لاحقًا بعد ظهر اليوم.

definitionEn: the most recent or newest
example: Have you seen the latest episode of the show?
exampleAr: هل شاهدت أحدث حلقة من البرنامج؟

definitionEn: used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned
example: Of the two options, I prefer the latter.
exampleAr: من بين الخيارين، أفضل الأخير.

definitionEn: to make the sounds and movements of your face that show you think something is funny or silly
example: The joke made everyone laugh.
exampleAr: أضحكت النكتة الجميع.

definitionEn: the sound you make when you think that something is funny or silly
example: She let out a loud laugh.
exampleAr: أطلقت ضحكة عالية.

definitionEn: the act or sound of laughing
example: The room was filled with laughter.
exampleAr: امتلأت الغرفة بالضحك.

meaningAr: يطلق (منتجًا أو حملة) / يطلق (صاروخًا أو سفينة)
definitionEn: to start an activity, especially an organized one
example: The company launched its new smartphone yesterday.
exampleAr: أطلقت الشركة هاتفها الذكي الجديد بالأمس.

definitionEn: the action of launching something
example: The launch of the new product was a huge success.
exampleAr: كان إطلاق المنتج الجديد نجاحًا كبيرًا.

definitionEn: a rule that deals with a particular crime, agreement, etc.
example: It's against the law to drive without insurance.
exampleAr: القيادة من دون تأمين مخالفة للقانون.

definitionEn: an area of ground covered in short grass in a garden or park, or used for playing a game on
example: He mows the lawn every Saturday.
exampleAr: يجزّ العشب كل سبت.

definitionEn: a claim or complaint against somebody that a person or an organization can make in court
example: The company is facing a lawsuit over the accident.
exampleAr: تواجه الشركة دعوى قضائية بسبب الحادث.

definitionEn: a person who is trained and qualified to advise people about the law and to represent them in court, and to write legal documents
example: She hired a lawyer to handle the divorce.
exampleAr: استعانت بمحامٍ لمعالجة إجراءات الطلاق.

definitionEn: to put somebody/something in a particular position, especially when it is done gently or carefully
example: She laid the baby gently in the crib.
exampleAr: وضعت الرضيع برفق في السرير.

definitionEn: a quantity or sheet of something that lies over a surface or between surfaces
example: The cake has three layers of chocolate sponge.
exampleAr: تتكون الكعكة من ثلاث طبقات من الإسفنج بالشوكولاتة.

definitionEn: the way in which the parts of something such as the page of a book, a website, a garden or a building are arranged
example: The layout of the office was changed to save space.
exampleAr: غُيّر مخطط توزيع المكتب لتوفير المساحة.

definitionEn: unwilling to work or be active; doing as little as possible
example: He's too lazy to clean his own room.
exampleAr: هو كسول جدًا لدرجة أنه لا ينظف غرفته بنفسه.

definitionEn: to go with or in front of a person or an animal to show the way or to make them go in the right direction
example: She leads a team of ten engineers.
exampleAr: تقود فريقًا مكونًا من عشرة مهندسين.

example: She took the lead in the final lap of the race.
exampleAr: تصدرت السباق في الشوط الأخير.

definitionEn: a person who leads a group of people, especially the head of a country, an organization, etc.
example: She is the leader of the opposition party.
exampleAr: هي زعيمة حزب المعارضة.

definitionEn: the state or position of being a leader
example: The company thrived under his leadership.
exampleAr: ازدهرت الشركة في ظل قيادته.

definitionEn: most important or most successful
example: She's a leading expert in artificial intelligence.
exampleAr: هي خبيرة رائدة في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي.

definitionEn: a flat green part of a plant, growing from a stem or branch or from the root
example: The leaves turn orange and red in autumn.
exampleAr: تتحول أوراق الشجر إلى اللونين البرتقالي والأحمر في الخريف.

definitionEn: a printed sheet of paper or a few printed pages that are given free to advertise or give information about something
example: They handed out leaflets advertising the new gym.
exampleAr: وزّعوا منشورات للإعلان عن صالة الرياضة الجديدة.

definitionEn: a group of sports teams who all play each other to earn points and find which team is best
example: The team finished second in the league last season.
exampleAr: احتل الفريق المركز الثاني في الدوري الموسم الماضي.

definitionEn: to allow liquid or gas to get in or out through a small hole
example: Water was leaking from the pipe under the sink.
exampleAr: كان الماء يتسرب من الأنبوب تحت الحوض.

definitionEn: a small hole that lets liquid or gas flow in or out of something by accident
example: There's a gas leak in the kitchen.
exampleAr: يوجد تسرب غاز في المطبخ.

definitionEn: to bend or move from a straight position to a sloping position
example: She leaned against the wall while waiting.
exampleAr: اتكأت على الجدار وهي تنتظر.

definitionEn: to bend or move from a straight position to a sloping position
example: He has a lean, athletic build.
exampleAr: يتمتع ببنية نحيلة ورياضية.

definitionEn: to jump high or a long way
example: She leapt over the puddle without slowing down.
exampleAr: قفزت فوق البركة من دون أن تبطئ.

definitionEn: a long or high jump
example: It was a huge leap forward for the company.
exampleAr: كانت قفزة كبيرة إلى الأمام بالنسبة للشركة.

definitionEn: to gain knowledge or skill by studying, from experience, from being taught, etc.
example: She's learning to play the piano.
exampleAr: تتعلم العزف على البيانو.

definitionEn: the process of learning something
example: Online learning has become very popular.
exampleAr: أصبح التعلم عبر الإنترنت شائعًا جدًا.

definitionEn: to the smallest degree
example: This was the least expensive option available.
exampleAr: كان هذا الخيار الأقل تكلفة من بين الخيارات المتاحة.

definitionEn: material made by removing the hair or fur from animal skins and preserving the skins using special processes
example: She bought a leather jacket for the winter.
exampleAr: اشترت سترة جلدية للشتاء.

definitionEn: to go away from a person or a place
example: The train leaves at nine o'clock.
exampleAr: يغادر القطار في الساعة التاسعة.

definitionEn: a period of time when you are allowed to be away from work for a holiday or for a special reason
example: He's on parental leave for three months.
exampleAr: هو في إجازة أبوة لمدة ثلاثة أشهر.

definitionEn: a talk that is given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course
example: The professor gave a fascinating lecture on climate change.
exampleAr: ألقى الأستاذ محاضرة رائعة عن تغير المناخ.

definitionEn: to give a talk or a series of talks to a group of people on a subject, especially as a way of teaching in a university or college
example: She lectured him about being more careful with money.
exampleAr: ألقت عليه محاضرة طويلة عن ضرورة توخي الحذر في المال.

definitionEn: on the side of your body that is towards the west when you are facing north
example: Turn left at the next corner.
exampleAr: انعطف يسارًا عند الزاوية التالية.

definitionEn: the left side or direction
example: The party leans to the left politically.
exampleAr: يميل الحزب سياسيًا إلى اليسار.

definitionEn: one of the long parts that connect the feet to the rest of the body
example: She broke her leg while skiing.
exampleAr: كسرت ساقها أثناء التزلج.

definitionEn: money or property that is given to you by somebody when they die
example: He left behind a legacy of kindness and generosity.
exampleAr: ترك وراءه إرثًا من الطيبة والكرم.

definitionEn: connected with the law
example: It's not legal to sell alcohol to minors.
exampleAr: بيع الكحول للقاصرين غير قانوني.

definitionEn: a story from ancient times about people and events, that may or may not be true; this type of story
example: According to legend, the castle is haunted.
exampleAr: وفقًا للأسطورة، القلعة مسكونة بالأشباح.

definitionEn: very famous and talked about a lot by people
example: The legendary singer performed for the last time before retiring.
exampleAr: قدّم المغني الأسطوري عرضه الأخير قبل اعتزاله.

definitionEn: a law or a set of laws passed by a parliament
example: New legislation was passed to protect workers' rights.
exampleAr: أُقر تشريع جديد لحماية حقوق العمال.

definitionEn: connected with the act of making and passing laws
example: The legislative branch is responsible for making laws.
exampleAr: السلطة التشريعية مسؤولة عن سن القوانين.

definitionEn: a group of people who have the power to make and change laws
example: The state legislature approved the new budget.
exampleAr: وافقت السلطة التشريعية للولاية على الميزانية الجديدة.

definitionEn: for which there is a fair and acceptable reason
example: She has a legitimate reason for being absent.
exampleAr: لديها سبب مشروع لغيابها.

definitionEn: time when you are not working or studying; free time
example: He spends his leisure time reading and gardening.
exampleAr: يقضي وقت فراغه في القراءة والعناية بالحديقة.

definitionEn: a yellow citrus fruit with juice that has a bitter, sharp taste. Slices of lemon and lemon juice are used in cooking and drinks.
example: She squeezed fresh lemon into her tea.
exampleAr: عصرت ليمونًا طازجًا في شايها.

definitionEn: to give something to somebody or allow them to use something that belongs to you, which they have to return to you later
example: Could you lend me some money until Friday?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تقرضني بعض المال حتى الجمعة؟

definitionEn: the size or measurement of something from one end to the other
example: The room is about five meters in length.
exampleAr: طول الغرفة نحو خمسة أمتار.

definitionEn: very long, and often too long, in time or size
example: After a lengthy discussion, they finally reached an agreement.
exampleAr: بعد نقاش طويل، توصلوا أخيرًا إلى اتفاق.

definitionEn: a curved piece of glass or plastic that makes things look larger, smaller or clearer when you look through it
example: She cleaned the camera lens before the shoot.
exampleAr: نظفت عدسة الكاميرا قبل التصوير.

definitionEn: sexually attracted to other women; connected with lesbians
example: The film follows a lesbian couple raising two children.
exampleAr: يتتبع الفيلم قصة ثنائي مثلي من النساء يربيان طفلين.

definitionEn: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a smaller amount of’
example: I have less time than I used to.
exampleAr: لدي وقت أقل مما كان لدي في السابق.

definitionEn: not as great in size, amount or importance as something/somebody else
example: He was found guilty of the lesser charge.
exampleAr: أُدين بالتهمة الأخف.

definitionEn: a period of time in which somebody is taught something
example: She takes piano lessons every Tuesday.
exampleAr: تأخذ دروس بيانو كل ثلاثاء.

definitionEn: used for making suggestions or as a polite way of telling people what you want them to do
example: Her parents let her stay out late.
exampleAr: سمح لها والداها بالبقاء خارج المنزل حتى وقت متأخر.

definitionEn: causing or able to cause death
example: The snake's venom is lethal.
exampleAr: سم الأفعى مميت.

definitionEn: a written, typed or printed message that is put in an envelope or attached to an email and sent to somebody
example: She wrote a letter to her grandmother.
exampleAr: كتبت رسالة إلى جدتها.

definitionEn: the height of something in relation to the ground or to what it used to be
example: The water level rose sharply after the storm.
exampleAr: ارتفع مستوى المياه بشكل حاد بعد العاصفة.

definitionEn: having a flat surface that does not slope
example: Make sure the shelf is level before fixing it.
exampleAr: تأكد من أن الرف مستوٍ قبل تثبيته.

definitionEn: legally responsible for paying the cost of something
example: The driver was found liable for the accident.
exampleAr: تقرر أن السائق مسؤول قانونيًا عن الحادث.

definitionEn: willing to understand and respect other people’s behaviour, opinions, etc., especially when they are different from your own; believing people should be able to choose how they behave
example: He holds fairly liberal views on social issues.
exampleAr: يتبنى آراءً ليبرالية إلى حد كبير في القضايا الاجتماعية.

definitionEn: the act or process of freeing a country or a person from the control of somebody else
example: The country celebrates its liberation from colonial rule.
exampleAr: تحتفل الدولة بتحررها من الحكم الاستعماري.

definitionEn: freedom to live as you choose without too many limits from government or authority
example: The statue symbolizes liberty and independence.
exampleAr: يرمز التمثال إلى الحرية والاستقلال.

definitionEn: a building in which collections of books, newspapers, etc. and sometimes films and recorded music are kept for people to read, study or borrow
example: She borrowed three books from the library.
exampleAr: استعارت ثلاثة كتب من المكتبة.

definitionEn: an official document that shows that permission has been given to do, own or use something
example: He lost his driving licence after the accident.
exampleAr: فقد رخصة قيادته بعد الحادث.

definitionEn: to give somebody official permission to do, own, or use something
example: The company is licensed to sell alcohol.
exampleAr: الشركة مرخصة لبيع الكحول.

definitionEn: to say or write something that you know is not true
example: He lied about his age.
exampleAr: كذب بشأن عمره.

definitionEn: a statement made by somebody knowing that it is not true
example: It was a lie that damaged their friendship.
exampleAr: كانت كذبة أضرت بصداقتهما.

definitionEn: the ability to breathe, grow, produce young, etc. that people, animals and plants have before they die and that objects do not have
example: She dedicated her life to helping others.
exampleAr: كرّست حياتها لمساعدة الآخرين.

definitionEn: lasting or existing all through your life
example: They have been lifelong friends since childhood.
exampleAr: ظلا صديقين مدى الحياة منذ الطفولة.

definitionEn: the way in which a person or a group of people lives and works
example: She adopted a healthier lifestyle after the diagnosis.
exampleAr: تبنّت أسلوب حياة أكثر صحة بعد التشخيص.

definitionEn: the length of time that somebody lives or that something lasts
example: He worked at the same company for his entire lifetime.
exampleAr: عمل في الشركة نفسها طوال حياته.

definitionEn: to raise somebody/something or be raised to a higher position or level
example: He lifted the heavy box onto the shelf.
exampleAr: رفع الصندوق الثقيل ووضعه على الرف.

definitionEn: a machine that carries people or goods up and down to different levels in a building or a mine
example: Let's take the lift to the fifth floor.
exampleAr: لنأخذ المصعد إلى الطابق الخامس.

definitionEn: the energy from the sun, a lamp, etc. that makes it possible to see things
example: She turned on the light in the hallway.
exampleAr: أضاءت النور في الردهة.

definitionEn: pale in colour
example: This bag is very light and easy to carry.
exampleAr: هذه الحقيبة خفيفة جدًا وسهلة الحمل.

definitionEn: to make something start to burn
example: He lit the candles on the birthday cake.
exampleAr: أشعل الشموع على كعكة عيد الميلاد.

definitionEn: the arrangement or type of light in a place
example: The restaurant has very romantic lighting.
exampleAr: يتميز المطعم بإضاءة رومانسية جدًا.

definitionEn: to find somebody/something pleasant, attractive or of a good enough standard; to enjoy something
example: I like reading before bed.
exampleAr: أحب القراءة قبل النوم.

definitionEn: similar to somebody/something
example: She sings like a professional.
exampleAr: تغني مثل المحترفين.

definitionEn: the chance of something happening; how likely something is to happen
example: There's a strong likelihood of rain tomorrow.
exampleAr: هناك احتمال قوي لهطول الأمطار غدًا.

definitionEn: having a good chance of happening or being something; probable or expected
example: It's likely to rain later today.
exampleAr: من المحتمل أن تمطر لاحقًا اليوم.

definitionEn: the same; in a similar way
example: He bowed to the audience, and the other performers did likewise.
exampleAr: انحنى للجمهور، وفعل بقية الفنانين المثل.

definitionEn: an arm or a leg; a similar part of an animal, such as a wing
example: He lost a limb in the accident.
exampleAr: فقد أحد أطرافه في الحادث.

definitionEn: the greatest or smallest amount of something that is allowed
example: There's a speed limit of fifty kilometers per hour on this road.
exampleAr: يوجد حد للسرعة يبلغ خمسين كيلومترًا في الساعة على هذا الطريق.

definitionEn: to stop something from increasing beyond a particular amount or level
example: The doctor advised him to limit his salt intake.
exampleAr: نصحه الطبيب بالحد من كمية الملح التي يتناولها.

definitionEn: the act or process of limiting or controlling somebody/something
example: Every method has its limitations.
exampleAr: لكل طريقة قيودها.

definitionEn: not very great in amount or extent
example: We have limited time to finish this project.
exampleAr: لدينا وقت محدود لإنهاء هذا المشروع.

definitionEn: a long, thin mark on a surface
example: Draw a straight line across the page.
exampleAr: ارسم خطًا مستقيمًا عبر الصفحة.

definitionEn: to cover the inside of something with a layer of another material, especially to keep it clean or make it stronger
example: Crowds lined the streets to watch the parade.
exampleAr: اصطفت الحشود على طول الشوارع لمشاهدة الموكب.

definitionEn: the people who are going to take part in a particular event
example: The band announced its line-up for the summer tour.
exampleAr: أعلنت الفرقة عن تشكيلتها لجولة الصيف.

definitionEn: of or in lines
example: The story doesn't follow a linear timeline.
exampleAr: لا تتبع القصة تسلسلًا زمنيًا خطيًا.

definitionEn: to continue to exist for longer than expected
example: The smell of smoke lingered in the room for days.
exampleAr: ظلت رائحة الدخان عالقة في الغرفة لأيام.

definitionEn: a connection between two or more people or things
example: Scientists found a link between diet and heart disease.
exampleAr: وجد العلماء علاقة بين النظام الغذائي وأمراض القلب.

definitionEn: to make a physical or electronic connection between one object, machine, place, etc. and another
example: The two events are closely linked.
exampleAr: يرتبط الحدثان ارتباطًا وثيقًا.

definitionEn: a large, powerful animal of the cat family that hunts in groups and lives in parts of Africa and southern Asia. Lions have yellow-brown fur and the male has a mane (= long, thick hair round its neck).
example: The lion is known as the king of the jungle.
exampleAr: يُعرف الأسد بملك الغابة.

definitionEn: either of the two soft edges at the opening to the mouth
example: She applied lipstick to her lips.
exampleAr: وضعت أحمر الشفاه على شفتيها.

definitionEn: a substance that flows freely and is not a solid or a gas, for example water or oil
example: Water is a liquid at room temperature.
exampleAr: الماء سائل في درجة حرارة الغرفة.

definitionEn: in the form of a liquid; not a solid or a gas
example: The medicine comes in liquid form.
exampleAr: يأتي الدواء في صورة سائلة.

definitionEn: a series of names, items, figures, etc., especially when they are written or printed
example: She made a list of things to buy.
exampleAr: أعدت قائمة بالأشياء التي ستشتريها.

definitionEn: to write a list of things in a particular order
example: The website lists all the local restaurants.
exampleAr: يسرد الموقع الإلكتروني جميع المطاعم المحلية.

definitionEn: to pay attention to somebody/something that you can hear
example: He listens to music while he works.
exampleAr: يستمع إلى الموسيقى أثناء عمله.

definitionEn: a person who listens
example: The radio show has millions of listeners.
exampleAr: يحظى البرنامج الإذاعي بملايين المستمعين.

definitionEn: a list, especially an official or published list of people or things, often arranged in alphabetical order
example: The real estate agent sent us a new listing.
exampleAr: أرسل لنا وكيل العقارات إعلانًا جديدًا.

definitionEn: the ability to read and write
example: The program aims to improve literacy among children.
exampleAr: يهدف البرنامج إلى تحسين معرفة القراءة والكتابة بين الأطفال.

definitionEn: in a literal way
example: He literally ran ten miles this morning.
exampleAr: ركض حرفيًا عشرة أميال هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: connected with literature
example: She has a strong interest in literary criticism.
exampleAr: لديها اهتمام كبير بالنقد الأدبي.

definitionEn: pieces of writing that are valued as works of art, especially novels, plays and poems (in contrast to technical books and newspapers, magazines, etc.)
example: She's studying English literature at university.
exampleAr: تدرس الأدب الإنجليزي في الجامعة.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring volume, equal to 1.76 British pints or 2.11 American pints
example: The car's fuel tank holds fifty litres.
exampleAr: يتسع خزان وقود السيارة لخمسين لترًا.

definitionEn: small pieces of rubbish such as paper, cans and bottles, that people have left lying in a public place
example: There was a lot of litter on the beach.
exampleAr: كانت هناك كمية كبيرة من القمامة المتناثرة على الشاطئ.

definitionEn: small pieces of rubbish such as paper, cans and bottles, that people have left lying in a public place
example: It's illegal to litter in this park.
exampleAr: إلقاء النفايات في هذه الحديقة مخالف للقانون.

definitionEn: not big; small; smaller than others
example: They have a little cottage by the sea.
exampleAr: لديهم كوخ صغير على البحر.

definitionEn: to a small degree
example: She was a little tired after the long trip.
exampleAr: كانت متعبة قليلًا بعد الرحلة الطويلة.

definitionEn: to have your home in a particular place
example: They live in a small apartment downtown.
exampleAr: يعيشون في شقة صغيرة في وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: living; not dead
example: The concert will be broadcast live on TV.
exampleAr: سيُبث الحفل مباشرة على التلفاز.

definitionEn: full of life and energy; active and enthusiastic
example: The city has a lively nightlife scene.
exampleAr: تتمتع المدينة بحياة ليلية نابضة بالحيوية.

definitionEn: a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile
example: Excessive drinking can damage your liver.
exampleAr: يمكن أن يضر الإفراط في الشرب بكبدك.

definitionEn: alive now
example: She's the oldest living relative in the family.
exampleAr: هي أكبر قريبة على قيد الحياة في العائلة.

definitionEn: money to buy the things that you need in life
example: He earns a living as a freelance writer.
exampleAr: يكسب رزقه ككاتب مستقل.

definitionEn: something that is being carried (usually in large amounts) by a person, vehicle, etc.
example: The truck was carrying a heavy load of bricks.
exampleAr: كانت الشاحنة تحمل حمولة ثقيلة من الطوب.

definitionEn: to put a large quantity of things or people onto or into something
example: They loaded the boxes onto the van.
exampleAr: حمّلوا الصناديق في الشاحنة الصغيرة.

definitionEn: money that an organization such as a bank lends and somebody borrows
example: She took out a loan to buy her first car.
exampleAr: حصلت على قرض لشراء سيارتها الأولى.

definitionEn: money that an organization such as a bank lends and somebody borrows
example: The bank loaned him the money for the business.
exampleAr: أقرضه البنك المال لمشروعه التجاري.

definitionEn: a large area inside the entrance of a public building where people can meet and wait
example: We agreed to meet in the hotel lobby.
exampleAr: اتفقنا على اللقاء في ردهة الفندق.

definitionEn: to try to influence a politician or the government and, for example, persuade them to support or oppose a change in the law
example: Activists lobbied the government for stricter laws.
exampleAr: ضغط النشطاء على الحكومة لسن قوانين أكثر صرامة.

definitionEn: belonging to or connected with the particular place or area that you are talking about or with the place where you live
example: She shops at the local market every Saturday.
exampleAr: تتسوق في السوق المحلي كل سبت.

definitionEn: a person who lives in a particular place or district
example: Ask a local for directions if you get lost.
exampleAr: اسأل أحد السكان المحليين عن الاتجاهات إذا تُهت.

definitionEn: to find the exact position of somebody/something
example: It took hours to locate the missing hikers.
exampleAr: استغرق العثور على المتنزهين المفقودين ساعات.

definitionEn: if something is located in a particular place, it exists there or has been put there
example: The hotel is located near the city center.
exampleAr: يقع الفندق بالقرب من وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: a place where something happens or exists; the position of something
example: They chose a beautiful location for the wedding.
exampleAr: اختارا موقعًا جميلًا لحفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: to fasten something with a lock; to be fastened with a lock
example: Don't forget to lock the door when you leave.
exampleAr: لا تنسَ قفل الباب عند مغادرتك.

definitionEn: a device that keeps a door, window, box, etc. shut, usually needing a key to open it
example: She changed the lock after losing her keys.
exampleAr: غيّرت القفل بعد أن فقدت مفاتيحها.

definitionEn: a thick piece of wood that is cut from or has fallen from a tree
example: They threw another log on the fire.
exampleAr: ألقوا جذع شجرة آخر على النار.

definitionEn: to put information in an official record or write a record of events
example: Please log in with your username and password.
exampleAr: يُرجى تسجيل الدخول باستخدام اسم المستخدم وكلمة المرور.

definitionEn: a way of thinking or explaining something
example: There's no logic behind his decision.
exampleAr: لا يوجد منطق وراء قراره.

definitionEn: seeming natural, reasonable or sensible
example: It's the logical choice given the circumstances.
exampleAr: إنه الخيار المنطقي في ظل هذه الظروف.

definitionEn: a printed design or symbol that a company or an organization uses as its special sign
example: The company redesigned its logo last year.
exampleAr: أعادت الشركة تصميم شعارها التجاري العام الماضي.

definitionEn: unhappy because you have no friends or people to talk to
example: She felt lonely after moving to a new city.
exampleAr: شعرت بالوحدة بعد انتقالها إلى مدينة جديدة.

definitionEn: measuring or covering a great length or distance, or a greater length or distance than usual
example: It was a long journey across the desert.
exampleAr: كانت رحلة طويلة عبر الصحراء.

definitionEn: for a long time
example: How long have you lived here?
exampleAr: منذ متى وأنت تعيش هنا؟

definitionEn: measuring or covering a great length or distance, or a greater length or distance than usual
example: She longed for a simpler life in the countryside.
exampleAr: تاقت إلى حياة أبسط في الريف.

definitionEn: that has existed or lasted for a long time
example: The two countries have a long-standing trade agreement.
exampleAr: يربط البلدين اتفاق تجاري قائم منذ زمن طويل.

definitionEn: lasting or having an effect over a long period of time
example: They're focused on long-term growth rather than quick profits.
exampleAr: يركزون على النمو طويل الأمد بدلًا من الأرباح السريعة.

definitionEn: having been the particular thing mentioned for a long time
example: He's a long-time supporter of the charity.
exampleAr: إنه داعم للجمعية الخيرية منذ فترة طويلة.

definitionEn: to turn your eyes in a particular direction
example: She looked out the window at the falling snow.
exampleAr: نظرت من النافذة إلى الثلج المتساقط.

definitionEn: an act of looking at somebody/something
example: He gave her a strange look across the room.
exampleAr: رمقها بنظرة غريبة عبر الغرفة.

definitionEn: to appear as a large shape that is not clear, especially in a frightening way
example: A crisis was looming on the horizon.
exampleAr: كانت أزمة تلوح في الأفق.

definitionEn: a shape like a curve or circle made by a line curving right round
example: Tie the rope into a loop.
exampleAr: اربط الحبل على شكل حلقة.

definitionEn: a shape like a curve or circle made by a line curving right round
example: The song loops continuously in the background.
exampleAr: تتكرر الأغنية باستمرار في الخلفية.

definitionEn: not securely fixed where it should be; able to become separated from something
example: The screw came loose over time.
exampleAr: أصبح المسمار اللولبي غير محكم مع مرور الوقت.

definitionEn: (in the UK) a man of high rank in the nobility (= people of high social class), or somebody who has been given the title ‘lord’ as an honour
example: He was made a lord for his services to the country.
exampleAr: مُنح لقب لورد تقديرًا لخدماته للبلاد.

definitionEn: a large vehicle for carrying heavy loads by road
example: A lorry blocked the entrance to the car park.
exampleAr: سدت شاحنة مدخل موقف السيارات.

definitionEn: to be unable to find something/somebody
example: They lost the match three to one.
exampleAr: خسروا المباراة بنتيجة ثلاثة إلى واحد.

meaningAr: خسارة (مالية أو في مباراة) / فقدان (شخص، حزن)
definitionEn: the state of no longer having something or as much of something; the process that leads to this
example: The company reported a huge loss this quarter.
exampleAr: أعلنت الشركة عن خسارة كبيرة هذا الربع.

definitionEn: unable to find your way; not knowing where you are
example: We got lost on the way to the hotel.
exampleAr: تهنا في طريقنا إلى الفندق.

definitionEn: used with verbs to mean ‘a great amount’
example: She has a lot of experience in marketing.
exampleAr: لديها خبرة كبيرة في التسويق.

definitionEn: a way of raising money for a government, charity, etc. by selling tickets that have different numbers on them that people have chosen. Numbers are then chosen by chance and the people who have those numbers on their tickets win prizes.
example: He won the lottery last year.
exampleAr: فاز باليانصيب العام الماضي.

definitionEn: making a lot of noise
example: The music was too loud for the small room.
exampleAr: كانت الموسيقى صاخبة جدًا بالنسبة للغرفة الصغيرة.

definitionEn: in a way that makes a lot of noise
example: He laughed loudly at the joke.
exampleAr: ضحك بصوت عالٍ على النكتة.

definitionEn: to have very strong feelings of liking and caring for somebody
example: She loves her family more than anything.
exampleAr: تحب عائلتها أكثر من أي شيء آخر.

definitionEn: a very strong feeling of liking and caring for somebody/something, especially a member of your family or a friend
example: Their love for each other grew stronger over the years.
exampleAr: نما حبهما لبعضهما البعض وترسخ على مر السنين.

definitionEn: beautiful; attractive
example: We had a lovely time at the beach.
exampleAr: قضينا وقتًا رائعًا على الشاطئ.

definitionEn: not high or tall; not far above the ground
example: Petrol prices have been unusually low this month.
exampleAr: كانت أسعار البنزين منخفضة بشكل غير معتاد هذا الشهر.

definitionEn: in or into a low position, not far above the ground
example: The plane flew low over the fields.
exampleAr: حلّقت الطائرة منخفضة فوق الحقول.

definitionEn: a low level or point; a low figure
example: Temperatures dropped to a new low overnight.
exampleAr: انخفضت درجات الحرارة إلى مستوى قياسي جديد بين عشية وضحاها.

definitionEn: to reduce something or to become less in value, quality, etc.
example: She lowered her voice so no one could hear.
exampleAr: خفضت صوتها حتى لا يسمعها أحد.

definitionEn: remaining constant in your support of somebody/something
example: He has always been loyal to his friends.
exampleAr: لطالما كان وفيًا لأصدقائه.

definitionEn: the quality of being constant in your support of somebody/something
example: The company values customer loyalty.
exampleAr: تقدّر الشركة ولاء عملائها.

definitionEn: good things that happen to you by chance, not because of your own efforts or abilities
example: With a bit of luck, we'll finish on time.
exampleAr: بقليل من الحظ، سننتهي في الموعد المحدد.

definitionEn: having good luck
example: She felt lucky to have such supportive friends.
exampleAr: شعرت بأنها محظوظة لامتلاكها أصدقاء داعمين كهؤلاء.

definitionEn: a meal eaten in the middle of the day
example: Let's grab lunch together tomorrow.
exampleAr: لنتناول الغداء معًا غدًا.

definitionEn: either of the two organs in the chest that you use for breathing
example: Smoking can seriously damage your lungs.
exampleAr: يمكن أن يضر التدخين برئتيك بشكل خطير.

definitionEn: the fact of enjoying special and expensive things, particularly food and drink, clothes and places
example: They stayed in a luxury hotel in Dubai.
exampleAr: أقاما في فندق فاخر في دبي.

definitionEn: expensive and of very high quality
example: She drives a luxury car she saved years for.
exampleAr: تقود سيارة فاخرة ادخرت لسنوات لشرائها.

definitionEn: the words of a popular song
example: I love the lyrics of that song.
exampleAr: أحب كلمات تلك الأغنية.

definitionEn: a piece of equipment with many parts that work together to do a particular task. The power used to work a machine may be electricity, steam, gas, etc. or human power.
example: The factory installed a new washing machine line.
exampleAr: ركّب المصنع خط إنتاج جديدًا لغسالات الملابس.

definitionEn: machines as a group, especially large ones
example: The farm uses heavy machinery to harvest crops.
exampleAr: تستخدم المزرعة معدات ثقيلة لحصاد المحاصيل.

definitionEn: very stupid; not at all sensible
example: She was mad at him for being late again.
exampleAr: كانت غاضبة منه لتأخره مرة أخرى.

definitionEn: a type of large thin book with a paper cover that you can buy every week or month, containing articles, photographs, etc., often on a particular topic; a similar collection of articles, etc. that appears regularly online
example: She subscribes to a fashion magazine.
exampleAr: تشترك في مجلة أزياء.

definitionEn: the secret power of appearing to make impossible things happen by saying special words or doing special things
example: The children were amazed by the magician's tricks and magic.
exampleAr: انبهر الأطفال بحيل الساحر وسحره.

definitionEn: having or using special powers to make impossible things happen or seem to happen
example: She waved her magic wand and the room went dark.
exampleAr: لوّحت بعصاها السحرية فأظلمت الغرفة.

definitionEn: containing magic; used in magic
example: The forest had a magical atmosphere at night.
exampleAr: كانت الغابة تكتسي أجواءً ساحرة ليلًا.

definitionEn: an official who acts as a judge in the lowest courts of law
example: The case was heard by a local magistrate.
exampleAr: نظر قاضي صلح محلي في القضية.

definitionEn: behaving like a magnet; that can be attracted by a magnet
example: The door has a magnetic lock.
exampleAr: الباب مزود بقفل مغناطيسي.

definitionEn: extremely attractive and impressive; deserving praise
example: The view from the mountain was magnificent.
exampleAr: كان المنظر من الجبل رائعًا.

definitionEn: the great size or importance of something; the degree to which something is large or important
example: The earthquake had a magnitude of 7.2.
exampleAr: بلغت قوة الزلزال 7.2 درجة.

definitionEn: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.
example: She checks her mail every morning.
exampleAr: تتفقد بريدها كل صباح.

definitionEn: to send something to somebody using the postal system
example: Please mail the documents by Friday.
exampleAr: يُرجى إرسال المستندات بالبريد بحلول الجمعة.

definitionEn: being the largest or most important of its kind
example: The main entrance is around the corner.
exampleAr: يقع المدخل الرئيسي عند الزاوية.

definitionEn: the main area of land of a country or region, not including any islands near to it
example: They took a ferry from the island to the mainland.
exampleAr: استقلوا عبّارة من الجزيرة إلى البر الرئيسي.

definitionEn: more than anything else; also used to talk about the most important reason for something
example: The population is mainly made up of young families.
exampleAr: يتألف السكان بشكل رئيسي من عائلات شابة.

definitionEn: considered normal because it reflects what is done or accepted by most people
example: The band's sound has become more mainstream over the years.
exampleAr: أصبح أسلوب الفرقة الموسيقي أكثر شيوعًا مع مرور السنين.

definitionEn: the ideas and opinions that are thought to be normal because they are shared by most people; the people whose ideas and opinions are most accepted
example: Her ideas were once radical but are now part of the mainstream.
exampleAr: كانت أفكارها راديكالية يومًا ما لكنها أصبحت الآن جزءًا من التيار السائد.

definitionEn: to make something continue at the same level, standard, etc.
example: It's important to maintain a healthy diet.
exampleAr: من المهم الحفاظ على نظام غذائي صحي.

definitionEn: the act of keeping something in good condition by checking or repairing it regularly
example: The building requires regular maintenance.
exampleAr: يحتاج المبنى إلى صيانة دورية.

definitionEn: very large or important
example: There was a major accident on the highway this morning.
exampleAr: وقع حادث كبير على الطريق السريع هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: very large or important
example: Her major is computer science.
exampleAr: تخصصها هو علوم الحاسوب.

definitionEn: the largest part of a group of people or things
example: The majority of students passed the exam.
exampleAr: نجحت أغلبية الطلاب في الامتحان.

definitionEn: to create or prepare something by combining materials or putting parts together
example: She made a cake for the party.
exampleAr: صنعت كعكة للحفلة.

definitionEn: the name or type of a machine, piece of equipment, etc. that is made by a particular company
example: What make is your car?
exampleAr: ما نوع سيارتك؟

definitionEn: coloured substances used on the skin to make yourself look more attractive or to change your appearance
example: She rarely wears make-up to work.
exampleAr: نادرًا ما تضع مكياجًا للعمل.

definitionEn: the act or process of making or producing something
example: This crisis has been years in the making.
exampleAr: كانت هذه الأزمة تتشكل على مدى سنوات.

definitionEn: being a man or boy
example: The zoo has three male lions.
exampleAr: تضم حديقة الحيوان ثلاثة أسود ذكور.

definitionEn: a male person, animal or plant
example: The male of the species is usually larger than the female.
exampleAr: عادة ما يكون ذكر هذا النوع أكبر من الأنثى.

definitionEn: a large building or covered area that has many shops, restaurants, etc. inside it
example: They spent the afternoon shopping at the mall.
exampleAr: قضيا فترة بعد الظهر في التسوق في مركز التسوق.

definitionEn: an adult male human
example: A man was waiting outside the office.
exampleAr: كان رجل ينتظر خارج المكتب.

definitionEn: an adult male human
example: Volunteers manned the information desk all day.
exampleAr: تولى المتطوعون تشغيل مكتب الاستعلامات طوال اليوم.

definitionEn: to control or be in charge of a business, a team, an organization, land, etc.

exampleAr: تدير فريقًا من عشرين شخصًا.

definitionEn: the activity of running and controlling a business or similar organization
example: The company's management decided to cut costs.
exampleAr: قررت إدارة الشركة خفض التكاليف.

definitionEn: a person who is in charge of running a business, a shop or a similar organization or part of one
example: She was promoted to manager last year.
exampleAr: تمت ترقيتها إلى منصب مديرة العام الماضي.

definitionEn: the authority to do something, given to a government or other organization by the people who vote for it in an election
example: The president won a clear mandate to reform the economy.
exampleAr: حصل الرئيس على تفويض واضح لإصلاح الاقتصاد.

definitionEn: the authority to do something, given to a government or other organization by the people who vote for it in an election
example: The law mandates that all cars have seatbelts.
exampleAr: يُلزم القانون جميع السيارات بوجود أحزمة أمان.

definitionEn: required by law
example: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for all cyclists.
exampleAr: ارتداء الخوذة إلزامي لجميع راكبي الدراجات.

definitionEn: to show something clearly, especially a feeling, an attitude or a quality
example: Her stress began to manifest as physical symptoms.
exampleAr: بدأ توترها يظهر على شكل أعراض جسدية.

meaningAr: يتلاعب بـ (شخص أو بيانات) / يشغّل بمهارة يدويًا
definitionEn: to control or influence somebody/something, often in a dishonest way so that they do not realize it
example: He manipulated the data to support his theory.
exampleAr: تلاعب بالبيانات لدعم نظريته.

definitionEn: behaviour that controls or influences somebody/something, often in a dishonest way so that they do not realize it
example: The scandal involved serious financial manipulation.
exampleAr: انطوت الفضيحة على تلاعب مالي خطير.

definitionEn: behaviour that is considered to be polite in a particular society or culture
example: She spoke in a calm, reassuring manner.
exampleAr: تحدثت بأسلوب هادئ ومطمئن.

definitionEn: to make goods in large quantities, using machines
example: The factory manufactures car parts for export.
exampleAr: يصنّع المصنع قطع غيار سيارات للتصدير.

definitionEn: the business or industry of producing goods in large quantities in factories, etc.
example: The country's economy depends heavily on manufacturing.
exampleAr: يعتمد اقتصاد البلاد بشكل كبير على التصنيع.

definitionEn: a copy of a book, piece of music, etc. before it has been printed
example: The publisher rejected her first manuscript.
exampleAr: رفض الناشر مخطوطتها الأولى.

definitionEn: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: Many people attended the concert.
exampleAr: حضر كثير من الناس الحفل الموسيقي.

definitionEn: a drawing or plan of the earth’s surface or part of it, showing countries, towns, rivers, etc.
example: She used a map to find her way through the city.
exampleAr: استخدمت خريطة لتجد طريقها عبر المدينة.

definitionEn: to make a map of an area
example: They mapped out a plan for the next five years.
exampleAr: وضعوا خطة مفصلة للسنوات الخمس القادمة.

definitionEn: a long running race of about 42 kilometres or 26 miles
example: She ran her first marathon last year.
exampleAr: ركضت أول ماراثون لها العام الماضي.

definitionEn: an organized walk by many people from one place to another, in order to protest about something, or to express their opinions
example: The exams start in March.
exampleAr: تبدأ الامتحانات في مارس.

definitionEn: to walk with stiff regular steps like a soldier
example: Thousands marched through the city to protest the new law.
exampleAr: سار آلاف الأشخاص عبر المدينة احتجاجًا على القانون الجديد.

definitionEn: the empty space at the side of a written or printed page
example: She wrote notes in the margin of the book.
exampleAr: كتبت ملاحظات على هامش الكتاب.

definitionEn: small and not important
example: The change had only a marginal effect on sales.
exampleAr: كان للتغيير تأثير طفيف فقط على المبيعات.

definitionEn: connected with the sea and the creatures and plants that live there
example: The aquarium has a large collection of marine life.
exampleAr: يضم حوض الأسماك مجموعة كبيرة من الحياة البحرية.

definitionEn: connected with the sea and the creatures and plants that live there
example: He served as a marine for six years.
exampleAr: خدم جنديًا في مشاة البحرية لمدة ست سنوات.

definitionEn: a written or printed symbol that is used as a sign of something, for example the quality of something or who made or owns it
example: There's a mark on the wall where the picture used to hang.
exampleAr: توجد علامة على الجدار في المكان الذي كانت تُعلّق فيه اللوحة.

definitionEn: to write or draw a symbol, line, etc. on something in order to give information about it
example: The teacher marked all the exams over the weekend.
exampleAr: صحح المعلم جميع الامتحانات خلال عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

definitionEn: an object or a sign that shows the position of something
example: He wrote the title with a black marker.
exampleAr: كتب العنوان بقلم تحديد أسود.

definitionEn: an occasion when people buy and sell goods; the open area or building where they meet to do this
example: She buys fresh vegetables at the market every week.
exampleAr: تشتري خضروات طازجة من السوق كل أسبوع.

definitionEn: to advertise a product in a particular way in order to make people want it
example: The company markets its products worldwide.
exampleAr: تسوّق الشركة منتجاتها في جميع أنحاء العالم.

definitionEn: the activity of presenting, advertising and selling a company’s products or services in the best possible way
example: She works in the marketing department.
exampleAr: تعمل في قسم التسويق.

definitionEn: the activity of competing with other companies to buy and sell goods, services, etc.
example: The two companies compete in the same marketplace.
exampleAr: تتنافس الشركتان في السوق نفسها.

definitionEn: the legal relationship between two people who are married to each other
example: They celebrated twenty years of marriage.
exampleAr: احتفلا بمرور عشرين عامًا على زواجهما.

definitionEn: having a husband or wife
example: She's been married for ten years.
exampleAr: هي متزوجة منذ عشر سنوات.

definitionEn: to become the husband or wife of somebody; to get married to somebody
example: They got married in a small ceremony last spring.
exampleAr: تزوجا في حفل صغير في الربيع الماضي.

example: He practices martial arts three times a week.
exampleAr: يمارس الفنون القتالية ثلاث مرات أسبوعيًا.

definitionEn: something that you wear over your face to hide it, or to frighten or entertain other people
example: She wore a mask to the costume party.
exampleAr: ارتدت قناعًا لحفلة الأزياء التنكرية.

definitionEn: something that you wear over your face to hide it, or to frighten or entertain other people
example: He tried to mask his disappointment with a smile.
exampleAr: حاول إخفاء خيبة أمله بابتسامة.

definitionEn: a large amount of a substance that does not have a definite shape or form
example: The mass of the object was measured in kilograms.
exampleAr: قيست كتلة الجسم بالكيلوغرامات.

definitionEn: affecting or involving a large number of people or things
example: The disaster caused a mass evacuation of the city.
exampleAr: تسببت الكارثة في إخلاء جماعي للمدينة.

definitionEn: the killing of a large number of people especially in a cruel way
example: The massacre shocked the entire world.
exampleAr: صدمت المجزرة العالم بأسره.

definitionEn: very large, heavy and solid
example: The company suffered a massive financial loss.
exampleAr: تكبدت الشركة خسارة مالية هائلة.

definitionEn: a man who has people working for him, often as servants in his home
example: He is a master of the violin.
exampleAr: هو سيد بارع في العزف على الكمان.

definitionEn: to learn or understand something completely
example: It took years to master the technique.
exampleAr: استغرق إتقان هذه التقنية سنوات.

definitionEn: a sports event where people or teams compete against each other
example: They watched the football match together.
exampleAr: شاهدا مباراة كرة القدم معًا.

definitionEn: to find somebody/something that goes together with or is connected with another person or thing
example: Her shoes matched her dress perfectly.
exampleAr: كان حذاؤها يلائم فستانها تمامًا.

definitionEn: having the same colour, pattern, style, etc. and therefore looking attractive together
example: They wore matching outfits for the photo.
exampleAr: ارتديا ملابس متناسقة للصورة.

definitionEn: a friend
example: He went to the pub with his mates.
exampleAr: ذهب إلى الحانة مع أصدقائه.

definitionEn: a substance that things can be made from
example: The dress is made of a soft, silky material.
exampleAr: الفستان مصنوع من قماش ناعم وحريري.

definitionEn: connected with money, possessions, etc. rather than with the needs of the mind or spirit
example: Money and material possessions don't guarantee happiness.
exampleAr: المال والممتلكات المادية لا تضمن السعادة.

definitionEn: connected with or involving mathematics
example: She has a strong mathematical mind.
exampleAr: تتمتع بعقل رياضي قوي.

definitionEn: the science of numbers and shapes. Branches of mathematics include arithmetic, algebra, geometry and trigonometry.
example: He teaches mathematics at a local high school.
exampleAr: يدرّس الرياضيات في مدرسة ثانوية محلية.

definitionEn: mathematics, especially as a subject in school
example: She struggled with maths in school.
exampleAr: عانت في مادة الرياضيات في المدرسة.

definitionEn: used (to ask) if somebody is upset, unhappy, etc. or if there is a problem
example: It's a matter of great importance to the whole team.
exampleAr: إنه أمر بالغ الأهمية بالنسبة للفريق بأكمله.

definitionEn: to be important or have an important effect on somebody/something
example: It doesn't matter what he thinks.
exampleAr: لا يهم ما يعتقده.

definitionEn: behaving in a sensible way, like an adult
example: She's very mature for her age.
exampleAr: هي ناضجة جدًا بالنسبة لسنها.

definitionEn: to become fully grown or developed
example: The wine needs time to mature before it's ready.
exampleAr: يحتاج النبيذ إلى وقت لينضج قبل أن يصبح جاهزًا.

definitionEn: to increase something as much as possible
example: The company wants to maximize its profits.
exampleAr: تريد الشركة تعظيم أرباحها.

definitionEn: as large, fast, etc. as is possible, or the most that is possible or allowed
example: The maximum speed limit here is one hundred kilometers per hour.
exampleAr: الحد الأقصى للسرعة هنا مئة كيلومتر في الساعة.

definitionEn: the greatest amount, size, speed, etc. that is possible, recorded or allowed
example: The elevator holds a maximum of eight people.
exampleAr: يتسع المصعد لثمانية أشخاص كحد أقصى.

definitionEn: the fifth month of the year, between April and June
example: The wedding is planned for May.
exampleAr: من المقرر أن يُقام الزفاف في مايو.

definitionEn: used to say that something is possible
example: It may rain later today.
exampleAr: قد تمطر لاحقًا اليوم.

definitionEn: used when you are not certain that something will happen or that something is true or is a correct number
example: Maybe we should wait until tomorrow.
exampleAr: ربما ينبغي أن ننتظر حتى الغد.

definitionEn: the head of the government of a town or city, etc., elected by the public
example: The mayor announced a new plan to reduce traffic.
exampleAr: أعلن العمدة عن خطة جديدة للحد من الازدحام المروري.

definitionEn: the form of I that is used when the speaker or writer is the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
example: Can you help me with this?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك مساعدتي في هذا؟

definitionEn: an occasion when people eat food, especially breakfast, lunch or dinner
example: They had a delicious meal at the new restaurant.
exampleAr: تناولا وجبة لذيذة في المطعم الجديد.

definitionEn: to have something as a meaning in the same or another language
example: What does this word mean?
exampleAr: ماذا تعني هذه الكلمة؟

definitionEn: to have something as a meaning in the same or another language
example: Don't be so mean to your little brother.
exampleAr: لا تكن لئيمًا جدًا مع أخيك الصغير.

definitionEn: the thing or idea that a sound, word, sign, etc. represents
example: The meaning of the poem is open to interpretation.
exampleAr: معنى القصيدة قابل للتأويل.

definitionEn: serious and important
example: She wanted a more meaningful career.
exampleAr: أرادت مسيرة مهنية أكثر جدوى.

definitionEn: an action, an object or a system by which a result is achieved; a way of achieving or doing something
example: Email is a common means of communication.
exampleAr: البريد الإلكتروني وسيلة تواصل شائعة.

definitionEn: for a short period of time but not permanently
example: In the meantime, please wait in the lobby.
exampleAr: في هذه الأثناء، يُرجى الانتظار في الردهة.

definitionEn: while something else is happening
example: Meanwhile, back at the office, everyone was waiting.
exampleAr: في هذه الأثناء، كان الجميع في المكتب ينتظرون.

definitionEn: to find the size, quantity, etc. of something in standard units
example: She measured the length of the table.
exampleAr: قاست طول الطاولة.

definitionEn: an official action that is done in order to achieve a particular aim
example: The government introduced new measures to fight inflation.
exampleAr: اتخذت الحكومة إجراءات جديدة لمكافحة التضخم.

definitionEn: the act or the process of finding the size, quantity or degree of something
example: The tailor took his measurements for the suit.
exampleAr: أخذ الخياط قياساته للبدلة.

definitionEn: the soft part of an animal or a bird that can be eaten as food; a particular type of this
example: She doesn't eat meat; she's vegetarian.
exampleAr: لا تأكل اللحم؛ فهي نباتية.

definitionEn: a person whose job is repairing machines, especially the engines of vehicles
example: The mechanic fixed the engine in an hour.
exampleAr: أصلح الميكانيكي المحرك خلال ساعة.

definitionEn: operated by power from an engine
example: The car had a mechanical fault that took days to find.
exampleAr: كان في السيارة عطل ميكانيكي استغرق اكتشافه أيامًا.

definitionEn: a set of moving parts in a machine that performs a task
example: The locking mechanism on the door is broken.
exampleAr: آلية القفل في الباب معطلة.

definitionEn: a flat piece of metal, usually like a coin in shape, that is given to the winner of a competition or to somebody who has been brave, for example in war
example: She won a gold medal at the championship.
exampleAr: فازت بميدالية ذهبية في البطولة.

definitionEn: the main ways that large numbers of people receive information and entertainment, that is television, radio, newspapers and the internet
example: The story was covered by the media worldwide.
exampleAr: غطت وسائل الإعلام العالمية القصة.

definitionEn: connected with illness and injury and their treatment
example: He needs urgent medical attention.
exampleAr: يحتاج إلى رعاية طبية عاجلة.

definitionEn: a drug or another form of medicine that you take to prevent or to treat an illness; treatment involving drugs
example: She takes medication for her blood pressure.
exampleAr: تتناول دواءً لضغط الدم.

definitionEn: the study and treatment of diseases and injuries
example: Take this medicine twice a day with food.
exampleAr: تناول هذا الدواء مرتين يوميًا مع الطعام.

definitionEn: connected with the Middle Ages (about AD 1000 to AD 1450)
example: The town has a beautiful medieval castle.
exampleAr: تضم البلدة قلعة جميلة من العصور الوسطى.

definitionEn: the practice of focusing your mind in silence, especially for religious reasons or in order to make your mind calm
example: She practices meditation every morning before work.
exampleAr: تمارس التأمل كل صباح قبل العمل.

definitionEn: in the middle between a larger and smaller size, amount, length, temperature, etc.
example: I'd like a medium coffee, please.
exampleAr: أود قهوة بحجم متوسط، من فضلك.

definitionEn: a way of communicating information, etc. to people
example: Television is a powerful medium for advertising.
exampleAr: التلفاز وسيلة إعلانية قوية.

definitionEn: to be in the same place as somebody by chance and talk to them
example: I met her at a conference last year.
exampleAr: قابلتها في مؤتمر العام الماضي.

definitionEn: an occasion when people come together to discuss or decide something
example: The meeting is scheduled for three o'clock.
exampleAr: من المقرر عقد الاجتماع في الساعة الثالثة.

definitionEn: a tune, especially the main tune in a piece of music written for several instruments or voices
example: The song has a beautiful melody.
exampleAr: تتمتع الأغنية بلحن جميل.

definitionEn: to become or make something become liquid as a result of heating
example: The ice cream melted quickly in the sun.
exampleAr: ذاب الآيس كريم بسرعة تحت الشمس.

definitionEn: a person, an animal or a plant that belongs to a particular group
example: She's a member of the tennis club.
exampleAr: هي عضوة في نادي التنس.

definitionEn: the state of being a member of a group, a club, an organization, etc.
example: He paid for an annual gym membership.
exampleAr: دفع رسوم عضوية سنوية في صالة الرياضة.

definitionEn: an official note from one person to another in the same organization
example: The manager sent a memo about the new policy.
exampleAr: أرسل المدير مذكرة بشأن السياسة الجديدة.

definitionEn: an account written by somebody, especially somebody famous, about their life and experiences
example: She wrote a memoir about her years as a war correspondent.
exampleAr: كتبت مذكرات عن سنواتها كمراسلة حرب.

definitionEn: worth remembering or easy to remember, especially because of being special or unusual
example: It was a truly memorable trip.
exampleAr: كانت رحلة لا تُنسى حقًا.

definitionEn: a statue, stone, etc. that is built in order to remind people of an important past event or of a famous person who has died
example: They built a memorial for the victims of the war.
exampleAr: بنوا نصبًا تذكاريًا لضحايا الحرب.

definitionEn: a statue, stone, etc. that is built in order to remind people of an important past event or of a famous person who has died
example: A memorial service was held for the late professor.
exampleAr: أُقيم حفل تأبين للأستاذ الراحل.

definitionEn: your ability to remember things
example: She has an excellent memory for names.
exampleAr: تتمتع بذاكرة ممتازة للأسماء.

definitionEn: connected with or happening in the mind; involving the process of thinking
example: Mental health is just as important as physical health.
exampleAr: الصحة النفسية لا تقل أهمية عن الصحة الجسدية.

definitionEn: to write or speak about something/somebody, especially without giving much information
example: She mentioned that she might be late.
exampleAr: ذكرت أنها قد تتأخر.

definitionEn: an act of referring to somebody/something in speech or writing
