exampleAr: حظي الفيلم بإشارة في حفل توزيع الجوائز.

definitionEn: an experienced person who advises and helps somebody with less experience over a period of time
example: She's been my mentor since I started this job.
exampleAr: كانت موجهتي منذ أن بدأت هذه الوظيفة.

definitionEn: an experienced person who advises and helps somebody with less experience over a period of time
example: He mentors young entrepreneurs in his free time.
exampleAr: يوجّه رواد أعمال شبابًا في وقت فراغه.

definitionEn: a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or to be served at a meal
example: Can I see the menu, please?
exampleAr: هل يمكنني رؤية قائمة الطعام، من فضلك؟

definitionEn: a person who buys and sells goods in large quantities, especially one who imports and exports goods
example: The merchant sold spices and silk along the trade route.
exampleAr: باع التاجر التوابل والحرير على طول طريق التجارة.

definitionEn: a kind or forgiving attitude towards somebody that you have the power to harm or right to punish
example: The prisoner begged the king for mercy.
exampleAr: توسل السجين إلى الملك طلبًا للرحمة.

definitionEn: used when you want to emphasize how small, unimportant, etc. somebody/something is
example: A mere glance was enough to tell she was upset.
exampleAr: كانت مجرد نظرة كافية لتبين أنها منزعجة.

definitionEn: used meaning ‘only’ or ‘simply’ to emphasize a fact or something that you are saying
example: I was merely trying to help.
exampleAr: كنت أحاول المساعدة فقط.

definitionEn: to combine or make two or more things combine to form a single thing
example: The two companies merged last year.
exampleAr: اندمجت الشركتان العام الماضي.

definitionEn: the act of joining two or more organizations or businesses into one
example: The merger created one of the largest banks in the country.
exampleAr: أوجد الاندماج أحد أكبر البنوك في البلاد.

definitionEn: the quality of being good and of deserving praise or reward
example: The idea has some merit but needs more research.
exampleAr: تتمتع الفكرة ببعض الجدارة لكنها تحتاج إلى مزيد من البحث.

definitionEn: the quality of being good and of deserving praise or reward
example: The proposal merits further discussion.
exampleAr: يستحق الاقتراح مزيدًا من النقاش.

definitionEn: a dirty or untidy state
example: The kids left the kitchen in a complete mess.
exampleAr: ترك الأطفال المطبخ في فوضى عارمة.

definitionEn: a written or spoken piece of information, etc. that you send to somebody or leave for somebody when you cannot speak to them yourself
example: She sent him a text message.
exampleAr: أرسلت له رسالة نصية.

definitionEn: a type of solid mineral substance that is usually hard and shiny and that heat and electricity can travel through, for example tin, iron and gold
example: The fence is made of metal.
exampleAr: السياج مصنوع من المعدن.

definitionEn: a word or phrase used to describe somebody/something else, in a way that is different from its normal use, in order to show that the two things have the same qualities and to make the description more powerful, for example She has a heart of stone; the use of such words and phrases
example: The poem uses the sea as a metaphor for life.
exampleAr: تستخدم القصيدة البحر استعارة للحياة.

definitionEn: a particular way of doing something
example: They tried a new method to teach reading.
exampleAr: جربوا طريقة جديدة لتعليم القراءة.

definitionEn: a set of methods and principles used to perform a particular activity
example: The research methodology was explained in detail.
exampleAr: شُرحت منهجية البحث بالتفصيل.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring length; a hundred centimetres
example: The pool is twenty-five metres long.
exampleAr: طول المسبح خمسة وعشرون مترًا.

definitionEn: the part of something that is at an equal distance from all its edges or sides; a point or a period of time between the beginning and the end of something
example: She stood in the middle of the room.
exampleAr: وقفت في وسط الغرفة.

definitionEn: in a position in the middle of an object, group of objects, people, etc.; between the beginning and the end of something
example: He belongs to the middle class.
exampleAr: ينتمي إلى الطبقة الوسطى.

definitionEn: 12 o’clock at night
example: The party continued until midnight.
exampleAr: استمرت الحفلة حتى منتصف الليل.

definitionEn: the middle part of something
example: They found themselves in the midst of a heated argument.
exampleAr: وجدا نفسيهما في خضم جدال محتدم.

definitionEn: used when showing that something is or was possible
example: It might rain later, so bring an umbrella.
exampleAr: قد تمطر لاحقًا، لذا أحضر مظلة.

definitionEn: used when showing that something is or was possible
example: They fought with all their might.
exampleAr: قاتلوا بكل قوتهم.

definitionEn: the movement every year of large numbers of birds or animals from one place to another
example: Bird migration patterns are changing due to climate change.
exampleAr: تتغير أنماط هجرة الطيور بسبب تغير المناخ.

meaningAr: معتدل / خفيف (طقس أو طعم) / خفيف (مرض أو رد فعل)
definitionEn: not severe or strong
example: The winter was unusually mild this year.
exampleAr: كان الشتاء معتدلًا بشكل غير معتاد هذا العام.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring distance equal to 1 609 metres or 1 760 yards
example: The nearest town is five miles away.
exampleAr: تبعد أقرب بلدة خمسة أميال.

definitionEn: using, or willing to use, force or strong pressure to achieve your aims, especially to achieve social or political change
example: The group took a more militant approach to protest.
exampleAr: اتخذت الجماعة نهجًا أكثر تشددًا في الاحتجاج.

definitionEn: a person who uses, or is willing to use, force or strong pressure to achieve their aims, especially to achieve social or political change
example: Several militants were arrested during the raid.
exampleAr: اعتُقل عدة مقاتلين متشددين خلال المداهمة.

definitionEn: soldiers; the armed forces
example: The military was deployed to help with the flood relief.
exampleAr: نُشر الجيش للمساعدة في جهود الإغاثة من الفيضانات.

definitionEn: connected with soldiers or the armed forces
example: They live on a military base.
exampleAr: يعيشون في قاعدة عسكرية.

definitionEn: a group of people who are not professional soldiers but who have had military training and can act as an army
example: A local militia took control of the town.
exampleAr: سيطرت ميليشيا محلية على البلدة.

definitionEn: the white liquid produced by cows, goats and some other animals as food for their young and used as a drink by humans
example: She drinks a glass of milk every morning.
exampleAr: تشرب كوبًا من الحليب كل صباح.

definitionEn: a building fitted with equipment for grinding grain into flour; a machine for grinding grain
example: The old mill used to grind wheat into flour.
exampleAr: كانت المطحنة القديمة تطحن القمح لتحويله إلى دقيق.

example: The company made a million dollars in profit.
exampleAr: حققت الشركة مليون دولار من الأرباح.

definitionEn: the part of a person that makes them able to be aware of things, to think and to feel
example: She has a brilliant mind for numbers.
exampleAr: تتمتع بعقل بارع في الأرقام.

definitionEn: to be upset, annoyed or worried by something
example: Would you mind closing the window?
exampleAr: هل تمانع في إغلاق النافذة؟

definitionEn: of or belonging to the person writing or speaking
example: This bag is mine, not yours.
exampleAr: هذه الحقيبة لي، وليست لك.

definitionEn: a deep hole or holes under the ground where minerals such as coal, gold, etc. are dug
example: The miners worked deep inside the coal mine.
exampleAr: عمل عمال المناجم في أعماق منجم الفحم.

definitionEn: a person who works in a mine taking out coal, gold, diamonds, etc.
example: The miner worked underground for eight hours a day.
exampleAr: عمل عامل المنجم تحت الأرض ثماني ساعات يوميًا.

definitionEn: a substance that is naturally present in the earth and is not formed from animal or vegetable matter, for example gold and salt. Some minerals are also present in food and drink and in the human body and are essential for good health.
example: The rock contains several valuable minerals.
exampleAr: تحتوي الصخرة على عدة معادن ثمينة.

definitionEn: very small in size or amount; as small as possible
example: The damage from the storm was minimal.
exampleAr: كانت الأضرار الناجمة عن العاصفة طفيفة.

definitionEn: to reduce something, especially something bad, to the lowest possible level
example: We need to minimize the risk of infection.
exampleAr: يجب أن نقلل من خطر العدوى إلى أدنى حد.

definitionEn: the smallest that is possible or allowed; extremely small
example: The minimum age to vote is eighteen.
exampleAr: الحد الأدنى لسن التصويت ثمانية عشر عامًا.

definitionEn: the smallest or lowest amount that is possible, required or recorded
example: You need a minimum of five years' experience.
exampleAr: تحتاج إلى خبرة لا تقل عن خمس سنوات.

definitionEn: the process of getting coal and other minerals from under the ground; the industry involved in this
example: The region's economy depends on coal mining.
exampleAr: يعتمد اقتصاد المنطقة على تعدين الفحم.

definitionEn: a senior member of the government who is in charge of a government department or a branch of one
example: She was appointed as the new foreign minister.
exampleAr: عُيّنت وزيرة جديدة للخارجية.

definitionEn: a government department that has a particular area of responsibility
example: He works at the Ministry of Education.
exampleAr: يعمل في وزارة التعليم.

definitionEn: not very large, important or serious
example: She suffered only minor injuries in the accident.
exampleAr: أُصيبت بجروح بسيطة فقط في الحادث.

definitionEn: not very large, important or serious
example: It's illegal to sell alcohol to a minor.
exampleAr: بيع الكحول لقاصر غير قانوني.

definitionEn: the smaller part of a group; less than half of the people or things in a large group
example: The policy aims to protect the rights of ethnic minorities.
exampleAr: تهدف السياسة إلى حماية حقوق الأقليات العرقية.

definitionEn: each of the 60 parts of an hour, that are equal to 60 seconds
example: Wait a minute, I'll be right there.
exampleAr: انتظر دقيقة، سأصل حالًا.

definitionEn: extremely small
example: The differences between the two versions are minute.
exampleAr: الفروق بين النسختين ضئيلة جدًا.

definitionEn: an act or event that does not follow the laws of nature and is believed to be caused by God
example: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the crash.
exampleAr: كان معجزة ألا يُصاب أحد في الحادث.

definitionEn: a piece of special flat glass that reflects images, so that you can see yourself when you look in it
example: She looked at herself in the mirror.
exampleAr: نظرت إلى نفسها في المرآة.

definitionEn: a piece of special flat glass that reflects images, so that you can see yourself when you look in it
example: His novels mirror his own life experiences.
exampleAr: تعكس رواياته تجاربه الحياتية الخاصة.

definitionEn: very unhappy or uncomfortable
example: He felt miserable after losing his job.
exampleAr: شعر بالبؤس بعد فقدان وظيفته.

definitionEn: great physical or mental pain
example: The war brought years of misery to the region.
exampleAr: جلبت الحرب سنوات من البؤس للمنطقة.

definitionEn: giving the wrong idea or impression and making you believe something that is not true
example: The advertisement was misleading about the product's price.
exampleAr: كان الإعلان مضللًا بشأن سعر المنتج.

definitionEn: to be or arrive too late for something
example: She missed the bus this morning.
exampleAr: فاتها الباص هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: to be or arrive too late for something
example: That was a close miss on the highway.
exampleAr: كانت تلك حادثة كادت أن تقع على الطريق السريع.

definitionEn: a weapon that is sent through the air and that explodes when it hits the thing that it is aimed at
example: The military tested a new missile system.
exampleAr: اختبر الجيش منظومة صواريخ جديدة.

definitionEn: that cannot be found or that is not in its usual place; that has been removed, lost or destroyed
example: Police are searching for the missing child.
exampleAr: تبحث الشرطة عن الطفل المفقود.

definitionEn: that cannot exist or be done; not possible
example: Their mission is to provide clean water to remote villages.
exampleAr: مهمتهم توفير المياه النظيفة للقرى النائية.

definitionEn: an action or an opinion that is not correct, or that produces a result that you did not want
example: She made a small mistake in her calculations.
exampleAr: ارتكبت خطأً صغيرًا في حساباتها.

definitionEn: to not understand or judge somebody/something correctly
example: I mistook him for his older brother.
exampleAr: ظننته خطأً أخاه الأكبر.

definitionEn: if two or more substances or things mix or you mix them, they combine, usually in a way that means they cannot easily be separated
example: Mix the flour and sugar together in a bowl.
exampleAr: اخلط الدقيق والسكر معًا في وعاء.

definitionEn: a combination of different people or things
example: The soundtrack is a mix of jazz and classical music.
exampleAr: الموسيقى التصويرية مزيج من الجاز والموسيقى الكلاسيكية.

definitionEn: consisting of different qualities or elements
example: She got mixed reactions to her new hairstyle.
exampleAr: لاقت ردود فعل متباينة على تسريحة شعرها الجديدة.

definitionEn: a combination of different things
example: Pour the mixture into a baking pan.
exampleAr: اسكب الخليط في صينية الخبز.

definitionEn: a large crowd of people, especially one that may become violent or cause trouble
example: An angry mob gathered outside the courthouse.
exampleAr: تجمع حشد غاضب خارج المحكمة.

definitionEn: connected with mobile phones, tablets, etc.
example: She's fully mobile again after her surgery.
exampleAr: أصبحت قادرة على الحركة بشكل كامل مجددًا بعد جراحتها.

definitionEn: a mobile phone
example: Can I borrow your mobile for a second?
exampleAr: هل يمكنني استعارة هاتفك المحمول للحظة؟

definitionEn: the ability to move easily from one place, social class or job to another
example: The injury affected her mobility for months.
exampleAr: أثرت الإصابة في قدرتها على الحركة لأشهر.

definitionEn: to work together in order to achieve a particular aim; to organize a group of people to do this
example: The government mobilized troops to the border.
exampleAr: عبأت الحكومة قوات إلى الحدود.

definitionEn: a particular way of doing something; a particular type of something
example: Switch the phone to silent mode during the meeting.
exampleAr: بدّل وضع الهاتف إلى الوضع الصامت أثناء الاجتماع.

definitionEn: a copy of something, usually smaller than the original object
example: The scientists built a model to predict climate change.
exampleAr: بنى العلماء نموذجًا للتنبؤ بتغير المناخ.

definitionEn: to create a copy or description of an activity, a situation, etc. so that you can study it before dealing with the real thing
example: She models for several fashion brands.
exampleAr: تعرض أزياء لعدة ماركات.

definitionEn: that is neither very good, large, hot, etc. nor very bad, small, cold, etc.
example: He holds fairly moderate political views.
exampleAr: يتبنى آراءً سياسية معتدلة إلى حد كبير.

definitionEn: that is neither very good, large, hot, etc. nor very bad, small, cold, etc.
example: She moderated the panel discussion at the conference.
exampleAr: أدارت حلقة النقاش في المؤتمر.

definitionEn: of the present time or recent times
example: They live in a modern apartment downtown.
exampleAr: يعيشون في شقة حديثة وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: not very large, expensive, important, etc.
example: Despite his fame, he remained modest.
exampleAr: رغم شهرته، ظل متواضعًا.

definitionEn: the act or process of changing something in order to improve it or make it more acceptable; a change that is made
example: The car underwent several modifications before the race.
exampleAr: خضعت السيارة لعدة تعديلات قبل السباق.

definitionEn: to change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose
example: They modified the design to reduce costs.
exampleAr: عدّلوا التصميم لخفض التكاليف.

definitionEn: a very short period of time
example: Wait a moment, I'll be right back.
exampleAr: انتظر لحظة، سأعود حالًا.

definitionEn: the ability to keep increasing or developing
example: The campaign gained momentum after the debate.
exampleAr: اكتسبت الحملة زخمًا بعد المناظرة.

definitionEn: the day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday, the first day of the working week
example: We have a meeting scheduled for Monday morning.
exampleAr: لدينا اجتماع مقرر صباح الاثنين.

definitionEn: what you earn by working or selling things, and use to buy things
example: She saved enough money to buy a car.
exampleAr: ادخرت ما يكفي من المال لشراء سيارة.

definitionEn: to watch and check something over a period of time in order to see how it develops, so that you can make any necessary changes
example: Doctors monitored his heart rate closely.
exampleAr: راقب الأطباء معدل ضربات قلبه عن كثب.

definitionEn: a screen that shows information from a computer; a television screen used to show particular kinds of information
example: She bought a new computer monitor.
exampleAr: اشترت شاشة حاسوب جديدة.

definitionEn: a member of a religious group of men who often live apart from other people in a monastery and who do not marry or have personal possessions
example: The monks lived a quiet life in the monastery.
exampleAr: عاش الرهبان حياة هادئة في الدير.

definitionEn: an animal with a long tail, that climbs trees and lives in hot countries. There are several types of monkey and they are related to apes and humans.
example: The monkeys swung from tree to tree in the jungle.
exampleAr: تأرجحت القرود من شجرة إلى أخرى في الغابة.

definitionEn: the complete control of trade in particular goods or the supply of a particular service; a type of goods or a service that is controlled in this way
example: The company has a monopoly on the region's electricity supply.
exampleAr: تحتكر الشركة إمدادات الكهرباء في المنطقة.

definitionEn: (in stories) an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly and frightening
example: The children were scared of the monster in the story.
exampleAr: خاف الأطفال من الوحش في القصة.

definitionEn: any of the twelve periods of time into which the year is divided, for example May or June
example: She's been working here for six months.
exampleAr: تعمل هنا منذ ستة أشهر.

definitionEn: happening once a month or every month
example: They pay a monthly rent of eight hundred dollars.
exampleAr: يدفعون إيجارًا شهريًا قدره ثمانمئة دولار.

definitionEn: a building, column, statue, etc. built to remind people of a famous person or event
example: The monument was built to honor fallen soldiers.
exampleAr: بُني النصب تكريمًا للجنود الذين سقطوا.

definitionEn: the way you are feeling at a particular time
example: She's been in a bad mood all day.
exampleAr: كانت في مزاج سيئ طوال اليوم.

definitionEn: the round object that moves around the earth once every 27½ days and shines at night by light reflected from the sun
example: The moon was full and bright last night.
exampleAr: كان القمر بدرًا ومضيئًا الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: connected with principles of right and wrong behaviour
example: It's a moral obligation to help those in need.
exampleAr: مساعدة المحتاجين واجب أخلاقي.

definitionEn: standards or principles of good behaviour, especially in matters of sexual relationships
example: The moral of the story is to always be honest.
exampleAr: عبرة القصة أن نكون صادقين دائمًا.

definitionEn: principles relating to right and wrong or good and bad behaviour
example: The play raises questions about morality and justice.
exampleAr: تثير المسرحية تساؤلات حول الأخلاق والعدالة.

definitionEn: a larger number or amount of
example: She needs more time to finish the report.
exampleAr: تحتاج إلى مزيد من الوقت لإنهاء التقرير.

definitionEn: used to introduce some new information that adds to or supports what you have said previously
example: The plan is expensive; moreover, it's unlikely to work.
exampleAr: الخطة مكلفة؛ علاوة على ذلك، من غير المرجح أن تنجح.

definitionEn: the early part of the day from the time when people wake up until 12 o'clock in the middle of the day or before lunch
example: She goes jogging every morning.
exampleAr: تمارس الجري كل صباح.

definitionEn: a legal agreement by which a bank or similar organization lends you money to buy a house, etc., and you pay the money back over a particular number of years; the sum of money that you borrow
example: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home.
exampleAr: حصلا على قرض عقاري لشراء منزلهما الأول.

definitionEn: a building where Muslims go to worship (= praise God)
example: They pray at the local mosque every Friday.
exampleAr: يصلون في المسجد المحلي كل جمعة.

definitionEn: the largest in number or amount
example: Most people agreed with the new policy.
exampleAr: وافق معظم الناس على السياسة الجديدة.

definitionEn: used to form the superlative of most adjectives and adverbs of two or more syllables
example: This is the most beautiful place I've ever seen.
exampleAr: هذا أجمل مكان رأيته في حياتي.

definitionEn: mainly; generally
example: The audience was mostly made up of students.
exampleAr: كان الجمهور مكونًا في الغالب من الطلاب.

definitionEn: a female parent of a child or animal; a person who is acting as a mother to a child
example: Her mother raised five children alone.
exampleAr: ربّت والدتها خمسة أطفال بمفردها.

definitionEn: the act or process of moving or the way something moves
example: The sensor detects motion in the room.
exampleAr: يكتشف المستشعر الحركة في الغرفة.

definitionEn: to be the reason why somebody does something or behaves in a particular way
example: Her coach motivated her to keep training.
exampleAr: حفّزها مدربها على مواصلة التدريب.

definitionEn: the reason why somebody does something or behaves in a particular way
example: He lacks the motivation to finish the project.
exampleAr: يفتقر إلى الدافع لإنهاء المشروع.

definitionEn: a reason for doing something
example: Police are still searching for a motive for the crime.
exampleAr: لا تزال الشرطة تبحث عن دافع للجريمة.

definitionEn: a device that uses electricity, petrol, etc. to produce movement and makes a machine, a vehicle, a boat, etc. work
example: The washing machine's motor burned out.
exampleAr: احترق محرك الغسالة.

definitionEn: a road vehicle with two wheels, driven by an engine, with one seat for the driver and often a seat for a passenger behind the driver
example: He rides his motorcycle to work every day.
exampleAr: يركب دراجته النارية إلى العمل كل يوم.

definitionEn: a person driving a car
example: Motorists were advised to avoid the flooded road.
exampleAr: نُصح سائقو السيارات بتجنب الطريق المغمور بالمياه.

definitionEn: to organize and begin something
example: She mounted her horse and rode off.
exampleAr: امتطت حصانها وانطلقت.

definitionEn: a very high hill, often with rocks near the top
example: They hiked to the top of the mountain.
exampleAr: تسلقوا إلى قمة الجبل.

definitionEn: a small animal that is covered in fur and has a long thin tail. Mice live in fields, in people’s houses or where food is stored.
example: A mouse ran across the kitchen floor.
exampleAr: جرى فأر عبر أرضية المطبخ.

definitionEn: the opening in the face used for speaking, eating, etc.; the area inside the head behind this opening
example: He covered his mouth when he coughed.
exampleAr: غطى فمه عندما سعل.

definitionEn: to change position or make somebody/something change position in a way that can be seen, heard or felt
example: Don't move, stay right there.
exampleAr: لا تتحرك، ابقَ مكانك.

definitionEn: a change of place or position
example: Getting a new job was a smart move.
exampleAr: كان الحصول على وظيفة جديدة خطوة ذكية.

meaningAr: حركة جسدية / حركة سياسية أو اجتماعية
definitionEn: an act of moving the body or part of the body
example: The dancer's movements were graceful.
exampleAr: كانت حركات الراقصة رشيقة.

definitionEn: a series of moving pictures recorded with sound that tells a story, watched at a movie theater or on a television or other device
example: They watched a movie at home last night.
exampleAr: شاهدا فيلمًا في المنزل الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: causing strong, often sad, feelings about somebody/something
example: It was a moving speech about loss and recovery.
exampleAr: كان خطابًا مؤثرًا عن الفقد والتعافي.

definitionEn: used with uncountable nouns, especially in negative sentences to mean ‘a large amount of something’, or after ‘how’ to ask about the amount of something. It is also used with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: There isn't much time left before the deadline.
exampleAr: لم يتبقَّ وقت كثير قبل الموعد النهائي.

definitionEn: to a great degree
example: She feels much better today.
exampleAr: تشعر بتحسن كبير اليوم.

definitionEn: wet earth that is soft and sticky
example: Their boots were covered in mud after the hike.
exampleAr: كانت أحذيتهم مغطاة بالطين بعد رحلة المشي.

definitionEn: many in number; involving many different people or things
example: She has multiple degrees in different fields.
exampleAr: لديها شهادات متعددة في مجالات مختلفة.

definitionEn: to add a number to itself a particular number of times
example: Multiply six by seven to get the answer.
exampleAr: اضرب ستة في سبعة للحصول على الناتج.

definitionEn: a mother
example: My mum picked me up from school.
exampleAr: أقلتني أمي من المدرسة.

definitionEn: connected with or belonging to a town, city or district that has its own local government
example: The municipal government manages waste collection.
exampleAr: تدير الحكومة البلدية جمع النفايات.

definitionEn: the crime of killing somebody deliberately
example: The police are investigating a murder case.
exampleAr: تحقق الشرطة في قضية جريمة قتل.

definitionEn: to kill somebody deliberately and illegally
example: He was accused of murdering his business partner.
exampleAr: اتُهم بقتل شريكه التجاري.

definitionEn: a piece of body tissue that you make tight and relax in order to move a particular part of the body; the tissue that forms the muscles of the body
example: Regular exercise helps build muscle.
exampleAr: تساعد التمارين المنتظمة على بناء العضلات.

definitionEn: a building in which objects of artistic, cultural, historical or scientific interest are kept and shown to the public
example: They spent the afternoon at the art museum.
exampleAr: قضيا فترة بعد الظهر في متحف الفنون.

definitionEn: sounds that are arranged in a way that is pleasant or exciting to listen to. People sing music or play it on instruments.
example: She listens to classical music while studying.
exampleAr: تستمع إلى الموسيقى الكلاسيكية أثناء الدراسة.

definitionEn: connected with music; containing music
example: He has a lot of musical talent.
exampleAr: لديه موهبة موسيقية كبيرة.

definitionEn: a play or film in which part or all of the story is told using songs and often dancing
example: We saw a musical on Broadway last night.
exampleAr: شاهدنا مسرحية غنائية في برودواي الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: a person who plays a musical instrument or writes music, especially as a job
example: She's a talented musician who plays the cello.
exampleAr: هي موسيقية موهوبة تعزف على التشيلو.

definitionEn: used to say that something is necessary or very important (sometimes involving a rule or a law)
example: You must wear a seatbelt in the car.
exampleAr: يجب أن ترتدي حزام الأمان في السيارة.

definitionEn: used to describe feelings that two or more people have for each other equally, or actions that affect two or more people equally
example: They have a mutual respect for each other.
exampleAr: يكنّان احترامًا متبادلًا لبعضهما.

definitionEn: of or belonging to the speaker or writer
example: This is my favorite book.
exampleAr: هذا كتابي المفضل.

definitionEn: used when the speaker or writer is also the person affected by an action
example: I made this cake myself.
exampleAr: صنعت هذه الكعكة بنفسي.

definitionEn: difficult to understand or explain; strange
example: There's something mysterious about that old house.
exampleAr: هناك شيء غامض في ذلك المنزل القديم.

definitionEn: something that is difficult to understand or to explain
example: The disappearance remains a mystery to this day.
exampleAr: لا يزال الاختفاء لغزًا حتى يومنا هذا.

definitionEn: a story from ancient times, especially one that was told to explain natural events or to describe the early history of a people; this type of story
example: According to Greek myth, Zeus ruled the gods.
exampleAr: وفقًا للأساطير اليونانية، حكم زيوس الآلهة.

definitionEn: the thin hard layer covering the outer tip of the fingers or toes
example: She painted her nails bright red.
exampleAr: طلت أظافرها باللون الأحمر الزاهي.

definitionEn: not wearing any clothes
example: The statue depicts a naked figure.
exampleAr: يصور التمثال شخصية عارية.

definitionEn: a word or words that a particular person, animal, place or thing is known by
example: What's your name?
exampleAr: ما اسمك؟

definitionEn: to give a name to somebody/something
example: They named their daughter after her grandmother.
exampleAr: سمّوا ابنتهم على اسم جدتها.

definitionEn: used to introduce more exact and detailed information about something that you have just mentioned
example: Two countries refused to sign, namely France and Germany.
exampleAr: رفضت دولتان التوقيع، وهما فرنسا وألمانيا.

definitionEn: a description of events
example: The film has a complex narrative structure.
exampleAr: يتميز الفيلم ببنية سردية معقدة.

definitionEn: measuring a short distance from one side to the other, especially in relation to length
example: They walked down a narrow alley.
exampleAr: ساروا في زقاق ضيق.

definitionEn: to become or make something less wide
example: They narrowed the list down to three candidates.
exampleAr: قلّصوا القائمة إلى ثلاثة مرشحين.

definitionEn: very bad or unpleasant
example: The medicine has a nasty taste.
exampleAr: للدواء طعم كريه.

definitionEn: a country considered as a group of people with the same language, culture and history, who live in a particular area under one government
example: The nation celebrated fifty years of independence.
exampleAr: احتفلت الأمة بمرور خمسين عامًا على الاستقلال.

definitionEn: connected with a particular nation; shared by a whole nation
example: The story made national news.
exampleAr: تصدرت القصة الأخبار الوطنية.

definitionEn: happening or existing in all parts of a particular country
example: The company launched a nationwide advertising campaign.
exampleAr: أطلقت الشركة حملة إعلانية على مستوى البلاد.

definitionEn: connected with the place where you were born and lived for the first years of your life
example: English is her native language.
exampleAr: الإنجليزية هي لغتها الأم.

definitionEn: a person who was born in a particular country or area
example: He's a native of New York.
exampleAr: هو من مواليد نيويورك الأصليين.

definitionEn: existing in nature; not made or caused by humans
example: Olive oil is a natural remedy for dry skin.
exampleAr: زيت الزيتون علاج طبيعي للبشرة الجافة.

definitionEn: in a way that you would expect
example: Naturally, she was upset about the news.
exampleAr: بطبيعة الحال، شعرت بالانزعاج من الخبر.

definitionEn: all the plants, animals and things that exist in the universe that are not made by people
example: She loves spending time in nature.
exampleAr: تحب قضاء الوقت في الطبيعة.

definitionEn: connected with the navy of a country
example: The country has a strong naval fleet.
exampleAr: تمتلك الدولة أسطولًا بحريًا قويًا.

definitionEn: the skill or the process of planning a route for a ship or other vehicle and taking it there
example: The ship's navigation system failed during the storm.
exampleAr: تعطل نظام الملاحة في السفينة أثناء العاصفة.

definitionEn: at a short distance away from somebody/something
example: The hotel is near the airport.
exampleAr: يقع الفندق بالقرب من المطار.

definitionEn: a short distance away
example: We should hear back in the near future.
exampleAr: من المفترض أن نتلقى ردًا في المستقبل القريب.

definitionEn: near in position; not far away
example: They stayed at a nearby hotel.
exampleAr: أقاما في فندق قريب.

definitionEn: a short distance from somebody/something; not far away
example: A dog was barking nearby.
exampleAr: كان كلب ينبح في مكان قريب.

definitionEn: almost; not quite; not completely
example: She's nearly finished with her homework.
exampleAr: أوشكت على الانتهاء من واجبها المدرسي.

definitionEn: tidy and in order; carefully done or arranged
example: His handwriting is very neat.
exampleAr: خط يده مرتب جدًا.

definitionEn: used to say that something cannot be avoided
example: Being rich doesn't necessarily mean being happy.
exampleAr: أن تكون ثريًا لا يعني بالضرورة أن تكون سعيدًا.

definitionEn: that is needed for a purpose or a reason
example: It's necessary to book in advance.
exampleAr: من الضروري الحجز مسبقًا.

definitionEn: the fact that something must happen or be done; the need for something
example: Clean water is a basic necessity.
exampleAr: المياه النظيفة ضرورة أساسية.

definitionEn: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders
example: She wore a scarf around her neck.
exampleAr: ارتدت وشاحًا حول رقبتها.

definitionEn: to require something/somebody because they are essential or very important, not just because you would like to have them
example: You need to rest after the surgery.
exampleAr: تحتاج إلى الراحة بعد الجراحة.

definitionEn: a situation when something is necessary or must be done
example: There's an urgent need for more doctors in rural areas.
exampleAr: هناك حاجة ملحة إلى مزيد من الأطباء في المناطق الريفية.

definitionEn: a small thin piece of steel that you use for sewing, with a point at one end and a hole for the thread at the other
example: The nurse used a needle to give the injection.
exampleAr: استخدمت الممرضة إبرة لإعطاء الحقنة.

definitionEn: bad or harmful
example: He always has a negative attitude toward change.
exampleAr: لديه دائمًا موقف سلبي تجاه التغيير.

definitionEn: to fail to take care of somebody/something
example: He neglected his health while working long hours.
exampleAr: أهمل صحته أثناء العمل لساعات طويلة.

definitionEn: the fact of not giving enough care or attention to something/somebody; the state of not receiving enough care or attention
example: The old building suffered years of neglect.
exampleAr: عانى المبنى القديم من سنوات من الإهمال.

definitionEn: having or showing fine personal qualities that people admire, such as courage, honesty and care for others

definitionEn: if you nod, nod your head or your head nods, you move your head up and down to show agreement, understanding, etc.

definitionEn: a person who is in a position of authority in a large organization
example: Government officials met to discuss the crisis.
exampleAr: اجتمع مسؤولون حكوميون لمناقشة الأزمة.

definitionEn: a child of a particular person or couple
example: The offspring inherited traits from both parents.
exampleAr: ورث النسل صفات من كلا الوالدين.

definitionEn: many times
example: I often go for a walk after dinner.
exampleAr: غالبًا ما أذهب في نزهة بعد العشاء.

definitionEn: used when you are reacting to something that has been said, especially if you did not know it before
example: Oh! I didn't see you there.
exampleAr: آه! لم أرك هناك.

definitionEn: a thick liquid that is found in rock underground
example: She cooked the vegetables in olive oil.
exampleAr: طهت الخضروات بزيت الزيتون.

definitionEn: safe and well; in a calm or happy state
example: The food was OK, nothing special.
exampleAr: كان الطعام مقبولًا، لا شيء مميز.

definitionEn: safe and well; in a calm or happy state
example: OK, let's get started.
exampleAr: حسنًا، لنبدأ.

meaningAr: كبير في السن، عجوز / قديم (شيء) / سابق (former)
definitionEn: of a particular age
example: My grandfather is quite old now.
exampleAr: جدي كبير في السن جدًا الآن.

definitionEn: not modern; no longer fashionable
example: He has quite old-fashioned views about marriage.
exampleAr: لديه آراء قديمة الطراز جدًا عن الزواج.

meaningAr: على (فوق سطح) / في (تاريخ أو يوم) / عن (موضوع)
definitionEn: in or into a position covering, touching or forming part of a surface
example: The book is on the table.
exampleAr: الكتاب على الطاولة.

definitionEn: on somebody’s body; being worn
example: Please leave the lights on when you go.
exampleAr: من فضلك، اترك الأنوار مضاءة عندما تغادر.

meaningAr: مرة واحدة / سابقًا، في وقت من الأوقات
definitionEn: on one occasion only; one time
example: I've only been there once.
exampleAr: لم أذهب إلى هناك سوى مرة واحدة.

definitionEn: as soon as; when
example: Once you finish, let me know.
exampleAr: بمجرد أن تنتهي، أخبرني.

definitionEn: the number 1
example: I only need one more minute.
exampleAr: لا أحتاج إلا إلى دقيقة واحدة أخرى.

definitionEn: used to avoid repeating a noun, when you are referring to somebody/something that has already been mentioned, or that the person you are speaking to knows about
example: One should always be polite to strangers.
exampleAr: ينبغي على المرء أن يكون مهذبًا دائمًا مع الغرباء.

definitionEn: continuing to exist or develop
example: The investigation into the fire is still ongoing.
exampleAr: لا يزال التحقيق في الحريق جاريًا.

definitionEn: a round vegetable with many layers inside each other and a brown, red or white skin. Onions have a strong smell and taste.
example: Chop one onion finely for the sauce.
exampleAr: قطّع بصلة واحدة ناعمًا للصلصة.

definitionEn: available on or done using the internet or other computer network
example: She's taking an online course this semester.
exampleAr: تلتحق بدورة إلكترونية هذا الفصل الدراسي.

definitionEn: onto the internet; using the internet or other computer network
example: I bought these shoes online last week.
exampleAr: اشتريت هذا الحذاء عبر الإنترنت الأسبوع الماضي.

definitionEn: nobody or nothing except
example: I only have five dollars left.
exampleAr: لم يتبقَّ معي سوى خمسة دولارات فقط.

definitionEn: used to say that no other or others of the same group exist or are there
example: She is an only child.
exampleAr: هي الابنة الوحيدة لوالديها.

definitionEn: used to say that no other or others of the same group exist or are there
example: I would go, only I have no time today.
exampleAr: كنت سأذهب، إلا أنني لا أملك وقتًا اليوم.

definitionEn: used with verbs to express movement on or to a particular place or position
example: The cat jumped onto the kitchen table.
exampleAr: قفزت القطة على طاولة المطبخ.

definitionEn: allowing things or people to go through; not closed or blocked
example: Please keep the door open.
exampleAr: من فضلك، أبقِ الباب مفتوحًا.

definitionEn: to move a door, window, lid, etc. into a position that is no longer closed; to get into this position
example: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
exampleAr: فتحت النافذة لإدخال الهواء النقي.

definitionEn: a space or hole that somebody/something can pass through
example: The store's grand opening is next week.
exampleAr: الافتتاح الكبير للمتجر الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: without hiding any feelings, opinions or information
example: He spoke openly about his past mistakes.
exampleAr: تحدث علنًا عن أخطائه السابقة.

definitionEn: a dramatic work in which all or most of the words are sung to music; works of this type as an art form or entertainment
example: We watched an opera at the Royal House last night.
exampleAr: شاهدنا أوبرا في دار الأوبرا الملكية الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: to work in a particular way
example: She learned to operate the new machine quickly.
exampleAr: تعلّمت تشغيل الآلة الجديدة بسرعة.

meaningAr: عملية (عسكرية أو تجارية)، تشغيل / عملية جراحية
definitionEn: the process of cutting open a part of a person’s body in order to remove or repair a damaged part
example: The rescue operation lasted three days.
exampleAr: استمرت عملية الإنقاذ ثلاثة أيام.

definitionEn: connected with the way in which a business, machine, system, etc. works
example: The new factory will be fully operational by June.
exampleAr: سيكون المصنع الجديد جاهزًا للعمل بالكامل بحلول يونيو.

meaningAr: عامل تشغيل، موظف مقسم هاتف / شركة مشغّلة
definitionEn: a person who operates equipment or a machine
example: She works as a telephone operator.
exampleAr: تعمل كعاملة في مقسم الهاتف.

definitionEn: your feelings or thoughts about somebody/something, rather than a fact
example: In my opinion, the movie was excellent.
exampleAr: في رأيي، كان الفيلم رائعًا.

definitionEn: a person that you are playing or fighting against in a game, competition, argument, etc.
example: She defeated her opponent in the final round.
exampleAr: هزمت خصمها في الجولة النهائية.

definitionEn: a time when a particular situation makes it possible to do or achieve something
example: This job is a great opportunity for her career.
exampleAr: هذه الوظيفة فرصة رائعة لمسيرتها المهنية.

definitionEn: to disagree strongly with somebody’s plan, policy, etc. and try to change it or prevent it from succeeding
example: Many voters oppose the new tax law.
exampleAr: يعارض كثير من الناخبين قانون الضريبة الجديد.

definitionEn: disagreeing strongly with something and trying to stop it
example: She is strongly opposed to the plan.
exampleAr: هي معارضة بشدة لهذه الخطة.

definitionEn: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something and usually facing them
example: They live on the opposite side of the street.
exampleAr: يعيشون في الجانب المقابل من الشارع.

definitionEn: a person or thing that is as different as possible from somebody/something else
example: Hot is the opposite of cold.
exampleAr: الساخن هو نقيض البارد.

definitionEn: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something, and usually facing them
example: The bank is opposite the post office.
exampleAr: يقع البنك مقابل مكتب البريد.

definitionEn: the act of strongly disagreeing with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening
example: The bill faced strong opposition in parliament.
exampleAr: واجه مشروع القانون معارضة قوية في البرلمان.

definitionEn: to choose to take or not to take a particular course of action
example: Many students opt to study abroad after graduation.
exampleAr: يختار كثير من الطلاب الدراسة في الخارج بعد التخرج.

definitionEn: connected with the sense of sight or the relationship between light and sight
example: It's just an optical illusion, not a real hole.
exampleAr: إنه مجرد خداع بصري، وليس حفرة حقيقية.

definitionEn: a feeling that good things will happen and that something will be successful
example: There's growing optimism about the economy.
exampleAr: هناك تفاؤل متزايد بشأن الاقتصاد.

definitionEn: expecting good things to happen or something to be successful; showing this feeling
example: She remains optimistic about her recovery.
exampleAr: لا تزال متفائلة بشأن تعافيها.

definitionEn: something that you can choose to have or do; the freedom to choose what you do
example: You have the option to pay monthly or yearly.
exampleAr: لديك خيار الدفع شهريًا أو سنويًا.

definitionEn: used to introduce another possibility
example: Would you like tea or coffee?
exampleAr: هل تفضل الشاي أم القهوة؟

definitionEn: spoken rather than written
example: Students must pass an oral exam.
exampleAr: يجب على الطلاب اجتياز امتحان شفهي.

definitionEn: a round citrus fruit with thick skin of a colour between red and yellow and a lot of sweet juice
example: She squeezed fresh orange juice for breakfast.
exampleAr: عصرت عصير البرتقال الطازج لتناول الإفطار.

definitionEn: between red and yellow in colour
example: She painted the wall a bright orange.
exampleAr: طلت الحائط بلون برتقالي زاهٍ.

definitionEn: a large group of people who play various musical instruments together, led by a conductor
example: The orchestra performed a symphony by Beethoven.
exampleAr: عزفت الأوركسترا سيمفونية لبيتهوفن.

definitionEn: the way in which people or things are placed or arranged in relation to each other
example: I placed an order for two pizzas.
exampleAr: قدّمت طلبية لشراء بيتزتين.

definitionEn: to ask for something to eat or drink in a restaurant, bar, etc.
example: We ordered pasta and salad for dinner.
exampleAr: طلبنا معكرونة وسلطة على العشاء.

definitionEn: not unusual or different in any way
example: It was just an ordinary day at work.
exampleAr: كان مجرد يوم عادي في العمل.

definitionEn: a part of the body that has a particular purpose, such as the heart or the brain; part of a plant with a particular purpose
example: The heart is a vital organ.
exampleAr: القلب عضو حيوي.

definitionEn: produced or practised without using artificial chemicals
example: They only buy organic vegetables and fruit.
exampleAr: لا يشترون سوى الخضروات والفواكه العضوية.

definitionEn: a group of people who form a business, club, etc. together in order to achieve a particular aim
example: She works for a non-profit organization.
exampleAr: تعمل في منظمة غير ربحية.

definitionEn: connected with the way in which the different parts of something are arranged; connected with an organization
example: The company went through major organizational changes.
exampleAr: مرّت الشركة بتغييرات تنظيمية كبيرة.

definitionEn: to make all the arrangements for something to happen or be provided
example: She organized the entire conference by herself.
exampleAr: نظّمت المؤتمر بأكمله بمفردها.

definitionEn: involving large numbers of people who work together to do something in a way that has been carefully planned
example: He's a very organized person who never loses anything.
exampleAr: إنه شخص منظّم جدًا ولا يفقد أي شيء أبدًا.

definitionEn: a person who makes the arrangements for something
example: The event organizer handled all the logistics.
exampleAr: تولّى منظّم الفعالية جميع الجوانب اللوجستية.

definitionEn: a person’s basic beliefs or feelings about a particular subject
example: New employees attend an orientation session on their first day.
exampleAr: يحضر الموظفون الجدد جلسة توجيهية في يومهم الأول.

definitionEn: the point from which something starts; the cause of something
example: The word has its origin in Latin.
exampleAr: أصل الكلمة يعود إلى اللاتينية.

definitionEn: existing at the beginning of a particular period, process or activity
example: This is the original painting, not a copy.
exampleAr: هذه هي اللوحة الأصلية، وليست نسخة.

definitionEn: a document, work of art, etc. produced for the first time, from which copies are later made
example: Keep the original and give them a copy.
exampleAr: احتفظ بالنسخة الأصلية وأعطهم نسخة.

definitionEn: used to describe the situation that existed at the beginning of a particular period or activity, especially before something was changed
example: The house was originally built in 1920.
exampleAr: بُني المنزل في الأصل عام 1920.

definitionEn: to happen or appear for the first time in a particular place or situation
example: The tradition originated in ancient China.
exampleAr: نشأ هذا التقليد في الصين القديمة.

definitionEn: used to refer to people or things that are additional or different to people or things that have been mentioned or are known about
example: Do you have any other questions?
exampleAr: هل لديك أي أسئلة أخرى؟

definitionEn: used to refer to people or things that are additional or different to people or things that have been mentioned or are known about
example: Some like tea, while others prefer coffee.
exampleAr: يحب بعضهم الشاي، بينما يفضّل آخرون القهوة.

definitionEn: used to state what the result would be if something did not happen or if the situation were different
example: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the train.
exampleAr: أسرع، وإلا سنفوّت القطار.

definitionEn: used to say what is the right thing to do
example: You ought to apologize to her.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تعتذر لها.

definitionEn: belonging to us; connected with us
example: This is our house.
exampleAr: هذا بيتنا.

definitionEn: the one or ones that belong to us
example: That car is ours, not theirs.
exampleAr: تلك السيارة ملكنا، وليست ملكهم.

definitionEn: the reflexive form of we; used when you and another person or other people together cause and are affected by an action
example: We did it all by ourselves.
exampleAr: قمنا بكل ذلك بأنفسنا.

meaningAr: خارج / منطفئ (نار أو ضوء) / علنًا، معروف (مكشوف)
definitionEn: away from the inside of a place or thing
example: She went out for a walk.
exampleAr: خرجت للتنزّه.

definitionEn: away from the inside of a place or thing
example: He looked out the window.
exampleAr: نظر من النافذة.

definitionEn: the sudden start of something unpleasant, especially violence or a disease
example: There was an outbreak of the flu last winter.
exampleAr: تفشّى مرض الإنفلونزا في الشتاء الماضي.

definitionEn: the result or effect of an action or event
example: We're waiting for the outcome of the negotiations.
exampleAr: ننتظر نتيجة المفاوضات.

definitionEn: used, happening or located outside rather than in a building
example: They enjoy outdoor activities like hiking.
exampleAr: يستمتعون بالأنشطة الخارجية مثل المشي لمسافات طويلة.

definitionEn: outside, rather than in a building
example: The children love playing outdoors.
exampleAr: يحب الأطفال اللعب في الهواء الطلق.

definitionEn: outside, rather than in a building
example: He loves spending time in the great outdoors.
exampleAr: يحب قضاء الوقت في أحضان الطبيعة.

definitionEn: on the outside of something
example: The outer layer of the jacket is waterproof.
exampleAr: الطبقة الخارجية للسترة مقاومة للماء.

definitionEn: a set of clothes that you wear together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose
example: She wore a stylish outfit to the party.
exampleAr: ارتدت زيًا أنيقًا إلى الحفلة.

definitionEn: a trip that you go on for pleasure or education, usually with a group of people and lasting no more than one day
example: The class went on a school outing to the museum.
exampleAr: ذهب الصف في رحلة مدرسية إلى المتحف.

meaningAr: منفذ بيع، متجر / مأخذ كهرباء / متنفس (عاطفي)
definitionEn: a shop or an organization that sells goods made by a particular company or of a particular type
example: There's a factory outlet nearby that sells discounted clothes.
exampleAr: يوجد منفذ بيع مصنعي قريب يبيع ملابس بأسعار مخفّضة.

definitionEn: a description of the main facts or points involved in something
example: She wrote an outline before starting the essay.
exampleAr: كتبت مخططًا قبل أن تبدأ كتابة المقال.

definitionEn: to give a description of the main facts or points involved in something
example: The manager outlined the new plan to the team.
exampleAr: أوجز المدير الخطة الجديدة للفريق.

meaningAr: توقعات مستقبلية، نظرة عامة / نظرة، موقف من الحياة
definitionEn: the attitude to life and the world of a particular person, group or culture
example: The economic outlook for next year looks positive.
exampleAr: تبدو التوقعات الاقتصادية للعام المقبل إيجابية.

definitionEn: the amount of something that a person, a machine or an organization produces
example: The factory increased its output by 20 percent.
exampleAr: زاد المصنع إنتاجه بنسبة 20 بالمئة.

definitionEn: a strong feeling of shock and anger
example: The decision caused public outrage.
exampleAr: أثار القرار سخطًا عامًا.

definitionEn: to make somebody very shocked and angry
example: The news outraged the local community.
exampleAr: أثار الخبر غضبًا شديدًا لدى المجتمع المحلي.

definitionEn: on or to a place on the outside of something
example: Wait for me outside the building.
exampleAr: انتظرني خارج المبنى.

definitionEn: not in a room, building or container but on or to the outside of it
example: It's cold outside today.
exampleAr: الجو بارد بالخارج اليوم.

definitionEn: the outer side or surface of something
example: The outside of the house needs painting.
exampleAr: يحتاج السطح الخارجي للمنزل إلى طلاء.

definitionEn: a person who is not accepted as a member of a society, group, etc.
example: As a new employee, she still felt like an outsider.
exampleAr: بصفتها موظفة جديدة، كانت لا تزال تشعر بأنها غريبة.

definitionEn: extremely good; excellent
example: She received an award for her outstanding performance.
exampleAr: حصلت على جائزة لأدائها المتميز.

definitionEn: the part of a cooker that is like a box with a door on the front, in which food is cooked or heated
example: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.
exampleAr: سخّن الفرن مسبقًا إلى 200 درجة.

definitionEn: resting on the surface of somebody/something and partly or completely covering them/it
example: There's a bridge over the river.
exampleAr: هناك جسر فوق النهر.

meaningAr: منتهٍ، انتهى / مرة أخرى، من جديد
definitionEn: across a street, an open space, etc.
example: The game is over.
exampleAr: انتهت المباراة.

definitionEn: including all the things or people that are involved in a particular situation; general
example: The overall quality of the product is excellent.
exampleAr: الجودة العامة للمنتج ممتازة.

definitionEn: including everything or everyone; in total
example: Overall, the trip was a great success.
exampleAr: بشكل عام، كانت الرحلة نجاحًا كبيرًا.

definitionEn: to succeed in dealing with or controlling a problem that has been preventing you from achieving something
example: She overcame many obstacles to succeed.
exampleAr: تغلّبت على عقبات كثيرة لتحقق النجاح.

definitionEn: to fail to see or notice something
example: Don't overlook the small details in the contract.
exampleAr: لا تتجاهل التفاصيل الصغيرة في العقد.

definitionEn: too; very
example: He's overly cautious about everything.
exampleAr: إنه حذر بشكل مفرط في كل شيء.

definitionEn: during or for the night
example: Success didn't happen overnight.
exampleAr: لم يتحقق النجاح بين ليلة وضحاها.

definitionEn: during or for the night
example: We took an overnight train to Paris.
exampleAr: ركبنا قطارًا ليليًا إلى باريس.

definitionEn: to or in a foreign country, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean
example: She moved overseas for a new job.
exampleAr: انتقلت إلى الخارج من أجل وظيفة جديدة.

definitionEn: connected with foreign countries, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean
example: The company has several overseas offices.
exampleAr: لدى الشركة عدة مكاتب في الخارج.

definitionEn: to watch somebody/something and make sure that a job or an activity is done correctly
example: She oversees a team of twenty engineers.
exampleAr: تُشرف على فريق من عشرين مهندسًا.

definitionEn: if something overturns, or if somebody overturns it, it turns into a position in which the top of it is where the bottom of it normally is or on its side
example: The court overturned the previous verdict.
exampleAr: ألغت المحكمة الحكم السابق.

definitionEn: to have such a strong emotional effect on somebody that it is difficult for them to resist or know how to react
example: She felt overwhelmed by all the paperwork.
exampleAr: شعرت بأنها مثقلة بسبب كل تلك الأوراق.

definitionEn: very great or very strong; so powerful that you cannot resist it or decide how to react
example: There was overwhelming support for the proposal.
exampleAr: كان هناك دعم ساحق للاقتراح.

definitionEn: to have to pay somebody for something that you have already received or return money that you have borrowed
example: I still owe him fifty dollars.
exampleAr: ما زلت مدينًا له بخمسين دولارًا.

definitionEn: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: She has her own car now.
exampleAr: أصبح لديها سيارتها الخاصة الآن.

definitionEn: to have something that belongs to you, especially because you have bought it
example: They own a small house in the countryside.
exampleAr: يملكون منزلًا صغيرًا في الريف.

definitionEn: a person who owns something
example: Who is the owner of this restaurant?
exampleAr: من هو مالك هذا المطعم؟

definitionEn: the fact of owning something
example: The company changed ownership last year.
exampleAr: تغيّرت ملكية الشركة العام الماضي.

definitionEn: a chemical element. Oxygen is a gas that is present in air and water and is necessary for people, animals and plants to live.
example: Plants release oxygen into the air.
exampleAr: تطلق النباتات الأكسجين في الهواء.

definitionEn: the speed at which somebody/something walks, runs or moves
example: He walked at a slow pace along the beach.
exampleAr: مشى بوتيرة بطيئة على طول الشاطئ.

definitionEn: to walk up and down in a small area many times, especially because you are feeling nervous or angry
example: She paced nervously while waiting for the results.
exampleAr: مشت جيئة وذهابًا بعصبية وهي تنتظر النتائج.

definitionEn: to put clothes, etc. into a bag in preparation for a trip away from home
example: Don't forget to pack your passport.
exampleAr: لا تنسَ أن تحزم جواز سفرك.

definitionEn: a container, usually made of paper, that holds a number of the same thing or an amount of something, ready to be sold
example: He bought a pack of playing cards.
exampleAr: اشترى حزمة أوراق لعب.

definitionEn: something that is wrapped in paper or put into a thick envelope so that it can be sent by mail, carried easily, or given as a present
example: The package arrived two days late.
exampleAr: وصل الطرد متأخرًا يومين.

definitionEn: to put something into a box, bag, etc. to be sold or transported
example: The company packages its products in recyclable boxes.
exampleAr: تُغلّف الشركة منتجاتها في علب قابلة لإعادة التدوير.

definitionEn: a small container made of paper or card in which goods are packed for selling
example: She opened a packet of chips.
exampleAr: فتحت كيس رقائق البطاطس.

definitionEn: a thick piece of soft material that is used, for example, for cleaning or protecting something or for holding liquid
example: He jotted the number down on a notepad.
exampleAr: دوّن الرقم في دفتر ملاحظات.

definitionEn: a thick piece of soft material that is used, for example, for cleaning or protecting something or for holding liquid
example: The jacket is padded for extra warmth.
exampleAr: السترة محشوّة لمزيد من الدفء.

definitionEn: one side or both sides of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, etc.
example: Please turn to page ten.
exampleAr: يُرجى الانتقال إلى الصفحة العاشرة.

definitionEn: the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill
example: She felt a sharp pain in her back.
exampleAr: شعرت بألم حاد في ظهرها.

definitionEn: the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill
example: It pains me to see him so upset.
exampleAr: يؤلمني أن أراه منزعجًا إلى هذا الحد.

definitionEn: causing you pain
example: The injury was very painful.
exampleAr: كانت الإصابة مؤلمة جدًا.
