definitionEn: to vary between two particular amounts, sizes, etc., including others between them
example: Prices range from $10 to $50.
exampleAr: تتراوح الأسعار بين 10 و50 دولارًا.

definitionEn: the position, especially a high position, that somebody has in a particular organization, society, etc.
example: He rose to the rank of captain.
exampleAr: ترقّى إلى رتبة نقيب.

definitionEn: to give somebody/something a particular position on a scale according to quality, importance, success, etc.; to have a position of this kind
example: The university is ranked among the top ten.
exampleAr: تُصنَّف الجامعة ضمن أفضل عشر جامعات.

definitionEn: the position of somebody/something on a scale that shows how good or important they are in relation to other similar people or things, especially in sport
example: She improved her ranking after the tournament.
exampleAr: حسّنت تصنيفها بعد البطولة.

definitionEn: the crime of forcing somebody to have sex when they do not want it or are not able to agree to it
example: The crime of rape carries a severe legal sentence.
exampleAr: تحمل جريمة الاغتصاب عقوبة قانونية شديدة.

definitionEn: to force somebody to have sex when they do not want it or are not able to agree to it
example: He was charged with raping a woman.
exampleAr: اتُّهم باغتصاب امرأة.

definitionEn: happening quickly or in a short period of time
example: The city has seen rapid economic growth.
exampleAr: شهدت المدينة نموًا اقتصاديًا سريعًا.

definitionEn: very quickly; at a great rate
example: Technology is changing rapidly.
exampleAr: تتغير التكنولوجيا بسرعة.

definitionEn: not done, seen, happening, etc. very often
example: This is a rare species found only in this region.
exampleAr: هذا نوع نادر لا يوجد إلا في هذه المنطقة.

definitionEn: not very often
example: She rarely eats fast food.
exampleAr: نادرًا ما تتناول الوجبات السريعة.

definitionEn: a small animal with a long tail, that looks like a large mouse, usually considered a pest (= an animal which is disliked because it destroys food or spreads disease)
example: There's a rat living in the basement.
exampleAr: هناك جرذ يعيش في القبو.

definitionEn: a measurement of the speed at which something happens
example: The unemployment rate fell last month.
exampleAr: انخفض معدل البطالة الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: to have or think that somebody/something has a particular level of quality, value, etc.
example: Critics rated the film highly.
exampleAr: قيّم النقاد الفيلم تقييمًا عاليًا.

meaningAr: إلى حد ما، بالأحرى / بدلاً من ذلك (would rather)
definitionEn: used to mean ‘fairly’ or ‘to some degree’, often when you are disappointed, surprised or expressing slight criticism
example: It's rather cold today.
exampleAr: الجو بارد إلى حد ما اليوم.

definitionEn: a measurement of how good, popular, important, etc. somebody/something is, especially in relation to other people or things
example: The restaurant has a five-star rating.
exampleAr: يحمل المطعم تقييم خمس نجوم.

definitionEn: the relationship between two groups of people or things that is represented by two numbers showing how much larger one group is than the other
example: The ratio of students to teachers is quite low.
exampleAr: نسبة الطلاب إلى المعلمين منخفضة جدًا.

definitionEn: based on reason rather than emotions
example: Try to make a rational decision, not an emotional one.
exampleAr: حاول أن تتخذ قرارًا عقلانيًا لا عاطفيًا.

definitionEn: not cooked
example: She prefers to eat raw vegetables.
exampleAr: تفضّل أكل الخضروات النيئة.

definitionEn: a narrow line of light, heat or other energy
example: A ray of sunlight came through the window.
exampleAr: تسلل شعاع من ضوء الشمس عبر النافذة.

definitionEn: to arrive at the place that you have been travelling to
example: We should reach the airport by noon.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن نصل إلى المطار بحلول الظهر.

definitionEn: the distance over which you can stretch your arms to touch something; the distance over which a particular object can be used to touch something else
example: The remote control is within easy reach.
exampleAr: جهاز التحكم عن بُعد في المتناول بسهولة.

definitionEn: to change or behave in a particular way as a result of or in response to something
example: How did she react to the news?
exampleAr: كيف تفاعلت مع الخبر؟

definitionEn: what you do, say or think as a result of something that has happened
example: His reaction to the surprise party was priceless.
exampleAr: كان رد فعله على حفلة المفاجأة لا يُقدَّر بثمن.

definitionEn: to look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols
example: She reads a book every week.
exampleAr: تقرأ كتابًا كل أسبوع.

definitionEn: a person who reads, especially one who reads a lot or in a particular way
example: The magazine has millions of readers worldwide.
exampleAr: تحظى المجلة بملايين القراء حول العالم.

definitionEn: quickly and without difficulty
example: He readily agreed to help.
exampleAr: وافق بسرعة على المساعدة.

definitionEn: the activity of somebody who reads
example: Reading is one of her favorite hobbies.
exampleAr: القراءة واحدة من هواياتها المفضلة.

definitionEn: fully prepared for what you are going to do and able to start it immediately
example: Are you ready to go?
exampleAr: هل أنت جاهز للذهاب؟

definitionEn: actually existing or happening and not imagined or pretended
example: Is that a real diamond or a fake one?
exampleAr: هل هذا ماس حقيقي أم مزيف؟

definitionEn: accepting in a sensible way what it is actually possible to do or achieve in a particular situation
example: We need to set realistic goals for this project.
exampleAr: نحتاج إلى وضع أهداف واقعية لهذا المشروع.

definitionEn: the true situation and the problems that actually exist in life, in contrast to how you would like life to be
example: In reality, the plan was much harder to execute.
exampleAr: في الواقع، كانت الخطة أصعب بكثير في التنفيذ.

definitionEn: the process of becoming aware of something
example: The realization that she'd made a mistake hit her suddenly.
exampleAr: صدمها فجأة إدراكها أنها ارتكبت خطأً.

definitionEn: to understand or become aware of a particular fact or situation
example: She realized she had forgotten her keys.
exampleAr: أدركت أنها نسيت مفاتيحها.

definitionEn: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb
example: I really enjoyed the movie.
exampleAr: استمتعت حقًا بالفيلم.

definitionEn: an area of activity, interest or knowledge
example: This falls outside the realm of possibility.
exampleAr: هذا يقع خارج نطاق الإمكان.

definitionEn: the back part of something
example: The engine is located at the rear of the car.
exampleAr: يقع المحرك في الجزء الخلفي من السيارة.

definitionEn: at or near the back of something
example: Check the rear window before reversing.
exampleAr: تحقق من النافذة الخلفية قبل الرجوع للخلف.

definitionEn: at or near the back of something
example: They reared cattle on their farm.
exampleAr: ربّوا الماشية في مزرعتهم.

definitionEn: a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done
example: She didn't give a reason for her absence.
exampleAr: لم تقدّم سببًا لغيابها.

definitionEn: a cause or an explanation for something that has happened or that somebody has done
example: He reasoned that the plan would fail.
exampleAr: استنتج أن الخطة ستفشل.

definitionEn: fair, practical, and sensible
example: The price seems reasonable for this quality.
exampleAr: يبدو السعر معقولًا مقابل هذه الجودة.

definitionEn: to a degree that is fairly good but not very good
example: The team performed reasonably well this season.
exampleAr: أدى الفريق بشكل جيد بصورة معقولة هذا الموسم.

definitionEn: the process of thinking about things in a logical way; opinions and ideas that are based on logical thinking
example: I don't follow your reasoning here.
exampleAr: لا أفهم منطقك هنا.

definitionEn: to say or do something that makes somebody less frightened or worried
example: The doctor reassured her that the surgery was routine.
exampleAr: طمأنها الطبيب بأن العملية روتينية.

definitionEn: a person who fights against the government of their country
example: Teenagers often rebel against their parents' rules.
exampleAr: غالبًا ما يتمرد المراهقون على قواعد آبائهم.

definitionEn: a person who fights against the government of their country
example: The rebels seized control of the capital.
exampleAr: سيطر المتمردون على العاصمة.

definitionEn: an attempt by some of the people in a country to change their government, using violence
example: The rebellion was crushed within weeks.
exampleAr: سُحق التمرد خلال أسابيع.

definitionEn: to build or put something together again
example: The city was rebuilt after the war.
exampleAr: أُعيد بناء المدينة بعد الحرب.

definitionEn: to remember something
example: She couldn't recall his name.
exampleAr: لم تستطع تذكر اسمه.

definitionEn: to remember something
example: The car recall affected over a million vehicles.
exampleAr: أثر استدعاء السيارات على أكثر من مليون مركبة.

definitionEn: a piece of paper or an electronic document that shows that goods or services have been paid for
example: Keep your receipt in case you need a refund.
exampleAr: احتفظ بإيصالك في حال احتجت إلى استرداد المبلغ.

definitionEn: to get or accept something that is sent or given to you
example: She received a letter from her old friend.
exampleAr: استلمت رسالة من صديقتها القديمة.

definitionEn: the part of a phone that you hold close to your mouth and ear
example: He picked up the receiver and dialed the number.
exampleAr: رفع السماعة وطلب الرقم.

definitionEn: that happened or began only a short time ago
example: In recent years, prices have risen sharply.
exampleAr: في السنوات الأخيرة، ارتفعت الأسعار بشكل حاد.

definitionEn: not long ago
example: She recently moved to a new city.
exampleAr: انتقلت مؤخرًا إلى مدينة جديدة.

definitionEn: the area inside the entrance of a hotel, an office building, etc. where guests or visitors go first when they arrive
example: The hotel reception is open 24 hours.
exampleAr: استقبال الفندق مفتوح على مدار 24 ساعة.

definitionEn: a difficult time for the economy of a country, when there is less trade and industrial activity than usual and more people are unemployed
example: The country entered a recession last year.
exampleAr: دخلت الدولة في ركود اقتصادي العام الماضي.

definitionEn: a set of instructions that tells you how to cook something and the ingredients (= items of food) you need for it
example: She shared her grandmother's recipe for apple pie.
exampleAr: شاركت وصفة جدتها لفطيرة التفاح.

definitionEn: a person who receives something
example: She was the recipient of a prestigious award.
exampleAr: كانت متلقية جائزة مرموقة.

definitionEn: to think something or have an opinion about something
example: I reckon it'll rain later today.
exampleAr: أظن أنها ستمطر لاحقًا اليوم.

definitionEn: the act of remembering who somebody is when you see them, or of identifying what something is
example: She finally received recognition for her hard work.
exampleAr: حصلت أخيرًا على تقدير لجهدها.

definitionEn: to know who somebody is or what something is when you see or hear them or it, because you have seen or heard them or it before
example: I almost didn't recognize you with short hair.
exampleAr: كدت لا أتعرف عليك بشعرك القصير.

definitionEn: to tell somebody that something is good or useful, or that somebody would be suitable for a particular job, etc.
example: Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن توصي بمطعم جيد قريب؟

definitionEn: an official suggestion about the best thing to do
example: The doctor gave her a recommendation for a specialist.
exampleAr: قدّم لها الطبيب توصية بأخصائي.

definitionEn: the process of changing or improving the condition of something or the way it works; the process of putting something back into the state it was in before
example: The reconstruction of the bridge took two years.
exampleAr: استغرقت إعادة بناء الجسر عامين.

definitionEn: a written account of something that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future
example: The hospital keeps a record of every patient visit.
exampleAr: يحتفظ المستشفى بسجل لكل زيارة مريض.

definitionEn: to keep a permanent account of facts or events by writing them down, filming them, storing them in a computer, etc.
example: The concert was recorded live.
exampleAr: سُجّل الحفل الموسيقي مباشرة.

definitionEn: sound or pictures that have been recorded on computer files or on CD, DVD, video, etc.
example: The recording quality was excellent.
exampleAr: كانت جودة التسجيل ممتازة.

definitionEn: sound or pictures that have been recorded on computer files or on CD, DVD, video, etc.
example: He recounted his adventures from the trip.
exampleAr: روى مغامراته من الرحلة.

definitionEn: to get well again after being ill, hurt, etc.
example: It took him months to recover from the surgery.
exampleAr: استغرق الأمر منه أشهرًا للتعافي من الجراحة.

definitionEn: the process of becoming well again after an illness or injury
example: Her recovery from the illness was slow but steady.
exampleAr: كان تعافيها من المرض بطيئًا لكنه ثابت.

definitionEn: to find new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.
example: The company is recruiting new graduates.
exampleAr: توظف الشركة خريجين جدد.

definitionEn: a person who has recently joined the armed forces or the police
example: The new recruit will start training next week.
exampleAr: سيبدأ المجند الجديد تدريبه الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: the act or process of finding new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.
example: The firm is investing more in recruitment this year.
exampleAr: تستثمر الشركة أكثر في التوظيف هذا العام.

definitionEn: to treat things that have already been used so that they can be used again
example: We should recycle paper and plastic.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن نعيد تدوير الورق والبلاستيك.

definitionEn: having the colour of blood or fire
example: She wore a bright red dress.
exampleAr: ارتدت فستانًا أحمر زاهيًا.

definitionEn: the colour of blood or fire
example: Red is her favorite color.
exampleAr: الأحمر هو لونها المفضل.

definitionEn: to make something less or smaller in size, quantity, price, etc.; to become less or smaller in size, quantity, etc.
example: The company reduced its prices by 10 percent.
exampleAr: خفّضت الشركة أسعارها بنسبة 10 بالمئة.

definitionEn: an act of making something less or smaller; the state of being made less or smaller
example: There was a significant reduction in accidents.
exampleAr: حدث انخفاض ملحوظ في الحوادث.

meaningAr: يشير إلى / يحيل شخصًا لجهة أخرى
definitionEn: to send somebody/something to somebody/something for help, advice or a decision
example: She referred to the report in her speech.
exampleAr: أشارت إلى التقرير في خطابها.

definitionEn: the official who controls the game in some sports
example: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
exampleAr: أطلق الحكم صافرته احتسابًا لمخالفة.

definitionEn: a thing you say or write that mentions somebody/something else; the act of mentioning somebody/something
example: She made a reference to an old proverb.
exampleAr: أشارت إلى مثل قديم.

definitionEn: an occasion when all the people of a country can vote on an important issue
example: The country held a referendum on the new constitution.
exampleAr: أجرت الدولة استفتاءً على الدستور الجديد.

definitionEn: to show the image of somebody/something on the surface of something such as a mirror, water or glass
example: The lake reflects the mountains perfectly.
exampleAr: تعكس البحيرة الجبال بشكل مثالي.

definitionEn: an image in a mirror, on a shiny surface, on water, etc.
example: He saw his reflection in the mirror.
exampleAr: رأى انعكاس صورته في المرآة.

definitionEn: change that is made to a social system, an organization, etc. in order to improve or correct it
example: The government introduced major education reforms.
exampleAr: أدخلت الحكومة إصلاحات تعليمية كبرى.

definitionEn: to improve a system, an organization, a law, etc. by making changes to it
example: They're working to reform the healthcare system.
exampleAr: يعملون على إصلاح نظام الرعاية الصحية.

definitionEn: shelter or protection from danger, trouble, etc.
example: They sought refuge from the storm in a nearby barn.
exampleAr: لجؤوا إلى حظيرة قريبة اتقاءً للعاصفة.

definitionEn: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons
example: The camp provides shelter for thousands of refugees.
exampleAr: يوفر المخيم مأوى لآلاف اللاجئين.

definitionEn: an act of saying or showing that you will not do, give or accept something
example: Her refusal to apologize surprised everyone.
exampleAr: فاجأ رفضها الاعتذار الجميع.

definitionEn: to say or show that you will not do something that somebody has asked you to do
example: He refused to answer any questions.
exampleAr: رفض الإجابة عن أي أسئلة.

definitionEn: to get back something you no longer have, especially an ability or a quality
example: She worked hard to regain her strength after the illness.
exampleAr: عملت بجد لاستعادة قوتها بعد المرض.

definitionEn: to think about somebody/something in a particular way
example: She is regarded as one of the best in her field.
exampleAr: تُعتبر من الأفضل في مجالها.

definitionEn: attention to or thought and care for somebody/something
example: He has great regard for his mentor.
exampleAr: لديه احترام كبير لمعلمه.

definitionEn: paying no attention, even if the situation is bad or there are difficulties
example: She continued working, regardless of the criticism.
exampleAr: واصلت العمل، بغض النظر عن الانتقادات.

definitionEn: a method or system of government, especially one that has not been elected in a fair way
example: The regime was overthrown after years of protests.
exampleAr: أُطيح بالنظام بعد سنوات من الاحتجاجات.

definitionEn: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders
example: This region is known for its wine production.
exampleAr: تشتهر هذه المنطقة بإنتاج النبيذ.

definitionEn: of or relating to a region
example: The company opened several regional offices.
exampleAr: افتتحت الشركة عدة مكاتب إقليمية.

definitionEn: to record your/somebody’s/something’s name on an official list
example: Please register for the course before Friday.
exampleAr: يُرجى التسجيل في الدورة قبل يوم الجمعة.

definitionEn: an official list or record of names, items, etc.; a book that contains such a list
example: Check the register for the list of attendees.
exampleAr: راجع السجل للاطلاع على قائمة الحاضرين.

definitionEn: the act of making an official record of something/somebody
example: Registration for the event closes next week.
exampleAr: يُغلق باب التسجيل في الفعالية الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: to feel sorry about something you have done or about something that you have not been able to do
example: She regrets not taking the job offer.
exampleAr: تندم على عدم قبولها عرض العمل.

definitionEn: a sad feeling because of something that has happened or something that you have done or not done
example: He has no regrets about his decision.
exampleAr: ليس لديه أي ندم على قراره.

definitionEn: following a pattern, especially with the same time or space in between each thing and the next
example: He's a regular customer at this café.
exampleAr: إنه زبون منتظم في هذا المقهى.

definitionEn: at regular intervals or times
example: She exercises regularly every morning.
exampleAr: تمارس الرياضة بانتظام كل صباح.

definitionEn: to control something by means of rules
example: The agency regulates food safety standards.
exampleAr: تنظم الوكالة معايير سلامة الغذاء.

definitionEn: an official rule made by a government or some other authority
example: The factory must comply with safety regulations.
exampleAr: يجب على المصنع الامتثال للوائح السلامة.

definitionEn: a person or an organization that officially controls an area of business or industry and makes sure that it is operating fairly
example: The financial regulator fined the bank heavily.
exampleAr: فرضت الجهة التنظيمية المالية غرامة كبيرة على البنك.

definitionEn: having the power to control an area of business or industry and make sure that it is operating fairly
example: The company faces new regulatory requirements.
exampleAr: تواجه الشركة متطلبات تنظيمية جديدة.

definitionEn: the process of helping somebody to return to a normal, healthy life after they have been in prison or very ill
example: He's undergoing rehabilitation after his injury.
exampleAr: يخضع لإعادة تأهيل بعد إصابته.

definitionEn: the period during which a king, queen, emperor, etc. rules
example: The queen's reign lasted over 60 years.
exampleAr: استمر حكم الملكة أكثر من 60 عامًا.

definitionEn: to rule as king, queen, emperor, etc.
example: The king reigned for four decades.
exampleAr: حكم الملك لأربعة عقود.

meaningAr: يعزز، يقوي / يعزز فكرة أو سلوكًا
definitionEn: to make a feeling, an idea, etc. stronger
example: The wall was reinforced with steel bars.
exampleAr: عُزّز الحائط بقضبان فولاذية.

definitionEn: to refuse to accept or consider something
example: The bank rejected his loan application.
exampleAr: رفض البنك طلب قرضه.

definitionEn: to refuse to accept or consider something
example: These shirts are factory rejects sold at a discount.
exampleAr: هذه القمصان منتجات مرفوضة من المصنع تُباع بخصم.

definitionEn: the act of refusing to accept or consider something
example: She faced several rejections before finding a publisher.
exampleAr: واجهت عدة حالات رفض قبل أن تجد ناشرًا.

meaningAr: يتعلق بـ، يربط / يتفهم، يتعاطف مع
definitionEn: show or make a connection between two or more things
example: This issue relates directly to our budget.
exampleAr: تتعلق هذه المسألة مباشرة بميزانيتنا.

definitionEn: connected with something/somebody in some way
example: The two problems are closely related.
exampleAr: المشكلتان مرتبطتان ارتباطًا وثيقًا.

definitionEn: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
example: There's no relation between the two events.
exampleAr: لا توجد علاقة بين الحدثين.

definitionEn: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
example: They have a strong relationship built on trust.
exampleAr: تربطهم علاقة قوية مبنية على الثقة.

definitionEn: considered and judged by being compared with something else
example: The two cities are similar in relative size.
exampleAr: تتشابه المدينتان في الحجم النسبي.

definitionEn: a person who is in the same family as somebody else
example: She invited all her relatives to the wedding.
exampleAr: دعت جميع أقاربها إلى حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: to a fairly large degree, especially in comparison to something else
example: The test was relatively easy.
exampleAr: كان الاختبار سهلًا نسبيًا.

definitionEn: to rest while you are doing something that you enjoy, especially after work or effort
example: Just relax and enjoy the movie.
exampleAr: استرخِ فقط واستمتع بالفيلم.

definitionEn: calm and not anxious or worried
example: She felt relaxed after the massage.
exampleAr: شعرت بالاسترخاء بعد جلسة التدليك.

definitionEn: helping you to rest and become less anxious
example: We spent a relaxing weekend at the beach.
exampleAr: قضينا عطلة نهاية أسبوع مريحة على الشاطئ.

meaningAr: يُطلق سراح، يصدر / يُصدر منتجًا أو فيلمًا
definitionEn: to let somebody come out of a place where they have been kept or stuck and unable to leave or move
example: The prisoner was released after five years.
exampleAr: أُطلق سراح السجين بعد خمس سنوات.

definitionEn: the act of setting a person or an animal free; the state of being set free
example: The movie's release was delayed by a month.
exampleAr: تأخر إصدار الفيلم شهرًا.

definitionEn: a close connection with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are in
example: The professor questioned the relevance of the study.
exampleAr: شكك الأستاذ في أهمية الدراسة.

definitionEn: closely connected with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are in
example: Please only include information that's relevant to the topic.
exampleAr: يُرجى تضمين المعلومات ذات الصلة بالموضوع فقط.

definitionEn: the quality of being able to be trusted to do what somebody wants or needs
example: The car is known for its reliability.
exampleAr: تشتهر السيارة بموثوقيتها.

definitionEn: that can be trusted to do something well; that you can rely on
example: She's a reliable and hardworking employee.

definitionEn: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject because they have studied it in detail

exampleAr: إنه باحث محترم في التاريخ القديم.

definitionEn: an amount of money given to somebody by an organization to help pay for their education
example: She received a full scholarship to study abroad.
exampleAr: حصلت على منحة دراسية كاملة للدراسة في الخارج.

definitionEn: a place where children go to be educated
example: Their children attend the local school.
exampleAr: يلتحق أطفالهم بالمدرسة المحلية.

definitionEn: knowledge about the structure and behaviour of the natural and physical world, based on facts that you can prove, for example by experiments
example: She's always been fascinated by science.
exampleAr: لطالما كانت مفتونة بالعلم.

definitionEn: involving science; connected with science
example: The claim lacks any scientific evidence.

definitionEn: a person who studies one or more of the natural sciences (= for example, physics, chemistry or biology)
example: The scientist published her research in a major journal.
exampleAr: نشرت العالمة بحثها في مجلة كبرى.

definitionEn: the opportunity or ability to do or achieve something
example: This issue is beyond the scope of our discussion.
exampleAr: هذه المسألة تتجاوز نطاق نقاشنا.

definitionEn: the number of points, goals, etc. scored by each player or team in a game or competition
example: The final score was three to one.

definitionEn: to win points, goals, etc. in a game or competition
example: She scored the winning goal in the last minute.

definitionEn: to rub your skin with your nails, usually because it is itching
example: The cat scratched the furniture.
exampleAr: خدشت القطة الأثاث.

definitionEn: a mark, a cut or an injury made by scratching somebody’s skin or the surface of something
example: There's a small scratch on the car door.
exampleAr: هناك خدش صغير على باب السيارة.

definitionEn: to give a loud, high shout, because you are hurt, frightened, excited, etc.

exampleAr: صرخت عندما رأت العنكبوت.

definitionEn: a loud high shout made by somebody who is hurt, frightened, excited, etc.; a loud high noise

definitionEn: the flat surface at the front of a television, computer, or other electronic device, on which you see pictures or information

definitionEn: to show a film, etc. in a cinema or on television

definitionEn: the act of showing a film or television programme

definitionEn: a thin pointed piece of metal like a nail with a raised spiral line (called a thread) along it and a line or cross cut into its head. Screws are turned and pressed into wood, metal, etc. with a screwdriver in order to fasten two things together.

exampleAr: استخدم برغيًا لتثبيت الرف على الحائط.

definitionEn: to fasten one thing to another or make something tight with a screw or screws

definitionEn: a written text of a play, film, broadcast, talk, etc.

definitionEn: careful and complete examination

exampleAr: خضعت الصفقة لتدقيق عام مكثف.

definitionEn: a work of art that is a solid figure or object made by carving or shaping wood, stone, clay, metal, etc.

exampleAr: يعرض المتحف منحوتة برونزية شهيرة.

definitionEn: the salt water that covers most of the earth’s surface and surrounds its continents and islands

definitionEn: an official design or mark, stamped on a document to show that it is real and carries the authority of a particular person or organization

definitionEn: to close an envelope, etc. by sticking the edges of the opening together

definitionEn: to look carefully for something/somebody; to examine a particular place when looking for something/somebody

definitionEn: an attempt to find somebody/something, especially by looking carefully for them/it

meaningAr: فصل من فصول السنة / موسم رياضي أو تلفزيوني

definitionEn: known about by only a few people; kept hidden from others

definitionEn: a person who works in an office, working for another person, dealing with mail and phone calls, keeping records, arranging meetings with people, etc.

definitionEn: any of the parts into which something is divided

definitionEn: a part of an area of activity, especially of a country’s economy

definitionEn: not connected with spiritual or religious matters

definitionEn: likely to continue or be successful for a long time

definitionEn: to obtain or achieve something, especially when this means using a lot of effort

definitionEn: to become aware of somebody/something by using your eyes

definitionEn: the small hard part produced by a plant, from which a new plant can grow

definitionEn: to look for something/somebody

definitionEn: a person who is trying to find or get the thing mentioned

definitionEn: to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things, usually according to a system

definitionEn: affecting or involving only a small number of people or things from a larger group

definitionEn: the type of person you are, especially the way you normally behave, look or feel

definitionEn: to make something go or be taken to a place, especially by post, email, radio, etc.

definitionEn: high in rank or status; higher in rank or status than others

definitionEn: high in rank or status; higher in rank or status than others

definitionEn: a feeling that you get when something affects your body

definitionEn: an understanding about something; an ability to judge something

definitionEn: to become aware of something even though you cannot see it, hear it, etc.

definitionEn: a set of words expressing a statement, a question or an order, usually containing a subject and a verb. In written English sentences begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop/period (.), a question mark (?) or an exclamation mark (!).

exampleAr: اكتب جملة باستخدام الكلمة الجديدة.

definitionEn: to say officially in court that somebody is to receive a particular punishment

definitionEn: a feeling or an opinion, especially one based on emotions

definitionEn: forming a unit by itself; not joined to something else

definitionEn: to divide into different parts or groups; to divide things into different parts or groups

definitionEn: the act of separating people or things; the state of being separate

definitionEn: a set of events, actions, numbers, etc. which have a particular order and which lead to a particular result

definitionEn: bad or dangerous

definitionEn: in a serious way

definitionEn: a person who works in another person’s house, and cooks, cleans, etc. for them

definitionEn: to give somebody food or drink, for example at a restaurant or during a meal

definitionEn: a system that provides something that the public needs, organized by the government or a private company

definitionEn: a period of time that is spent doing a particular activity

meaningAr: يضع، يحدد / يحدد موعدًا أو هدفًا
definitionEn: to prepare or arrange something so that it is ready for use or in position

definitionEn: a group of similar things that belong together in some way

definitionEn: a group of similar things that belong together in some way

definitionEn: a way of organizing something; a system

example: She has seven cousins on her mother's side.

example: He turned seventeen last week.

definitionEn: the feelings and activities connected with a person’s sexual desires

definitionEn: a period of time worked by a group of workers who start work as another group finishes
example: There has been a major shift in public opinion on the issue.
exampleAr: حدث تحوّل كبير في الرأي العام تجاه هذه القضية.

meaningAr: يتحوّل / يتغيّر / ينقل / يحرّك من مكانه
definitionEn: to move, or move something, from one position or place to another
example: Public attitudes have shifted over the past decade.
exampleAr: تغيّرت مواقف الرأي العام خلال العقد الماضي.

definitionEn: to produce or reflect light; to be bright
example: The sun was shining brightly all day.
exampleAr: كانت الشمس تسطع بشدة طوال اليوم.

definitionEn: to produce or reflect light; to be bright
example: The car's paint had a brilliant shine after washing.
exampleAr: اكتسب طلاء السيارة لمعانًا رائعًا بعد غسلها.

definitionEn: smooth and bright; reflecting the light
example: He was wearing a shiny new watch.
exampleAr: كان يرتدي ساعة جديدة لامعة.

definitionEn: a large boat that carries people or goods by sea
example: The ship sailed from Alexandria to Piraeus.
exampleAr: أبحرت السفينة من الإسكندرية إلى بيرايوس.

definitionEn: to send or transport somebody/something by ship or by another means of transport
example: The company ships orders within 24 hours.
exampleAr: تشحن الشركة الطلبات خلال 24 ساعة.

definitionEn: ships in general or considered as a group
example: The shipping industry was badly affected by the canal blockage.
exampleAr: تضرّرت صناعة الشحن بشدة جراء انسداد القناة.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body, made of light cloth, with sleeves and usually with a collar and buttons down the front
example: He ironed his shirt before the meeting.
exampleAr: كوى قميصه قبل الاجتماع.

definitionEn: a strong feeling of surprise as a result of something happening, especially something unpleasant; the event that causes this feeling
example: The news came as a huge shock to everyone.
exampleAr: جاء الخبر صدمة كبيرة للجميع.

definitionEn: to surprise and upset somebody
example: Her sudden resignation shocked the whole team.
exampleAr: صدمت استقالتها المفاجئة الفريق بأكمله.

definitionEn: surprised and upset; showing that somebody feels surprised and upset
example: I was shocked to hear about the accident.
exampleAr: كنت مصدومًا عندما سمعت عن الحادث.

definitionEn: that offends or upsets people; that is morally wrong
example: The report revealed shocking levels of pollution in the river.
exampleAr: كشف التقرير عن مستويات صادمة من التلوث في النهر.

definitionEn: one of a pair of objects usually made of leather or plastic that you wear on your feet
example: She bought a new pair of running shoes.
exampleAr: اشترت زوجًا جديدًا من أحذية الجري.

definitionEn: to fire a gun or other weapon; to fire something from a weapon
example: The police officer shot the suspect in the leg.
exampleAr: أطلق ضابط الشرطة النار على المشتبه به في ساقه.

definitionEn: the part that grows up from the ground when a plant starts to grow; a new part that grows on plants or trees
example: The photo shoot took place on the beach at sunrise.
exampleAr: أُقيمت جلسة التصوير على الشاطئ عند شروق الشمس.

definitionEn: a situation in which a person is shot with a gun
example: Three people were injured in the shooting downtown.
exampleAr: أُصيب ثلاثة أشخاص في حادثة إطلاق نار وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: a building or part of a building where you can buy goods or services
example: There's a small shop on the corner that sells fresh bread.
exampleAr: يوجد محل صغير عند الزاوية يبيع الخبز الطازج.

definitionEn: to buy things in shops
example: We usually shop for groceries on Fridays.
exampleAr: عادةً ما نتسوّق لشراء البقالة أيام الجمعة.

definitionEn: the activity of going to shops and buying things or ordering them online
example: I hate shopping for clothes; it takes forever.
exampleAr: أكره التسوّق لشراء الملابس؛ فهو يستغرق وقتًا طويلًا جدًا.

definitionEn: the land along the edge of the sea, the ocean or a lake
example: They walked along the shore at sunset.
exampleAr: مشيا على طول الشاطئ عند الغروب.

meaningAr: قصير (بالطول أو الزمن) / ناقص / غير كافٍ (short of/on)
definitionEn: measuring or covering a small length or distance, or a smaller length or distance than usual
example: She has short hair and a short attention span.
exampleAr: شعرها قصير، ومدى انتباهها قصير كذلك.

definitionEn: lasting a short time; designed only for a short period of time in the future
example: The company is focused on short-term profits rather than long-term growth.
exampleAr: تركّز الشركة على الأرباح قصيرة الأمد بدلاً من النمو على المدى الطويل.

definitionEn: a situation when there is not enough of the people or things that are needed
example: There's a serious shortage of affordable housing in the city.
exampleAr: هناك نقص حاد في المساكن ذات الأسعار المعقولة في المدينة.

definitionEn: a short time; not long
example: The manager will be with you shortly.
exampleAr: سيكون المدير معك بعد قليل.

meaningAr: طلقة (رصاصة) / محاولة / فرصة (give it a shot) / لقطة (تصوير سينمائي أو فوتوغرافي) / حقنة (طبية)
definitionEn: the act of firing a gun; the sound this makes
example: They heard a shot ring out in the distance.
exampleAr: سمعوا دوي طلقة نارية في البعيد.

definitionEn: used to show what is right, appropriate, etc., especially when criticizing somebody’s actions
example: You should see a doctor if the pain continues.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تراجع طبيبًا إذا استمر الألم.

definitionEn: either of the two parts of the body between the top of each arm and the neck
example: He carried the heavy bag over his shoulder.
exampleAr: حمل الحقيبة الثقيلة على كتفه.

definitionEn: either of the two parts of the body between the top of each arm and the neck
example: She had to shoulder the responsibility alone after he left.
exampleAr: اضطرت إلى تحمّل المسؤولية وحدها بعد رحيله.

definitionEn: to say something in a loud voice; to speak loudly/angrily to somebody
example: He shouted for help when he saw the fire.
exampleAr: صرخ طلبًا للنجدة عندما رأى الحريق.

definitionEn: a loud cry of anger, fear, excitement, etc.
example: I heard a shout coming from the other room.
exampleAr: سمعت صرخة قادمة من الغرفة الأخرى.

definitionEn: to make something clear; to prove something
example: Can you show me how this machine works?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تُريني كيف تعمل هذه الآلة؟

definitionEn: a programme on television or the radio
example: We watched a great show on Netflix last night.
exampleAr: شاهدنا برنامجًا رائعًا على نتفليكس ليلة أمس.

definitionEn: a piece of equipment producing a flow of water that you stand under to wash yourself; the small room or part of a room that contains a shower
example: I usually take a shower first thing in the morning.
exampleAr: عادةً ما أستحمّ أول شيء في الصباح.

definitionEn: a piece of equipment producing a flow of water that you stand under to wash yourself; the small room or part of a room that contains a shower
example: He showers every morning before work.
exampleAr: يستحم كل صباح قبل الذهاب إلى العمل.

definitionEn: to become smaller, especially when washed in water that is too hot; to make clothes, cloth, etc. smaller in this way
example: The sweater shrank after I washed it in hot water.
exampleAr: انكمشت الكنزة بعدما غسلتها بماء ساخن.

meaningAr: يهزّ كتفيه (كإشارة لعدم المبالاة أو عدم المعرفة)
definitionEn: to raise your shoulders and then drop them to show that you do not know or care about something
example: She just shrugged when I asked for her opinion.
exampleAr: اكتفت بهزّ كتفيها حين سألتها عن رأيها.

definitionEn: to close something; to become closed
example: Please shut the door behind you, it's cold outside.
exampleAr: من فضلك أغلق الباب خلفك، فالجو بارد في الخارج.

definitionEn: not open
example: The shop was already shut when we arrived.
exampleAr: كان المحل مغلقًا بالفعل عندما وصلنا.

definitionEn: nervous or embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people
example: He's quite shy around people he doesn't know.
exampleAr: يكون خجولًا جدًا مع الأشخاص الذين لا يعرفهم.

definitionEn: a brother or sister
example: Do you have any siblings, or are you an only child?
exampleAr: هل لديك إخوة أم أنك الطفل الوحيد؟

meaningAr: مريض / سئم / تعِب من شيء (sick of)
definitionEn: physically or mentally ill
example: She stayed home from work because she felt sick.
exampleAr: بقيت في المنزل ولم تذهب إلى العمل لأنها شعرت بالمرض.

meaningAr: جانب / جهة / فريق / طرف (في نزاع أو مباراة)
definitionEn: either of the two halves of a surface, an object or an area that is divided by an imaginary central line
example: He was standing on the other side of the street.
exampleAr: كان واقفًا على الجانب الآخر من الشارع.

definitionEn: to take and then let out a long deep breath that can be heard, to show that you are disappointed, sad, tired, etc.
example: She sighed with relief when the test results came back clear.
exampleAr: تنهّدت بارتياح عندما جاءت نتيجة الفحص سليمة.

definitionEn: an act or the sound of sighing
example: He let out a deep sigh before starting his speech.
exampleAr: أطلق تنهيدة عميقة قبل أن يبدأ خطابه.

definitionEn: the ability to see
example: His sight has gotten noticeably worse with age.
exampleAr: ساء بصره بشكل ملحوظ مع تقدّمه في العمر.

definitionEn: an event, an action, a fact, etc. that shows that something exists, is happening or may happen in the future
example: A rash can sometimes be a sign of an allergy.
exampleAr: قد يكون الطفح الجلدي أحيانًا علامة على حساسية.

definitionEn: to write your name on a document, letter, etc. to show that you have written it, that you agree with what it says, or that it is real
example: Please sign the contract on the last page.
exampleAr: من فضلك وقّع العقد في الصفحة الأخيرة.

definitionEn: a movement or sound that you make to give somebody information, instructions, a warning, etc.
example: My phone has a very weak signal in this building.
exampleAr: إشارة هاتفي ضعيفة جدًا داخل هذا المبنى.

definitionEn: to make a movement or sound to give somebody a message, an order, etc.
example: He signaled for the waiter to bring the bill.
exampleAr: أشار إلى النادل ليحضر الفاتورة.

definitionEn: your name as you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter
example: I need your signature at the bottom of the last page.
exampleAr: أحتاج إلى توقيعك أسفل الصفحة الأخيرة.

definitionEn: the importance of something, especially when this has an effect on what happens in the future
example: Historians still debate the true significance of the event.
exampleAr: لا يزال المؤرخون يتناقشون حول الأهمية الحقيقية لهذا الحدث.

definitionEn: large or important enough to have an effect or to be noticed
example: There has been a significant increase in sales this year.
exampleAr: طرأت زيادة ملحوظة على المبيعات هذا العام.

definitionEn: in a way that is large or important enough to have an effect on something or to be noticed
example: Prices have risen significantly over the past year.
exampleAr: ارتفعت الأسعار بشكل ملحوظ خلال العام الماضي.

definitionEn: a complete lack of noise or sound
example: There was a long silence after she asked the question.
exampleAr: ساد صمت طويل بعد أن طرحت سؤالها.

definitionEn: a complete lack of noise or sound
example: The new law was widely seen as an attempt to silence critics.
exampleAr: اعتُبر القانون الجديد على نطاق واسع محاولة لإسكات المنتقدين.

definitionEn: where there is little or no sound; making little or no sound
example: Everyone stayed silent during the moment of remembrance.
exampleAr: بقي الجميع صامتين أثناء لحظة التأبين.

definitionEn: fine soft thread produced by silkworms
example: The dress was made of pure silk.
exampleAr: كان الفستان مصنوعًا من الحرير الخالص.

meaningAr: سخيف / تافه (غبي بشكل بسيط أو مضحك)
definitionEn: showing a lack of thought, understanding, or judgement
example: It was a silly mistake, nothing to worry about.
exampleAr: كان خطأً سخيفًا، لا داعي للقلق بشأنه.

definitionEn: a chemical element. Silver is a shiny, grey-white precious metal used for making coins, jewellery, beautiful objects, etc.
example: The necklace is made of solid silver.
exampleAr: القلادة مصنوعة من الفضة الخالصة.

definitionEn: shiny grey-white in colour
example: She drives a silver car.
exampleAr: تقود سيارة فضية اللون.

definitionEn: like somebody/something but not exactly the same
example: Their opinions on the topic are quite similar.
exampleAr: آراؤهم حول الموضوع متشابهة إلى حد كبير.

definitionEn: the state of being similar to somebody/something but not exactly the same
example: There's a striking similarity between the two paintings.
exampleAr: هناك تشابه لافت بين اللوحتين.

definitionEn: in almost the same way
example: Similarly, sales in Europe also declined this quarter.
exampleAr: وبالمثل، تراجعت المبيعات في أوروبا هذا الربع أيضًا.

definitionEn: not complicated; easy to understand or do
example: The instructions were simple and easy to follow.
exampleAr: كانت التعليمات بسيطة وسهلة الاتباع.

definitionEn: used to emphasize how easy or basic something is
example: Simply press the button to start the machine.
exampleAr: ما عليك سوى الضغط على الزر لتشغيل الآلة.

definitionEn: to create particular conditions that exist in real life using computers, models, etc., usually for study or training purposes
example: The software can simulate real flight conditions.
exampleAr: يمكن للبرنامج أن يحاكي ظروف الطيران الحقيقية.

definitionEn: a situation in which a particular set of conditions is created artificially in order to study or experience something that could exist in reality
example: Pilots train for emergencies using flight simulations.
exampleAr: يتدرّب الطيارون على حالات الطوارئ باستخدام محاكاة طيران.

definitionEn: at the same time as something else
example: She can talk on the phone and cook simultaneously.
exampleAr: تستطيع التحدث في الهاتف والطهي في آنٍ واحد.

definitionEn: an offence against God or against a religious or moral law
example: Many religions consider lying to be a sin.
exampleAr: تعتبر أديان كثيرة الكذب خطيئة.

definitionEn: an offence against God or against a religious or moral law
example: He believed he had sinned and sought forgiveness.
exampleAr: اعتقد أنه أخطأ دينيًا فسعى إلى نيل المغفرة.

definitionEn: from a time in the past until a later past time, or until now
example: She has lived in this city since 2015.
exampleAr: تعيش في هذه المدينة منذ عام 2015.

definitionEn: from an event in the past until a later past event, or until now
example: I haven't seen him since he moved to Cairo.
exampleAr: لم أره منذ أن انتقل إلى القاهرة.

definitionEn: from a time in the past until a later past time, or until now
example: He left the company in 2019 and I haven't seen him since.
exampleAr: غادر الشركة عام 2019 ولم أره منذ ذلك الحين.

definitionEn: showing what you really think or feel
example: Please accept my sincere apologies for the delay.
exampleAr: أرجو أن تقبل اعتذاري الصادق عن التأخير.

definitionEn: to make musical sounds with your voice in the form of a song or tune
example: She sings beautifully in the school choir.
exampleAr: تغنّي بشكل جميل في جوقة المدرسة.

definitionEn: a person who sings, or whose job is singing, especially in public
example: He dreams of becoming a famous singer one day.
exampleAr: يحلم بأن يصبح مغنّيًا مشهورًا يومًا ما.

definitionEn: the activity of making musical sounds with your voice
example: Her singing impressed everyone at the concert.
exampleAr: أبهر غناؤها الجميع في الحفل الموسيقي.

meaningAr: واحد فقط (لا أكثر) / أعزب / عازب (غير متزوج)
definitionEn: only one
example: I didn't eat a single bite all day.
exampleAr: لم آكل ولو لقمة واحدة طوال اليوم.

definitionEn: to go down below the surface or towards the bottom of a liquid or soft substance
example: The boat began to sink shortly after hitting the rock.
exampleAr: بدأ القارب يغرق بعد اصطدامه بالصخرة بقليل.

definitionEn: to go down below the surface or towards the bottom of a liquid or soft substance
example: She washed the dishes in the kitchen sink.
exampleAr: غسلت الأطباق في حوض المطبخ.

definitionEn: used as a polite way of addressing a man whose name you do not know, for example in a shop or restaurant
example: Excuse me, sir, is this seat taken?
exampleAr: عفوًا يا سيدي، هل هذا المقعد محجوز؟

definitionEn: a girl or woman who has the same mother and father as another person
example: My older sister lives in Alexandria.
exampleAr: تعيش أختي الكبرى في الإسكندرية.

definitionEn: to rest your weight on your bottom with your back straight, for example on/in a chair
example: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
exampleAr: من فضلك اجلس واجعل نفسك في راحة.

definitionEn: a place where a building, town, etc. was, is or will be located
example: They chose a new site for the factory near the port.
exampleAr: اختاروا موقعًا جديدًا للمصنع بالقرب من الميناء.

definitionEn: in a particular place or position
example: The hotel is situated close to the beach.
exampleAr: يقع الفندق بالقرب من الشاطئ.

definitionEn: all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place
example: The economic situation has improved slightly this year.
exampleAr: تحسّن الوضع الاقتصادي قليلًا هذا العام.

example: She has six brothers and sisters.
exampleAr: لديها ستة إخوة وأخوات.

example: He turned sixteen last month.
exampleAr: أتم عامه السادس عشر الشهر الماضي.

example: My grandfather is turning sixty this year.
exampleAr: سيبلغ جدي الستين من عمره هذا العام.

definitionEn: how large or small a person or thing is
example: What size shoes do you wear?
exampleAr: ما مقاس حذائك؟

definitionEn: a simple picture that is drawn quickly and does not have many details
example: He made a quick sketch of the building's facade.
exampleAr: رسم رسمًا تخطيطيًا سريعًا لواجهة المبنى.

definitionEn: a simple picture that is drawn quickly and does not have many details
example: She sketched the view from her hotel window.
exampleAr: رسمت المنظر الذي تراه من نافذة فندقها.

definitionEn: to move over snow on skis, especially as a sport
example: He learned to ski when he was five years old.
exampleAr: تعلّم التزلج عندما كان في الخامسة من عمره.

definitionEn: the sport or activity of moving over snow on skis
example: Skiing is one of her favorite winter sports.
exampleAr: التزلج هو أحد رياضاتها الشتوية المفضلة.

definitionEn: the ability to do something well
example: Good communication is an important skill at work.
exampleAr: التواصل الجيد مهارة مهمة في العمل.

definitionEn: having enough ability, experience and knowledge to be able to do something well
example: They hired a skilled electrician to fix the wiring.
exampleAr: استأجروا كهربائيًا ماهرًا لإصلاح الأسلاك.

definitionEn: the layer of tissue that covers the body
example: She has very sensitive skin.
exampleAr: بشرتها حساسة جدًا.

definitionEn: to move forwards lightly and quickly making a little jump with each step
example: He decided to skip breakfast and go straight to work.
exampleAr: قرر تخطّي الفطور والذهاب مباشرة إلى العمل.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing that hangs from the middle part of the body
example: She wore a long black skirt to the interview.
exampleAr: ارتدت تنّورة سوداء طويلة إلى المقابلة.

definitionEn: the bone structure that forms the head and surrounds and protects the brain
example: The X-ray showed no damage to the skull.
exampleAr: أظهرت الأشعة السينية عدم وجود ضرر في الجمجمة.

definitionEn: the space above the earth that you can see when you look up, where clouds and the sun, moon and stars appear
example: The sky turned orange as the sun set.
exampleAr: تحوّلت السماء إلى اللون البرتقالي مع غروب الشمس.

definitionEn: to shut, or to make something shut, with a lot of force, making a loud noise
example: He slammed the door and stormed out of the room.
exampleAr: أغلق الباب بعنف وخرج غاضبًا من الغرفة.

definitionEn: to hit somebody/something with the flat part of your hand
example: She slapped him across the face in anger.
exampleAr: صفعته على وجهه غاضبة.

definitionEn: to hit somebody/something with the flat part of your hand
example: He got a slap on the wrist for being late again.
exampleAr: لم يتلقَّ سوى صفعة على المعصم بسبب تأخره مرة أخرى.

meaningAr: يخفض بشكل حاد (كالأسعار) / يجرح / يشق بأداة حادة
definitionEn: to make a long cut with a sharp object, especially in a violent way
example: The store slashed prices by 50% for the sale.
exampleAr: خفّض المتجر الأسعار بنسبة 50% خلال التخفيضات.

definitionEn: a person who is owned by another person and is forced to work for and obey them
example: The museum has an exhibit on the history of slaves in the region.
exampleAr: يضم المتحف معرضًا عن تاريخ العبيد في المنطقة.

definitionEn: the state of being forced to work as a slave
example: Slavery was formally abolished in the 19th century.
exampleAr: أُلغيت العبودية رسميًا في القرن التاسع عشر.

definitionEn: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body not active
example: I usually sleep for about seven hours a night.
exampleAr: أنام عادةً حوالي سبع ساعات في الليلة.

definitionEn: the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is not active, and your mind is not conscious
example: He hasn't gotten much sleep this week.
exampleAr: لم ينل قسطًا كافيًا من النوم هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: a thin flat piece of bread, meat, cheese, etc. that has been cut off a larger piece; a piece of cake that has been cut from a larger cake
example: Would you like another slice of bread?
exampleAr: هل تريد شريحة أخرى من الخبز؟

definitionEn: to cut something into slices
example: She sliced the tomatoes for the salad.
exampleAr: قطّعت الطماطم شرائح من أجل السلطة.

definitionEn: to move easily over a smooth or wet surface; to make something move in this way
example: He slid across the icy pavement and almost fell.
exampleAr: انزلق على الرصيف المتجمد وكاد أن يسقط.

definitionEn: one page of an electronic presentation, that may contain text and images, that is usually viewed on a computer screen or projected onto a larger screen
example: The kids were playing on the slide in the park.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال يلعبون على الزحليقة في الحديقة.

definitionEn: very small in degree
example: There's been a slight improvement in his condition.
exampleAr: طرأ تحسّن طفيف على حالته.

definitionEn: a little
example: The temperature dropped slightly overnight.
exampleAr: انخفضت درجة الحرارة قليلًا خلال الليل.

definitionEn: to slide a short distance by accident so that you fall or nearly fall
example: She slipped on the wet floor and fell.
exampleAr: انزلقت على الأرضية المبللة وسقطت.

definitionEn: to slide a short distance by accident so that you fall or nearly fall
example: It was just a slip of the tongue, nothing serious.
exampleAr: كانت مجرد زلّة لسان، لا شيء خطير.

definitionEn: a word or phrase that is easy to remember, used for example by a political party or in advertising to attract people’s attention or to suggest an idea quickly
example: The company's new slogan appeared on billboards everywhere.
exampleAr: ظهر شعار الشركة الجديد على اللوحات الإعلانية في كل مكان.

definitionEn: a surface or piece of land that slopes (= is higher at one end than the other)
example: The ski slope was covered in fresh snow.
exampleAr: كان منحدر التزلج مغطى بثلج طازج.

meaningAr: فتحة (لإدخال شيء) / موعد / فترة زمنية محجوزة
definitionEn: a long, narrow opening, into which you put or fit something
example: Insert the coin into the slot to start the machine.
exampleAr: أدخل العملة في الفتحة لتشغيل الآلة.

definitionEn: not moving, acting or done quickly; taking a long time; not fast
example: The traffic was extremely slow this morning.
exampleAr: كانت حركة المرور بطيئة جدًا هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: to go or to make something/somebody go at a slower speed or be less active
example: Please slow down, you're driving too fast.
exampleAr: من فضلك أبطئ السرعة، فأنت تقود بسرعة كبيرة.

definitionEn: at a slow speed; not quickly
example: He walked slowly toward the exit, deep in thought.
exampleAr: مشى ببطء نحو المخرج، غارقًا في تفكيره.

definitionEn: not large in size, number, degree, amount, etc.
example: They live in a small apartment downtown.
exampleAr: يعيشون في شقة صغيرة وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: looking clean and neat; well dressed in fashionable and/or formal clothes
example: She's a smart student who always gets good grades.
exampleAr: هي طالبة ذكية تحصل دائمًا على درجات جيدة.

definitionEn: a mobile phone that also has some of the functions of a computer, for example the facility to use apps and the internet
example: Almost everyone has a smartphone these days.
exampleAr: يمتلك الجميع تقريبًا هاتفًا ذكيًا هذه الأيام.

definitionEn: to break something, or to be broken, violently and noisily into many pieces
example: He smashed the window to escape the burning house.
exampleAr: حطّم النافذة ليهرب من المنزل المحترق.

definitionEn: to have a particular smell
example: I can smell smoke coming from the kitchen.
exampleAr: أستطيع شمّ رائحة دخان قادمة من المطبخ.

definitionEn: the quality of something that people and animals sense through their noses
example: There's a strange smell coming from the fridge.
exampleAr: توجد رائحة غريبة قادمة من الثلاجة.

definitionEn: to make a smile appear on your face
example: She smiled when she saw the surprise.
exampleAr: ابتسمت عندما رأت المفاجأة.

definitionEn: the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or you think something is funny, in which the corners of your mouth turn upwards
example: He greeted us with a warm smile.
exampleAr: رحّب بنا بابتسامة دافئة.

definitionEn: the grey, white or black gas that is produced by something burning
example: Thick smoke filled the room after the fire started.
exampleAr: امتلأت الغرفة بدخان كثيف بعد اندلاع الحريق.

definitionEn: to take smoke from a cigarette, pipe, etc. into your mouth and let it out again
example: He's been trying to quit smoking for years.
exampleAr: ما زال يحاول الإقلاع عن التدخين منذ سنوات.

definitionEn: the activity or habit of smoking cigarettes, etc.
example: Smoking is banned in most public places now.
exampleAr: التدخين ممنوع الآن في معظم الأماكن العامة.

definitionEn: completely flat and even, without any rough areas or holes
example: The baby's skin is incredibly smooth.
exampleAr: بشرة الطفل ناعمة إلى حد مذهل.

definitionEn: a reptile with a very long thin body and no legs. There are many types of snake, some of which are poisonous.
example: He was bitten by a snake while hiking in the desert.
exampleAr: تعرّض للدغة ثعبان أثناء تنزهه في الصحراء.

meaningAr: ينكسر فجأة مع صوت فرقعة / يتحدث بحدّة وغضب (snap at)
definitionEn: to break something suddenly with a sharp noise; to be broken in this way
example: The branch snapped under his weight.
exampleAr: انكسر الغصن فجأة تحت وزنه.

definitionEn: small soft white pieces (called flakes) of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather; this substance when it is lying on the ground
example: The mountains were completely covered in snow.
exampleAr: كانت الجبال مغطاة بالثلج بالكامل.

definitionEn: when it snows, snow falls from the sky
example: It's supposed to snow heavily tonight.
exampleAr: من المفترض أن تتساقط الثلوج بغزارة الليلة.

definitionEn: to such a great degree
example: I'm so tired today, I can barely keep my eyes open.
exampleAr: أنا متعب جدًا اليوم، بالكاد أستطيع إبقاء عيني مفتوحتين.

definitionEn: used to show the reason for something
example: It was raining, so we decided to stay home.
exampleAr: كانت الأمطار تهطل، لذلك قررنا البقاء في المنزل.

meaningAr: يُسمّى بـ / ما يُعرف بـ (غالبًا بشكل ساخر)
definitionEn: used to show that you do not think that the word or phrase that is being used to describe somebody/something is appropriate
example: The so-called experts got it completely wrong.
exampleAr: أخطأ من يُسمَّون بالخبراء خطأً فادحًا.

definitionEn: to put something in liquid for a time so that it becomes completely wet; to become completely wet in this way
example: Let the beans soak in water overnight.
exampleAr: اترك الفول ينقع في الماء طوال الليل.

definitionEn: a substance that you use with water for washing your body
example: Please wash your hands with soap before eating.
exampleAr: من فضلك اغسل يديك بالصابون قبل الأكل.

definitionEn: if the value, amount or level of something soars, it rises very quickly
example: The eagle soared high above the valley.
exampleAr: حلّق النسر عاليًا فوق الوادي.

definitionEn: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball which players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team’s goal.
example: Kids in the US usually call football 'soccer'.
exampleAr: عادةً ما يُطلق الأطفال في الولايات المتحدة على كرة القدم اسم «سوكر».

definitionEn: connected with activities in which people meet each other for pleasure
example: She has a very active social life.
exampleAr: تتمتع بحياة اجتماعية نشطة جدًا.

definitionEn: connected with socialism
example: The party promotes socialist economic policies.
exampleAr: يروّج الحزب لسياسات اقتصادية اشتراكية.

definitionEn: connected with socialism
example: He has always described himself as a socialist.
exampleAr: لطالما وصف نفسه بأنه اشتراكي.

definitionEn: people in general, living together in communities
example: Technology has changed society in many ways.
exampleAr: غيّرت التكنولوجيا المجتمع بطرق عديدة.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing that is worn over the foot, ankle and lower part of the leg, especially inside a shoe
example: He lost one sock in the laundry again.
exampleAr: فقد جوربًا واحدًا في الغسيل مرة أخرى.

definitionEn: changing shape easily when pressed; not stiff or hard
example: The blanket felt incredibly soft.
exampleAr: كانت البطانية ناعمة الملمس إلى حد مذهل.

definitionEn: the programs used by a computer for doing particular jobs
example: The company develops software for small businesses.
exampleAr: تطوّر الشركة برمجيات للشركات الصغيرة.

definitionEn: the top layer of the earth in which plants, trees, etc. grow
example: The soil here is very fertile for growing vegetables.
exampleAr: التربة هنا خصبة جدًا لزراعة الخضروات.

definitionEn: of or connected with the sun
example: They installed solar panels on the roof last summer.
exampleAr: ركّبوا ألواحًا شمسية على السطح الصيف الماضي.

definitionEn: a member of an army, especially one who is not an officer
example: His father was a soldier in the army for twenty years.
exampleAr: كان والده جنديًا في الجيش لمدة عشرين عامًا.

definitionEn: only; single
example: She was the sole survivor of the crash.
exampleAr: كانت الناجية الوحيدة من الحادث.

definitionEn: only; single
example: The sole of my shoe came loose after the hike.
exampleAr: انفكّ نعل حذائي بعد المشي لمسافات طويلة.

definitionEn: only; not involving somebody/something else
example: The decision was based solely on the test results.
exampleAr: استند القرار حصريًا على نتائج الاختبار.

meaningAr: محامٍ (خاصة في المعاملات القانونية كالعقارات، بريطاني)
definitionEn: a lawyer who prepares legal documents, for example for the sale of land or buildings, advises people on legal matters, and can speak for them in some courts of law
example: She hired a solicitor to handle the sale of the house.
exampleAr: استعانت بمحامٍ لتولّي عملية بيع المنزل.

definitionEn: hard; not in the form of a liquid or gas
example: Water turns solid when it freezes.
exampleAr: يتحول الماء إلى حالة صلبة عندما يتجمد.

definitionEn: support by one person or group of people for another because they share feelings, opinions, aims, etc.
example: Workers showed solidarity by going on strike together.
exampleAr: أظهر العمال تضامنهم بالإضراب معًا.

definitionEn: done by one person alone, without anyone helping them
example: She decided to make the trip solo this time.
exampleAr: قررت القيام بالرحلة بمفردها هذه المرة.

definitionEn: a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation
example: They finally found a solution to the problem.
exampleAr: توصّلوا أخيرًا إلى حل للمشكلة.

definitionEn: to find a way of dealing with a problem or difficult situation
example: It took hours to solve the math problem.
exampleAr: استغرق حلّ مسألة الرياضيات ساعات.

definitionEn: used with uncountable nouns or plural countable nouns to mean ‘an amount of’ or ‘a number of’, when the amount or number is not given
example: Some people prefer tea over coffee.
exampleAr: يفضّل بعض الناس الشاي على القهوة.

definitionEn: a person who is not known or mentioned by name
example: Somebody left their umbrella here.
exampleAr: نسي شخص ما مظلته هنا.

definitionEn: in a way that is not known or certain
example: Somehow, they managed to finish the project on time.
exampleAr: بطريقة ما، تمكّنوا من إنهاء المشروع في الوقت المحدد.

definitionEn: a person who is not known or mentioned by name
example: Someone called while you were out.
exampleAr: اتصل شخص ما بينما كنت في الخارج.

definitionEn: a thing that is not known or mentioned by name
example: There's something strange about this place.
exampleAr: هناك شيء غريب في هذا المكان.

definitionEn: at a time that you do not know exactly or has not yet been decided
example: Let's meet up sometime next week.
exampleAr: لنلتقِ في وقت ما الأسبوع القادم.

definitionEn: occasionally rather than all of the time
example: Sometimes I like to walk to work instead of driving.
exampleAr: أحيانًا أحب المشي إلى العمل بدلاً من القيادة.

definitionEn: to some degree
example: The results were somewhat disappointing.
exampleAr: كانت النتائج مخيبة للآمال إلى حد ما.

definitionEn: in, at or to a place that you do not know or do not mention by name
example: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
exampleAr: تركت مفاتيحي في مكان ما داخل المنزل.

definitionEn: a person’s male child
example: Their son just started university this year.
exampleAr: بدأ ابنهما دراسته الجامعية للتو هذا العام.

definitionEn: a short piece of music with words that you sing
example: This song always reminds me of summer.
exampleAr: تذكّرني هذه الأغنية دائمًا بالصيف.

definitionEn: in a short time from now; a short time after something else has happened
example: We'll be there soon, just a few more minutes.
exampleAr: سنصل قريبًا، بعد بضع دقائق فقط.

meaningAr: راقٍ / أنيق (متطور بالذوق) / معقّد / متطور تقنيًا
definitionEn: clever and complicated in the way that it works or is presented
example: The restaurant has a sophisticated atmosphere.
exampleAr: يتميّز المطعم بأجواء راقية.

definitionEn: feeling sad and ashamed about something that has been done
example: I'm sorry for being late to the meeting.
exampleAr: أنا آسف على تأخري عن الاجتماع.

definitionEn: a group or type of people or things that are similar in a particular way
example: What sort of music do you like?
exampleAr: ما نوع الموسيقى التي تحبها؟

definitionEn: to arrange things in groups or in a particular order according to their type, etc.; to separate things of one type from others
example: She sorted the papers into different folders.
exampleAr: فرزت الأوراق في مجلدات مختلفة.

definitionEn: the spiritual part of a person, believed to exist after death
example: She believed the soul lives on after death.
exampleAr: كانت تؤمن بأن الروح تستمر بعد الموت.

definitionEn: something that you can hear
example: I heard a strange sound coming from the engine.
exampleAr: سمعت صوتًا غريبًا قادمًا من المحرك.

definitionEn: sensible; that you can rely on and that will probably give good results
example: It seems like a sound investment strategy.
exampleAr: يبدو أنها استراتيجية استثمار سليمة.

definitionEn: to give a particular impression when heard or read about
example: That sounds like a great idea to me.
exampleAr: يبدو ذلك فكرة رائعة بالنسبة لي.

definitionEn: a liquid food made by boiling meat, vegetables, etc. in water, often eaten as the first course of a meal
example: She made vegetable soup for dinner.
exampleAr: أعدّت شوربة خضار للعشاء.

definitionEn: a place, person or thing that you get something from
example: The journalist refused to reveal her source.
exampleAr: رفضت الصحفية الكشف عن مصدرها.

definitionEn: the direction that is on your right when you watch the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass
example: They moved south to escape the cold winters.
exampleAr: انتقلوا جنوبًا هربًا من فصول الشتاء الباردة.

definitionEn: located in the south or facing south; connected with or typical of the south part of the world or a region
example: He grew up in a small southern town.
exampleAr: نشأ في بلدة جنوبية صغيرة.

definitionEn: complete power to govern a country
example: The country fought hard to protect its sovereignty.
exampleAr: ناضلت الدولة بشدة لحماية سيادتها.

definitionEn: the area outside the earth’s atmosphere where all the other planets and stars are
example: Scientists are researching ways to travel deeper into space.
exampleAr: يبحث العلماء عن طرق للسفر إلى أعماق الفضاء.

definitionEn: advertising material sent by email to people who have not asked for it; advertising material on the internet that is not wanted
example: My inbox is full of spam every morning.
exampleAr: صندوق بريدي ممتلئ برسائل مزعجة كل صباح.

definitionEn: the length of time that something lasts or is able to continue
example: The project has a span of about six months.
exampleAr: يمتد المشروع لفترة تُقارب ستة أشهر.

definitionEn: to last all through a period of time or to cover the whole of it
example: His career spanned four decades.
exampleAr: امتدت مسيرته المهنية على مدى أربعة عقود.

definitionEn: available to do what you want with rather than work
example: Do you have a spare key to the apartment?
exampleAr: هل لديك مفتاح احتياطي للشقة؟

definitionEn: to make something such as time or money available to somebody or for something, especially when it requires an effort for you to do this
example: Can you spare a few minutes to talk?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك تخصيص بضع دقائق للحديث؟

definitionEn: to cause something to start or develop, especially suddenly
example: A single spark started the massive wildfire.
exampleAr: تسببت شرارة واحدة في اندلاع حريق هائل.

definitionEn: to cause something to start or develop, especially suddenly
example: The announcement sparked outrage online.
exampleAr: أثار الإعلان موجة من الغضب على الإنترنت.

definitionEn: to talk to somebody about something; to have a conversation with somebody
example: She can speak three languages fluently.
exampleAr: تستطيع التحدث بثلاث لغات بطلاقة.

definitionEn: a person who gives a talk or makes a speech
example: The keynote speaker gave an inspiring talk.
exampleAr: ألقى المتحدث الرئيسي كلمة ملهمة.

definitionEn: not ordinary or usual; different from what is normal
example: Today is a special day for our family.
exampleAr: اليوم يوم مميز لعائلتنا.

definitionEn: a person who is an expert in a particular area of work or study
example: You should see a specialist about that knee pain.
exampleAr: ينبغي أن تراجع أخصائيًا بشأن ألم ركبتك ذاك.

definitionEn: to become an expert in a particular area of work, study or business; to spend more time on one area of work, etc. than on others
example: She specializes in pediatric medicine.
exampleAr: تتخصص في طب الأطفال.

definitionEn: designed or developed for a particular purpose or area of knowledge
example: The hospital has specialized equipment for cancer treatment.
exampleAr: يمتلك المستشفى معدات متخصصة لعلاج السرطان.

definitionEn: a group into which animals, plants, etc. that are able to have sex with each other and produce healthy young are divided, smaller than a genus and identified by a Latin name
example: This species of bird is found only in this region.
exampleAr: لا يوجد هذا النوع من الطيور إلا في هذه المنطقة.

definitionEn: connected with one particular thing only
example: Can you give me a specific example?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تعطيني مثالًا محددًا؟

definitionEn: connected with or intended for one particular thing only
example: I specifically asked him not to be late.
exampleAr: طلبت منه تحديدًا ألا يتأخر.

definitionEn: a detailed description of how something is, or should be, designed or made
example: The engineer checked the product against the technical specifications.
exampleAr: تحقق المهندس من المنتج مقارنةً بالمواصفات الفنية.

definitionEn: to state something, especially by giving an exact measurement, time, exact instructions, etc.
example: Please specify your preferred delivery date.
exampleAr: من فضلك حدد تاريخ التسليم الذي تفضله.

definitionEn: a small amount of something that shows what the rest of it is like
example: The lab tested a blood specimen from the patient.
exampleAr: فحص المختبر عيّنة دم من المريض.

definitionEn: two lenses in a frame that rests on the nose and ears. People wear spectacles in order to be able to see better or to protect their eyes from bright light.
example: The opening ceremony was an impressive spectacle.
exampleAr: كان حفل الافتتاح استعراضًا مبهرًا.

definitionEn: very impressive
example: The view from the mountain top was spectacular.
exampleAr: كان المنظر من قمة الجبل مذهلاً.

definitionEn: a person who is watching an event, especially a sports event
example: Thousands of spectators watched the match live.
exampleAr: شاهد آلاف المتفرجين المباراة مباشرةً.

definitionEn: a band of coloured lights in order of their wavelengths, as seen in a rainbow and into which light may be separated
example: Opinions on the issue span a wide spectrum.
exampleAr: تتراوح الآراء حول هذه القضية على نطاق واسع.

definitionEn: to form an opinion about something without knowing all the details or facts
example: Analysts speculate that prices will rise next year.
exampleAr: يتكهّن المحللون بأن الأسعار سترتفع العام المقبل.

definitionEn: the act of forming opinions about what has happened or what might happen without knowing all the facts
example: There's a lot of speculation about who will win the election.
exampleAr: هناك الكثير من التكهنات حول من سيفوز في الانتخابات.

definitionEn: a formal talk that a person gives to an audience
example: The president gave a speech about the economy.
exampleAr: ألقى الرئيس خطابًا عن الاقتصاد.

definitionEn: the rate at which somebody/something moves or travels
example: The car was traveling at high speed.
exampleAr: كانت السيارة تسير بسرعة عالية.

definitionEn: to move along quickly
example: He was fined for speeding on the highway.
exampleAr: تمت معاقبته بغرامة بسبب تجاوزه السرعة المسموحة على الطريق السريع.

definitionEn: to say or write the letters of a word in the correct order
example: Can you spell your last name for me?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تتهجى لي اسم عائلتك؟

meaningAr: تعويذة (سحرية) / فترة قصيرة (من طقس أو حالة)
definitionEn: a short period of time during which something lasts
example: The witch cast a spell on the prince.
exampleAr: ألقت الساحرة تعويذة على الأمير.

definitionEn: the act of forming words correctly from individual letters; the ability to do this
example: English spelling can be very tricky for learners.
exampleAr: يمكن أن تكون تهجئة الإنجليزية معقدة جدًا بالنسبة للمتعلمين.

definitionEn: to give money to pay for goods, services, etc.
example: They spent a lot of money on the wedding.
exampleAr: أنفقوا الكثير من المال على حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: the amount of money that is spent by a government, an organization or a person
example: Government spending on healthcare increased this year.
exampleAr: ازداد إنفاق الحكومة على الرعاية الصحية هذا العام.

definitionEn: a solid figure that is completely round, with every point on its surface at an equal distance from the centre
example: The planet is roughly a perfect sphere.
exampleAr: يكاد يكون شكل الكوكب كرة مثالية.

definitionEn: one of the various types of powder or seed that come from plants and are used in cooking. Spices have a strong taste and smell.
example: The dish was full of exotic spices.
exampleAr: كان الطبق مليئًا بالتوابل الغريبة.

definitionEn: having a strong taste because spices have been added to it
example: I love spicy food, especially curry.
exampleAr: أحب الطعام الحار، خاصةً الكاري.

definitionEn: a small creature with eight thin legs. Many spiders spin webs to catch insects for food.
example: She screamed when she saw a spider in the bathroom.
exampleAr: صرخت عندما رأت عنكبوتًا في الحمام.

definitionEn: to flow over the edge of a container by accident; to make liquid do this
example: He spilled coffee all over his shirt.
exampleAr: سكب القهوة على قميصه بالكامل.

definitionEn: to flow over the edge of a container by accident; to make liquid do this
example: The oil spill damaged miles of coastline.
exampleAr: ألحق انسكاب النفط أضرارًا بأميال من الساحل.

definitionEn: to turn round and round quickly; to make something do this
example: The wheels began to spin on the icy road.
exampleAr: بدأت العجلات تدور على الطريق المتجمد.

definitionEn: a very fast turning movement
example: The dancer finished with an elegant spin.
exampleAr: أنهت الراقصة عرضها بدورانٍ أنيق.

definitionEn: the row of small bones that are connected together down the middle of the back
example: He injured his spine in the accident.
exampleAr: أصيب في عموده الفقري خلال الحادث.

definitionEn: the part of a person that includes their mind, feelings and character rather than their body
example: Despite the setback, the team's spirit remained high.
exampleAr: رغم النكسة، ظلّت معنويات الفريق مرتفعة.

definitionEn: connected with the human spirit, rather than the body or physical things
example: She found the retreat to be a deeply spiritual experience.
exampleAr: وجدت في هذا الاعتكاف تجربة روحية عميقة.

definitionEn: a feeling of wanting to hurt or upset somebody
example: He did it out of spite, not necessity.
exampleAr: فعل ذلك بدافع الحقد، لا الضرورة.

definitionEn: to divide, or to make something divide, into two or more parts
example: Let's split the bill evenly between us.
exampleAr: لنقسّم الفاتورة بالتساوي بيننا.

definitionEn: an argument or disagreement that divides a group of people or makes somebody separate from somebody else
example: There was a split in the party over the new policy.
exampleAr: حدث انقسام داخل الحزب بشأن السياسة الجديدة.

definitionEn: to change something good into something bad, unpleasant, etc.
example: The milk will spoil if you don't refrigerate it.
exampleAr: سيفسد الحليب إذا لم تضعه في الثلاجة.

definitionEn: involving speaking rather than writing; expressed in speech rather than in writing
example: Spoken English can be very different from written English.
exampleAr: قد تختلف الإنجليزية المحكية كثيرًا عن الإنجليزية المكتوبة.
