definitionEn: an act of hitting a ball, for example with a bat or racket
example: He suffered a stroke last year and is still recovering.
exampleAr: أُصيب بسكتة دماغية العام الماضي وما زال يتعافى.

definitionEn: an act of hitting a ball, for example with a bat or racket
example: She gently stroked the cat's fur.
exampleAr: مسّدت فرو القطة برفق.

definitionEn: having a lot of physical power so that you can lift heavy weights, do hard physical work, etc.
example: He has a strong grip from years of manual labor.
exampleAr: لديه قبضة قوية من سنوات العمل اليدوي.

definitionEn: in a way that shows definite and serious opinions or beliefs
example: I strongly recommend seeing a doctor about that.
exampleAr: أنصحك بشدة بمراجعة طبيب بشأن ذلك.

definitionEn: connected with the way in which something is built or organized
example: The engineers found structural damage to the bridge.
exampleAr: اكتشف المهندسون أضرارًا إنشائية في الجسر.

definitionEn: the way in which the parts of something are connected together, arranged or organized; a particular arrangement of parts
example: The company changed its management structure.
exampleAr: غيّرت الشركة هيكلها الإداري.

definitionEn: to arrange or organize something into a system or pattern
example: You need to structure your essay more clearly.
exampleAr: عليك أن تنظّم مقالك بشكل أوضح.

definitionEn: to try very hard to do something when it is difficult or when there are a lot of problems
example: She struggled to pay her bills after losing her job.
exampleAr: كافحت لسداد فواتيرها بعد أن فقدت وظيفتها.

definitionEn: a hard fight in which people try to obtain or achieve something, especially something that somebody else does not want them to have
example: Their struggle for independence lasted decades.
exampleAr: استمر كفاحهم من أجل الاستقلال عقودًا.

definitionEn: a person who is studying at a university or college
example: She's a student at the local university.
exampleAr: هي طالبة في الجامعة المحلية.

meaningAr: استوديو (تسجيل أو تصوير) / شقة استوديو (سكن صغير)
definitionEn: a room where radio or television programmes are recorded and broadcast from, or where music is recorded
example: The band recorded their new album in a studio in London.
exampleAr: سجّلت الفرقة ألبومها الجديد في استوديو بلندن.

definitionEn: to spend time learning about a subject by reading, going to college, etc.
example: He studies medicine at Cairo University.
exampleAr: يدرس الطب في جامعة القاهرة.

definitionEn: the activity of learning or gaining knowledge, either from books or by examining things in the world
example: A new study found a link between diet and sleep quality.
exampleAr: توصّلت دراسة جديدة إلى وجود صلة بين النظام الغذائي وجودة النوم.

definitionEn: used to refer to a substance, material, group of objects, etc. when you do not know the name, when the name is not important or when it is obvious what you are talking about
example: Can you help me carry this stuff upstairs?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك مساعدتي في حمل هذه الأغراض إلى الطابق العلوي؟

definitionEn: to hit your foot against something while you are walking or running and almost fall
example: She stumbled on the uneven pavement and nearly fell.
exampleAr: تعثرت في الرصيف غير المستوي وكادت أن تسقط.

definitionEn: to make a person or an animal unconscious for a short time, especially by hitting them on the head
example: The announcement stunned everyone in the room.
exampleAr: أذهل الإعلان الجميع في الغرفة.

definitionEn: extremely attractive or impressive
example: The view from the summit was absolutely stunning.
exampleAr: كان المنظر من القمة خلّابًا تمامًا.

definitionEn: showing a lack of thought or good judgement
example: It was a stupid mistake that cost us a lot of money.
exampleAr: كان خطأً غبيًا كلّفنا الكثير من المال.

definitionEn: the particular way in which something is done
example: She has a very distinctive style of writing.
exampleAr: تتمتع بأسلوب كتابة مميز جدًا.

definitionEn: a thing or person that is being discussed, described or dealt with
example: Let's change the subject and talk about something else.
exampleAr: لنغيّر الموضوع ونتحدث عن شيء آخر.

definitionEn: likely to be affected by something, especially something bad
example: The plan is still subject to final approval.
exampleAr: لا تزال الخطة خاضعة للموافقة النهائية.

definitionEn: the act of accepting that somebody has defeated you and that you must obey them
example: The deadline for submission of applications is Friday.
exampleAr: الموعد النهائي لتقديم الطلبات هو يوم الجمعة.

definitionEn: to give a document, proposal, etc. to somebody in authority so that they can study or consider it
example: Please submit your assignment by midnight.
exampleAr: من فضلك قدّم واجبك قبل منتصف الليل.

definitionEn: a person who pays money, usually once a year, to receive regular copies of a magazine or newspaper or have access to it online
example: The channel has over a million subscribers.
exampleAr: تضم القناة أكثر من مليون مشترك.

definitionEn: an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service, be a member of a club, support a charity or receive regular copies of a newspaper or magazine; the act of paying this money
example: I canceled my magazine subscription last month.
exampleAr: ألغيت اشتراكي في المجلة الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: happening or coming after something else
example: The subsequent chapters explain the theory in more detail.
exampleAr: تشرح الفصول اللاحقة النظرية بمزيد من التفصيل.

definitionEn: afterwards; later; after something else has happened
example: He was arrested and subsequently released on bail.
exampleAr: اعتُقل ثم أُطلق سراحه لاحقًا بكفالة.

definitionEn: money that is paid by a government or an organization to reduce the costs of services or of producing goods so that their prices can be kept low
example: The government provides subsidies for local farmers.
exampleAr: تقدّم الحكومة إعانات مالية للمزارعين المحليين.

definitionEn: a type of solid, liquid or gas that has particular qualities
example: Police found an illegal substance in the car.
exampleAr: عثرت الشرطة على مادة غير مشروعة في السيارة.

definitionEn: large in amount, value or importance
example: They made substantial changes to the original design.
exampleAr: أجروا تغييرات جوهرية على التصميم الأصلي.

definitionEn: very much; a lot
example: Prices have increased substantially this year.
exampleAr: ارتفعت الأسعار بشكل كبير هذا العام.

definitionEn: a person or thing that you use or have instead of the one you normally use or have
example: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar.
exampleAr: يمكنك استخدام العسل كبديل للسكر.

definitionEn: to take the place of somebody/something else; to use somebody/something instead of somebody/something else
example: You can substitute butter with oil in this recipe.
exampleAr: يمكنك استبدال الزبدة بالزيت في هذه الوصفة.

definitionEn: an act of using one person or thing in the place of another
example: The coach made a substitution early in the second half.
exampleAr: أجرى المدرب تبديلًا في وقت مبكر من الشوط الثاني.

definitionEn: not very obvious or easy to notice
example: There's a subtle difference between the two colors.
exampleAr: هناك فرق دقيق بين اللونين.

definitionEn: an area where people live that is outside the centre of a city
example: They moved to a quiet suburb outside the city.
exampleAr: انتقلوا إلى ضاحية هادئة خارج المدينة.

definitionEn: in or connected with a suburb
example: They grew up in a typical suburban neighborhood.
exampleAr: نشأوا في حي ضاحوي نموذجي.

definitionEn: to achieve something that you have been trying to do or get; to have the result or effect that was intended
example: She worked hard and finally succeeded in her career.
exampleAr: عملت بجد ونجحت أخيرًا في مسيرتها المهنية.

definitionEn: the fact that you have achieved something that you want and have been trying to do or get
example: The event was a huge success.
exampleAr: كانت الفعالية نجاحًا كبيرًا.

definitionEn: achieving your aims or what was intended
example: He's a successful businessman with several companies.
exampleAr: هو رجل أعمال ناجح يمتلك عدة شركات.

definitionEn: in a way that achieves your aims or what was intended
example: The surgery was completed successfully.
exampleAr: تمت العملية الجراحية بنجاح.

definitionEn: a number of people or things that follow each other in time or order
example: There was a succession of problems throughout the project.
exampleAr: توالت المشكلات طوال المشروع.

definitionEn: following immediately one after the other
example: The team won three successive championships.
exampleAr: فاز الفريق بثلاث بطولات متتالية.

definitionEn: a person or thing that comes after somebody/something else and takes their/its place
example: The company announced her successor as CEO.
exampleAr: أعلنت الشركة عن خليفتها في منصب الرئيس التنفيذي.

definitionEn: used to emphasize the great degree of something
example: I've never seen such a beautiful sunset.
exampleAr: لم أرَ من قبل غروبًا بهذا الجمال.

definitionEn: to take liquid, air, etc. into your mouth by using the muscles of your lips
example: The baby was sucking on a pacifier.
exampleAr: كان الطفل يمصّ اللهّاية.

definitionEn: happening or done quickly and unexpectedly
example: There was a sudden change in the weather.
exampleAr: طرأ تغيّر مفاجئ على الطقس.

definitionEn: quickly and unexpectedly
example: Suddenly, all the lights went out.
exampleAr: فجأة، انطفأت جميع الأضواء.

definitionEn: to make a claim against a person or an organization in court about something that they have said or done to harm you
example: The company decided to sue for breach of contract.
exampleAr: قررت الشركة رفع دعوى قضائية بسبب الإخلال بالعقد.

definitionEn: to be badly affected by a disease, pain, sad feelings, a lack of something, etc.
example: Many people suffer from chronic back pain.
exampleAr: يعاني كثير من الناس من آلام مزمنة في الظهر.

definitionEn: physical or mental pain
example: The war caused immense human suffering.
exampleAr: تسببت الحرب في معاناة إنسانية هائلة.

definitionEn: enough for a particular purpose; as much as you need
example: We don't have sufficient evidence to make a decision.
exampleAr: ليس لدينا أدلة كافية لاتخاذ قرار.

definitionEn: enough for a particular purpose; as much as you need
example: The room wasn't sufficiently heated in winter.
exampleAr: لم تكن الغرفة مدفأة بشكل كافٍ في الشتاء.

definitionEn: a sweet substance, often in the form of white or brown crystals, made from the juices of various plants, used in cooking or to make tea, coffee, etc. sweeter
example: He takes two spoons of sugar in his coffee.
exampleAr: يضع ملعقتين من السكر في قهوته.

definitionEn: to put forward an idea or a plan for other people to think about
example: I suggest we leave early to avoid the traffic.
exampleAr: أقترح أن نغادر مبكرًا لتجنب الزحام.

definitionEn: an idea or a plan that you mention for somebody else to think about
example: Do you have any suggestions for the party?
exampleAr: هل لديك أي اقتراحات للحفلة؟

definitionEn: the act of killing yourself deliberately
example: The organization offers support and resources to people affected by suicide.
exampleAr: تقدّم المنظمة الدعم والموارد للأشخاص المتأثرين بالانتحار.

definitionEn: a set of clothes made of the same cloth, including a jacket and trousers or a skirt
example: He wore a dark suit to the interview.
exampleAr: ارتدى بدلة داكنة للمقابلة.

definitionEn: to be convenient or useful for somebody
example: This color really suits you.
exampleAr: هذا اللون يناسبك حقًا.

definitionEn: right or appropriate for a particular purpose or occasion
example: This film isn't suitable for young children.
exampleAr: هذا الفيلم غير مناسب للأطفال الصغار.

definitionEn: a set of rooms, especially in a hotel
example: They booked a suite for their honeymoon.
exampleAr: حجزوا جناحًا لشهر عسلهما.

definitionEn: an amount of money
example: They donated a large sum of money to the charity.
exampleAr: تبرعوا بمبلغ كبير من المال للجمعية الخيرية.

definitionEn: to give a summary of something
example: Can you summarize the article in a few sentences?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك تلخيص المقال في بضع جمل؟

definitionEn: a short statement that gives only the main points of something, not the details
example: Please provide a summary of the report.
exampleAr: من فضلك قدّم ملخصًا للتقرير.

definitionEn: the warmest season of the year, coming between spring and autumn
example: We usually travel to the coast every summer.
exampleAr: عادةً ما نسافر إلى الساحل كل صيف.

definitionEn: the highest point of something, especially the top of a mountain
example: They reached the summit after a six-hour climb.
exampleAr: وصلوا إلى القمة بعد تسلّق استمر ست ساعات.

definitionEn: the star that shines in the sky during the day and gives the earth heat and light
example: The sun was shining brightly all afternoon.
exampleAr: كانت الشمس تسطع بشدة طوال فترة بعد الظهر.

definitionEn: the day of the week after Saturday and before Monday, thought of as either the first or the last day of the week
example: We usually have a big family lunch on Sundays.
exampleAr: عادةً ما نتناول غداءً عائليًا كبيرًا أيام الأحد.

definitionEn: extremely good
example: The food at that restaurant was super!
exampleAr: كان الطعام في ذلك المطعم رائعًا جدًا!

definitionEn: excellent; of very good quality
example: The service at the hotel was superb.
exampleAr: كانت الخدمة في الفندق ممتازة.

definitionEn: better in quality than somebody/something else; greater than somebody/something else
example: This model is superior to the older version.
exampleAr: هذا الطراز أعلى جودة من النسخة القديمة.

definitionEn: better in quality than somebody/something else; greater than somebody/something else
example: She reported the issue to her superior.
exampleAr: أبلغت رئيسها في العمل بالمشكلة.

definitionEn: a large shop that sells food, drinks and goods used in the home. People choose what they want from the shelves and pay for it as they leave.
example: I need to go to the supermarket to buy groceries.
exampleAr: أحتاج إلى الذهاب إلى السوبر ماركت لشراء البقالة.

definitionEn: to be in charge of somebody/something and make sure that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.
example: She supervises a team of ten employees.
exampleAr: تشرف على فريق مكون من عشرة موظفين.

definitionEn: the work or activity involved in being in charge of somebody/something and making sure that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.
example: Children should swim only under adult supervision.
exampleAr: ينبغي ألا يسبح الأطفال إلا تحت إشراف شخص بالغ.

definitionEn: a person who supervises somebody/something
example: You'll need approval from your supervisor first.
exampleAr: ستحتاج إلى موافقة مشرفك أولاً.

definitionEn: a thing that is added to something else to improve or complete it
example: He takes a vitamin supplement every morning.
exampleAr: يتناول مكملًا غذائيًا من الفيتامينات كل صباح.

definitionEn: to add something to something in order to improve it or make it more complete
example: She supplements her income with freelance work.
exampleAr: تكمّل دخلها بالعمل الحر.

definitionEn: an amount of something that is provided or available to be used
example: The city faced a water supply shortage during the drought.
exampleAr: واجهت المدينة نقصًا في إمدادات المياه خلال الجفاف.

definitionEn: to provide somebody/something with something that they need or want, especially in large quantities
example: The factory supplies parts to major car manufacturers.
exampleAr: يزوّد المصنع كبرى شركات صناعة السيارات بالقطع.

definitionEn: to help or encourage somebody/something by saying or showing that you agree with them/it
example: Her parents fully support her career choice.
exampleAr: يدعم والداها اختيارها المهني بالكامل.

definitionEn: approval that you give to somebody/something because you want them to be successful
example: Thank you for all your support during this difficult time.
exampleAr: شكرًا لك على كل دعمك خلال هذه الفترة الصعبة.

definitionEn: a person who supports a political party, an idea, etc.
example: He's a lifelong supporter of the local football team.
exampleAr: هو مشجّع دائم لفريق كرة القدم المحلي منذ صغره.

definitionEn: encouraging somebody or giving them help or sympathy
example: My colleagues have been very supportive since the accident.
exampleAr: كان زملائي داعمين جدًا منذ وقوع الحادث.

definitionEn: to think or believe that something is true or possible (based on the knowledge that you have)
example: I suppose you're right about that.
exampleAr: أفترض أنك محق في ذلك.

meaningAr: على ما يُفترض / حسب ما يُقال
definitionEn: according to what is generally thought or believed but not known for certain
example: The restaurant is supposedly the best in town.
exampleAr: يُقال إن هذا المطعم هو الأفضل في المدينة.

definitionEn: to put an end, often by force, to a group or an activity that is believed to threaten authority
example: The government tried to suppress the protests.
exampleAr: حاولت الحكومة قمع الاحتجاجات.

definitionEn: highest in rank or position
example: The Supreme Court made a final ruling on the case.
exampleAr: أصدرت المحكمة العليا حكمًا نهائيًا في القضية.

definitionEn: confident that you know something or that you are right
example: Are you sure you locked the door?
exampleAr: هل أنت متأكد أنك أغلقت الباب؟

definitionEn: used to show that you are almost certain of what you are saying and want other people to agree with you
example: Surely there's a better way to solve this.
exampleAr: بالتأكيد توجد طريقة أفضل لحل هذا الأمر.

definitionEn: the outside or top layer of something
example: The table has a smooth wooden surface.
exampleAr: تمتلك الطاولة سطحًا خشبيًا أملس.

definitionEn: the outside or top layer of something
example: New evidence surfaced during the investigation.
exampleAr: ظهرت أدلة جديدة خلال التحقيق.

definitionEn: a sudden increase of a strong feeling
example: There was a surge in demand for masks during the pandemic.
exampleAr: حدث ارتفاع مفاجئ في الطلب على الكمامات خلال الجائحة.

definitionEn: to move quickly and with force in a particular direction
example: Prices surged right after the announcement.
exampleAr: ارتفعت الأسعار فجأة فور الإعلان.

definitionEn: a doctor who is trained to perform surgery (= medical operations that involve cutting open a person’s body)
example: The surgeon operated on his knee for three hours.
exampleAr: أجرى الجراح عملية لركبته استمرت ثلاث ساعات.

definitionEn: medical treatment of injuries or diseases that involves cutting open a person’s body and often removing or replacing some parts; the branch of medicine connected with this treatment
example: She's recovering well after her surgery.
exampleAr: تتعافى جيدًا بعد جراحتها.

definitionEn: used in or connected with surgery
example: The hospital has state-of-the-art surgical equipment.
exampleAr: يمتلك المستشفى معدات جراحية حديثة جدًا.

definitionEn: an amount that is extra or more than you need
example: The country reported a budget surplus this year.
exampleAr: أعلنت الدولة عن فائض في الميزانية هذا العام.

definitionEn: an event, a piece of news, etc. that is unexpected or that happens suddenly
example: It was a nice surprise to see her at the party.
exampleAr: كانت مفاجأة سارة رؤيتها في الحفلة.

definitionEn: to make somebody feel surprised
example: The results surprised everyone on the team.
exampleAr: فاجأت النتائج جميع أفراد الفريق.

definitionEn: feeling or showing surprise
example: I was surprised to see how much he had grown.
exampleAr: تفاجأت بمدى نموّه.

definitionEn: causing surprise
example: It's surprising how quickly the situation changed.
exampleAr: من المثير للدهشة كم تغيّر الوضع بسرعة.

definitionEn: to admit that you have been defeated and want to stop fighting; to allow yourself to be caught, taken prisoner, etc.
example: The army was forced to surrender after weeks of fighting.
exampleAr: اضطر الجيش إلى الاستسلام بعد أسابيع من القتال.

definitionEn: to admit that you have been defeated and want to stop fighting; to allow yourself to be caught, taken prisoner, etc.
example: The general announced the country's surrender.
exampleAr: أعلن الجنرال استسلام البلاد.

definitionEn: to be all around something/somebody
example: Mountains surround the small village on all sides.
exampleAr: تحيط الجبال بالقرية الصغيرة من جميع الجهات.

definitionEn: that is near or around something
example: The surrounding countryside is beautiful in spring.
exampleAr: يكون الريف المحيط جميلًا في الربيع.

definitionEn: the act of carefully watching a person suspected of a crime or a place where a crime may be committed
example: The building is monitored by 24-hour surveillance cameras.
exampleAr: يُراقَب المبنى بكاميرات مراقبة على مدار 24 ساعة.

definitionEn: an investigation of the opinions, behaviour, etc. of a particular group of people, which is usually done by asking them questions
example: The company conducted a survey to understand customer needs.
exampleAr: أجرت الشركة استطلاعًا لفهم احتياجات العملاء.

definitionEn: to look carefully at the whole of something, especially in order to get a general impression of it
example: Researchers surveyed over a thousand people for the study.
exampleAr: استطلع الباحثون آراء أكثر من ألف شخص من أجل الدراسة.

definitionEn: the state of continuing to live or exist, often despite difficulty or danger
example: Their survival depended on finding water quickly.
exampleAr: توقفت نجاتهم على إيجاد الماء بسرعة.

definitionEn: to continue to live or exist
example: Few passengers survived the crash.
exampleAr: نجا عدد قليل من الركاب من الحادث.

definitionEn: a person who continues to live, especially despite being nearly killed or experiencing great danger or difficulty
example: The survivor described the terrifying experience to reporters.
exampleAr: وصف الناجي التجربة المرعبة للصحفيين.

definitionEn: to have an idea that something is probably true or likely to happen, especially something bad, but without having definite proof
example: Police suspect the fire was started deliberately.
exampleAr: تشتبه الشرطة في أن الحريق أُشعل عمدًا.

definitionEn: a person who is suspected of a crime or of having done something wrong
example: The suspect was arrested near the scene of the crime.
exampleAr: أُلقي القبض على المشتبه به قرب مسرح الجريمة.

meaningAr: يعلّق / يوقف مؤقتًا / يوقف شخصًا مؤقتًا (عقابيًا)
definitionEn: to hang something from something else
example: The airline suspended flights due to the storm.
exampleAr: علّقت شركة الطيران رحلاتها بسبب العاصفة.

meaningAr: تعليق / إيقاف مؤقت / إيقاف عن العمل أو الدراسة (عقابي)
definitionEn: the act of officially removing somebody from their job, school, team, etc. for a period of time, usually as a punishment
example: There was a temporary suspension of trading on the stock exchange.
exampleAr: حدث تعليق مؤقت للتداول في البورصة.

definitionEn: a feeling that somebody has done something wrong, illegal or dishonest, even though you have no proof
example: The police arrested him on suspicion of theft.
exampleAr: ألقت الشرطة القبض عليه للاشتباه في تورطه بالسرقة.

definitionEn: feeling that somebody has done something wrong, illegal or dishonest, without having any proof
example: The neighbors reported suspicious activity near the house.
exampleAr: أبلغ الجيران عن نشاط مريب بالقرب من المنزل.

definitionEn: to provide enough of what somebody/something needs in order to live or exist
example: It's hard to sustain this level of growth long-term.
exampleAr: من الصعب الحفاظ على هذا المستوى من النمو على المدى الطويل.

definitionEn: involving the use of natural products and energy in a way that does not harm the environment
example: The company is investing in sustainable energy sources.
exampleAr: تستثمر الشركة في مصادر طاقة مستدامة.

definitionEn: to make food, drink, etc. go down your throat into your stomach
example: It's important to chew your food well before you swallow.
exampleAr: من المهم مضغ الطعام جيدًا قبل بلعه.

definitionEn: to make food, drink, etc. go down your throat into your stomach
example: A swallow flew past the open window.
exampleAr: حلّق طائر سنونو أمام النافذة المفتوحة.

definitionEn: to use rude or offensive language, usually because you are angry
example: I swear I didn't take your phone.
exampleAr: أقسم أنني لم آخذ هاتفك.

definitionEn: a piece of clothing for the upper part of the body, made of wool or cotton, with long sleeves
example: She wore a warm sweater in the cold weather.
exampleAr: ارتدت كنزة دافئة في الطقس البارد.

definitionEn: to clean a room, surface, etc. using a broom (= a type of brush on a long handle)
example: He swept the floor before the guests arrived.
exampleAr: كنس الأرضية قبل وصول الضيوف.

definitionEn: containing, or tasting as if it contains, a lot of sugar
example: This cake is a little too sweet for me.
exampleAr: هذه الكعكة حلوة أكثر مما يناسبني قليلاً.

definitionEn: to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom
example: They swim in the lake every summer.
exampleAr: يسبحون في البحيرة كل صيف.

definitionEn: the sport or activity of swimming
example: Swimming is great exercise for the whole body.
exampleAr: السباحة تمرين رائع للجسم كله.

definitionEn: to move backwards or forwards or from side to side while hanging from a fixed point; to make something do this
example: The door swung open suddenly in the wind.
exampleAr: انفتح الباب فجأة متأرجحًا مع الريح.

definitionEn: a swinging movement or rhythm
example: The kids love playing on the swing in the park.
exampleAr: يحب الأطفال اللعب على الأرجوحة في الحديقة.

definitionEn: a small device that you press or move up and down in order to turn a light or piece of electrical equipment on and off
example: Flip the switch to turn on the lights.
exampleAr: اقلب المفتاح لتشغيل الأضواء.

definitionEn: to change or make something change from one thing to another
example: She switched jobs last year for a better salary.
exampleAr: بدّلت وظيفتها العام الماضي من أجل راتب أفضل.

definitionEn: a weapon with a long metal blade (= sharp cutting part) and a handle
example: The museum displays an ancient sword from the medieval period.
exampleAr: يعرض المتحف سيفًا قديمًا من العصور الوسطى.

definitionEn: a person, an object, an event, etc. that represents a more general quality or situation
example: The dove is a symbol of peace.
exampleAr: الحمامة رمز للسلام.

definitionEn: containing symbols, or being used as a symbol
example: The gesture was largely symbolic, without real legal power.
exampleAr: كانت البادرة رمزية إلى حد كبير، دون قوة قانونية حقيقية.

definitionEn: kind to somebody who is hurt or sad; showing that you understand and care about their problems
example: She was very sympathetic when I told her about the loss.
exampleAr: كانت متعاطفة جدًا عندما أخبرتها عن الخسارة.

definitionEn: the feeling of being sorry for somebody; showing that you understand and care about somebody’s problems
example: He received messages of sympathy from friends and family.
exampleAr: تلقّى رسائل تعاطف من الأصدقاء والعائلة.

definitionEn: a change in your body or mind that shows that you are not healthy
example: Fever is a common symptom of the flu.
exampleAr: الحمّى عرض شائع للإنفلونزا.

definitionEn: a set of physical conditions that show you have a particular disease or medical problem
example: The disorder is known as chronic fatigue syndrome.
exampleAr: يُعرف هذا الاضطراب باسم متلازمة الإرهاق المزمن.

definitionEn: the act of combining separate ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.; a mixture or combination of ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.
example: The report is a synthesis of years of research.
exampleAr: التقرير عبارة عن توليف لسنوات من البحث.

definitionEn: an organized set of ideas or theories or a particular way of doing something
example: The company installed a new security system.
exampleAr: ركّبت الشركة نظام أمان جديدًا.

definitionEn: done according to a system or plan, in a complete, efficient or determined way
example: They took a systematic approach to solving the problem.
exampleAr: اتبعوا نهجًا منهجيًا لحل المشكلة.

definitionEn: an informal shirt, usually with short sleeves (= arms) no collar or buttons, or just a few buttons at the top
example: He was wearing a plain white T-shirt.
exampleAr: كان يرتدي تي شيرت أبيض بسيطًا.

definitionEn: a piece of furniture that consists of a flat top supported by legs
example: Please set the table before dinner.
exampleAr: من فضلك جهّز الطاولة قبل العشاء.

definitionEn: a small computer that is easy to carry, with a large touch screen and usually without a physical keyboard
example: She reads books on her tablet every night.
exampleAr: تقرأ الكتب على جهازها اللوحي كل ليلة.

meaningAr: يعالج / يتصدى لـ (مشكلة) / يطيح بـ (في الرياضة)
definitionEn: to make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem or situation
example: The government needs to tackle unemployment more seriously.
exampleAr: يتعين على الحكومة التصدي للبطالة بجدية أكبر.

definitionEn: the particular method you use to achieve something
example: Their main tactic was to wear down the opponent slowly.
exampleAr: كان تكتيكهم الرئيسي هو إنهاك الخصم تدريجيًا.

definitionEn: connected with the particular method you use to achieve something
example: The coach made a smart tactical decision at halftime.
exampleAr: اتخذ المدرب قرارًا تكتيكيًا ذكيًا خلال الاستراحة بين الشوطين.

definitionEn: a small piece of paper, cloth, plastic, etc. attached to something to identify it or give information about it
example: Check the price tag before you buy it.
exampleAr: تحقق من بطاقة السعر قبل أن تشتريه.

meaningAr: يضع علامة على (شيء، للتعريف) / يُشير إلى شخص (في صورة على مواقع التواصل)
definitionEn: to fasten a tag onto something/somebody
example: Workers tagged each animal before releasing it back into the wild.
exampleAr: وضع العمال علامة تعريف على كل حيوان قبل إطلاقه مجددًا في البرية.

definitionEn: the part that sticks out at the back of the body of a bird, an animal or a fish, which the animal can move from side to side or up and down
example: The dog wagged its tail happily.
exampleAr: هزّ الكلب ذيله بسعادة.

definitionEn: to carry or move something from one place to another
example: Can you take this box to the office for me?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أخذ هذا الصندوق إلى المكتب من أجلي؟

definitionEn: a story created using the imagination, especially one that is full of action and adventure
example: She told the children a bedtime tale.
exampleAr: حكت للأطفال حكاية قبل النوم.

definitionEn: a natural ability to do something well
example: He has a real talent for painting.
exampleAr: يمتلك موهبة حقيقية في الرسم.

definitionEn: having a natural ability to do something well
example: She's a talented young musician.
exampleAr: هي موسيقية شابة موهوبة.

definitionEn: to say things; to speak in order to give information or to express feelings, ideas, etc.
example: We talked for hours about our plans for the future.
exampleAr: تحدثنا لساعات عن خططنا للمستقبل.

definitionEn: a speech or lecture on a particular subject
example: I need to have a serious talk with him.
exampleAr: أحتاج إلى إجراء حديث جاد معه.

definitionEn: having a greater than average height
example: He's the tallest person in his class.
exampleAr: هو أطول شخص في صفه.

definitionEn: a large container for holding liquid or gas
example: The fish tank needs to be cleaned regularly.
exampleAr: يحتاج خزان الأسماك إلى التنظيف بانتظام.

definitionEn: a device for controlling the flow of water from a pipe into a bath or sink
example: Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.
exampleAr: أغلق الصنبور أثناء تنظيف أسنانك.

definitionEn: to hit somebody/something quickly and lightly
example: She tapped him on the shoulder to get his attention.
exampleAr: نقرت على كتفه لتلفت انتباهه.

definitionEn: a long, narrow piece of material with a sticky substance on one side that is used for sticking things together
example: He used tape to seal the box securely.
exampleAr: استخدم شريطًا لاصقًا لإغلاق الصندوق بإحكام.

definitionEn: a result that you try to achieve
example: The company set an ambitious sales target for the year.
exampleAr: حددت الشركة هدف مبيعات طموحًا لهذا العام.

definitionEn: to aim an attack or a criticism at somebody/something
example: The ad campaign targets young professionals.
exampleAr: تستهدف الحملة الإعلانية المهنيين الشباب.

definitionEn: a piece of work that somebody has to do, especially a hard or unpleasant one
example: She completed the task ahead of schedule.
exampleAr: أنجزت المهمة قبل الموعد المحدد.

definitionEn: the particular quality that different foods and drinks have that allows you to recognize them when you put them in your mouth
example: The soup has a rich, spicy taste.
exampleAr: للشوربة طعم غني وحار.

definitionEn: to have a particular taste
example: Can I taste a bit of your dessert?
exampleAr: هل يمكنني تذوّق قليل من حلواك؟

definitionEn: money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services. People pay tax according to their income and businesses pay tax according to their profits. Tax is also often paid on goods and services.
example: They increased the tax on imported goods.
exampleAr: رفعوا الضريبة على البضائع المستوردة.

definitionEn: to put a tax on somebody/something; to make somebody pay tax
example: The government taxes cigarettes heavily.
exampleAr: تفرض الحكومة ضريبة مرتفعة على السجائر.

definitionEn: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere. Taxis usually have meters that show how much money you have to pay.
example: We took a taxi to the airport.
exampleAr: استقللنا سيارة أجرة إلى المطار.

definitionEn: a person who pays tax to the government, especially on the money that they earn
example: Taxpayers are funding the new infrastructure project.
exampleAr: يموّل دافعو الضرائب مشروع البنية التحتية الجديد.

definitionEn: the dried leaves (called tea leaves) of the tea bush
example: Would you like a cup of tea?
exampleAr: هل ترغب في كوب من الشاي؟

definitionEn: to give lessons to students in a school, college, university, etc.; to help somebody learn something by giving information about it
example: She teaches English at a local school.
exampleAr: تُدرّس اللغة الإنجليزية في مدرسة محلية.

definitionEn: a person whose job is teaching, especially in a school
example: My favorite teacher was my high school biology teacher.
exampleAr: كان معلمي المفضل هو مدرّس الأحياء في المرحلة الثانوية.

definitionEn: the work of a teacher
example: He's dedicated his life to teaching.
exampleAr: كرّس حياته للتدريس.

definitionEn: a group of people who play a particular game or sport against another group of people
example: Our team won the championship this year.
exampleAr: فاز فريقنا بالبطولة هذا العام.

definitionEn: to damage something by pulling it apart or into pieces or by cutting it on something sharp; to become damaged in this way
example: He tore the letter into small pieces.
exampleAr: مزّق الرسالة إلى قطع صغيرة.

definitionEn: a hole that has been made in something by tearing
example: A tear rolled down her cheek during the film.
exampleAr: انسابت دمعة على خدها أثناء الفيلم.

definitionEn: connected with the practical use of machines, methods, etc. in science and industry
example: The manual is full of technical terms.
exampleAr: الدليل مليء بالمصطلحات التقنية.

definitionEn: a particular way of doing something, especially one in which you have to learn special skills
example: She used a new technique to paint the mural.
exampleAr: استخدمت تقنية جديدة لرسم الجدارية.

definitionEn: connected with technology
example: The company invests heavily in technological innovation.
exampleAr: تستثمر الشركة بكثافة في الابتكار التكنولوجي.

definitionEn: scientific knowledge used in practical ways in industry, for example in designing new machines
example: Technology has changed the way we communicate.
exampleAr: غيّرت التكنولوجيا طريقة تواصلنا.

definitionEn: between 13 and 19 years old; connected with people of this age
example: She has two teenage daughters.
exampleAr: لديها ابنتان مراهقتان.

definitionEn: a person who is between 13 and 19 years old
example: As a teenager, he loved playing video games.
exampleAr: عندما كان مراهقًا، كان يحب لعب ألعاب الفيديو.

definitionEn: the years of a person’s life when they are between 13 and 19 years old
example: She started writing poetry in her teens.
exampleAr: بدأت في كتابة الشعر في سن المراهقة.

definitionEn: a system for talking to somebody else over long distances, using wires or radio; a machine used for this
example: He answered the telephone on the first ring.
exampleAr: ردّ على الهاتف من أول رنّة.

definitionEn: a piece of electrical equipment with a screen on which you can watch programmes with moving pictures and sounds
example: They watched the news on television every evening.
exampleAr: كانوا يشاهدون الأخبار على التلفزيون كل مساء.

definitionEn: to give information to somebody by speaking or writing
example: Can you tell me what happened?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني ماذا حدث؟

definitionEn: the measurement in degrees of how hot or cold a thing or place is
example: The temperature dropped sharply overnight.
exampleAr: انخفضت درجة الحرارة بشكل حاد خلال الليل.

definitionEn: a building used for religious worship, especially in religions other than Christianity
example: They visited an ancient temple in Luxor.
exampleAr: زاروا معبدًا قديمًا في الأقصر.

definitionEn: in a way that lasts or is intended to last or be used only for a short time; in a way that is not permanent
example: The road is temporarily closed for repairs.
exampleAr: الطريق مغلق مؤقتًا لإجراء الإصلاحات.

definitionEn: lasting or intended to last or be used only for a short time; not permanent
example: She took a temporary job while looking for something permanent.
exampleAr: قبلت وظيفة مؤقتة بينما كانت تبحث عن شيء دائم.

definitionEn: to attract somebody or make somebody want to do or have something, even if they know it is wrong
example: The smell of fresh bread tempted him to stop at the bakery.
exampleAr: أغرته رائحة الخبز الطازج بالتوقف عند المخبز.

example: There are ten students in the class.
exampleAr: يوجد عشرة طلاب في الصف.

definitionEn: a person who pays rent for the use of a room, building, land, etc. to the person who owns it
example: The tenant reported a leak in the bathroom.
exampleAr: أبلغ المستأجر عن تسرب في الحمام.

definitionEn: to be likely to do something or to happen in a particular way because this is what often or usually happens
example: People tend to eat more during the holidays.
exampleAr: يميل الناس إلى الإكثار من الأكل خلال العطلات.

definitionEn: if somebody/something has a particular tendency, they are likely to behave or act in a particular way
example: He has a tendency to procrastinate.
exampleAr: لديه ميل إلى التسويف.

definitionEn: kind, gentle and loving
example: She gave him a tender smile before leaving.
exampleAr: منحته ابتسامة رقيقة قبل أن ترحل.

definitionEn: a game in which two or four players use rackets to hit a ball backwards and forwards across a net on a specially marked court
example: They play tennis every weekend.
exampleAr: يلعبون التنس كل نهاية أسبوع.

definitionEn: a situation in which people do not trust each other, or feel unfriendly towards each other, and that may cause them to attack each other
example: There was a lot of tension in the room during the meeting.
exampleAr: كان هناك الكثير من التوتر في الغرفة أثناء الاجتماع.

definitionEn: a shelter made of a large sheet of canvas, nylon, etc. that is supported by poles and ropes fixed to the ground, and is used especially for camping
example: They pitched their tent near the river.
exampleAr: نصبوا خيمتهم قرب النهر.

definitionEn: the period of time when somebody holds an important job, especially a political one; the act of holding an important job
example: He was granted tenure after ten years at the university.
exampleAr: مُنح الثبات الوظيفي بعد عشر سنوات في الجامعة.

meaningAr: مصطلح / فصل دراسي / مدة / فترة (زمنية أو رئاسية)
definitionEn: a word or phrase used as the name of something, especially one connected with a particular type of language
example: This is a technical term used in law.
exampleAr: هذا مصطلح تقني يُستخدم في القانون.

definitionEn: a building or set of buildings at an airport where passengers arrive and leave
example: Our flight departs from Terminal 2.
exampleAr: تقلع رحلتنا من الصالة رقم 2.

definitionEn: that cannot be cured and will lead to death, often slowly
example: He was diagnosed with a terminal illness.
exampleAr: شُخِّص بمرض عضال.

definitionEn: to end; to make something end
example: The company decided to terminate his contract.
exampleAr: قررت الشركة إنهاء عقده.

definitionEn: the conditions that people offer, demand or accept when they make an agreement, an arrangement or a contract
example: Both sides agreed to the terms of the contract.
exampleAr: وافق الطرفان على شروط العقد.

definitionEn: used to refer to an area of land when you are mentioning its natural features, for example, if it is rough, flat, etc.
example: The terrain was too rocky for the vehicle to pass.
exampleAr: كانت التضاريس شديدة الوعورة بحيث تعذر على المركبة العبور.

definitionEn: very unpleasant; making you feel very unhappy, upset or frightened
example: The weather was terrible during our trip.
exampleAr: كان الطقس فظيعًا خلال رحلتنا.

definitionEn: very
example: I'm terribly sorry for the confusion.
exampleAr: أنا آسف جدًا على هذا الالتباس.

definitionEn: excellent; wonderful
example: You did a terrific job on the presentation.
exampleAr: قمت بعمل رائع في العرض التقديمي.

definitionEn: to make somebody feel extremely frightened
example: The loud thunder terrified the little boy.
exampleAr: أرعب الرعد العالي الطفل الصغير.

definitionEn: land that is under the control of a particular country or political leader
example: The two countries have long disputed this territory.
exampleAr: تتنازع الدولتان على هذا الإقليم منذ زمن طويل.

definitionEn: a feeling of extreme fear
example: The hostages described the terror of that night.
exampleAr: وصف الرهائن رعب تلك الليلة.

definitionEn: the use of violent action in order to achieve political aims or to force a government to act
example: The country has strengthened its laws against terrorism.
exampleAr: عزّزت الدولة قوانينها لمكافحة الإرهاب.

definitionEn: a person who takes part in terrorism
example: The suspect was charged as a terrorist.
exampleAr: اتُّهم المشتبه به بأنه إرهابي.

definitionEn: an examination of somebody’s knowledge or ability, consisting of questions for them to answer or activities for them to perform
example: She passed her driving test on the first try.
exampleAr: اجتازت اختبار القيادة من المحاولة الأولى.

definitionEn: to find out how much somebody knows, or what they can do by asking them questions or giving them activities to perform
example: They tested the new software before launching it.
exampleAr: اختبروا البرنامج الجديد قبل إطلاقه.

definitionEn: to make a statement that something happened or that something is true, especially as a witness in court
example: She was called to testify in court.
exampleAr: استُدعيت للشهادة أمام المحكمة.

definitionEn: a thing that shows that something else exists or is true
example: His testimony was crucial to the case.
exampleAr: كانت شهادته حاسمة في القضية.

definitionEn: the activity of testing somebody/something in order to find something out, see if it works, etc.
example: The vaccine went through years of testing.
exampleAr: خضع اللقاح لسنوات من الاختبار.

definitionEn: any form of written material
example: Read the text carefully before answering the questions.
exampleAr: اقرأ النص بعناية قبل الإجابة عن الأسئلة.

definitionEn: any form of written material
example: She texted me the address this morning.
exampleAr: أرسلت لي العنوان برسالة نصية هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: a book that teaches a particular subject and that is used especially in schools and colleges
example: Bring your textbook to class tomorrow.
exampleAr: أحضر كتابك الدراسي إلى الصف غدًا.

definitionEn: the way a surface, substance or piece of cloth feels when you touch it, for example how rough, smooth, hard or soft it is
example: The fabric has a soft, smooth texture.
exampleAr: يتميّز القماش بملمس ناعم وسلس.

definitionEn: used to introduce the second part of a comparison
example: She's taller than her brother.
exampleAr: هي أطول من أخيها.

definitionEn: to tell somebody that you are grateful for something
example: I want to thank you for all your help.
exampleAr: أريد أن أشكرك على كل مساعدتك.

definitionEn: used to show that you are pleased that something good has happened or that something bad has been avoided
example: Thankfully, no one was injured in the accident.
exampleAr: لحسن الحظ، لم يُصب أحد في الحادث.

definitionEn: used to show that you are grateful to somebody for something they have done
example: Thanks for coming to the party.
exampleAr: شكرًا لحضورك الحفلة.

definitionEn: used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker or as near to the speaker as another
example: That book on the shelf is mine.
exampleAr: ذلك الكتاب على الرف يخصني.

definitionEn: used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker, or not as near to the speaker as another
example: This is the house that I grew up in.
exampleAr: هذا هو المنزل الذي نشأت فيه.

definitionEn: used after some verbs, adjectives and nouns to introduce a new part of the sentence
example: She said that she would come to the party.
exampleAr: قالت إنها ستأتي إلى الحفلة.

definitionEn: used to refer to somebody/something that has already been mentioned or is easily understood
example: The sun rises in the east.
exampleAr: تشرق الشمس من الشرق.

definitionEn: a building or an outdoor area where plays and similar types of entertainment are performed
example: They went to the theatre to see a new play.
exampleAr: ذهبوا إلى المسرح لمشاهدة مسرحية جديدة.

definitionEn: connected with the theatre
example: The show had a very theatrical style.
exampleAr: كان للعرض طابع مسرحي واضح.

definitionEn: the crime of stealing something from a person or place
example: The store installed cameras to prevent theft.
exampleAr: ركّب المتجر كاميرات لمنع السرقة.

definitionEn: of or belonging to people, animals or things that have already been mentioned or are easily identified
example: They left their bags at the hotel.
exampleAr: تركوا حقائبهم في الفندق.

definitionEn: of or belonging to them
example: This car is theirs, not ours.
exampleAr: هذه السيارة ملكهم، لا ملكنا.

definitionEn: used when referring to people, animals or things as the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
example: I saw them at the mall yesterday.
exampleAr: رأيتهم في المركز التجاري أمس.

definitionEn: the subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing or work of art
example: The main theme of the novel is loss and redemption.
exampleAr: الفكرة الرئيسية للرواية هي الخسارة والفداء.

definitionEn: used when people or animals performing an action are also affected by it
example: The children made the cake themselves.
exampleAr: صنع الأطفال الكعكة بأنفسهم.

meaningAr: ثم / بعد ذلك / في ذلك الوقت
definitionEn: used to refer to a particular time in the past or future
example: We had dinner, and then we watched a movie.
exampleAr: تناولنا العشاء، ثم شاهدنا فيلمًا.

definitionEn: the study of religion and beliefs
example: He studied theology at a seminary in Rome.
exampleAr: درس علم اللاهوت في معهد ديني في روما.

definitionEn: connected with the ideas and principles on which a particular subject is based, rather than with practice and experiment
example: The course focuses more on theoretical concepts than practical skills.
exampleAr: يركز المقرر على المفاهيم النظرية أكثر من المهارات العملية.

definitionEn: a formal set of ideas that is intended to explain why something happens or exists
example: Darwin's theory of evolution changed modern biology.
exampleAr: غيّرت نظرية داروين في التطور علم الأحياء الحديث.

definitionEn: a specialist who treats a particular type of illness or problem, or who uses a particular type of treatment
example: She started seeing a therapist twice a month.
exampleAr: بدأت مراجعة معالج مرتين شهريًا.

definitionEn: the treatment of a physical problem or an illness
example: He's been doing physical therapy after his knee surgery.
exampleAr: يخضع للعلاج الطبيعي بعد جراحة ركبته.

definitionEn: used to show that something exists or happens
example: Put the box over there, next to the door.
exampleAr: ضع الصندوق هناك، بجانب الباب.

definitionEn: used to show that something exists or happens
example: There are many reasons to visit Egypt.
exampleAr: هناك أسباب كثيرة لزيارة مصر.

definitionEn: after the time or event mentioned
example: The rules changed in 2020, and thereafter, applications increased.
exampleAr: تغيّرت القواعد في عام 2020، وازدادت الطلبات بعد ذلك.

definitionEn: used to introduce the result of the action or situation mentioned
example: He missed the deadline, thereby losing the contract.
exampleAr: تجاوز الموعد النهائي، وبذلك خسر العقد.

definitionEn: used to introduce the logical result of something that has just been mentioned
example: The store was closed; therefore, we went home.
exampleAr: كان المتجر مغلقًا؛ لذلك عدنا إلى المنزل.

definitionEn: a long piece of writing completed by a student as part of a university degree, based on their own research
example: She's writing her thesis on climate change policy.
exampleAr: تكتب أطروحتها حول سياسات تغيّر المناخ.

definitionEn: people, animals or things that have already been mentioned or are easily identified
example: They arrived late because of the traffic.
exampleAr: وصلوا متأخرين بسبب الزحام.

definitionEn: having a larger distance between opposite sides or surfaces than other similar objects or than normal
example: The soup was thick and creamy.
exampleAr: كانت الشوربة سميكة وقشدية.

definitionEn: a person who steals something from another person or place
example: The thief was caught trying to escape.
exampleAr: قُبض على اللص وهو يحاول الهرب.

definitionEn: having a smaller distance between opposite sides or surfaces than other similar objects or than normal
example: She sliced the bread into thin pieces.
exampleAr: قطّعت الخبز إلى شرائح رفيعة.

definitionEn: an object whose name you do not use because you do not need to or want to, or because you do not know it
example: There's one thing I forgot to mention.
exampleAr: هناك شيء واحد نسيت أن أذكره.

definitionEn: to have a particular idea or opinion about something/somebody; to believe something
example: He sat quietly, thinking about what to do next.
exampleAr: جلس بهدوء، يفكر فيما سيفعله بعد ذلك.

definitionEn: the process of thinking about something
example: Her thinking has changed a lot since college.
exampleAr: تغيّر تفكيرها كثيرًا منذ الجامعة.

definitionEn: each of three equal parts of something
example: This is the third time he's been late this week.
exampleAr: هذه هي المرة الثالثة التي يتأخر فيها هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: needing or wanting to drink
example: After the run, she was extremely thirsty.
exampleAr: بعد الجري، كانت عطشى للغاية.

example: He'll turn thirteen next month.
exampleAr: سيبلغ الثالثة عشرة الشهر المقبل.

example: She just turned thirty last week.
exampleAr: بلغت الثلاثين للتو الأسبوع الماضي.

definitionEn: used to refer to a particular person, thing or event that is close to you, especially compared with another
example: This book is much better than the last one.
exampleAr: هذا الكتاب أفضل بكثير من السابق.

definitionEn: to this degree; so
example: This is exactly what I needed.
exampleAr: هذا بالضبط ما كنت بحاجة إليه.

definitionEn: done completely; with great attention to detail
example: The inspector did a thorough check of the building.
exampleAr: أجرى المفتش فحصًا شاملاً للمبنى.

definitionEn: very much; completely
example: Please read the contract thoroughly before signing.
exampleAr: من فضلك اقرأ العقد بدقة قبل التوقيع.

definitionEn: despite the fact that
example: Though it was raining, they went for a walk.
exampleAr: رغم أن المطر كان يهطل، خرجا للمشي.

definitionEn: used especially at the end of a sentence or clause to add a fact or an opinion that makes the previous statement less strong or less important
example: I didn't like the movie much. It was well-acted, though.
exampleAr: لم يعجبني الفيلم كثيرًا. غير أن التمثيل كان جيدًا.

definitionEn: something that you think of or remember
example: She shared her thoughts on the proposal.
exampleAr: شاركت أفكارها حول الاقتراح.

definitionEn: making people think seriously about a particular subject or issue
example: It was a thought-provoking documentary about climate change.
exampleAr: كان فيلمًا وثائقيًا مثيرًا للتفكير حول تغيّر المناخ.

meaningAr: مراعٍ / لطيف (يهتم بمشاعر الآخرين) / متأمل / مُفكِّر
definitionEn: quiet, because you are thinking
example: It was very thoughtful of you to remember my birthday.
exampleAr: كان لطفًا كبيرًا منك أن تتذكر عيد ميلادي.

example: The event attracted over a thousand visitors.
exampleAr: جذبت الفعالية أكثر من ألف زائر.

definitionEn: a thin string of cotton, wool, silk, etc. used for sewing or making cloth
example: She used blue thread to sew the button.
exampleAr: استخدمت خيطًا أزرق لخياطة الزر.

definitionEn: a statement in which you tell somebody that you will punish or harm them, especially if they do not do what you want
example: The company received a bomb threat yesterday.
exampleAr: تلقّت الشركة تهديدًا بوجود قنبلة أمس.

definitionEn: to say that you will cause trouble, hurt somebody, etc. if you do not get what you want
example: Rising sea levels threaten many coastal cities.
exampleAr: يهدد ارتفاع مستوى سطح البحر العديد من المدن الساحلية.

example: They have three children.
exampleAr: لديهم ثلاثة أطفال.

definitionEn: the floor or ground at the bottom of a doorway, considered as the entrance to a building or room
example: He carried her over the threshold.
exampleAr: حملها عبر عتبة الباب.

definitionEn: very excited and pleased
example: She was thrilled to hear the good news.
exampleAr: كانت مسرورة جدًا لسماع الخبر السار.

definitionEn: to become, and continue to be, successful, strong, healthy, etc.
example: The business has thrived since moving to the new location.
exampleAr: ازدهر العمل منذ الانتقال إلى الموقع الجديد.

definitionEn: a passage in the neck through which food and air pass on their way into the body; the front part of the neck
example: He had a sore throat and a slight fever.
exampleAr: كان يعاني من التهاب في الحلق وحمّى خفيفة.

definitionEn: from one end or side of something/somebody to the other
example: They walked through the park on their way home.
exampleAr: مشيا عبر الحديقة في طريقهما إلى المنزل.

definitionEn: in or into every part of something
example: It rained throughout the entire trip.
exampleAr: هطل المطر طوال الرحلة بأكملها.

definitionEn: to send something from your hand through the air by moving your hand or arm quickly
example: He threw the ball to his son.
exampleAr: رمى الكرة إلى ابنه.

definitionEn: the short, thick finger at the side of the hand, slightly apart from the other four
example: She hurt her thumb while chopping vegetables.
exampleAr: أصابت إبهامها أثناء تقطيع الخضروات.

definitionEn: the day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday
example: We usually meet for coffee on Thursdays.
exampleAr: عادةً ما نلتقي لتناول القهوة أيام الخميس.

definitionEn: in this way; like this
example: The flight was delayed, and thus, we missed the connection.
exampleAr: تأخرت الرحلة، وبالتالي فاتتنا رحلة الوصل.

definitionEn: a printed piece of paper, or a message or image received on your phone or computer, that gives you the right to travel on a particular bus, train, etc. or to go into a theatre, etc.
example: He bought two tickets for the concert.
exampleAr: اشترى تذكرتين للحفل الموسيقي.

definitionEn: a regular rise and fall in the level of the sea, caused by the pull of the moon and sun; the flow of water that happens as the sea rises and falls
example: The tide comes in around sunset.
exampleAr: يبدأ المدّ عند غروب الشمس تقريبًا.

definitionEn: arranged neatly and with everything in order
example: Her room is always neat and tidy.
exampleAr: غرفتها دائمًا مرتبة ونظيفة.

definitionEn: to make something look neat by putting things in the place where they belong
example: Can you tidy up before your guests arrive?
exampleAr: هل يمكنك أن ترتب المكان قبل وصول ضيوفك؟

definitionEn: to attach or hold two or more things together using string, rope, etc.; to fasten somebody/something with string, rope, etc.
example: He tied his shoelaces before the race.
exampleAr: ربط رباط حذائه قبل السباق.

definitionEn: a long, narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck, especially by men, with a knot in front
example: He wore a blue tie to the interview.
exampleAr: ارتدى ربطة عنق زرقاء للمقابلة.

definitionEn: held or fixed in position securely; difficult to move, open or separate
example: These shoes feel a bit tight.
exampleAr: هذا الحذاء يبدو ضيقًا بعض الشيء.

definitionEn: to hold or fix something more securely in position; to make something or become more difficult to move, open or separate
example: He tightened the screws on the shelf.
exampleAr: أحكم شدّ البراغي على الرف.

definitionEn: until
example: The shop is open till 9 PM.
exampleAr: المحل مفتوح حتى الساعة التاسعة مساءً.

definitionEn: until
example: Wait here till I get back.
exampleAr: انتظر هنا حتى أعود.

definitionEn: trees that are grown to be used in building or for making things
example: The house was built using local timber.
exampleAr: بُني المنزل باستخدام خشب محلي.

definitionEn: what is measured in minutes, hours, days, etc.
example: I don't have enough time to finish this today.
exampleAr: لا يتوفر لدي وقت كافٍ لإنهاء هذا اليوم.

definitionEn: happening at exactly the right time
example: Thanks to their timely response, the issue was resolved quickly.
exampleAr: بفضل استجابتهم في الوقت المناسب، حُلّت المشكلة بسرعة.

definitionEn: the act of choosing when something happens; a particular point or period of time when something happens or is planned
example: The timing of the announcement surprised everyone.
exampleAr: فاجأ توقيت الإعلان الجميع.

definitionEn: a metal container in which food is sold; the contents of one of these containers
example: The toy soldiers were made of tin.
exampleAr: كانت الجنود اللعبة مصنوعة من القصدير.

definitionEn: very small in size or amount
example: The apartment has a tiny kitchen.
exampleAr: تحتوي الشقة على مطبخ صغير جدًا.

definitionEn: a small piece of advice about something practical
example: Here's a useful tip for saving money.
exampleAr: إليك نصيحة مفيدة لتوفير المال.

definitionEn: to give somebody an extra amount of money to thank them for something they have done for you as part of their job
example: Don't forget to tip the delivery driver.
exampleAr: لا تنسَ إعطاء إكرامية لسائق التوصيل.

definitionEn: feeling that you would like to sleep or rest; needing rest
example: I'm so tired after the long shift.
exampleAr: أشعر بتعب شديد بعد هذه الوردية الطويلة.

definitionEn: a piece of soft paper, used especially as a handkerchief
example: Can I borrow a tissue? I have a runny nose.
exampleAr: هل يمكنني أخذ منديل ورقي؟ أنفي يسيل.

definitionEn: the name of a book, poem, painting, piece of music, etc.
example: What's the title of the book you're reading?
exampleAr: ما عنوان الكتاب الذي تقرؤه؟

definitionEn: in the direction of something; towards something
example: She's going to the store.
exampleAr: هي ذاهبة إلى المتجر.

definitionEn: the dried leaves of the tobacco plant that are used for making cigarettes, smoking in a pipe, etc.
example: The region is known for growing tobacco.
exampleAr: تشتهر المنطقة بزراعة التبغ.

definitionEn: this day
example: Today is a special day for our family.
exampleAr: اليوم يوم مميز لعائلتنا.

definitionEn: on this day
example: I need to finish this today.
exampleAr: أحتاج إلى إنهاء هذا اليوم.

definitionEn: one of the five small parts that stick out from the foot; any similar part on the foot of an animal or bird
example: She stubbed her toe on the table leg.
exampleAr: صدمت إصبع قدمها بساق الطاولة.

definitionEn: with or near to somebody/something else; with each other
example: They walked to school together every morning.
exampleAr: كانا يمشيان إلى المدرسة معًا كل صباح.

definitionEn: a large bowl attached to a pipe that you sit on or stand over when you get rid of waste matter from your body
example: The toilet in the guest bathroom needs fixing.
exampleAr: يحتاج المرحاض في حمام الضيوف إلى الإصلاح.

definitionEn: the quality of being willing to accept or tolerate somebody/something, especially opinions or behaviour that you may not agree with, or people who are not like you
example: The workshop promotes tolerance and mutual understanding.
exampleAr: تعزّز الورشة التسامح والتفاهم المتبادل.

definitionEn: to allow somebody to do something that you do not agree with or like
example: She won't tolerate any form of disrespect.
exampleAr: لن تتسامح مع أي شكل من أشكال قلة الاحترام.

definitionEn: money that you pay to use a particular road or bridge
example: You have to pay a toll to use this highway.
exampleAr: يجب أن تدفع رسوم عبور لاستخدام هذا الطريق السريع.

definitionEn: a soft fruit with a lot of juice and shiny red skin that is eaten as a vegetable either raw or cooked
example: She added fresh tomatoes to the salad.
exampleAr: أضافت طماطم طازجة إلى السلطة.

definitionEn: the day after today
example: Tomorrow is a public holiday.
exampleAr: الغد عطلة رسمية.

definitionEn: on or during the day after today
example: I'll call you tomorrow morning.
exampleAr: سأتصل بك صباح الغد.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring weight, in the UK 2 240 pounds (long ton) and in the US 2 000 pounds (short ton)
example: The truck can carry up to five tons of cargo.
exampleAr: يمكن للشاحنة حمل ما يصل إلى خمسة أطنان من البضائع.

definitionEn: the quality of somebody’s voice, especially expressing a particular emotion
example: He spoke in a calm, reassuring tone.
exampleAr: تحدث بنبرة هادئة ومطمئنة.

definitionEn: the soft part in the mouth that moves around, used for tasting, swallowing, speaking, etc.
example: He accidentally bit his tongue while eating.
exampleAr: عضّ لسانه عن طريق الخطأ أثناء الأكل.

definitionEn: on or during the evening or night of today
example: We're having dinner with friends tonight.
exampleAr: سنتناول العشاء مع أصدقاء الليلة.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 1 000 kilograms
example: The ship carries thousands of tonnes of grain.
exampleAr: تحمل السفينة آلاف الأطنان من الحبوب.

definitionEn: used before adjectives and adverbs to say that something is more than is good, necessary, possible, etc.
example: I'd like to come too, if that's okay.
exampleAr: أود أن آتي أيضًا، إذا كان ذلك مناسبًا.

definitionEn: an instrument such as a hammer, screwdriver, saw, etc. that you hold in your hand and use for making things, repairing things, etc.
example: A hammer is a basic tool for construction.
exampleAr: المطرقة أداة أساسية في البناء.

definitionEn: any of the hard white structures in the mouth used for biting food
example: He has a toothache and needs to see a dentist.
exampleAr: يعاني من ألم في السن ويحتاج إلى مراجعة طبيب أسنان.

definitionEn: the highest part or point of something
example: They reached the top of the mountain at sunrise.
exampleAr: وصلوا إلى قمة الجبل عند شروق الشمس.

definitionEn: highest in position
example: She's one of the top students in her class.
exampleAr: هي من أفضل الطالبات في صفها.

definitionEn: a subject that you talk, write or learn about
example: Let's move on to the next topic.
exampleAr: لننتقل إلى الموضوع التالي.

definitionEn: the act of causing somebody severe pain in order to punish them or make them say or do something
example: The report documented cases of torture in the prison.
exampleAr: وثّق التقرير حالات تعذيب في السجن.

definitionEn: to hurt somebody physically or mentally in order to punish them or make them tell you something
example: The regime was accused of torturing political prisoners.
exampleAr: اتُّهم النظام بتعذيب المعتقلين السياسيين.

definitionEn: to throw something lightly or carelessly
example: She tossed the ball gently to her brother.
exampleAr: رمت الكرة برفق إلى أخيها.

definitionEn: being the amount or number after everyone or everything is counted or added together
example: The total cost of the trip was higher than expected.
exampleAr: كانت التكلفة الإجمالية للرحلة أعلى مما كان متوقعًا.

definitionEn: the amount you get when you add several numbers or amounts together; the final number of people or things when they have all been counted
example: The total came to about 500 pounds.
exampleAr: بلغ المجموع نحو 500 جنيه.

definitionEn: completely
example: I totally agree with what you said.
exampleAr: أوافقك تمامًا فيما قلته.

definitionEn: to put your hand or another part of your body onto somebody/something
example: Please don't touch the paintings in the museum.
exampleAr: من فضلك لا تلمس اللوحات في المتحف.

definitionEn: the sense that enables you to be aware of things and what they are like when you put your hands and fingers on them
example: Let's keep in touch after the trip.
exampleAr: لنبقَ على تواصل بعد الرحلة.

definitionEn: having or causing problems or difficulties
example: It was a tough decision to make.
exampleAr: كان قرارًا صعبًا اتخاذه.

definitionEn: a journey made for pleasure during which several different towns, countries, etc. are visited
example: They took a guided tour of the old city.
exampleAr: قاما بجولة إرشادية في المدينة القديمة.

definitionEn: to travel around a place, for example on holiday, or to perform, to advertise something, etc.
example: The band is touring Europe this summer.
exampleAr: تقوم الفرقة بجولة في أوروبا هذا الصيف.

definitionEn: the business activity connected with providing accommodation, services and entertainment for people who are visiting a place for pleasure
example: Tourism is a major source of income for the country.
exampleAr: تُعد السياحة مصدر دخل رئيسي للبلاد.

definitionEn: a person who is travelling or visiting a place for pleasure
example: The city is full of tourists during the summer.
exampleAr: تمتلئ المدينة بالسياح خلال الصيف.

definitionEn: a sports competition involving a number of teams or players who take part in different games and must leave the competition if they lose. The competition continues until there is only the winner left.
example: He won the chess tournament last year.
exampleAr: فاز ببطولة الشطرنج العام الماضي.

definitionEn: in the direction of somebody/something
example: They walked slowly towards the exit.
exampleAr: مشيا ببطء نحو المخرج.

definitionEn: a piece of cloth or paper used for drying things, especially your body
example: She dried her hands with a towel.
exampleAr: جفّفت يديها بمنشفة.

definitionEn: a tall narrow building or part of a building, especially of a church or castle
example: The Eiffel Tower is one of the most visited landmarks in the world.
exampleAr: يُعد برج إيفل من أكثر المعالم زيارةً في العالم.

definitionEn: a place with many houses, shops, etc. where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.
example: They live in a small town near the coast.
exampleAr: يعيشون في بلدة صغيرة قرب الساحل.

definitionEn: containing poison; poisonous
example: The factory was fined for releasing toxic chemicals.
exampleAr: غُرّم المصنع لإطلاقه مواد كيميائية سامة.

definitionEn: an object for children to play with
example: The children were playing with their toys in the garden.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال يلعبون بألعابهم في الحديقة.

definitionEn: a mark, an object or a sign that shows that somebody/something existed or was present
example: There was no trace of the missing documents.
exampleAr: لم يكن هناك أي أثر للوثائق المفقودة.

definitionEn: to find or discover somebody/something by looking carefully for them/it
example: Police traced the call to an address downtown.
exampleAr: تتبّعت الشرطة المكالمة إلى عنوان في وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: rails (= metal bars) that a train moves along
example: They followed the animal's tracks through the snow.
exampleAr: تتبّعوا آثار الحيوان عبر الثلج.

definitionEn: to find somebody/something by following the marks, signs, information, etc., that they have left behind them
example: The app tracks your daily steps automatically.
exampleAr: يتتبّع التطبيق خطواتك اليومية تلقائيًا.

definitionEn: the activity of buying and selling or of exchanging goods or services between people or countries
example: The two countries signed a new trade agreement.
exampleAr: وقّعت الدولتان اتفاقية تجارية جديدة.

definitionEn: to buy and sell things
example: They trade mainly in agricultural products.
exampleAr: يتاجرون بشكل أساسي في المنتجات الزراعية.

definitionEn: a name, symbol or design that a company uses for its products and that cannot be used by anyone else
example: The logo is a registered trademark of the company.
exampleAr: الشعار علامة تجارية مسجلة باسم الشركة.

definitionEn: the activity of buying and selling things
example: He works in stock trading.
exampleAr: يعمل في تداول الأسهم.

definitionEn: a belief, custom or way of doing something that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people; a set of these beliefs or customs
example: It's a family tradition to gather every New Year's Eve.
exampleAr: من تقاليد العائلة أن تجتمع في ليلة رأس السنة كل عام.

definitionEn: being part of the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time
example: They served traditional Egyptian dishes at the wedding.
exampleAr: قدّموا أطباقًا مصرية تقليدية في حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: the vehicles that are on a road at a particular time
example: There was heavy traffic on the way to work this morning.
exampleAr: كانت هناك زحمة مرورية شديدة في الطريق إلى العمل هذا الصباح.

definitionEn: a very sad event or situation, especially one that involves death
example: The fire was a terrible tragedy for the whole community.
exampleAr: كان الحريق مأساة فظيعة للمجتمع بأكمله.

definitionEn: making you feel very sad, usually because somebody has died or suffered a lot
example: The accident had a tragic outcome.
exampleAr: كانت نتيجة الحادث مأساوية.

definitionEn: a long line or series of marks that is left by somebody/something
example: They hiked along a scenic trail in the mountains.
exampleAr: ساروا على درب خلاب في الجبال.

definitionEn: to pull something behind somebody/something, usually along the ground; to be pulled along in this way
example: The team was trailing by two points at halftime.
exampleAr: كان الفريق متأخرًا بفارق نقطتين عند الاستراحة.

definitionEn: a truck, or a container with wheels, that is pulled by another vehicle
example: They towed a trailer full of furniture.
exampleAr: قطروا مقطورة مليئة بالأثاث.

definitionEn: a number of connected coaches or trucks, pulled by an engine or powered by a motor in each one, taking people and goods from one place to another
example: We took the train instead of driving.
exampleAr: استقللنا القطار بدلاً من القيادة.

definitionEn: to teach a person or an animal the skills for a particular job or activity; to be taught in this way
example: She trains every morning before work.
exampleAr: تتدرّب كل صباح قبل العمل.

definitionEn: a shoe that you wear for sports or as informal clothing
example: He hired a personal trainer to help him get fit.
exampleAr: استعان بمدرّب شخصي ليساعده على اللياقة البدنية.

definitionEn: the process of learning the skills that you need to do a job
example: New employees go through two weeks of training.
exampleAr: يخضع الموظفون الجدد لتدريب مدته أسبوعان.

definitionEn: a particular quality in your personality
example: Patience is one of her best traits.
exampleAr: الصبر واحدة من أفضل سماتها.

definitionEn: a piece of business that is done between people, especially an act of buying or selling
example: The bank flagged the transaction as suspicious.
exampleAr: صنّف البنك المعاملة على أنها مشبوهة.

meaningAr: كشف درجات (أكاديمي) / نص مكتوب (لمحادثة أو جلسة)
definitionEn: a written or printed copy of words that have been spoken
example: She requested an official transcript of her university grades.
exampleAr: طلبت كشفًا رسميًا بدرجاتها الجامعية.

definitionEn: to move from one place to another; to move something/somebody from one place to another
example: He transferred the money to his savings account.
exampleAr: حوّل المال إلى حسابه في التوفير.

definitionEn: the act of moving somebody/something from one place, group or job to another; an occasion when this happens
example: The transfer of funds usually takes two business days.

example: It's unlikely that they'll finish the project on time.
exampleAr: من غير المحتمل أن ينهوا المشروع في الوقت المحدد.

definitionEn: not needed; more than is needed
example: Try to avoid unnecessary expenses this month.
exampleAr: حاول تجنّب النفقات غير الضرورية هذا الشهر.

definitionEn: not pleasant or comfortable
example: There was an unpleasant smell coming from the kitchen.
exampleAr: كانت هناك رائحة كريهة قادمة من المطبخ.

definitionEn: that has never happened, been done or been known before
example: The company reported unprecedented growth this quarter.
exampleAr: أعلنت الشركة عن نمو غير مسبوق هذا الربع.

definitionEn: up to the point in time or the event mentioned
example: The store is open until 10 PM.
exampleAr: المتجر مفتوح حتى الساعة العاشرة مساءً.

definitionEn: up to the point in time or the event mentioned
example: Wait here until I call you.
exampleAr: انتظر هنا حتى أتصل بك.

definitionEn: different from what is usual or normal
example: It's unusual for him to be late.
exampleAr: من غير المعتاد أن يتأخر.

definitionEn: to remove a cover or curtain from a painting, statue, etc. so that it can be seen in public for the first time
example: The company will unveil its new product next week.
exampleAr: ستكشف الشركة عن منتجها الجديد الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: towards or in a higher position
example: Please stand up when your name is called.
exampleAr: من فضلك قف عندما يُنادى اسمك.

definitionEn: going to happen soon
example: Tickets for the upcoming concert are selling fast.
exampleAr: تُباع تذاكر الحفل القادم بسرعة.

definitionEn: to make something more modern by adding new parts, etc.
example: Please update your contact information.
exampleAr: من فضلك حدّث معلومات التواصل الخاصة بك.

definitionEn: a report or broadcast that gives the most recent information about something; a new version of something containing the most recent information
example: The app released a new update yesterday.
exampleAr: أصدر التطبيق تحديثًا جديدًا أمس.

definitionEn: to make a machine, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient; to start using a new and better version of a machine, system, etc.
example: They upgraded the office computers last month.
exampleAr: طوّروا أجهزة الكمبيوتر في المكتب الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: the act of making a machine, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient; the more powerful and efficient machine, computer system, etc.
example: The airline offered him a free seat upgrade.
exampleAr: عرضت عليه شركة الطيران ترقية مقعد مجانية.

definitionEn: to support something that you think is right and make sure that it continues to exist
example: The court upheld the original decision.
exampleAr: أيّدت المحكمة القرار الأصلي.

example: Upon arrival, please check in at the front desk.
exampleAr: عند الوصول، من فضلك سجّل حضورك في مكتب الاستقبال.

definitionEn: located above something else, especially something of the same type or the other of a pair
example: She lives on the upper floor of the building.
exampleAr: تعيش في الطابق العلوي من المبنى.

definitionEn: unhappy or disappointed because of something unpleasant that has happened
example: She was upset about losing the competition.
exampleAr: كانت منزعجة بسبب خسارتها المسابقة.

definitionEn: to make somebody/yourself feel unhappy, anxious or annoyed
example: The news upset him deeply.
exampleAr: أحزنه الخبر بشدة.

definitionEn: up the stairs; on or to a floor of a house or other building higher than the one that you are on
example: The bedrooms are upstairs.
exampleAr: توجد غرف النوم في الطابق العلوي.

definitionEn: towards a higher place or position
example: Prices have been moving upwards steadily.
exampleAr: تتحرك الأسعار نحو الأعلى بثبات.

definitionEn: connected with a town or city
example: Urban areas tend to have higher population density.
exampleAr: تميل المناطق الحضرية إلى كثافة سكانية أعلى.

definitionEn: to advise or try hard to persuade somebody to do something
example: Doctors urge people to get regular checkups.
exampleAr: يحث الأطباء الناس على إجراء فحوصات دورية.

definitionEn: to advise or try hard to persuade somebody to do something
example: She felt a sudden urge to travel somewhere new.
exampleAr: شعرت برغبة ملحّة مفاجئة للسفر إلى مكان جديد.

definitionEn: that needs to be dealt with or happen immediately
example: This is an urgent matter that needs immediate attention.
exampleAr: هذا أمر عاجل يحتاج إلى اهتمام فوري.

definitionEn: used when the speaker or writer and another or others are the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
example: They invited us to their wedding.
exampleAr: دعونا إلى حفل زفافهم.

definitionEn: the way in which words are used in a language
example: Water usage increases significantly in summer.
exampleAr: يزداد استخدام المياه بشكل ملحوظ في الصيف.

definitionEn: to do something with a machine, a method, an object, etc. for a particular purpose
example: You can use my phone if you need to make a call.
exampleAr: يمكنك استخدام هاتفي إذا احتجت لإجراء مكالمة.

definitionEn: the act of using something; the state of being used
example: This tool has many practical uses.
exampleAr: لهذه الأداة استخدامات عملية كثيرة.

definitionEn: familiar with something because you do it or experience it often
example: They bought a used car instead of a new one.
exampleAr: اشتروا سيارة مستعملة بدلاً من سيارة جديدة.

definitionEn: used to say that something happened continuously or frequently during a period in the past
example: I used to live in Alexandria before moving here.
exampleAr: كنت أعيش في الإسكندرية قبل الانتقال إلى هنا.

definitionEn: that can help you to do or achieve what you want
example: This app is really useful for learning new words.
exampleAr: هذا التطبيق مفيد جدًا لتعلّم كلمات جديدة.

definitionEn: not useful; not doing or achieving what is needed or wanted
example: The old machine is completely useless now.
exampleAr: أصبحت الآلة القديمة عديمة الفائدة تمامًا الآن.

definitionEn: a person or thing that uses something
example: The app has over ten million active users.
exampleAr: يضم التطبيق أكثر من عشرة ملايين مستخدم نشط.

definitionEn: that happens or is done most of the time or in most cases
example: He arrived at the usual time.
exampleAr: وصل في الوقت المعتاد.

definitionEn: in the way that is usual or normal; most often
example: I usually wake up around seven.
exampleAr: عادةً ما أستيقظ حوالي الساعة السابعة.

definitionEn: a service provided for the public, for example an electricity, water or gas supply
example: Utility bills have gone up this winter.
exampleAr: ارتفعت فواتير المرافق هذا الشتاء.

definitionEn: to use something, especially for a practical purpose
example: The company utilizes advanced technology in production.
exampleAr: تستخدم الشركة تقنية متطورة في الإنتاج.

definitionEn: completely
example: The plan was utterly ridiculous from the start.
exampleAr: كانت الخطة سخيفة تمامًا منذ البداية.

definitionEn: a period of time spent travelling or resting away from home
example: They're going on vacation to the coast next week.
exampleAr: سيذهبون في إجازة إلى الساحل الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: a space that is completely empty of all substances, including all air or other gas
example: She used the vacuum to clean the carpet.
exampleAr: استخدمت المكنسة الكهربائية لتنظيف السجادة.

definitionEn: a space that is completely empty of all substances, including all air or other gas
example: He vacuumed the living room before the guests arrived.
exampleAr: كنس غرفة المعيشة بالمكنسة الكهربائية قبل وصول الضيوف.
