definitionEn: not clear in a person’s mind
example: His explanation was too vague to be helpful.
exampleAr: كان تفسيره غامضًا جدًا لدرجة أنه لم يكن مفيدًا.

definitionEn: that is legally or officially acceptable
example: Your passport must be valid for at least six months.
exampleAr: يجب أن يكون جواز سفرك ساري المفعول لمدة ستة أشهر على الأقل.

definitionEn: the state of being legally or officially acceptable
example: Researchers questioned the validity of the study's results.
exampleAr: شكّك الباحثون في صحة نتائج الدراسة.

definitionEn: an area of low land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it; the land that a river flows through
example: The village is located in a beautiful green valley.
exampleAr: تقع القرية في وادٍ أخضر جميل.

definitionEn: worth a lot of money
example: She gave me some valuable advice before the interview.
exampleAr: قدّمت لي بعض النصائح القيّمة قبل المقابلة.

definitionEn: how much something is worth in money or other goods for which it can be exchanged
example: The house has increased in value over the years.
exampleAr: ازدادت قيمة المنزل على مر السنين.

definitionEn: to think that somebody/something is important
example: I really value your opinion on this matter.
exampleAr: أقدّر رأيك حقًا في هذا الأمر.

definitionEn: a covered vehicle with no side windows in its back half, usually smaller than a lorry, used for carrying goods or people
example: They loaded the furniture into a rental van.
exampleAr: حمّلوا الأثاث في شاحنة صغيرة مستأجرة.

definitionEn: to disappear suddenly and/or in a way that you cannot explain
example: The magician made the coin vanish before our eyes.
exampleAr: جعل الساحر العملة تختفي أمام أعيننا.

definitionEn: a situation, number or quantity that can vary or be varied
example: There are several variables that could affect the results.
exampleAr: هناك عدة متغيرات قد تؤثر على النتائج.

definitionEn: often changing; likely to change
example: The weather has been quite variable this week.
exampleAr: كان الطقس متقلبًا جدًا هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: a change, especially in the amount or level of something
example: There's a lot of variation in prices between stores.
exampleAr: هناك تفاوت كبير في الأسعار بين المتاجر.

definitionEn: of many different types
example: The menu offers a varied selection of dishes.
exampleAr: تقدّم القائمة تشكيلة متنوعة من الأطباق.

definitionEn: several different sorts of the same thing
example: The shop sells a wide variety of cheeses.
exampleAr: يبيع المحل تشكيلة واسعة من الأجبان.

definitionEn: several different
example: The report covers various aspects of the economy.
exampleAr: يغطي التقرير جوانب متعددة من الاقتصاد.

definitionEn: to be different from each other in size, shape, etc.
example: Prices vary depending on the season.
exampleAr: تتفاوت الأسعار بحسب الموسم.

definitionEn: extremely large in area, size, amount, etc.
example: The desert stretched across a vast area.
exampleAr: امتدت الصحراء عبر مساحة شاسعة.

definitionEn: a plant or part of a plant that is eaten as food. Potatoes, beans and onions are all vegetables.
example: She grows her own vegetables in the garden.
exampleAr: تزرع خضارها الخاصة في الحديقة.

definitionEn: a thing that is used for transporting people or goods from one place to another, such as a car or lorry
example: The vehicle was parked outside the building.
exampleAr: كانت المركبة متوقفة خارج المبنى.

definitionEn: any of the tubes that carry blood from all parts of the body towards the heart
example: The nurse had trouble finding a vein for the injection.
exampleAr: واجهت الممرضة صعوبة في إيجاد وريد لإعطاء الحقنة.

definitionEn: a business project or activity, especially one that involves taking risks
example: The new business venture turned out to be very profitable.
exampleAr: تبيّن أن المشروع التجاري الجديد مربح جدًا.

definitionEn: to go somewhere even though you know that it might be dangerous or unpleasant
example: They ventured into unknown territory during the expedition.
exampleAr: غامروا بالدخول إلى أرض مجهولة أثناء الرحلة الاستكشافية.

definitionEn: a place where people meet for an organized event, for example a concert, sporting event or conference
example: They changed the venue for the conference at the last minute.
exampleAr: غيّروا مكان انعقاد المؤتمر في اللحظة الأخيرة.

definitionEn: relating to words
example: They reached a verbal agreement before signing the contract.
exampleAr: توصلوا إلى اتفاق شفهي قبل توقيع العقد.

definitionEn: an official judgement made in court or at an inquest (= an official investigation into somebody's death)
example: The jury reached a verdict after three days of deliberation.
exampleAr: توصلت هيئة المحلفين إلى حكم بعد ثلاثة أيام من المداولات.

definitionEn: to check that something is true or accurate
example: Please verify your email address to continue.
exampleAr: من فضلك تحقق من عنوان بريدك الإلكتروني للمتابعة.

definitionEn: writing that is arranged in lines, often with a regular rhythm or pattern of rhyme
example: She memorized the entire verse for the recital.
exampleAr: حفظت المقطع الشعري بأكمله للأمسية الشعرية.

definitionEn: a form of something that is slightly different from an earlier form or from other forms of the same thing
example: This is an updated version of the software.
exampleAr: هذه نسخة محدّثة من البرنامج.

definitionEn: used to show that two teams or sides are against each other
example: It's a classic debate of quality versus quantity.
exampleAr: إنه جدل كلاسيكي بين الجودة مقابل الكمية.

definitionEn: going straight up or down from a level surface or from top to bottom in a picture, etc.
example: The line on the graph is completely vertical.
exampleAr: الخط في الرسم البياني عمودي تمامًا.

definitionEn: used before adjectives, adverbs and determiners to mean ‘in a high degree’ or ‘extremely’
example: She was very tired after the long journey.
exampleAr: كانت متعبة جدًا بعد الرحلة الطويلة.

definitionEn: a tube that carries blood through the body of a person or an animal, or liquid through the parts of a plant
example: The cargo vessel docked early this morning.
exampleAr: رست سفينة الشحن في وقت مبكر هذا الصباح.

meaningAr: قدامى المحاربين / شخص ذو خبرة طويلة (مجازي)
definitionEn: a person who has a lot of experience in a particular area or activity
example: He's a veteran of the Gulf War.
exampleAr: هو أحد قدامى المحاربين في حرب الخليج.

definitionEn: through a place
example: You can contact us via email or phone.
exampleAr: يمكنك التواصل معنا عبر البريد الإلكتروني أو الهاتف.

definitionEn: that can be done; that will be successful
example: The plan seems financially viable.
exampleAr: تبدو الخطة قابلة للتطبيق من الناحية المالية.

definitionEn: full of life and energy
example: The city has a vibrant nightlife.
exampleAr: تتمتع المدينة بحياة ليلية نابضة بالحياة.

definitionEn: criminal activities that involve sex or drugs
example: Gambling was considered a vice by many in the community.
exampleAr: كان القمار يُعد رذيلة في نظر كثيرين في المجتمع.

definitionEn: violent and cruel
example: The dog gave a vicious bark when the stranger approached.
exampleAr: نبح الكلب بشراسة عندما اقترب الغريب.

definitionEn: a person who has been attacked, injured or killed as the result of a crime, a disease, an accident, etc.
example: The victim was taken to the hospital immediately.
exampleAr: نُقلت الضحية إلى المستشفى على الفور.

definitionEn: success in a game, an election, a war, etc.
example: The team celebrated their victory with a big parade.
exampleAr: احتفل الفريق بانتصاره باستعراض كبير.

definitionEn: a system of recording moving pictures and sound, either using a digital method of storing data or (in the past) using videotape
example: She uploaded a new video to her channel.
exampleAr: رفعت فيديو جديدًا إلى قناتها.

definitionEn: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful countryside
example: The hotel room has a stunning view of the sea.
exampleAr: تتمتع غرفة الفندق بمنظر خلاب للبحر.

definitionEn: to think about somebody/something in a particular way
example: You can view the document online.
exampleAr: يمكنك مشاهدة المستند عبر الإنترنت.

definitionEn: a person watching television or a video on the internet
example: The show attracts millions of viewers every week.
exampleAr: يجذب البرنامج ملايين المشاهدين كل أسبوع.

definitionEn: a way of thinking about a subject
example: He explained his viewpoint on the issue clearly.
exampleAr: شرح وجهة نظره حول القضية بوضوح.

definitionEn: a very small town located in a country area
example: They grew up in a small village in the countryside.
exampleAr: نشآ في قرية صغيرة في الريف.

definitionEn: a person who lives in a village
example: The villagers gathered to celebrate the harvest.
exampleAr: تجمّع أهالي القرية للاحتفال بموسم الحصاد.

definitionEn: to go against or refuse to obey a law, an agreement, etc.
example: The company violated several safety regulations.
exampleAr: انتهكت الشركة عدة لوائح تتعلق بالسلامة.

definitionEn: the act of going against or refusing to obey a law, an agreement, etc.
example: The fine was issued for a parking violation.
exampleAr: صدرت الغرامة بسبب مخالفة وقوف.

definitionEn: violent behaviour that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
example: The film contains scenes of graphic violence.
exampleAr: يحتوي الفيلم على مشاهد عنف صريح.

definitionEn: involving or caused by physical force that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
example: The protest turned violent after dark.
exampleAr: تحوّلت الاحتجاجات إلى العنف بعد حلول الظلام.

definitionEn: made to appear to exist by the use of computer software, for example on the internet
example: They held a virtual meeting instead of an in-person one.
exampleAr: عقدوا اجتماعًا افتراضيًا بدلاً من اجتماع حضوري.

definitionEn: behaviour or attitudes that show high moral standards
example: Patience is considered a virtue in many cultures.
exampleAr: يُعد الصبر فضيلة في ثقافات كثيرة.

definitionEn: a living thing, too small to be seen without a microscope, that causes disease in people, animals and plants
example: The virus spread quickly through the community.
exampleAr: انتشر الفيروس بسرعة في المجتمع.

definitionEn: a stamp or mark put in your passport by officials of a foreign country that gives you permission to enter, pass through or leave their country
example: He applied for a tourist visa last month.
exampleAr: تقدّم بطلب للحصول على تأشيرة سياحية الشهر الماضي.

definitionEn: that can be seen
example: The mountain was clearly visible from the hotel window.
exampleAr: كان الجبل مرئيًا بوضوح من نافذة الفندق.

definitionEn: the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position
example: His vision has improved since he got glasses.
exampleAr: تحسّنت رؤيته منذ أن ارتدى النظارة.

definitionEn: to go to see a person or a place for a period of time
example: They plan to visit their grandparents this weekend.
exampleAr: يخططان لزيارة جديهما في نهاية هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: an occasion or a period of time when somebody goes to see a place or person and spends time there
example: It was a short but pleasant visit.
exampleAr: كانت زيارة قصيرة لكنها ممتعة.

definitionEn: a person who visits a person or place
example: The museum welcomes thousands of visitors each month.
exampleAr: يستقبل المتحف آلاف الزوار شهريًا.

definitionEn: of or connected with seeing or sight
example: The presentation included a lot of visual aids.
exampleAr: تضمّن العرض التقديمي الكثير من الوسائل البصرية المساعدة.

definitionEn: necessary or essential in order for something to succeed or exist
example: Sleep is vital for good health.
exampleAr: النوم أمر حيوي للصحة الجيدة.

definitionEn: a natural substance found in food that is an essential part of what humans and animals need to help them grow and stay healthy. There are many different vitamins.
example: Oranges are a great source of vitamin C.
exampleAr: البرتقال مصدر رائع لفيتامين سي.

definitionEn: connected with the voice
example: She's taking vocal lessons to improve her singing.
exampleAr: تأخذ دروسًا في الغناء لتحسين أدائها الصوتي.

definitionEn: the sound or sounds produced through the mouth by a person speaking or singing
example: She has a beautiful singing voice.
exampleAr: تمتلك صوتًا جميلاً في الغناء.

definitionEn: the amount of space that an object or a substance fills; the amount of space that a container has
example: The volume of traffic increases during rush hour.
exampleAr: يزداد حجم حركة المرور خلال ساعة الذروة.

definitionEn: done willingly, not because you are forced
example: Participation in the survey is completely voluntary.
exampleAr: المشاركة في الاستطلاع طوعية تمامًا.

definitionEn: a person who does a job without being paid for it
example: She works as a volunteer at the animal shelter.
exampleAr: تعمل متطوعة في دار إيواء الحيوانات.

definitionEn: to offer to do something without being forced to do it or without getting paid for it
example: He volunteered to help organize the event.
exampleAr: تطوّع للمساعدة في تنظيم الفعالية.

definitionEn: to show formally by marking a paper, raising your hand, using a voting machine, etc. which person you want to win an election, or which plan or idea you support
example: Citizens over eighteen are eligible to vote.
exampleAr: يحق للمواطنين فوق سن الثامنة عشرة التصويت.

definitionEn: a formal choice that you make in an election or at a meeting in order to choose somebody or decide something
example: The proposal won by a narrow vote.
exampleAr: فاز الاقتراح بفارق ضئيل من الأصوات.

definitionEn: the action of choosing somebody/something in an election or at a meeting
example: Voting will take place next Tuesday.
exampleAr: سيجري التصويت يوم الثلاثاء المقبل.

definitionEn: to make a formal and serious promise to do something or a formal statement that is true
example: They exchanged wedding vows in front of their families.
exampleAr: تبادلا عهود الزواج أمام عائلتيهما.

definitionEn: to make a formal and serious promise to do something or a formal statement that is true
example: She vowed to never make the same mistake again.
exampleAr: تعهّدت بألا تكرر الخطأ نفسه مرة أخرى.

definitionEn: the fact of being weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally
example: The report highlighted the vulnerability of coastal communities to flooding.
exampleAr: سلّط التقرير الضوء على هشاشة المجتمعات الساحلية أمام الفيضانات.

definitionEn: weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally
example: Elderly people are more vulnerable to the disease.
exampleAr: كبار السن أكثر عرضة للإصابة بهذا المرض.

definitionEn: a regular amount of money that you earn, usually every week or every month, for work or services
example: The company raised the minimum wage this year.
exampleAr: رفعت الشركة الحد الأدنى للأجور هذا العام.

definitionEn: to stay where you are or delay doing something until somebody/something comes or something happens
example: Please wait here until your name is called.
exampleAr: من فضلك انتظر هنا حتى يُنادى اسمك.

definitionEn: a man whose job is to serve customers at their tables in a restaurant, etc.
example: The waiter recommended the fish special.
exampleAr: أوصى النادل بطبق السمك المميز.

definitionEn: to stop sleeping; to make somebody stop sleeping
example: He usually wakes up at six in the morning.
exampleAr: عادةً ما يستيقظ في السادسة صباحًا.

definitionEn: to move or go somewhere by putting one foot in front of the other on the ground, but without running
example: They walked to the park after lunch.
exampleAr: مشيا إلى الحديقة بعد الغداء.

definitionEn: a journey on foot, usually for pleasure or exercise
example: Let's go for a walk along the beach.
exampleAr: لنذهب في نزهة على طول الشاطئ.

definitionEn: a long, solid structure that rises straight up from the ground, made of stone, brick or concrete, that surrounds, divides or protects an area of land
example: They hung a large painting on the wall.
exampleAr: علّقوا لوحة كبيرة على الحائط.

definitionEn: to walk slowly around or to a place, often without any particular sense of purpose or direction
example: They wandered through the old streets of the city.
exampleAr: تجوّلا في شوارع المدينة القديمة.

definitionEn: to have a desire or a wish for something/somebody
example: She wants to become a doctor someday.
exampleAr: تريد أن تصبح طبيبة يومًا ما.

definitionEn: a situation in which two or more countries or groups of people fight against each other over a period of time
example: The country has been at war for over a decade.
exampleAr: ظلت البلاد في حالة حرب لأكثر من عقد.

definitionEn: a separate room or area in a hospital for people with the same type of medical condition
example: He was moved to the recovery ward after surgery.
exampleAr: نُقل إلى جناح التعافي بعد الجراحة.

definitionEn: a building where large quantities of goods are stored, especially before they are sent to shops to be sold
example: The goods are stored in a large warehouse outside the city.
exampleAr: تُخزَّن البضائع في مستودع كبير خارج المدينة.

definitionEn: the activity of fighting a war, especially using particular weapons or methods
example: Modern warfare relies heavily on technology.
exampleAr: تعتمد الحرب الحديثة بشكل كبير على التكنولوجيا.

definitionEn: at a fairly high temperature in a way that is pleasant, rather than being hot or cold
example: It was a warm, sunny afternoon.
exampleAr: كان بعد ظهر دافئًا ومشمسًا.

definitionEn: to make something/somebody warm or warmer; to become warm or warmer
example: She warmed her hands by the fire.
exampleAr: دفّأت يديها بجانب النار.

definitionEn: the process of making something, or of becoming, warm or warmer
example: Global warming is affecting weather patterns worldwide.
exampleAr: يؤثر الاحترار العالمي على أنماط الطقس في جميع أنحاء العالم.

definitionEn: to tell somebody about something, especially something dangerous or unpleasant that is likely to happen, so that they can avoid it
example: The lifeguard warned swimmers about the strong currents.
exampleAr: حذّر منقذ الشاطئ السباحين من التيارات القوية.

definitionEn: a statement, an event, etc. telling somebody that something bad or unpleasant may happen in the future so that they can try to avoid it
example: The government issued a storm warning for the coastal areas.
exampleAr: أصدرت الحكومة تحذيرًا من عاصفة للمناطق الساحلية.

definitionEn: a legal document that is signed by a judge and gives the police authority to do something
example: Police obtained a warrant to search the house.
exampleAr: حصلت الشرطة على مذكرة لتفتيش المنزل.

definitionEn: to make something necessary or appropriate in a particular situation
example: The situation doesn't warrant such a drastic response.
exampleAr: لا يستدعي الموقف مثل هذا الرد الحاد.

definitionEn: (especially in the past) a person who fights in a battle or war
example: The statue depicts an ancient warrior holding a shield.
exampleAr: يصوّر التمثال محاربًا قديمًا يحمل درعًا.

definitionEn: to make something/somebody clean using water and usually soap
example: Please wash your hands before eating.
exampleAr: من فضلك اغسل يديك قبل الأكل.

definitionEn: the act of cleaning something using water and usually soap
example: She hung the washing out to dry in the sun.
exampleAr: علّقت الغسيل ليجف في الشمس.

definitionEn: the act of using something in a careless or unnecessary way, causing it to be lost or destroyed
example: The factory produces a lot of industrial waste.
exampleAr: ينتج المصنع كمية كبيرة من النفايات الصناعية.

definitionEn: to use more of something than is necessary or useful
example: Don't waste your money on things you don't need.
exampleAr: لا تُهدر مالك على أشياء لا تحتاجها.

definitionEn: to look at somebody/something for a time, paying attention to what happens
example: They watched a movie together last night.
exampleAr: شاهدا فيلمًا معًا الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: a type of small clock that you wear on your wrist, or (in the past) carried in your pocket
example: He got a new watch for his birthday.
exampleAr: حصل على ساعة يد جديدة في عيد ميلاده.

definitionEn: a liquid without colour, smell or taste that falls as rain, is in lakes, rivers and seas, and is used for drinking, washing, etc.
example: Please drink more water during the summer.
exampleAr: من فضلك اشرب مزيدًا من الماء خلال الصيف.

definitionEn: to pour water on plants, etc.
example: She waters the plants every morning.
exampleAr: تسقي النباتات كل صباح.

definitionEn: a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea, ocean, etc.
example: The waves were too strong for swimming today.
exampleAr: كانت الأمواج قوية جدًا للسباحة اليوم.

definitionEn: to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air in order to attract attention, say hello, etc.
example: She waved goodbye as the train left the station.
exampleAr: لوّحت مودعةً بينما غادر القطار المحطة.

definitionEn: a method, style or manner of doing something
example: There must be a better way to solve this.
exampleAr: لا بد من وجود طريقة أفضل لحل هذا الأمر.

definitionEn: I and another person or other people; I and you
example: We are going to the beach this weekend.
exampleAr: سنذهب إلى الشاطئ نهاية هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: not physically strong
example: He felt weak after being sick for a week.
exampleAr: شعر بالضعف بعد أن كان مريضًا لمدة أسبوع.

definitionEn: to make somebody/something less strong or powerful; to become less strong or powerful
example: The scandal weakened public trust in the government.
exampleAr: أضعفت الفضيحة ثقة الجمهور بالحكومة.

definitionEn: lack of physical strength
example: Time management is one of his weaknesses.
exampleAr: إدارة الوقت واحدة من نقاط ضعفه.

definitionEn: a large amount of money, property, etc. that a person or country owns
example: The family built their wealth through real estate.
exampleAr: بنت العائلة ثروتها من خلال العقارات.

definitionEn: having a lot of money, possessions, etc.
example: They live in a wealthy neighborhood.
exampleAr: يعيشون في حي ثري.

definitionEn: an object such as a knife, gun, bomb, etc. that is used for fighting or attacking somebody
example: Police found an illegal weapon in the car.
exampleAr: عثرت الشرطة على سلاح غير مرخص في السيارة.

definitionEn: to have something on your body as a piece of clothing, a decoration, etc.
example: She usually wears a hat to protect herself from the sun.
exampleAr: عادةً ما ترتدي قبعة لحماية نفسها من الشمس.

definitionEn: the condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, such as the temperature, and if there is wind, rain, sun, etc.
example: The weather has been unpredictable lately.
exampleAr: كان الطقس غير مستقر مؤخرًا.

definitionEn: to make cloth, a carpet, a basket, etc. by crossing threads or narrow pieces of material across, over and under each other by hand or on a machine called a loom
example: She wove a beautiful basket from palm leaves.
exampleAr: نسجت سلة جميلة من سعف النخيل.

definitionEn: a system for finding information on the internet, in which documents are connected to other documents
example: A spider had spun a web in the corner of the room.
exampleAr: نسج عنكبوت شبكة في زاوية الغرفة.

definitionEn: a set of pages on the internet, where a company or an organization, or an individual person, puts information
example: You can book your ticket on the airline's website.
exampleAr: يمكنك حجز تذكرتك على الموقع الإلكتروني لشركة الطيران.

definitionEn: a marriage ceremony, and the meal or party that usually follows it
example: They're planning a small wedding next spring.
exampleAr: يخططان لحفل زفاف صغير في الربيع المقبل.

definitionEn: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday
example: The exam is scheduled for next Wednesday.
exampleAr: الامتحان مقرر يوم الأربعاء المقبل.

definitionEn: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted, especially among crops or garden plants
example: He spent the morning pulling weeds from the garden.
exampleAr: قضى الصباح في اقتلاع الأعشاب الضارة من الحديقة.

definitionEn: a period of seven days, either from Monday to Sunday or from Sunday to Saturday
example: I'll see you next week.
exampleAr: سأراك الأسبوع المقبل.

definitionEn: Saturday and Sunday
example: They're going hiking this weekend.
exampleAr: سيذهبان للتنزه في نهاية هذا الأسبوع.

definitionEn: happening, done or published once a week or every week
example: The magazine is published on a weekly basis.
exampleAr: تُنشر المجلة بشكل أسبوعي.

definitionEn: to have a particular weight
example: The suitcase weighs almost twenty kilos.
exampleAr: تزن الحقيبة نحو عشرين كيلوغرامًا.

definitionEn: how heavy somebody/something is, which can be measured in, for example, kilograms or pounds
example: He's been trying to lose weight since January.
exampleAr: يحاول إنقاص وزنه منذ يناير.

definitionEn: very strange or unusual and difficult to explain
example: That was a really weird dream I had last night.
exampleAr: كان ذلك حلمًا غريبًا حقًا رأيته الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: to say hello to somebody in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere
example: They welcomed the new employees with a small party.
exampleAr: رحّبوا بالموظفين الجدد بحفلة صغيرة.

definitionEn: accepted or wanted somewhere
example: You're always welcome to visit us anytime.
exampleAr: أنت دائمًا مرحّب بك لزيارتنا في أي وقت.

definitionEn: the general health, happiness and safety of a person, an animal or a group
example: The organization focuses on animal welfare.
exampleAr: تركّز المنظمة على رعاية الحيوانات.

definitionEn: in a good, right or acceptable way
example: She did really well on the exam.
exampleAr: أدّت أداءً جيدًا حقًا في الامتحان.

definitionEn: a deep hole in the ground from which people obtain water. The sides of wells are usually covered with brick or stone and there is usually a cover or a small wall at the top of the well.
example: They dug a well to access underground water.
exampleAr: حفروا بئرًا للوصول إلى المياه الجوفية.

definitionEn: in good health
example: I hope you're feeling well soon.
exampleAr: أتمنى أن تتحسن صحتك قريبًا.

definitionEn: general health and happiness
example: The company offers programs to support employee well-being.
exampleAr: تقدّم الشركة برامج لدعم رفاهية الموظفين.

definitionEn: the direction that you look towards to see the sun go down; one of the four main points of the compass
example: The sun sets in the west.
exampleAr: تغرب الشمس في الغرب.

definitionEn: located in the west or facing west
example: They studied Western literature in college.
exampleAr: درسا الأدب الغربي في الجامعة.

definitionEn: covered with or containing liquid, especially water
example: Don't sit on the wet grass.
exampleAr: لا تجلس على العشب المبلل.

definitionEn: used in questions to ask for particular information about somebody/something
example: What did you say?
exampleAr: ماذا قلت؟

definitionEn: used in questions to ask for particular information about somebody/something
example: What time is it?
exampleAr: كم الساعة؟

definitionEn: any or every; anything or everything
example: Whatever you decide, I'll support you.
exampleAr: مهما قررت، سأدعمك.

definitionEn: not at all; not of any kind
example: There's no evidence whatsoever to support that claim.
exampleAr: لا يوجد أي دليل على الإطلاق يدعم هذا الادعاء.

definitionEn: a plant grown for its grain that is used to produce the flour for bread, cakes, pasta, etc.; the grain of this plant
example: Egypt imports a large amount of wheat every year.
exampleAr: تستورد مصر كمية كبيرة من القمح كل عام.

definitionEn: one of the round objects under a car, bicycle, bus, etc. that turns when it moves
example: One of the car's wheels needs to be replaced.
exampleAr: تحتاج إحدى عجلات السيارة إلى الاستبدال.

definitionEn: at what time; on what occasion
example: When are you leaving for the airport?
exampleAr: متى ستغادر إلى المطار؟

definitionEn: at or during the time that
example: Call me when you arrive at the hotel.
exampleAr: اتصل بي عندما تصل إلى الفندق.

definitionEn: at any time that; on any occasion that
example: You can visit whenever you like.
exampleAr: يمكنك الزيارة متى ما شئت.

definitionEn: in or to what place or situation
example: Where did you put my keys?
exampleAr: أين وضعت مفاتيحي؟

definitionEn: used to compare or contrast two facts
example: He loves the city, whereas she prefers the countryside.
exampleAr: هو يحب المدينة، بينما تفضل هي الريف.

definitionEn: by which; because of which
example: They signed an agreement whereby both sides share the profits.
exampleAr: وقّعا اتفاقًا يتقاسم بموجبه الطرفان الأرباح.

definitionEn: in any place
example: You can sit wherever you like.
exampleAr: يمكنك الجلوس أينما تشاء.

definitionEn: used to express a doubt or choice between two possibilities
example: I'm not sure whether he's coming or not.
exampleAr: لست متأكدًا إن كان سيأتي أم لا.

definitionEn: used in questions to ask somebody to be exact about one or more people or things from a limited number
example: Which one do you prefer?
exampleAr: أيهما تفضل؟

definitionEn: during the time that something is happening; at the same time as something else is happening
example: She read a book while waiting for the bus.
exampleAr: قرأت كتابًا بينما كانت تنتظر الحافلة.

definitionEn: a period of time
example: Let's talk for a while before we leave.
exampleAr: لنتحدث لفترة قبل أن نغادر.

definitionEn: during the time that something is happening; at the same time as something else is happening
example: Whilst I understand your concern, I disagree with the solution.
exampleAr: بينما أتفهّم قلقك، فإنني لا أوافق على الحل.

definitionEn: to hit a person or an animal hard with a whip, as a punishment or to make them go faster or work harder
example: The rider carried a whip but rarely used it.
exampleAr: كان الفارس يحمل سوطًا لكنه نادرًا ما استخدمه.

definitionEn: to hit a person or an animal hard with a whip, as a punishment or to make them go faster or work harder
example: She whipped the cream until it formed peaks.
exampleAr: خفقت الكريمة حتى تشكّلت قمم منها.

definitionEn: to speak very quietly to somebody so that other people cannot hear what you are saying
example: She whispered the secret in his ear.
exampleAr: همست بالسر في أذنه.

definitionEn: a low, quiet voice or the sound it makes
example: He spoke in a low whisper so no one else could hear.
exampleAr: تحدث بهمس خافت حتى لا يسمعه أحد آخر.

definitionEn: having the colour of fresh snow or of milk
example: She wore a white dress to the wedding.
exampleAr: ارتدت فستانًا أبيض إلى حفل الزفاف.

definitionEn: used in questions to ask about the name, identity or function of one or more people
example: Who is coming to the party tonight?
exampleAr: من سيأتي إلى الحفلة الليلة؟

definitionEn: the person or people who; any person who
example: Whoever finishes first wins the prize.
exampleAr: من ينتهي أولاً يفوز بالجائزة.

definitionEn: full; complete
example: She spent the whole day cleaning the house.
exampleAr: قضت اليوم بأكمله في تنظيف المنزل.

definitionEn: completely
example: The decision was wholly unexpected.
exampleAr: كان القرار غير متوقع تمامًا.

definitionEn: used instead of ‘who’ as the object of a verb or preposition
example: To whom should I address the letter?
exampleAr: إلى من ينبغي أن أوجّه الرسالة؟

definitionEn: used in questions to ask who something belongs to
example: Whose bag is this?
exampleAr: لمن هذه الحقيبة؟

definitionEn: used in questions to ask the reason for or purpose of something
example: Why did you decide to leave early?
exampleAr: لماذا قررت المغادرة مبكرًا؟

definitionEn: measuring a large distance from one side to the other
example: The river is very wide at this point.
exampleAr: النهر عريض جدًا عند هذه النقطة.

definitionEn: by a lot of people; in or to many places
example: The book is widely regarded as a classic.
exampleAr: يُعد الكتاب على نطاق واسع عملاً كلاسيكيًا.

definitionEn: to become wider; to make something wider
example: They widened the road to reduce traffic congestion.
exampleAr: وسّعوا الطريق لتقليل ازدحام المرور.

definitionEn: existing or happening over a large area or among many people
example: There was widespread support for the new policy.
exampleAr: كان هناك تأييد واسع الانتشار للسياسة الجديدة.

definitionEn: a woman whose husband or wife has died and who has not married again
example: She became a widow at a young age.
exampleAr: أصبحت أرملة في سن مبكرة.

definitionEn: the measurement from one side of something to the other; how wide something is
example: Measure the width of the door before buying the frame.
exampleAr: قِس عرض الباب قبل شراء الإطار.

definitionEn: the woman that somebody is married to; a married woman
example: His wife works as a doctor at the local hospital.
exampleAr: تعمل زوجته طبيبة في المستشفى المحلي.

definitionEn: living or growing in natural conditions; not kept in a house or on a farm
example: They saw wild elephants during the safari.
exampleAr: شاهدا أفيالاً برية أثناء رحلة السفاري.

definitionEn: animals, birds, insects, etc. that are wild and live in a natural environment
example: The park is home to a rich variety of wildlife.
exampleAr: يضم المتنزه تنوعًا غنيًا من الحياة البرية.

definitionEn: used for talking about or predicting the future
example: I will call you tomorrow morning.
exampleAr: سأتصل بك صباح الغد.

definitionEn: the ability to control your thoughts and actions in order to achieve what you want to do; a strong and determined desire to do something that you want to do
example: She has a strong will to succeed.
exampleAr: تمتلك إرادة قوية للنجاح.

definitionEn: not objecting to doing something; having no reason for not doing something
example: She's willing to work overtime if needed.
exampleAr: هي مستعدة للعمل الإضافي إذا لزم الأمر.

definitionEn: the quality of being happy and ready to do something
example: His willingness to help impressed everyone.
exampleAr: أعجب استعداده للمساعدة الجميع.

definitionEn: to be the most successful in a competition, race, battle, etc.
example: They won the match in the final minute.
exampleAr: فازوا بالمباراة في الدقيقة الأخيرة.

definitionEn: a victory in a game, contest, etc.
example: It was a hard-fought win for the underdogs.
exampleAr: كان فوزًا شاقًا للفريق المستضعف.

example: The wind was strong enough to knock over the umbrella.
exampleAr: كانت الريح قوية بما يكفي لإسقاط المظلة.

definitionEn: to have many bends and twists
example: The road winds through the mountains for several miles.
exampleAr: يلتف الطريق عبر الجبال لعدة أميال.

definitionEn: an opening in the wall or roof of a building, car, etc., usually covered with glass, that allows light and air to come in and people to see out; the glass in a window
example: She opened the window to let in some fresh air.
exampleAr: فتحت النافذة لتدخل بعض الهواء المنعش.

definitionEn: an alcoholic drink made from the juice of grapes that has been left to ferment. There are many different kinds of wine.
example: They ordered a bottle of red wine with dinner.
exampleAr: طلبا زجاجة نبيذ أحمر مع العشاء.

definitionEn: one of the parts of the body of a bird, insect or bat that it uses for flying
example: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
exampleAr: فرد الطائر جناحيه وطار بعيدًا.

definitionEn: a person, a team, an animal, etc. that wins something
example: The winner will receive a cash prize.
exampleAr: سيحصل الفائز على جائزة مالية.

definitionEn: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring
example: It snows heavily here in winter.
exampleAr: تتساقط الثلوج بغزارة هنا في الشتاء.

definitionEn: to rub something against a surface, in order to remove dirt or liquid from it; to rub a surface with a cloth, etc. in order to clean it
example: He wiped the table after dinner.
exampleAr: مسح الطاولة بعد العشاء.

definitionEn: metal in the form of thin thread; a piece of this
example: The electrician replaced the damaged wire.
exampleAr: استبدل الكهربائي السلك التالف.

definitionEn: the ability to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have
example: She shared some wisdom she'd gained over the years.
exampleAr: شاركت بعض الحكمة التي اكتسبتها عبر السنين.

definitionEn: able to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have
example: It was a wise decision to save some money each month.
exampleAr: كان قرارًا حكيمًا أن تدّخر بعض المال كل شهر.

definitionEn: to want something to happen or to be true even though it is unlikely or impossible
example: I wish I could travel more often.
exampleAr: أتمنى لو كان بإمكاني السفر أكثر.

definitionEn: used especially in a letter, email or card to say that you hope that somebody will be happy, well or successful
example: She made a wish before blowing out the candles.
exampleAr: تمنّت أمنية قبل أن تطفئ الشموع.

definitionEn: the ability to say or write things that are both clever and humorous
example: He's known for his quick wit and sense of humor.
exampleAr: يُعرف بخفة بديهته وحسّه الفكاهي.

definitionEn: in the company or presence of somebody/something
example: She went to the concert with her friends.
exampleAr: ذهبت إلى الحفل الموسيقي مع صديقاتها.

definitionEn: to take money out of a bank account
example: He withdrew some cash from the ATM.
exampleAr: سحب بعض النقود من ماكينة الصراف الآلي.

definitionEn: the act of taking an amount of money out of your bank account
example: The bank charges a fee for early withdrawal.
exampleAr: يفرض البنك رسومًا على السحب المبكر.

definitionEn: before a particular period of time has passed; during a particular period of time
example: The package should arrive within three days.
exampleAr: من المفترض أن يصل الطرد في غضون ثلاثة أيام.

definitionEn: not having, experiencing or showing something
example: She left without saying goodbye.
exampleAr: غادرت دون أن تودّع أحدًا.

definitionEn: a person who sees something happen and is able to describe it to other people
example: The witness described exactly what she saw.
exampleAr: وصفت الشاهدة بالضبط ما رأته.

definitionEn: to see something happen (typically a crime or an accident)
example: Thousands of people witnessed the historic event.
exampleAr: شهد آلاف الأشخاص هذا الحدث التاريخي.

definitionEn: an adult female human
example: The woman at the front desk was very helpful.
exampleAr: كانت المرأة في مكتب الاستقبال متعاونة جدًا.

definitionEn: to think about something and try to decide what is true, what will happen, what you should do, etc.
example: I wonder what time the meeting starts.
exampleAr: أتساءل في أي وقت يبدأ الاجتماع.

definitionEn: a feeling of surprise and pleasure that you have when you see or experience something beautiful, unusual or unexpected
example: The children looked at the fireworks in wonder.
exampleAr: نظر الأطفال إلى الألعاب النارية في دهشة.

definitionEn: very good, pleasant or a lot of fun
example: We had a wonderful time at the beach.
exampleAr: قضينا وقتًا رائعًا في الشاطئ.

definitionEn: the hard material that the trunk and branches of a tree are made of; this material when it is used to build or make things with, or as a fuel
example: The table is made of solid wood.
exampleAr: الطاولة مصنوعة من الخشب الصلب.

definitionEn: made of wood
example: They have a beautiful wooden staircase.
exampleAr: يمتلكون درجًا خشبيًا جميلاً.

definitionEn: the soft hair that covers the body of sheep and some other animals
example: The sweater is made of pure wool.
exampleAr: الكنزة مصنوعة من الصوف الخالص.

definitionEn: a single unit of language that means something and can be spoken or written
example: I don't understand this word, can you explain it?
exampleAr: لا أفهم هذه الكلمة، هل يمكنك أن تشرحها؟

definitionEn: to do something that involves physical or mental effort, especially as part of a job
example: She works at a hospital downtown.
exampleAr: تعمل في مستشفى وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: the job that a person does especially in order to earn money
example: He has a lot of work to finish before Friday.
exampleAr: لديه الكثير من العمل لإنهائه قبل يوم الجمعة.

definitionEn: a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of work
example: The factory employs over five hundred workers.
exampleAr: يوظّف المصنع أكثر من خمسمائة عامل.

definitionEn: all the people who work for a particular company, organization, etc.
example: Women make up nearly half of the workforce.
exampleAr: تشكّل النساء ما يقرب من نصف القوى العاملة.

definitionEn: having a job for which you are paid
example: She's a working mother with two kids.
exampleAr: هي أم عاملة لديها طفلان.

definitionEn: a period of physical exercise that you do to keep fit
example: He does a quick workout every morning before work.
exampleAr: يمارس تمرينًا رياضيًا سريعًا كل صباح قبل العمل.

definitionEn: the office, factory, etc. where people work
example: The company promotes a healthy workplace culture.
exampleAr: تعزّز الشركة ثقافة عمل صحية في مكان العمل.

definitionEn: a period of discussion and practical work on a particular subject, in which a group of people share their knowledge and experience
example: She attended a writing workshop last weekend.
exampleAr: حضرت ورشة عمل للكتابة نهاية الأسبوع الماضي.

definitionEn: the earth, with all its countries, peoples and natural features
example: They traveled around the world for a year.
exampleAr: سافرا حول العالم لمدة عام.

definitionEn: affecting all parts of the world
example: The brand has worldwide recognition.
exampleAr: تحظى العلامة التجارية باعتراف عالمي.

definitionEn: a long, thin creature with a soft body and no bones or legs
example: The bird pulled a worm out of the ground.
exampleAr: سحب الطائر دودة من الأرض.

definitionEn: thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen and therefore feeling unhappy and afraid
example: She looked worried about the exam results.
exampleAr: بدت قلقة بشأن نتائج الامتحان.

definitionEn: to keep thinking about unpleasant things that might happen or about problems that you have
example: Don't worry, everything will be fine.
exampleAr: لا تقلق، كل شيء سيكون بخير.

definitionEn: the state of worrying about something
example: Money is a constant worry for many families.
exampleAr: يُعد المال مصدر قلق دائم لعائلات كثيرة.

definitionEn: of poorer quality or lower standard; more unpleasant
example: The traffic today is even worse than yesterday.
exampleAr: حركة المرور اليوم أسوأ حتى من أمس.

definitionEn: to show respect for God or a god, especially by saying prayers, singing, etc. with other people in a religious building
example: They gathered at the temple to worship.
exampleAr: تجمّعوا في المعبد للعبادة.

definitionEn: the practice of showing respect for God or a god, by saying prayers, singing with others, etc.; a ceremony for this
example: The building is used for worship every Friday.
exampleAr: يُستخدم المبنى للعبادة كل يوم جمعة.

definitionEn: of the poorest quality or lowest standard; worse than any other person or thing of a similar kind
example: That was the worst movie I've ever seen.
exampleAr: كان ذلك أسوأ فيلم شاهدته على الإطلاق.

definitionEn: having a value in money, etc.
example: The painting is worth a lot of money.
exampleAr: تساوي اللوحة الكثير من المال.

definitionEn: an amount of something that has the value mentioned
example: He proved his worth to the team early on.
exampleAr: أثبت قيمته للفريق في وقت مبكر.

definitionEn: important, pleasant, interesting, etc.; worth spending time, money or effort on
example: The trip was long, but it was worthwhile.
exampleAr: كانت الرحلة طويلة، لكنها كانت تستحق العناء.

definitionEn: having the qualities that deserve somebody/something
example: She's a worthy winner of the award.
exampleAr: هي فائزة جديرة بهذه الجائزة.

meaningAr: سوف (تعبير عن المستقبل بالنسبة للماضي) / تعبير عن الرغبة أو الافتراض
definitionEn: used in polite offers or invitations
example: He said he would call later that evening.
exampleAr: قال إنه سيتصل في وقت لاحق من تلك الأمسية.

definitionEn: an injury to part of the body, especially one in which a hole is made in the skin using a weapon
example: The doctor cleaned the wound carefully.
exampleAr: نظّف الطبيب الجرح بعناية.

definitionEn: to injure part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin using a weapon
example: He was wounded during the accident.
exampleAr: أُصيب بجروح أثناء الحادث.

definitionEn: used to show that you are very surprised or impressed by somebody/something
example: Wow, this view is absolutely amazing!
exampleAr: واو، هذا المنظر مذهل تمامًا!

definitionEn: to cover something completely in paper or other material, for example when you are giving it as a present
example: She wrapped the gift in colorful paper.
exampleAr: لفّت الهدية بورق ملون.

definitionEn: the joint between the hand and the arm
example: She wears a bracelet on her wrist.
exampleAr: ترتدي سوارًا في معصمها.

definitionEn: to make letters or numbers on a surface, especially using a pen or a pencil
example: He writes a new blog post every week.
exampleAr: يكتب مقالة جديدة على مدونته كل أسبوع.

definitionEn: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc.
example: She's a writer known for her mystery novels.
exampleAr: هي كاتبة معروفة برواياتها البوليسية.

definitionEn: the activity of writing, in contrast to reading, speaking, etc.
example: Her writing has improved a lot since last year.
exampleAr: تحسّنت كتابتها كثيرًا منذ العام الماضي.

definitionEn: expressed in writing rather than in speech
example: Please provide written confirmation of the agreement.
exampleAr: من فضلك قدّم تأكيدًا مكتوبًا للاتفاق.

definitionEn: not right or correct
example: I think you dialed the wrong number.
exampleAr: أعتقد أنك اتصلت برقم خاطئ.

definitionEn: a piece of land next to or around your house where you can grow flowers, fruit, vegetables, etc., usually with a lawn (= an area of grass)
example: The kids were playing in the backyard.
exampleAr: كان الأطفال يلعبون في الفناء الخلفي.

example: Yeah, I think that sounds like a great idea.
exampleAr: نعم، أعتقد أن هذه فكرة رائعة.

definitionEn: the period from 1 January to 31 December, that is 365 or 366 days, divided into 12 months
example: They got married last year.
exampleAr: تزوجا العام الماضي.

definitionEn: to shout loudly, for example because you are angry, excited, frightened or in pain
example: He yelled at the driver to stop.
exampleAr: صرخ في وجه السائق ليتوقف.

definitionEn: having the colour of lemons or butter
example: She painted her room a bright yellow.
exampleAr: طلت غرفتها باللون الأصفر الزاهي.

definitionEn: used to answer a question and say that something is correct or true
example: Yes, I'd love to join you for dinner.
exampleAr: نعم، يسعدني الانضمام إليكم لتناول العشاء.

definitionEn: on the day before today
example: I saw her at the market yesterday.
exampleAr: رأيتها في السوق أمس.

meaningAr: حتى الآن (في النفي) / لكن / ومع ذلك
definitionEn: used in negative sentences and questions to talk about something that has not happened but that you expect to happen
example: I haven't finished the report yet.
exampleAr: لم أنتهِ من التقرير حتى الآن.

definitionEn: the total amount of crops, profits, etc. that are produced
example: The new farming method yielded a much bigger harvest.
exampleAr: أثمرت طريقة الزراعة الجديدة عن حصاد أكبر بكثير.

definitionEn: the total amount of crops, profits, etc. that are produced
example: Farmers reported a lower yield this season due to the drought.
exampleAr: أفاد المزارعون بانخفاض الإنتاج هذا الموسم بسبب الجفاف.

definitionEn: used as the subject or object of a verb or after a preposition to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to
example: You should try this restaurant sometime.
exampleAr: عليك أن تجرّب هذا المطعم في وقت ما.

definitionEn: having lived or existed for only a short time; not fully developed
example: They have three young children.
exampleAr: لديهم ثلاثة أطفال صغار.

definitionEn: a young person or a child
example: The youngsters spent the afternoon playing football.
exampleAr: قضى الصغار بعد الظهر في لعب كرة القدم.

definitionEn: of or belonging to the person or people being spoken or written to
example: Is this your bag?
exampleAr: هل هذه حقيبتك؟

definitionEn: of or belonging to you
example: This pen is yours, not mine.
exampleAr: هذا القلم ملكك، وليس ملكي.

definitionEn: used when the person or people being spoken to both cause and are affected by an action
example: Did you make this cake yourself?
exampleAr: هل صنعت هذه الكعكة بنفسك؟

definitionEn: the time of life when a person is young, especially the time before a child becomes an adult
example: He was a talented athlete in his youth.
exampleAr: كان رياضيًا موهوبًا في شبابه.

example: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
exampleAr: انخفضت درجة الحرارة إلى الصفر الليلة الماضية.

definitionEn: an area or a region with a particular feature or use
example: This area has been declared a no-parking zone.
exampleAr: أُعلنت هذه المنطقة منطقة ممنوع الوقوف فيها.

definitionEn: acceptable; in an acceptable manner
example: The interview went all right.
exampleAr: سارت المقابلة بشكل جيد.

definitionEn: used to check that somebody agrees or understands
example: All right, let's get started.
exampleAr: حسنًا، لنبدأ.

definitionEn: one more; an extra thing or person
example: This cake is good, can I have another?
exampleAr: هذه الكعكة لذيذة، هل يمكنني أخذ واحدة أخرى؟

meaningAr: أي مكان (كموضوع أو مفعول في الجملة)
definitionEn: used in negative sentences and in questions instead of somewhere
example: Anywhere is fine with me.
exampleAr: أي مكان يناسبني.

definitionEn: used for asking people to listen to something that is being announced
example: Attention, please! The train is arriving.
exampleAr: انتباه من فضلكم! القطار قادم.

definitionEn: on the other side; further on
example: The road continues for another mile, and beyond, there's nothing but desert.
exampleAr: يمتد الطريق لميل آخر، وفيما بعد ذلك، لا يوجد سوى الصحراء.

definitionEn: an empty space on a printed form or document for you to write answers, information, etc. in
example: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.
exampleAr: املأ الفراغات بالكلمات الصحيحة.

definitionEn: used with plural nouns to mean ‘the two’ or ‘the one as well as the other’
example: I like tea and coffee — I'll have both.
exampleAr: أحب الشاي والقهوة، سآخذ كليهما.

definitionEn: to apply a brand name, image or identity to something
example: The media branded him a liar.
exampleAr: وصفته وسائل الإعلام بالكاذب.

definitionEn: a quiet and peaceful time or situation
example: After the storm, a strange calm settled over the town.
exampleAr: بعد العاصفة، خيّم هدوء غريب على المدينة.

meaningAr: بحرف كبير (عن الحروف الأبجدية) / متعلق بعقوبة الإعدام
definitionEn: having the form and size used at the beginning of a sentence or a name
example: Write your name in capital letters.
exampleAr: اكتب اسمك بأحرف كبيرة.

definitionEn: the act of capturing somebody/something or of being captured
example: News of his capture spread quickly across the country.
exampleAr: انتشرت أخبار أسره بسرعة في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

definitionEn: a person who cheats, especially in a game
example: Everyone at school knew he was a cheat.
exampleAr: عرف الجميع في المدرسة أنه غشّاش.

meaningAr: فعل مساعد يفيد القدرة في الماضي / فعل مساعد للطلب المؤدب / فعل مساعد يفيد الاحتمال
definitionEn: used as the past tense of ‘can’
example: She could swim before she was five.
exampleAr: كانت تستطيع السباحة قبل أن تبلغ الخامسة.

definitionEn: very popular with a particular group of people
example: The film became a cult classic among fans.
exampleAr: أصبح الفيلم عملاً كلاسيكيًا يحظى بجمهور متعصب.

definitionEn: to make somebody feel very worried or unhappy
example: The news of the accident distressed the whole family.
exampleAr: أحزن خبر الحادث العائلة بأكملها.

definitionEn: in, towards or typical of the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: They opened a new downtown office.
exampleAr: افتتحوا مكتبًا جديدًا في وسط المدينة.

definitionEn: a group of twelve of the same thing
example: Dozens of people gathered outside the building.
exampleAr: تجمّع العشرات من الناس خارج المبنى.

definitionEn: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: The tickets cost ten dollars each.
exampleAr: تكلف التذاكر عشرة دولارات لكل واحدة.

definitionEn: in or towards the east
example: They live on the east coast.
exampleAr: يعيشون على الساحل الشرقي.

definitionEn: used after negative phrases to state that a feeling or situation is similar to one already mentioned
example: I don't like coffee, and I don't like tea either.
exampleAr: لا أحب القهوة، ولا أحب الشاي أيضًا.

definitionEn: one or the other of two; it does not matter which
example: Would you like tea or coffee? — Either is fine.
exampleAr: هل تريد شايًا أم قهوة؟ - أيٌّ منهما يناسبني.

definitionEn: as many or as much as somebody needs or wants
example: I've had enough, thank you.
exampleAr: اكتفيت، شكرًا.

definitionEn: connected with the family or a particular family
example: We took a family trip to the coast.
exampleAr: قمنا برحلة عائلية إلى الساحل.

definitionEn: used with plural nouns and a plural verb to mean ‘a small number’, ‘some’
example: His friends are few.
exampleAr: أصدقاؤه قليلون.

definitionEn: a small number of people, things or places; some
example: Few believed his story.
exampleAr: قلة من الناس صدّقوا قصته.

definitionEn: for all the hours of a week during which people normally work or study, rather than just for a part of it
example: She works full-time as a nurse.
exampleAr: تعمل بدوام كامل كممرضة.

definitionEn: used when you are leaving somebody or when somebody else is leaving
example: They said their goodbyes at the airport.
exampleAr: ودّعوا بعضهم في المطار.

definitionEn: the colour of smoke or ashes
example: She was dressed in grey.
exampleAr: كانت ترتدي اللون الرمادي.

definitionEn: used as a greeting when you meet somebody, in an email, when you answer the phone or when you want to attract somebody’s attention
example: He gave me a quick hello before leaving.
exampleAr: ألقى عليّ تحية سريعة قبل أن يغادر.

definitionEn: forming the inner part of something; not on the outside
example: He keeps his wallet in the inside pocket of his jacket.
exampleAr: يحتفظ بمحفظته في الجيب الداخلي لسترته.

definitionEn: on or to the inside
example: It's cold outside — let's go inside.
exampleAr: الجو بارد بالخارج، لنذهب إلى الداخل.

definitionEn: used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned
example: Most of the growth happened in the latter half of the year.
exampleAr: حدث معظم النمو في النصف الأخير من العام.

definitionEn: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
example: I have the least money of all of us.
exampleAr: لدي أقل مبلغ من المال بيننا جميعًا.

definitionEn: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
example: That's the least I can do.
exampleAr: هذا أقل ما يمكنني فعله.

definitionEn: on or to the left side
example: Turn left at the next corner.
exampleAr: انعطف يسارًا عند الزاوية القادمة.

definitionEn: to a smaller degree; not so much
example: This problem is less serious than I thought.
exampleAr: هذه المشكلة أقل خطورة مما كنت أعتقد.

definitionEn: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a smaller amount of’
example: I earn less than my sister.
exampleAr: أكسب أقل من أختي.

definitionEn: a person who understands and respects other people’s opinions and behaviour, especially when they are different from their own
example: He has always identified as a liberal.
exampleAr: لطالما اعتبر نفسه ليبراليًا.

definitionEn: over a long period of time
example: It's better to invest long-term rather than chase quick profits.
exampleAr: من الأفضل الاستثمار على المدى الطويل بدلاً من السعي وراء أرباح سريعة.

definitionEn: used with verbs to mean ‘a great amount’
example: I enjoyed the movie a lot.
exampleAr: استمتعت بالفيلم كثيرًا.

definitionEn: a large number or amount of somebody/something
example: A lot of people came to the event.
exampleAr: حضر عدد كبير من الناس الفعالية.

definitionEn: a large number or amount
example: A lot has changed since then.
exampleAr: تغير الكثير منذ ذلك الحين.

definitionEn: in a way that makes a lot of noise or can be easily heard
example: Don't laugh so loud, people are sleeping.
exampleAr: لا تضحك بصوت عالٍ هكذا، الناس نائمون.

definitionEn: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: Many believe the plan will fail.
exampleAr: يعتقد كثيرون أن الخطة ستفشل.

definitionEn: to have sex in order to produce young
example: Many bird species mate for life.
exampleAr: تتزاوج أنواع كثيرة من الطيور مدى الحياة.

definitionEn: used to form the comparative of most adjectives and adverbs with two or more syllables
example: This exam was more difficult than the last one.
exampleAr: كان هذا الامتحان أصعب من السابق.

definitionEn: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: Do you need more?
exampleAr: هل تحتاج إلى المزيد؟

definitionEn: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: Most of them agreed with the plan.
exampleAr: معظمهم وافقوا على الخطة.

definitionEn: having an engine; using the power of an engine
example: He works in the motor industry.
exampleAr: يعمل في صناعة السيارات.

definitionEn: used with plural nouns and verbs, especially in negative sentences or in more formal English, to mean ‘a large number of’. Also used in questions to ask about the size of a number, and with ‘as’, ‘so’ and ‘too’.
example: There isn't much left.
exampleAr: لم يتبقَّ الكثير.

definitionEn: describing events or telling a story
example: The book is written in a narrative style.
exampleAr: الكتاب مكتوب بأسلوب سردي.

definitionEn: at a short distance away
example: As the deadline drew near, everyone worked faster.
exampleAr: مع اقتراب الموعد النهائي، عمل الجميع بسرعة أكبر.

definitionEn: and not
example: She didn't call, nor did she text.
exampleAr: لم تتصل، ولم ترسل رسالة أيضًا.

definitionEn: in or towards the north
example: A cold north wind was blowing.
exampleAr: كانت تهب ريح شمالية باردة.

definitionEn: towards the north
example: The birds fly north in the spring.
exampleAr: تطير الطيور نحو الشمال في الربيع.

definitionEn: the job or skill of caring for people who are sick or injured
example: Her grandmother lives in a nursing home.
exampleAr: تعيش جدتها في دار للرعاية التمريضية.

definitionEn: safe and well; in a calm or happy state
example: She did OK in the exam, not great but OK.
exampleAr: أدت بشكل مقبول في الامتحان، ليس رائعًا لكن لا بأس.

definitionEn: on the other side of a particular area from somebody/something and usually facing them
example: He sat opposite during the meeting.
exampleAr: جلس في المقابل أثناء الاجتماع.

definitionEn: for part of the day or week in which people work
example: She works part-time while studying.
exampleAr: تعمل بدوام جزئي أثناء الدراسة.

definitionEn: the colour that is produced when you mix red and white together
example: Pink is her favourite colour.
exampleAr: الوردي هو لونها المفضل.

definitionEn: the colour of blue and red mixed together
example: She painted the wall purple.
exampleAr: طلت الجدار باللون البنفسجي.

definitionEn: living in a particular place
example: He works as a resident doctor at the hospital.
exampleAr: يعمل طبيبًا مقيمًا في المستشفى.

definitionEn: made of rubber
example: Wear rubber gloves when you clean with bleach.
exampleAr: ارتدِ قفازات مطاطية عند التنظيف بالمبيّض.

definitionEn: in the same way
example: The teacher treats all students the same.
exampleAr: يعامل المعلم جميع الطلاب بنفس الطريقة.

definitionEn: the same thing or things
example: I'll have the same, please.
exampleAr: سآخذ نفس الشيء، من فضلك.

definitionEn: more than two but not very many
example: I sent many emails, but only several were answered.
exampleAr: أرسلت رسائل كثيرة، لكن رُدّ على عدة منها فقط.

definitionEn: a ticket that allows you to travel to a place but not back again
example: The band released their new single yesterday.
exampleAr: أصدرت الفرقة أغنيتها المنفردة الجديدة أمس.

definitionEn: connected with the sport of skiing
example: We stayed at a ski resort in the Alps.
exampleAr: أقمنا في منتجع للتزلج في جبال الألب.

definitionEn: one of a pair of long narrow pieces of wood, metal or plastic that you attach to boots so that you can move smoothly over snow
example: One of my skis broke on the slope.
exampleAr: انكسرت إحدى زلاجاتي على المنحدر.

definitionEn: to be at an angle so that it is higher at one end than the other
example: The garden slopes gently down to the river.
exampleAr: تنحدر الحديقة بلطف نحو النهر.

definitionEn: a substance or an object that is solid, not a liquid or a gas
example: Water becomes a solid when it freezes.
exampleAr: يتحول الماء إلى مادة صلبة عند تجمّده.

definitionEn: a piece of music, dance or entertainment performed by only one person
example: The guitarist played an amazing solo.
exampleAr: عزف عازف الجيتار مقطوعة منفردة رائعة.

definitionEn: used to refer to an amount of something or a number of people or things when the amount or number is not given
example: I made some coffee — would you like some?
exampleAr: أعددت بعض القهوة، هل تريد بعضًا منها؟

definitionEn: a place that you do not know or do not mention by name
example: Somewhere in the city, someone was celebrating.
exampleAr: في مكان ما بالمدينة، كان أحدهم يحتفل.

definitionEn: used when you are apologizing for something
example: Sorry! I didn't see you there.
exampleAr: آسف! لم أرك هناك.

definitionEn: in or towards the south
example: They flew to the south coast for the weekend.
exampleAr: سافروا جوًا إلى الساحل الجنوبي لقضاء عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

definitionEn: towards the south
example: The road heads south towards the border.
exampleAr: يتجه الطريق جنوبًا نحو الحدود.

definitionEn: having or involving expert knowledge of a particular area of work, study or medicine
example: You should ask a specialist shop for spare parts.
exampleAr: يجب أن تسأل متجرًا متخصصًا عن قطع الغيار.

definitionEn: used to emphasize the great degree of something
example: He's not a doctor as such, but he has medical training.
exampleAr: هو ليس طبيبًا بهذا المعنى تحديدًا، لكن لديه تدريبًا طبيًا.

definitionEn: an amount of money
example: To sum up, the project was a success.
exampleAr: باختصار، كان المشروع ناجحًا.

definitionEn: a small piece of sweet food, usually made with sugar and/or chocolate and eaten between meals
example: The children were given a sweet after dinner.
exampleAr: أُعطي الأطفال قطعة حلوى بعد العشاء.

definitionEn: to speak to somebody by phone
example: Please telephone me as soon as you arrive.
exampleAr: يرجى الاتصال بي فور وصولك.

definitionEn: words or actions that show that you are grateful to somebody for something
example: They gave thanks for the food before eating.
exampleAr: قدموا الشكر على الطعام قبل الأكل.

definitionEn: from one end or side of something to the other
example: She read the whole report through before signing it.
exampleAr: قرأت التقرير بأكمله قبل التوقيع عليه.

definitionEn: in or into every part of something
example: The house was newly painted throughout.
exampleAr: كان المنزل مطليًا حديثًا بالكامل.

definitionEn: used to show purpose or intention
example: I want to learn English.
exampleAr: أريد أن أتعلم الإنجليزية.

definitionEn: the evening or night of today
example: Tonight will be a night to remember.
exampleAr: ستكون الليلة ليلة لا تُنسى.

definitionEn: made as a copy of a particular thing and used for playing with
example: She has a toy poodle as a pet.
exampleAr: لديها كلب بودل صغير الحجم كحيوان أليف.

definitionEn: used to describe one of a pair of children who are twins
example: The hotel room had twin beds.
exampleAr: كانت غرفة الفندق تحتوي على سريرين توأم.

definitionEn: below something
example: This ride is for children aged ten and under.
exampleAr: هذه اللعبة مخصصة للأطفال الذين تبلغ أعمارهم عشر سنوات فأقل.

definitionEn: under the surface of the ground
example: Moles spend most of their lives underground.
exampleAr: تقضي الخُلد معظم حياتها تحت الأرض.

definitionEn: to or in a higher position somewhere
example: They walked up the hill to the old castle.
exampleAr: صعدوا التل سيرًا على الأقدام نحو القلعة القديمة.

definitionEn: used to say that something happened continuously or frequently during a period in the past
example: I used to live in Alexandria before moving here.
exampleAr: كنت أعيش في الإسكندرية قبل الانتقال إلى هنا.

definitionEn: no longer needed for a particular process and therefore thrown away
example: The factory produces a lot of waste material.
exampleAr: ينتج المصنع الكثير من المواد المهملة.

definitionEn: in or towards the west
example: They live in the west wing of the palace.
exampleAr: يعيشون في الجناح الغربي من القصر.

definitionEn: towards the west
example: The ship sailed west across the ocean.
exampleAr: أبحرت السفينة غربًا عبر المحيط.

definitionEn: any or every; anything or everything
example: Whatever reason he gives, I won't forgive him.
exampleAr: مهما كان السبب الذي يقدمه، لن أسامحه.

definitionEn: what/which time
example: Since when do you like spicy food?
exampleAr: منذ متى وأنت تحب الطعام الحار؟

definitionEn: (in) the place or situation in which
example: Leave the box where you found it.
exampleAr: اترك الصندوق حيث وجدته.

definitionEn: used in questions to ask somebody to be exact about one or more people or things from a limited number
example: Which book do you want to borrow?
exampleAr: أي كتاب تريد استعارته؟

definitionEn: the colour of fresh snow or of milk
example: She was dressed all in white.
exampleAr: كانت ترتدي اللون الأبيض بالكامل.

definitionEn: used in questions to ask who something belongs to
example: That's the boy whose bag was stolen.
exampleAr: هذا هو الولد الذي سُرقت حقيبته.

definitionEn: affecting all parts of the world
example: The product is sold worldwide.
exampleAr: يُباع المنتج على مستوى العالم.

definitionEn: the colour of lemons or butter
example: The walls were painted yellow.
exampleAr: طُليت الجدران باللون الأصفر.

definitionEn: the day before today
example: Yesterday's meeting was cancelled.
exampleAr: أُلغي اجتماع الأمس.

definitionEn: later in time; afterwards
example: They had dinner and went to the cinema after.
exampleAr: تناولوا العشاء وذهبوا إلى السينما بعد ذلك.

definitionEn: completely
example: She was all alone in the house.
exampleAr: كانت وحيدة تمامًا في المنزل.

definitionEn: the whole number or amount
example: All is well.
exampleAr: كل شيء بخير.

definitionEn: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb in negative sentences or questions, meaning ‘at all’
example: I can't walk any further.
exampleAr: لا أستطيع المشي أكثر من ذلك.

definitionEn: used in negative sentences and in questions and after if or whether to refer to an amount or a number, however large or small
example: Do you have any left?
exampleAr: هل تبقى لديك أي شيء؟

definitionEn: used when you are comparing two people or things, or two situations
example: He is as tall as his brother.
exampleAr: هو بنفس طول أخيه.

definitionEn: to be equal to a particular amount as an average
example: Sales average about 500 units a month.
exampleAr: تبلغ المبيعات في المتوسط حوالي 500 وحدة شهريًا.

definitionEn: something that is better
example: In the end, her curiosity got the better of her.
exampleAr: في النهاية، تغلب عليها فضولها.

definitionEn: in the space or period of time separating two or more points, objects, etc. or two dates, events, etc.
example: There were two houses with a garden between.
exampleAr: كان هناك منزلان بينهما حديقة.

definitionEn: to send somebody a bill for something
example: The hotel will bill you for any extra services.
exampleAr: سيرسل لك الفندق فاتورة بأي خدمات إضافية.

definitionEn: past
example: A car drove by without stopping.
exampleAr: مرت سيارة بجانبنا دون أن تتوقف.

definitionEn: to be the person or thing around which most activity takes place; to make somebody/something the central person or thing
example: The discussion centred on climate change.
exampleAr: تمحور النقاش حول تغير المناخ.

definitionEn: to act as the chairman or chairwoman of a meeting, discussion, etc.
example: She will chair tomorrow's meeting.
exampleAr: ستترأس اجتماع الغد.

definitionEn: to record or follow the progress or development of somebody/something
example: The report charts the company's growth over ten years.
exampleAr: يرصد التقرير نمو الشركة على مدى عشر سنوات.

definitionEn: for a low price
example: I got this jacket cheap at the market.
exampleAr: اشتريت هذا الجاكيت رخيصًا من السوق.

definitionEn: an act of climbing up a mountain, rock or large number of steps; a period of time spent climbing
example: It was a long, hard climb to the top of the mountain.
exampleAr: كان تسلقًا طويلاً وشاقًا إلى قمة الجبل.

definitionEn: the end of a period of time or an activity
example: The meeting came to a close at five o'clock.
exampleAr: انتهى الاجتماع في الساعة الخامسة.

definitionEn: used in expressions that show that you are surprised, upset, annoyed or worried
example: Oh dear, I think I've lost my keys.
exampleAr: يا إلهي، أظن أنني فقدت مفاتيحي.

definitionEn: without stopping or changing direction or vehicle
example: You can fly direct from Cairo to London.
exampleAr: يمكنك السفر مباشرة من القاهرة إلى لندن.

definitionEn: in twos or in two parts
example: He earns double what I do.
exampleAr: يكسب ضعف ما أكسبه.

definitionEn: twice as much or as many as
example: We need double the amount of flour for this recipe.
exampleAr: نحتاج ضعف كمية الدقيق لهذه الوصفة.

definitionEn: on a floor of a house or building lower than the one you are on, especially the one at ground level
example: We have a downstairs bathroom.
exampleAr: لدينا حمام في الطابق السفلي.

definitionEn: a person or thing of the same quality or with the same status, rights, etc. as another
example: She treats everyone as an equal.
exampleAr: تعامل الجميع كأنداد.

definitionEn: used before you mention something that makes a statement not completely true
example: I would go, except that I'm busy tonight.
exampleAr: كنت سأذهب، إلا أنني مشغول الليلة.

definitionEn: in addition; more than is usual, expected or exists already
example: Please be extra careful with this box.
exampleAr: الرجاء توخي حذر إضافي مع هذا الصندوق.

definitionEn: the feeling you get when you touch something or are touched
example: I love the feel of silk on my skin.
exampleAr: أحب ملمس الحرير على بشرتي.

definitionEn: a sudden attack of an illness, such as epilepsy, in which somebody becomes unconscious and their body may make violent movements
example: She burst into a fit of laughter.
exampleAr: انفجرت في نوبة من الضحك.

definitionEn: after or as a result of a particular event
example: Following the meeting, we had lunch together.
exampleAr: بعد الاجتماع، تناولنا الغداء معًا.

definitionEn: without payment
example: Children under five go in free.
exampleAr: يدخل الأطفال دون سن الخامسة مجانًا.

definitionEn: to the extent of half
example: The cake was only half baked.
exampleAr: كانت الكعكة نصف مخبوزة فقط.

definitionEn: connected with the place where you live
example: Nothing beats home cooking.
exampleAr: لا شيء يضاهي الطبخ المنزلي.

definitionEn: a feeling of unhappiness because somebody has been unkind or unfair to you
example: Years later, she still felt the hurt of his words.
exampleAr: بعد سنوات، ظلت تشعر بألم كلماته.

definitionEn: to put information into a computer using a keyboard
example: Please key in your password.
exampleAr: يرجى إدخال كلمة المرور.

definitionEn: after anyone or anything else; at the end
example: He finished last in the race.
exampleAr: أنهى السباق في المركز الأخير.

definitionEn: the person or thing that comes or happens after all other similar people or things
example: She was the last to arrive.
exampleAr: كانت آخر من وصل.

definitionEn: coming after something else or at a time in the future
example: We can arrange a later date if this doesn't work.
exampleAr: يمكننا ترتيب موعد لاحق إذا لم يناسبك هذا.

definitionEn: the most recent or the newest thing or piece of news
example: Have you heard the latest about the merger?
exampleAr: هل سمعت آخر أخبار الاندماج؟

definitionEn: to make something flat or smooth
example: The earthquake levelled the entire village.
exampleAr: دمّر الزلزال القرية بأكملها.

definitionEn: the things that you like
example: We may never see the likes of him again.
exampleAr: قد لا نرى مثله مرة أخرى.

definitionEn: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a small amount’, ‘some’
example: We have little time left.
exampleAr: لم يتبقَّ لدينا سوى وقت قليل.

definitionEn: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a small amount’, ‘some’
example: Little is known about his early life.
exampleAr: القليل معروف عن حياته المبكرة.

definitionEn: broadcast at the time of an actual event; played or recorded at an actual performance
example: The match was broadcast live around the world.
exampleAr: بُثت المباراة مباشرة حول العالم.

definitionEn: a citizen of a particular country
example: He is a British national living in Spain.
exampleAr: هو مواطن بريطاني يعيش في إسبانيا.

definitionEn: a word or statement that means ‘no’; an act of refusing to do something or of denying something
example: He answered in the negative.
exampleAr: أجاب بالنفي.

definitionEn: used to show that a negative statement is also true of somebody/something else
example: I don't smoke, and neither does my husband.
exampleAr: أنا لا أدخن، وكذلك زوجي.

meaningAr: لا هذا ولا ذاك (بدون اسم بعده)
definitionEn: not one nor the other of two things or people
example: Neither of the answers is correct.
exampleAr: لا هذه الإجابة ولا تلك صحيحة.

definitionEn: a person or thing that is next
example: One customer left, and the next came in.
exampleAr: غادر أحد الزبائن، ودخل التالي.

definitionEn: the usual or average state, level or standard
example: After the holidays, things went back to normal.
exampleAr: بعد العطلة، عادت الأمور إلى طبيعتها.

definitionEn: of, on or facing the outer side
example: We need outside help to fix this problem.
exampleAr: نحتاج مساعدة خارجية لحل هذه المشكلة.

definitionEn: used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with somebody
example: This isn't a rented car, it's my own.
exampleAr: هذه ليست سيارة مستأجرة، إنها ملكي الخاص.

definitionEn: from one side of something to the other
example: He walked past without noticing me.
exampleAr: مرّ بجانبي دون أن يلاحظني.

definitionEn: used after a number to show that the real number or amount is more than the one mentioned
example: Speaking two languages is a big plus for this job.
exampleAr: التحدث بلغتين ميزة كبيرة لهذه الوظيفة.

definitionEn: an advantage; a good thing
example: Free parking is definitely a plus.
exampleAr: موقف السيارات المجاني ميزة إضافية بالتأكيد.

definitionEn: to put somebody/something in a particular position
example: She positioned the camera to get a better shot.
exampleAr: وضعت الكاميرا للحصول على لقطة أفضل.

definitionEn: a good or useful quality or aspect
example: There were several positives to take from the game.
exampleAr: كانت هناك عدة إيجابيات يمكن استخلاصها من المباراة.

definitionEn: to give a computer, etc. a set of instructions to make it perform a particular task
example: He learned to program in Python last year.
exampleAr: تعلم البرمجة بلغة بايثون العام الماضي.

definitionEn: moving in a circle
example: Why don't you come round for dinner tonight?
exampleAr: لماذا لا تأتي إلى منزلنا لتناول العشاء الليلة؟

definitionEn: the right to influence something by giving your opinion before a decision is made
example: Employees should have a say in company decisions.
exampleAr: يجب أن يكون للموظفين رأي في قرارات الشركة.

definitionEn: to have one of the main parts in a film, play, etc.
example: She starred in several Hollywood films.
exampleAr: شاركت كنجمة بطولة في عدة أفلام هوليوودية.

definitionEn: provided or controlled by the government of a country
example: My children go to a state school.
exampleAr: يذهب أطفالي إلى مدرسة حكومية.

definitionEn: to fill a space or container tightly with something
example: We stuffed the turkey before roasting it.
exampleAr: حشونا الديك الرومي قبل شويه.

definitionEn: used to say ‘yes’ to somebody
example: Sure enough, it started raining the moment we left.
exampleAr: وبالفعل، بدأ المطر يهطل بمجرد أن غادرنا.

definitionEn: a period of time during which you swim
example: Let's go for a swim before breakfast.
exampleAr: لنذهب لنسبح قبل الفطور.

definitionEn: an act of trying to take the ball from an opponent in football (soccer), hockey, etc.; an act of knocking somebody to the ground, for example in rugby or American football
example: The defender made a strong tackle to win the ball.
exampleAr: قام المدافع بعرقلة قوية للفوز بالكرة.

definitionEn: to use a particular name or word to describe somebody/something
example: The event was later termed a disaster.
exampleAr: وُصف الحدث لاحقًا بأنه كارثة.

definitionEn: to such a degree; so
example: I didn't think it would be that difficult.
exampleAr: لم أظن أنه سيكون بهذه الصعوبة.

definitionEn: to this degree; so
example: I've never travelled this far from home before.
exampleAr: لم أسافر بهذا البعد عن المنزل من قبل.

definitionEn: to measure how long it takes for something to happen or for somebody to do something
example: He timed his run with a stopwatch.
exampleAr: وقّت جريه بساعة توقيت.

definitionEn: to give a book, piece of music, etc. a particular name
example: She titled her new novel 'The Silent House'.
exampleAr: عنونت روايتها الجديدة بـ 'البيت الصامت'.

definitionEn: to be higher than a particular amount
example: Her new album topped the charts.
exampleAr: تصدّر ألبومها الجديد قوائم الأغاني.

definitionEn: to reach a particular total
example: The cost of repairs totalled over $2000.
exampleAr: بلغت تكلفة الإصلاحات أكثر من 2000 دولار.

definitionEn: to catch your foot on something and fall or almost fall
example: He tripped over the wire and fell.
exampleAr: تعثّر بالسلك ووقع.

definitionEn: on a floor of a house or other building that is higher than the one that you are on
example: The upstairs bedroom has a lovely view.
exampleAr: غرفة النوم في الطابق العلوي تطل على منظر جميل.

definitionEn: used to emphasize that you are talking about a particular thing or person and not about another
example: This is the very book I was looking for.
exampleAr: هذا هو الكتاب نفسه الذي كنت أبحث عنه.

definitionEn: an act of waiting; an amount of time waited
example: We had a long wait at the airport.
exampleAr: كان لدينا انتظار طويل في المطار.

definitionEn: an act of cleaning somebody/something using water and usually soap
example: This shirt needs a wash.
exampleAr: هذا القميص يحتاج إلى غسيل.

definitionEn: very far; by a large amount
example: This car is way too expensive for us.
exampleAr: هذه السيارة باهظة الثمن جدًا بالنسبة لنا.

definitionEn: used as a greeting to tell somebody that you are pleased that they are there
example: Welcome to our home!
exampleAr: أهلاً وسهلاً بكم في منزلنا!

definitionEn: something that you do or say to somebody when they arrive, especially something that makes them feel you are happy to see them
example: They gave us a warm welcome.
exampleAr: قدّموا لنا ترحيبًا حارًا.

definitionEn: used to express surprise, anger or relief
example: Well, I suppose you're right.
exampleAr: حسنًا، أعتقد أنك محق.

definitionEn: all that there is of something
example: The team, as a whole, performed very well.
exampleAr: أدى الفريق ككل بشكل جيد جدًا.

definitionEn: less well
example: He played worse than usual in the final.
exampleAr: لعب بشكل أسوأ من المعتاد في النهائي.

definitionEn: more problems or bad news
example: The weather has taken a turn for the worse.
exampleAr: تحول الطقس نحو الأسوأ.

definitionEn: most badly or seriously
